// â”€â”€ Styles â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
const S_ATTEND = {
  card: {
    background: "#fff", border: "1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius: 14,
    padding: "18px 20px", boxShadow: "0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)",
  },
  btn: (color = "#1d4ed8", bg = "#eff6ff") => ({
    background: bg, color, border: "1.5px solid " + (color) + "30", borderRadius: 8,
    padding: "8px 18px", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer",
  }),
  btnSolid: (bg = "#1d4ed8") => ({
    background: bg, color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: 8,
    padding: "9px 20px", fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, cursor: "pointer",
  }),
  inp: {
    border: "1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius: 8, padding: "9px 14px",
    fontSize: 14, width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", outline: "none",
  },
  badge: (color = "#1d4ed8") => ({
    background: color + "18", color, borderRadius: 6,
    padding: "2px 10px", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, display: "inline-block",
  }),
};

function AttendanceModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const uid = user?.name || "unknown";

  const [records, setRecords] = useState([]);
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState([]);
  const [checkedIn, setCheckedIn] = useState(null);
  const [adminTab, setAdminTab] = useState("today");
  const [filterName, setFilterName] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const myRecs = (await moduleStoreGet("attendance:" + (uid))) || [];
    setRecords(myRecs);

    const active = await moduleStoreGet("attendance-active:" + (uid));
    setCheckedIn(active || null);

    // Compute attendance streak
    const days = new Set(myRecs.map(r => r.date));
    let s = 0; let d = new Date();
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-constant-condition
    while (true) {
      const key = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      if (days.has(key)) { s++; d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1); } else break;
    }
    setStreak(s);

    if (isAdmin) {
      const shared = (await moduleStoreGet("attendance-sessions", true)) || [];
      setSessions(shared.sort((a, b) => b.checkIn.localeCompare(a.checkIn)));
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, [uid, isAdmin]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const handleCheckIn = async () => {
    const ts = new Date().toISOString();
    await moduleStoreSet("attendance-active:" + (uid), ts);
    setCheckedIn(ts);
  };

  const handleCheckOut = async () => {
    if (!checkedIn) return;
    const rec = {
      uid, name: user.name, date: todayStr(),
      checkIn: checkedIn, checkOut: new Date().toISOString(),
      duration: Math.round((Date.now() - new Date(checkedIn)) / 60000),
    };
    const myRecs = [...records, rec];
    await moduleStoreSet("attendance:" + (uid), myRecs);
    await moduleStoreSet("attendance-active:" + (uid), null);
    const shared = (await moduleStoreGet("attendance-sessions", true)) || [];
    await moduleStoreSet("attendance-sessions", [...shared, rec], true);
    setCheckedIn(null);
    setRecords(myRecs);
    load();
  };

  const totalMins = records.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.duration || 0), 0);

  const memberStats = {};
  sessions.forEach(r => {
    if (!memberStats[r.uid]) memberStats[r.uid] = { name: r.name, sessions: 0, mins: 0 };
    memberStats[r.uid].sessions++;
    memberStats[r.uid].mins += r.duration || 0;
  });

  const filteredSessions = sessions.filter(r =>
    !filterName || r.name?.toLowerCase().includes(filterName.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) return <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: 60, color: "#9ca3af" }}>Loading attendanceâ€¦</div>;

  // â”€â”€ Student View â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const StudentView = () => (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16 }}>
      {/* Check-in card */}
      <div style={{
        ...S_ATTEND.card, background: checkedIn ? "#f0fdf4" : "#fff",
        border: checkedIn ? "2px solid #16a34a" : "1px solid #e2e8f0",
      }}>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
          <div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 18 }}>
              {checkedIn ? "âœ… You're checked in!" : "ðŸ‘‹ Not checked in"}
            </div>
            {checkedIn && (
              <div style={{ color: "#16a34a", fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4 }}>
                Since {fmtTime(checkedIn)} Â· {Math.round((Date.now() - new Date(checkedIn)) / 60000)} min so far
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {checkedIn
            ? <button style={S_ATTEND.btnSolid("#dc2626")} onClick={handleCheckOut}>ðŸšª Check Out</button>
            : <button style={S_ATTEND.btnSolid("#16a34a")} onClick={handleCheckIn}>âœ… Check In</button>
          }
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stats row */}
      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(3,1fr)", gap: 14 }}>
        {[
          { label: "Total Sessions", value: records.length, icon: "ðŸ“‹", color: "#1d4ed8" },
          { label: "Total Time", value: (Math.floor(totalMins / 60)) + "h " + (totalMins % 60) + "m", icon: "â±ï¸", color: "#7c3aed" },
          { label: "Attendance Streak", value: "ðŸ”¥ " + (streak) + " day" + (streak !== 1 ? "s" : ""), icon: "", color: "#ea580c" },
        ].map(stat => (
          <div key={stat.label} style={{ ...S_ATTEND.card, textAlign: "center" }}>
            {stat.icon && <div style={{ fontSize: 26, marginBottom: 4 }}>{stat.icon}</div>}
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 20, color: stat.color }}>{stat.value}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#9ca3af", marginTop: 2 }}>{stat.label}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Week view */}
      <div style={S_ATTEND.card}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, marginBottom: 12 }}>ðŸ“… This Week</div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
          {["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"].map((day, i) => {
            const d = new Date();
            d.setDate(d.getDate() - ((d.getDay() + 6) % 7) + i);
            const key = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
            const attended = records.some(r => r.date === key);
            const isPast = d <= new Date();
            return (
              <div key={day} style={{
                flex: 1, textAlign: "center", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 4px",
                background: attended ? "#dcfce7" : isPast ? "#f8fafc" : "#fff",
                border: "1.5px solid " + (attended ? "#16a34a" : "#e2e8f0"),
              }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: "#9ca3af", marginBottom: 4 }}>{day}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>{attended ? "âœ…" : isPast ? "â—‹" : "Â·"}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* History */}
      <div style={S_ATTEND.card}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15, marginBottom: 14 }}>ðŸ“œ Session History</div>
        {records.length === 0 && (
          <div style={{ color: "#9ca3af", textAlign: "center", padding: 20 }}>
            No sessions yet â€” check in to start tracking!
          </div>
        )}
        {[...records].reverse().slice(0, 30).map((r, i) => (
          <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", padding: "10px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid #f1f5f9" }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14 }}>{fmtDate(r.date)}</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#9ca3af" }}>
                {fmtTime(r.checkIn)} â†’ {r.checkOut ? fmtTime(r.checkOut) : "â€”"}
              </div>
            </div>
            <span style={S_ATTEND.badge("#16a34a")}>{r.duration ?? "?"} min</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  // â”€â”€ Admin View â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const AdminView = () => (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 16 }}>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
        {[["today","ðŸ“… Today"],["all","ðŸ“‹ All Sessions"],["stats","ðŸ“Š Member Stats"]].map(([t, label]) => (
          <button key={t} onClick={() => setAdminTab(t)}
            style={adminTab === t ? S_ATTEND.btnSolid() : S_ATTEND.btn()}>
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {adminTab === "today" && (
        <div style={S_ATTEND.card}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 14 }}>
            Today â€” {fmtDate(todayStr())}
          </div>
          {sessions.filter(r => r.date === todayStr()).length === 0
            ? <div style={{ color: "#9ca3af", textAlign: "center", padding: 24 }}>No check-ins today yet.</div>
            : sessions.filter(r => r.date === todayStr()).map((r, i) => (
              <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", padding: "10px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid #f1f5f9" }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{r.name}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#6b7280" }}>
                  {fmtTime(r.checkIn)} â†’ {r.checkOut ? fmtTime(r.checkOut) : <span style={{ color: "#16a34a", fontWeight: 700 }}>Currently in âœ…</span>}
                </div>
                <span style={S_ATTEND.badge("#7c3aed")}>{r.duration ?? "?"} min</span>
              </div>
            ))
          }
        </div>
      )}

      {adminTab === "all" && (
        <div style={S_ATTEND.card}>
          <input style={{ ...S_ATTEND.inp, marginBottom: 14 }} placeholder="ðŸ” Filter by nameâ€¦"
            value={filterName} onChange={e => setFilterName(e.target.value)} />
          {filteredSessions.slice(0, 50).map((r, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", padding: "9px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid #f1f5f9" }}>
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14 }}>{r.name}</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#9ca3af" }}>
                  {fmtDate(r.date)} Â· {fmtTime(r.checkIn)} â†’ {r.checkOut ? fmtTime(r.checkOut) : "â€”"}
                </div>
              </div>
              <span style={S_ATTEND.badge()}>{r.duration ?? "?"} min</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {adminTab === "stats" && (
        <div style={S_ATTEND.card}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 16, marginBottom: 14 }}>Member Stats</div>
          {Object.values(memberStats).sort((a, b) => b.sessions - a.sessions).map((m, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", padding: "10px 0", borderBottom: "1px solid #f1f5f9" }}>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{m.name}</div>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 8 }}>
                <span style={S_ATTEND.badge("#1d4ed8")}>{m.sessions} sessions</span>
                <span style={S_ATTEND.badge("#7c3aed")}>{Math.floor(m.mins / 60)}h {m.mins % 60}m</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 24, marginBottom: 20 }}>ðŸ—“ï¸ Attendance</div>
      {isAdmin ? <AdminView /> : <StudentView />}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ SCOUTINGMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *


const fmt = (iso) => new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric" });

const S_SCOUTI = {
  card: { background:"#fff", border:"1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:14, padding:"18px 20px", boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn: (color="#1d4ed8", bg="#eff6ff") => ({ background:bg, color, border:"1.5px solid " + (color) + "30", borderRadius:8, padding:"8px 18px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnSolid: (bg="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:bg, color:"#fff", border:"none", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 20px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp: { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", outline:"none" },
  sel: { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", background:"#fff" },
  label: { fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, color:"#374151", marginBottom:4, display:"block" },
  badge: (c="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:c+"18", color:c, borderRadius:6, padding:"2px 10px", fontSize:12, fontWeight:700, display:"inline-block" }),
  row: { display:"flex", gap:12, alignItems:"flex-start" },
};

// Default match scouting fields â€” easily expanded
const MATCH_FIELDS = [
  { id:"team", label:"Team #", type:"number", placeholder:"e.g. 12345" },
  { id:"match", label:"Match #", type:"number", placeholder:"e.g. 5" },
  { id:"alliance", label:"Alliance", type:"select", options:["Red","Blue"] },
  { id:"autoScore", label:"Auto Score", type:"number", placeholder:"pts" },
  { id:"teleScore", label:"Teleop Score", type:"number", placeholder:"pts" },
  { id:"endgame", label:"Endgame", type:"select", options:["None","Parked","Partial Hang","Full Hang","High Hang"] },
  { id:"defense", label:"Defense Played?", type:"select", options:["No","Light","Heavy"] },
  { id:"fouls", label:"Fouls Committed", type:"number", placeholder:"0" },
  { id:"notes", label:"Notes", type:"textarea", placeholder:"Observations, breakdowns, strategyâ€¦" },
];

const PIT_FIELDS = [
  { id:"team", label:"Team #", type:"number", placeholder:"e.g. 12345" },
  { id:"driveType", label:"Drivetrain", type:"select", options:["Tank","Mecanum","Swerve","Holonomic","Other"] },
  { id:"autoCapability", label:"Auto Capability", type:"select", options:["None","Simple","Full Field","Multi-Piece"] },
  { id:"endgameCapability", label:"Endgame Capability", type:"select", options:["None","Park","Hang","High Hang"] },
  { id:"programming", label:"Programming Language", type:"select", options:["Java","Kotlin","Blocks","Python","Other"] },
  { id:"strengths", label:"Robot Strengths", type:"textarea", placeholder:"Fast cycle, reliable autoâ€¦" },
  { id:"weaknesses", label:"Weaknesses", type:"textarea", placeholder:"Defense susceptible, limited rangeâ€¦" },
  { id:"notes", label:"Additional Notes", type:"textarea", placeholder:"Anything else noteworthyâ€¦" },
];

function ScoutForm({ fields, onSave, saved }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState({});
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);

  const set = (id, val) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [id]: val }));

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.team) return alert("Team # is required.");
    await onSave({ ...form, ts: new Date().toISOString() });
    setForm({});
    setSubmitted(true);
    setTimeout(() => setSubmitted(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display:"flex", flexDirection:"column", gap:14 }}>
      {submitted && (
        <div style={{ background:"#dcfce7", border:"1px solid #16a34a", borderRadius:8, padding:"10px 16px", color:"#15803d", fontWeight:700 }}>
          âœ… Scouting data saved!
        </div>
      )}
      {fields.map(f => (
        <div key={f.id}>
          <label style={S_SCOUTI.label}>{f.label}</label>
          {f.type === "select" ? (
            <select style={S_SCOUTI.sel} value={form[f.id] || ""} onChange={e => set(f.id, e.target.value)}>
              <option value="">â€” select â€”</option>
              {f.options.map(o => <option key={o} value={o}>{o}</option>)}
            </select>
          ) : f.type === "textarea" ? (
            <textarea style={{ ...S_SCOUTI.inp, minHeight:70, resize:"vertical" }}
              placeholder={f.placeholder} value={form[f.id] || ""}
              onChange={e => set(f.id, e.target.value)} />
          ) : (
            <input style={S_SCOUTI.inp} type={f.type || "text"} placeholder={f.placeholder}
              value={form[f.id] || ""} onChange={e => set(f.id, e.target.value)} />
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
      <button style={S_SCOUTI.btnSolid("#1d4ed8")} onClick={handleSave}>ðŸ’¾ Save Entry</button>
      {saved.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{ marginTop:8, color:"#6b7280", fontSize:13 }}>
          {saved.length} entr{saved.length === 1 ? "y" : "ies"} saved this session.
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ScoutingModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("match");
  const [matchData, setMatchData] = useState([]);
  const [pitData, setPitData] = useState([]);
  const [compareA, setCompareA] = useState("");
  const [compareB, setCompareB] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const md = (await moduleStoreGet("scouting-match", true)) || [];
    const pd = (await moduleStoreGet("scouting-pit", true)) || [];
    setMatchData(md);
    setPitData(pd);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const saveMatch = async (entry) => {
    const updated = [...matchData, { ...entry, scoutedBy: user.name }];
    await moduleStoreSet("scouting-match", updated, true);
    setMatchData(updated);
  };

  const savePit = async (entry) => {
    const updated = [...pitData, { ...entry, scoutedBy: user.name }];
    await moduleStoreSet("scouting-pit", updated, true);
    setPitData(updated);
  };

  // Team aggregated stats
  const getTeamStats = (teamNum) => {
    const entries = matchData.filter(e => String(e.team) === String(teamNum));
    if (!entries.length) return null;
    const avg = (field) => {
      const vals = entries.map(e => Number(e[field])).filter(v => !isNaN(v));
      return vals.length ? (vals.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / vals.length).toFixed(1) : "â€”";
    };
    return {
      count: entries.length,
      avgAuto: avg("autoScore"),
      avgTele: avg("teleScore"),
      entries,
    };
  };

  const allTeams = [...new Set(matchData.map(e => e.team))].sort((a,b) => a-b);

  if (loading) return <div style={{ textAlign:"center", padding:60, color:"#9ca3af" }}>Loading scouting dataâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ fontWeight:900, fontSize:24, marginBottom:20 }}>ðŸŽ¯ Scouting</div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{ display:"flex", gap:8, marginBottom:20, flexWrap:"wrap" }}>
        {[["match","ðŸ“‹ Match Scout"],["pit","ðŸ”§ Pit Scout"],["data","ðŸ“Š Team Data"],["compare","âš–ï¸ Compare"]].map(([t,label]) => (
          <button key={t} onClick={() => setTab(t)}
            style={tab===t ? S_SCOUTI.btnSolid("#1d4ed8") : S_SCOUTI.btn()}>
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Match Scouting Form */}
      {tab === "match" && (
        <div style={S_SCOUTI.card}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight:800, fontSize:16, marginBottom:18 }}>ðŸ“‹ Match Scouting Form</div>
          <ScoutForm fields={MATCH_FIELDS} onSave={saveMatch} saved={matchData.filter(e => e.scoutedBy === user.name)} />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pit Scouting Form */}
      {tab === "pit" && (
        <div style={S_SCOUTI.card}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight:800, fontSize:16, marginBottom:18 }}>ðŸ”§ Pit Scouting Form</div>
          <ScoutForm fields={PIT_FIELDS} onSave={savePit} saved={pitData.filter(e => e.scoutedBy === user.name)} />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Team Data */}
      {tab === "data" && (
        <div style={{ display:"flex", flexDirection:"column", gap:14 }}>
          <div style={{ color:"#6b7280", fontSize:13 }}>
            {matchData.length} match entries Â· {pitData.length} pit entries Â· {allTeams.length} teams scouted
          </div>
          {allTeams.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{ ...S_SCOUTI.card, textAlign:"center", padding:40, color:"#9ca3af" }}>
              No scouting data yet â€” submit forms to see team stats here.
            </div>
          )}
          {allTeams.map(teamNum => {
            const stats = getTeamStats(teamNum);
            const pit = pitData.find(p => String(p.team) === String(teamNum));
            return (
              <div key={teamNum} style={S_SCOUTI.card}>
                <div style={{ display:"flex", justifyContent:"space-between", alignItems:"flex-start", marginBottom:10 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight:900, fontSize:18 }}>Team #{teamNum}</div>
                  <span style={S_SCOUTI.badge()}>{stats.count} match{stats.count !== 1 ? "es" : ""}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{ display:"grid", gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(3,1fr)", gap:10, marginBottom:10 }}>
                  {[
                    { label:"Avg Auto", value:stats.avgAuto, color:"#7c3aed" },
                    { label:"Avg Teleop", value:stats.avgTele, color:"#1d4ed8" },
                    { label:"Drivetrain", value:pit?.driveType || "â€”", color:"#059669" },
                  ].map(s => (
                    <div key={s.label} style={{ background:"#f8fafc", borderRadius:8, padding:"10px 12px" }}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize:11, color:"#9ca3af" }}>{s.label}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontWeight:800, color:s.color, fontSize:16 }}>{s.value}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {pit && (
                  <div style={{ fontSize:13, color:"#6b7280" }}>
                    <b>Endgame:</b> {pit.endgameCapability} Â· <b>Auto:</b> {pit.autoCapability}
                    {pit.strengths && <span> Â· <b>Strengths:</b> {pit.strengths}</span>}
                  </div>
                )}
                {/* Mini match log */}
                <div style={{ marginTop:10 }}>
                  {stats.entries.slice(-3).reverse().map((e, i) => (
                    <div key={i} style={{ fontSize:12, color:"#9ca3af", borderTop:"1px solid #f1f5f9", paddingTop:6, marginTop:6 }}>
                      M{e.match} Â· Auto:{e.autoScore || 0} Tele:{e.teleScore || 0} Â· {e.endgame || "â€”"} Â· {e.notes || ""}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Compare */}
      {tab === "compare" && (
        <div style={{ display:"flex", flexDirection:"column", gap:14 }}>
          <div style={{ display:"grid", gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr", gap:12 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={S_SCOUTI.label}>Team A #</label>
              <input style={S_SCOUTI.inp} type="number" placeholder="e.g. 12345"
                value={compareA} onChange={e => setCompareA(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={S_SCOUTI.label}>Team B #</label>
              <input style={S_SCOUTI.inp} type="number" placeholder="e.g. 67890"
                value={compareB} onChange={e => setCompareB(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
          </div>

          {compareA && compareB && (() => {
            const sA = getTeamStats(compareA);
            const sB = getTeamStats(compareB);
            if (!sA && !sB) return <div style={{ ...S_SCOUTI.card, textAlign:"center", color:"#9ca3af" }}>No data for either team.</div>;

            const rows = [
              { label:"Matches Scouted", a:sA?.count ?? "â€”", b:sB?.count ?? "â€”" },
              { label:"Avg Auto Score", a:sA?.avgAuto ?? "â€”", b:sB?.avgAuto ?? "â€”" },
              { label:"Avg Teleop Score", a:sA?.avgTele ?? "â€”", b:sB?.avgTele ?? "â€”" },
            ];
            return (
              <div style={S_SCOUTI.card}>
                <div style={{ display:"grid", gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr", gap:0 }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, color:"#9ca3af", padding:"8px 0" }}></div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight:900, fontSize:16, color:"#1d4ed8", padding:"8px 0", textAlign:"center" }}>#{compareA}</div>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight:900, fontSize:16, color:"#dc2626", padding:"8px 0", textAlign:"center" }}>#{compareB}</div>
                  {rows.map(r => (
                    <React.Fragment key={r.label}>
                      <div style={{ fontSize:13, color:"#6b7280", padding:"10px 0", borderTop:"1px solid #f1f5f9" }}>{r.label}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize:15, fontWeight:700, textAlign:"center", padding:"10px 0", borderTop:"1px solid #f1f5f9", color:"#1d4ed8" }}>{r.a}</div>
                      <div style={{ fontSize:15, fontWeight:700, textAlign:"center", padding:"10px 0", borderTop:"1px solid #f1f5f9", color:"#dc2626" }}>{r.b}</div>
                    </React.Fragment>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ BOMMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *


const STATUSES = ["Needed","Requested","Ordered","Arrived","Installed"];
const STATUS_COLORS = {
  Needed:    { bg:"#fef2f2", border:"#dc2626", text:"#dc2626" },
  Requested: { bg:"#fff7ed", border:"#ea580c", text:"#ea580c" },
  Ordered:   { bg:"#fffbeb", border:"#d97706", text:"#d97706" },
  Arrived:   { bg:"#f0fdf4", border:"#16a34a", text:"#16a34a" },
  Installed: { bg:"#eff6ff", border:"#1d4ed8", text:"#1d4ed8" },
};
const SUBTEAMS = ["Mechanical","Electrical","Programming","Business","General"];

const S_BOM = {
  card: { background:"#fff", border:"1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:14, padding:"18px 20px", boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn: (color="#1d4ed8", bg="#eff6ff") => ({ background:bg, color, border:"1.5px solid " + (color) + "30", borderRadius:8, padding:"8px 18px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnSolid: (bg="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:bg, color:"#fff", border:"none", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 20px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp: { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", outline:"none" },
  sel: { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", background:"#fff" },
  label: { fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, color:"#374151", marginBottom:4, display:"block" },
};

const EMPTY_FORM = { name:"", partNum:"", qty:"1", vendor:"", price:"", subteam:"Mechanical", status:"Needed", url:"", notes:"" };

function BOMModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [parts, setParts] = useState([]);
  const [view, setView] = useState("pipeline"); // "pipeline" | "list" | "add"
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [filterSub, setFilterSub] = useState("All");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const data = (await moduleStoreGet("bom-parts", true)) || [];
    setParts(data);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const save = async () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) return alert("Part name is required.");
    let updated;
    if (editId) {
      updated = parts.map(p => p.id === editId ? { ...form, id:editId, updatedBy:user.name, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString() } : p);
    } else {
      const newPart = { ...form, id: Date.now().toString(), addedBy:user.name, addedAt:new Date().toISOString() };
      updated = [...parts, newPart];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("bom-parts", updated, true);
    setParts(updated);
    setForm(EMPTY_FORM);
    setEditId(null);
    setView("pipeline");
  };

  const updateStatus = async (id, status) => {
    const updated = parts.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, status, updatedBy:user.name, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString() } : p);
    await moduleStoreSet("bom-parts", updated, true);
    setParts(updated);
  };

  const deletePart = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Delete this part?")) return;
    const updated = parts.filter(p => p.id !== id);
    await moduleStoreSet("bom-parts", updated, true);
    setParts(updated);
  };

  const startEdit = (part) => {
    setForm({ name:part.name, partNum:part.partNum||"", qty:part.qty||"1", vendor:part.vendor||"", price:part.price||"", subteam:part.subteam||"Mechanical", status:part.status||"Needed", url:part.url||"", notes:part.notes||"" });
    setEditId(part.id);
    setView("add");
  };

  const filtered = parts.filter(p =>
    (filterSub === "All" || p.subteam === filterSub) &&
    (!search || p.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || (p.partNum||"").toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  );

  const totalCost = parts.reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.price) * Number(p.qty) || 0), 0);
  const arrivedCost = parts.filter(p => ["Arrived","Installed"].includes(p.status)).reduce((s, p) => s + (Number(p.price) * Number(p.qty) || 0), 0);

  if (loading) return <div style={{ textAlign:"center", padding:60, color:"#9ca3af" }}>Loading BOMâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display:"flex", justifyContent:"space-between", alignItems:"center", marginBottom:20 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight:900, fontSize:24 }}>ðŸ”© Bill of Materials</div>
        {(isAdmin || true) && (
          <button style={S_BOM.btnSolid()} onClick={() => { setForm(EMPTY_FORM); setEditId(null); setView("add"); }}>
            + Add Part
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Summary stats */}
      <div style={{ display:"grid", gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(4,1fr)", gap:12, marginBottom:20 }}>
        {[
          { label:"Total Parts", value:parts.length, color:"#374151" },
          { label:"Est. Budget", value:"$" + (totalCost.toFixed(2)), color:"#1d4ed8" },
          { label:"Spent/Arrived", value:"$" + (arrivedCost.toFixed(2)), color:"#16a34a" },
          { label:"Still Needed", value:parts.filter(p=>p.status==="Needed").length, color:"#dc2626" },
        ].map(s => (
          <div key={s.label} style={{ ...S_BOM.card, textAlign:"center" }}>
            <div style={{ fontWeight:900, fontSize:20, color:s.color }}>{s.value}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize:12, color:"#9ca3af", marginTop:2 }}>{s.label}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{ display:"flex", gap:8, marginBottom:18 }}>
        {[["pipeline","ðŸ—‚ï¸ Pipeline"],["list","ðŸ“‹ List"]].map(([t,label]) => (
          <button key={t} onClick={() => setView(t)} style={view===t ? S_BOM.btnSolid() : S_BOM.btn()}>
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
        <div style={{ flex:1 }}></div>
        <select style={{ ...S_BOM.sel, width:160 }} value={filterSub} onChange={e => setFilterSub(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="All">All Subteams</option>
          {SUBTEAMS.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Add / Edit Form */}
      {view === "add" && (
        <div style={{ ...S_BOM.card, marginBottom:20 }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight:800, fontSize:16, marginBottom:18 }}>
            {editId ? "âœï¸ Edit Part" : "âž• Add Part"}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display:"grid", gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr", gap:14 }}>
            {[
              { key:"name", label:"Part Name*", type:"text", placeholder:"e.g. REV Through Bore Encoder" },
              { key:"partNum", label:"Part #", type:"text", placeholder:"e.g. REV-11-1271" },
              { key:"qty", label:"Quantity", type:"number", placeholder:"1" },
              { key:"vendor", label:"Vendor", type:"text", placeholder:"e.g. REV Robotics" },
              { key:"price", label:"Unit Price ($)", type:"number", placeholder:"0.00" },
              { key:"url", label:"Link / URL", type:"text", placeholder:"https://â€¦" },
            ].map(f => (
              <div key={f.key}>
                <label style={S_BOM.label}>{f.label}</label>
                <input style={S_BOM.inp} type={f.type} placeholder={f.placeholder}
                  value={form[f.key]} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, [f.key]:e.target.value }))} />
              </div>
            ))}
            <div>
              <label style={S_BOM.label}>Subteam</label>
              <select style={S_BOM.sel} value={form.subteam} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, subteam:e.target.value }))}>
                {SUBTEAMS.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={S_BOM.label}>Status</label>
              <select style={S_BOM.sel} value={form.status} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, status:e.target.value }))}>
                {STATUSES.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{ marginTop:14 }}>
            <label style={S_BOM.label}>Notes</label>
            <textarea style={{ ...S_BOM.inp, minHeight:60, resize:"vertical" }}
              placeholder="Why we need it, specs, alternativesâ€¦"
              value={form.notes} onChange={e => setForm(p => ({ ...p, notes:e.target.value }))} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ display:"flex", gap:10, marginTop:16 }}>
            <button style={S_BOM.btnSolid()} onClick={save}>ðŸ’¾ {editId ? "Update" : "Save Part"}</button>
            <button style={S_BOM.btn()} onClick={() => { setView("pipeline"); setEditId(null); setForm(EMPTY_FORM); }}>Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pipeline view */}
      {view === "pipeline" && (
        <div style={{ display:"grid", gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(5,1fr)", gap:12, overflowX:"auto" }}>
          {STATUSES.map(status => {
            const sc = STATUS_COLORS[status];
            const col = filtered.filter(p => p.status === status);
            return (
              <div key={status} style={{ minWidth:160 }}>
                <div style={{ background:sc.bg, border:"1.5px solid " + (sc.border) + "\", borderRadius:10, padding:\"8px 12px\", marginBottom:10, display:\"flex\", justifyContent:\"space-between\", alignItems:\"center\" }}>\n                  <span style={{ fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, color:sc.text }}>{status}</span>\n                  <span style={{ background:sc.border, color:\"#fff\", borderRadius:20, padding:\"1px 8px\", fontSize:11, fontWeight:700 }}>{col.length}</span>\n                </div>\n                <div style={{ display:\"flex\", flexDirection:\"column\", gap:8 }}>\n                  {col.map(part => (\n                    <div key={part.id} style={{ background:\"#fff\", border:\"1px solid #e2e8f0\", borderRadius:10, padding:\"10px 12px\", boxShadow:\"0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)\" }}>\n                      <div style={{ fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, marginBottom:4 }}>{part.name}</div>\n                      {part.partNum && <div style={{ fontSize:11, color:\"#9ca3af\" }}>{part.partNum}</div>}\n                      <div style={{ fontSize:12, color:\"#6b7280\", marginTop:4 }}>\n                        Qty: <b>{part.qty}</b>\n                        {part.price && <span> Â· \" + ((Number(part.price)*Number(part.qty)).toFixed(2)) + \"</span>}\n                      </div>\n                      <div style={{ fontSize:11, color:\"#9ca3af\", marginTop:2 }}>{part.subteam}</div>\n                      {part.url && (\n                        <a href={part.url} target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noreferrer\"\n                          style={{ fontSize:11, color:\"#1d4ed8\", display:\"block\", marginTop:4 }}>ðŸ”— Link</a>\n                      )}\n                      {/* Status advance buttons */}\n                      <div style={{ display:\"flex\", gap:4, marginTop:8, flexWrap:\"wrap\" }}>\n                        {status !== \"Installed\" && (\n                          <button style={{ background:\"#eff6ff\", color:\"#1d4ed8\", border:\"none\", borderRadius:5, padding:\"3px 8px\", fontSize:11, fontWeight:700, cursor:\"pointer\" }}\n                            onClick={() => updateStatus(part.id, STATUSES[STATUSES.indexOf(status)+1])}>\n                            â†’ {STATUSES[STATUSES.indexOf(status)+1]}\n                          </button>\n                        )}\n                        {isAdmin && (\n                          <>\n                            <button style={{ background:\"#fff7ed\", color:\"#ea580c\", border:\"none\", borderRadius:5, padding:\"3px 8px\", fontSize:11, fontWeight:700, cursor:\"pointer\" }}\n                              onClick={() => startEdit(part)}>âœï¸</button>\n                            <button style={{ background:\"#fef2f2\", color:\"#dc2626\", border:\"none\", borderRadius:5, padding:\"3px 8px\", fontSize:11, fontWeight:700, cursor:\"pointer\" }}\n                              onClick={() => deletePart(part.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>\n                          </>\n                        )}\n                      </div>\n                    </div>\n                  ))}\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            );\n          })}\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* List view */}\n      {view === \"list\" && (\n        <div style={S_BOM.card}>\n          <input style={{ ...S_BOM.inp, marginBottom:14 }} placeholder=\"ðŸ” Search partsâ€¦\"\n            value={search} onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)} />\n          {filtered.length === 0 && (\n            <div style={{ textAlign:\"center\", padding:30, color:\"#9ca3af\" }}>No parts found.</div>\n          )}\n          <div style={{ overflowX:\"auto\" }}>\n            <table style={{ width:\"100%\", borderCollapse:\"collapse\", fontSize:13 }}>\n              <thead>\n                <tr style={{ background:\"#f8fafc\" }}>\n                  {[\"Part Name\",\"Part #\",\"Qty\",\"Vendor\",\"Unit $\",\"Total $\",\"Subteam\",\"Status\",\"\"].map(h => (\n                    <th key={h} style={{ textAlign:\"left\", padding:\"8px 10px\", fontWeight:700, color:\"#374151\", whiteSpace:\"nowrap\" }}>{h}</th>\n                  ))}\n                </tr>\n              </thead>\n              <tbody>\n                {filtered.map(p => {\n                  const sc = STATUS_COLORS[p.status];\n                  return (\n                    <tr key={p.id} style={{ borderTop:\"1px solid #f1f5f9\" }}>\n                      <td style={{ padding:\"9px 10px\", fontWeight:600 }}>{p.name}</td>\n                      <td style={{ padding:\"9px 10px\", color:\"#9ca3af\" }}>{p.partNum || \"â€”\"}</td>\n                      <td style={{ padding:\"9px 10px\" }}>{p.qty}</td>\n                      <td style={{ padding:\"9px 10px\", color:\"#6b7280\" }}>{p.vendor || \"â€”\"}</td>\n                      <td style={{ padding:\"9px 10px\" }}>{p.price ? \"$" + (Number(p.price).toFixed(2)) : "â€”"}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding:"9px 10px", fontWeight:700 }}>{p.price ? "$" + ((Number(p.price)*Number(p.qty)).toFixed(2)) : "â€”"}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding:"9px 10px", color:"#7c3aed" }}>{p.subteam}</td>
                      <td style={{ padding:"9px 10px" }}>
                        <span style={{ background:sc.bg, color:sc.text, border:"1px solid " + (sc.border), borderRadius:6, padding:"2px 8px", fontSize:11, fontWeight:700 }}>
                          {p.status}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding:"9px 10px" }}>
                        <div style={{ display:"flex", gap:6 }}>
                          {p.status !== "Installed" && (
                            <button style={{ background:"#eff6ff", color:"#1d4ed8", border:"none", borderRadius:5, padding:"3px 8px", fontSize:11, cursor:"pointer", fontWeight:700 }}
                              onClick={() => updateStatus(p.id, STATUSES[STATUSES.indexOf(p.status)+1])}>
                              â†‘
                            </button>
                          )}
                          {isAdmin && (
                            <>
                              <button style={{ background:"#fff7ed", color:"#ea580c", border:"none", borderRadius:5, padding:"3px 8px", fontSize:11, cursor:"pointer" }}
                                onClick={() => startEdit(p)}>âœï¸</button>
                              <button style={{ background:"#fef2f2", color:"#dc2626", border:"none", borderRadius:5, padding:"3px 8px", fontSize:11, cursor:"pointer" }}
                                onClick={() => deletePart(p.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ FUNDRAISINGMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *



const SPONSOR_TIERS = ["Platinum","Gold","Silver","Bronze","In-Kind"];
const TIER_COLORS = { Platinum:"#0ea5e9", Gold:"#d97706", Silver:"#6b7280", Bronze:"#b45309", "In-Kind":"#059669" };
const GRANT_STATUSES = ["Researching","Applied","Pending","Awarded","Rejected"];
const EXPENSE_CATS = ["Registration","Parts","Tools","Travel","Outreach","Marketing","Misc"];

const S_FUNDRA = {
  card: { background:"#fff", border:"1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:14, padding:"18px 20px", boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn: (color="#1d4ed8", bg="#eff6ff") => ({ background:bg, color, border:"1.5px solid " + (color) + "30", borderRadius:8, padding:"8px 18px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnSolid: (bg="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:bg, color:"#fff", border:"none", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 20px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp: { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", outline:"none" },
  sel: { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", background:"#fff" },
  label: { fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, color:"#374151", marginBottom:4, display:"block" },
  badge: (c="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:c+"18", color:c, borderRadius:6, padding:"2px 10px", fontSize:12, fontWeight:700 }),
};

function Modal({ title, onClose, children }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ position:"fixed", inset:0, background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)", display:"flex", alignItems:"center", justifyContent:"center", zIndex:999 }}
      onClick={onClose}>
      <div style={{ background:"#fff", borderRadius:16, width:"100%", maxWidth:500, maxHeight:"85vh", overflowY:"auto", padding:24 }} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div style={{ display:"flex", justifyContent:"space-between", alignItems:"center", marginBottom:20 }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight:800, fontSize:17 }}>{title}</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background:"none", border:"none", fontSize:20, cursor:"pointer", color:"#9ca3af" }}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FundraisingModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("overview");
  const [sponsors, setSponsors] = useState([]);
  const [grants, setGrants] = useState([]);
  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState([]);
  const [budget, setBudget] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Modal state
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null); // "sponsor"|"grant"|"expense"|"budget"
  const [form, setForm] = useState({});

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setSponsors((await moduleStoreGet("funding-sponsors", true)) || []);
    setGrants((await moduleStoreGet("funding-grants", true)) || []);
    setExpenses((await moduleStoreGet("funding-expenses", true)) || []);
    setBudget((await moduleStoreGet("funding-budget", true)) || 0);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  // Save helpers
  const addSponsor = async () => {
    if (!form.name) return alert("Sponsor name required.");
    const updated = [...sponsors, { ...form, id:Date.now().toString(), addedBy:user.name, addedAt:new Date().toISOString() }];
    await moduleStoreSet("funding-sponsors", updated, true);
    setSponsors(updated); setModal(null); setForm({});
  };
  const addGrant = async () => {
    if (!form.name) return alert("Grant name required.");
    const updated = [...grants, { ...form, id:Date.now().toString(), addedBy:user.name, addedAt:new Date().toISOString() }];
    await moduleStoreSet("funding-grants", updated, true);
    setGrants(updated); setModal(null); setForm({});
  };
  const addExpense = async () => {
    if (!form.description || !form.amount) return alert("Description and amount required.");
    const updated = [...expenses, { ...form, id:Date.now().toString(), addedBy:user.name, date:new Date().toISOString() }];
    await moduleStoreSet("funding-expenses", updated, true);
    setExpenses(updated); setModal(null); setForm({});
  };
  const saveBudget = async () => {
    await moduleStoreSet("funding-budget", Number(form.budget), true);
    setBudget(Number(form.budget)); setModal(null); setForm({});
  };
  const deleteItem = async (type, id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Delete this entry?")) return;
    if (type === "sponsor") { const u=sponsors.filter(s=>s.id!==id); await moduleStoreSet("funding-sponsors",u,true); setSponsors(u); }
    if (type === "grant")   { const u=grants.filter(g=>g.id!==id);   await moduleStoreSet("funding-grants",u,true);   setGrants(u); }
    if (type === "expense") { const u=expenses.filter(e=>e.id!==id); await moduleStoreSet("funding-expenses",u,true); setExpenses(u); }
  };

  // Computed
  const totalSponsored = sponsors.reduce((s,sp)=>s+Number(sp.amount||0),0);
  const totalAwarded   = grants.filter(g=>g.status==="Awarded").reduce((s,g)=>s+Number(g.amount||0),0);
  const totalIncome    = totalSponsored + totalAwarded;
  const totalExpenses  = expenses.reduce((s,e)=>s+Number(e.amount||0),0);
  const balance        = totalIncome - totalExpenses;
  const budgetPct      = budget > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((totalIncome / budget) * 100)) : 0;

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading funding dataâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸ’° Fundraising & Sponsorship</div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["overview","ðŸ“Š Overview"],["sponsors","ðŸ¤ Sponsors"],["grants","ðŸ“ Grants"],["expenses","ðŸ’³ Expenses"]].map(([t,label])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?S_FUNDRA.btnSolid():S_FUNDRA.btn()}>{label}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Overview */}
      {tab==="overview" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:16}}>
          {/* KPI grid */}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(2,1fr)",gap:12}}>
            {[
              {label:"Total Income",value:"$" + (totalIncome.toLocaleString()),color:"#16a34a",icon:"ðŸ’µ"},
              {label:"Total Expenses",value:"$" + (totalExpenses.toLocaleString()),color:"#dc2626",icon:"ðŸ’³"},
              {label:"Balance",value:"$" + (balance.toLocaleString()),color:balance>=0?"#16a34a":"#dc2626",icon:"âš–ï¸"},
              {label:"Season Budget",value:"$" + (Number(budget).toLocaleString()),color:"#1d4ed8",icon:"ðŸŽ¯"},
            ].map(k=>(
              <div key={k.label} style={{...S_FUNDRA.card,display:"flex",gap:14,alignItems:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:32}}>{k.icon}</div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,color:k.color}}>{k.value}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{k.label}</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Budget progress */}
          {budget > 0 && (
            <div style={S_FUNDRA.card}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:8}}>
                <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>Budget Progress</span>
                <span style={{fontWeight:700,color:"#1d4ed8"}}>{budgetPct}%</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:12,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                <div style={{width:(budgetPct) + "%\",height:\"100%\",background:\"linear-gradient(90deg,#1d4ed8,#7c3aed)\",borderRadius:99,transition:\"width 0.5s\"}} />\n              </div>\n              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:\"#9ca3af\",marginTop:6}}>\" + (totalIncome.toLocaleString()) + \" raised of \" + (Number(budget).toLocaleString()) + \" goal</div>\n            </div>\n          )}\n\n          {/* Expense breakdown */}\n          {expenses.length > 0 && (\n            <div style={S_FUNDRA.card}>\n              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:14}}>Expense Breakdown</div>\n              {EXPENSE_CATS.map(cat=>{\n                const amt=expenses.filter(e=>e.category===cat).reduce((s,e)=>s+Number(e.amount||0),0);\n                if (!amt) return null;\n                const pct=totalExpenses>0?Math.round(amt/totalExpenses*100):0;\n                return (\n                  <div key={cat} style={{marginBottom:10}}>\n                    <div style={{display:\"flex\",justifyContent:\"space-between\",fontSize:13,marginBottom:4}}>\n                      <span style={{fontWeight:600}}>{cat}</span>\n                      <span style={{color:\"#6b7280\"}}>\" + (amt.toFixed(2)) + \" ({pct}%)</span>\n                    </div>\n                    <div style={{background:\"#e2e8f0\",borderRadius:99,height:6}}>\n                      <div style={{width:\"" + (pct) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#1d4ed8",borderRadius:99}} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}

          {isAdmin && (
            <button style={S_FUNDRA.btn("#7c3aed","#faf5ff")} onClick={()=>{setForm({budget});setModal("budget");}}>
              âš™ï¸ Set Season Budget
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Sponsors */}
      {tab==="sponsors" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {isAdmin && <button style={S_FUNDRA.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{setForm({tier:"Gold"});setModal("sponsor");}}>+ Add Sponsor</button>}
          {sponsors.length===0 && <div style={{...S_FUNDRA.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No sponsors added yet.</div>}
          {SPONSOR_TIERS.map(tier=>{
            const tiered=sponsors.filter(s=>s.tier===tier);

*\n\n\nconst SUBTEAMS_SUBTEAMS2 = [\"Mechanical\",\"Electrical\",\"Programming\",\"Business\",\"Drive Team\",\"Leadership\",\"Mentor\",\"Alumni\"];\nconst ROLES    = [\"Student\",\"Subteam Lead\",\"Captain\",\"Mentor\",\"Coach\",\"Alumni\",\"Parent\"];\nconst ONBOARDING = [\n  \"Filled out team registration form\",\n  \"Signed safety waiver\",\n  \"Completed safety training\",\n handbook\",\n  \"Completed tool safety certification\",\n];\n\nconst S_ROSTER = {\n  card: { background:\"#fff\", border:\"1px solid #e2e8f0\", borderRadius:14, padding:\"18px 20px\", boxShadow:\"0 fontSize:13, cursor:\"pointer\" }),\n  btnSolid: (bg=\"#059669\") => ({ background:bg, color:\"#fff\", border:\"none\", borderRadius:8, padding:\"9px 20px\", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, border:\"1.5px solid #e2e8f0\", borderRadius:8, padding:\"9px 14px\", fontSize:14, width:\"100%\", boxSizing:\"border-box\", background:\"#fff\" },\n  label: { fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, color:\"#374151\", marginBottom:4, display:\"block\" },\n  badge: (c=\"#059669\") => ({ background:c+\"18\", color:c, borderRadius:6, padding:\"2px 10px\", fontSize:12, fontWeight:700, display:\"inline-block\" }),\n};\n\nconst SUBTEAM_COLORS = {\n  Mechanical:\"#ea580c\", Electrical:\"#7c3aed\", Programming:\"#1d4ed8\",\n  Business:\"#059669\", \"Drive Team\":\"#dc2626\", Leadership:\"#d97706\",\n  Mentor:\"#0891b2\", Alumni:\"#9ca3af\",\n};\n\nfunction Avatar({ name, size = 40 }) {\n  const initials = (name || \"?\").split(\" \").map(w=>w[0]).join(\"\").slice(0,2).toUpperCase();\n  const hue = (name||\"\").split(\"\").reduce((s,c)=>s+c.charCodeAt(0),0) % 360;\n  return (\n    <div style={{ width:size, height:size, borderRadius:size/2, background:\"hsl(" + (hue) + ",60%,55%)", display:"flex", alignItems:"center", justifyContent:"center", color:"#fff", fontWeight:800, fontSize:size*0.38, flexShrink:0 }}>

function Modal({ title, onClose, children }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999 }} onClick={onClose}>
      <div style={{ background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:520,maxHeight:"88vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24 }} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div style={{ display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:18 }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight:800,fontSize:17 }}>{title}</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background:"none",border:"none",fontSize:20,cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af" }}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const EMPTY_MEMBER = { name:"", role:"Student", subteam:"Programming", email:"", phone:"", grade:"", bio:"", skills:"", github:"", onboarding:[] };

function RosterModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [members, setMembers] = useState([]);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("roster");
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null); // "add"|"view"|"onboarding"
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY_MEMBER);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [viewMember, setViewMember] = useState(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filterSub, setFilterSub] = useState("All");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setMembers((await moduleStoreGet("roster-members", true)) || []);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const saveMember = async () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) return alert("Name is required.");
    let updated;
    if (editId) {
      updated = members.map(m => m.id===editId ? { ...form, id:editId } : m);
    } else {
      updated = [...members, { ...form, id:Date.now().toString(), joinedAt:new Date().toISOString() }];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("roster-members", updated, true);
    setMembers(updated);
    setForm(EMPTY_MEMBER);
    setEditId(null);
    setModal(null);
  };

  const deleteMember = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Remove this member from the roster?")) return;
    const updated = members.filter(m=>m.id!==id);
    await moduleStoreSet("roster-members", updated, true);
    setMembers(updated);
  };

  const updateOnboarding = async (memberId, item, checked) => {
    const updated = members.map(m => {
      if (m.id !== memberId) return m;
      const ob = m.onboarding || [];
      return { ...m, onboarding: checked ? [...ob, item] : ob.filter(i=>i!==item) };
    });
    await moduleStoreSet("roster-members", updated, true);
    setMembers(updated);
    setViewMember(updated.find(m=>m.id===memberId));
  };

  const startEdit = (m) => {
    setForm({ name:m.name, role:m.role||"Student", subteam:m.subteam||"Programming", email:m.email||"", phone:m.phone||"", grade:m.grade||"", bio:m.bio||"", skills:m.skills||"", github:m.github||"", onboarding:m.onboarding||[] });
    setEditId(m.id);
    setModal("add");
  };

  const filtered = members.filter(m =>
    (filterSub==="All" || m.subteam===filterSub) &&
    (!search || m.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || m.subteam?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  );

  // Grouped by subteam
  const grouped = {};
  SUBTEAMS_SUBTEAMS2.forEach(s => { grouped[s] = filtered.filter(m=>m.subteam===s); });

  // Stats
  const roleCounts = {};
  members.forEach(m => { roleCounts[m.role] = (roleCounts[m.role]||0)+1; });

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading rosterâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸ‘¥ Team Roster</div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["roster","ðŸ‘¥ All Members"],["subteams","ðŸ”§ By Subteam"],["onboarding","âœ… Onboarding"]].map(([t,label])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?S_ROSTER.btnSolid():S_ROSTER.btn()}>{label}</button>
        ))}
        <div style={{flex:1}} />
        {isAdmin && (
          <button style={S_ROSTER.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{setForm(EMPTY_MEMBER);setEditId(null);setModal("add");}}>+ Add Member</button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Roster tab */}
      {tab==="roster" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {/* Quick stats */}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            {[
              {label:"Total Members",value:members.length,color:"#059669"},
              {label:"Students",value:members.filter(m=>m.role==="Student"||m.role==="Captain"||m.role?.includes("Lead")).length,color:"#1d4ed8"},
              {label:"Mentors/Coaches",value:members.filter(m=>["Mentor","Coach"].includes(m.role)).length,color:"#7c3aed"},
            ].map(s=>(
              <div key={s.label} style={{...S_ROSTER.card,flex:1,minWidth:100,textAlign:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,color:s.color}}>{s.value}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.label}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Search + filter */}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10}}>
            <input style={{...S_ROSTER.inp,flex:1}} placeholder="ðŸ” Search by name or subteamâ€¦"
              value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} />
            <select style={{...S_ROSTER.sel,width:180}} value={filterSub} onChange={e=>setFilterSub(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="All">All Subteams</option>
              {SUBTEAMS_SUBTEAMS2.map(s=><option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>

          {filtered.length===0 && <div style={{...S_ROSTER.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No members found.</div>}

          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr))",gap:12}}>
            {filtered.map(m=>{
              const sc = SUBTEAM_COLORS[m.subteam] || "#6b7280";
              const onbPct = ONBOARDING.length > 0 ? Math.round(((m.onboarding||[]).length / ONBOARDING.length)*100) : 0;
              return (
                <div key={m.id} style={{...S_ROSTER.card,cursor:"pointer"}} onClick={()=>{setViewMember(m);setModal("view");}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:10}}>
                    <Avatar name={m.name} size={44} />
                    <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:0}}>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{m.name}</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{m.role}{m.grade ? " Â· Grade " + (m.grade) : ""}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                    <span style={{background:sc+"18",color:sc,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 8px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700}}>{m.subteam}</span>
                  </div>
                  {/* Onboarding mini bar */}
                  {onbPct < 100 && (
                    <div style={{marginTop:10}}>
                      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>
                        <span>Onboarding</span><span>{onbPct}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:5}}>
                        <div style={{width:(onbPct) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#059669",borderRadius:99}} />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,marginTop:10}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
                      <button style={{background:"#eff6ff",color:"#1d4ed8",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700}} onClick={()=>startEdit(m)}>âœï¸ Edit</button>
                      <button style={{background:"#fef2f2",color:"#dc2626",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>deleteMember(m.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* By subteam */}
      {tab==="subteams" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:20}}>
          {SUBTEAMS_SUBTEAMS2.map(sub=>{
            const mems = members.filter(m=>m.subteam===sub);
            if (!mems.length) return null;
            const sc = SUBTEAM_COLORS[sub] || "#6b7280";
            return (
              <div key={sub}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,marginBottom:12}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,color:sc}}>{sub}</div>
                  <span style={{background:sc+"18",color:sc,borderRadius:20,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:12,fontWeight:700}}>{mems.length} member{mems.length!==1?"s":""}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
                  {mems.map(m=>(
                    <div key={m.id} style={{background:"#fff",border:"1.5px solid " + (sc) + "30",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,cursor:"pointer"}} onClick={()=>{setViewMember(m);setModal("view");}}>
                      <Avatar name={m.name} size={36} />
                      <div>
                        <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{m.name}</div>
                        <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{m.role}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Onboarding tab */}
      {tab==="onboarding" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13}}>
            {members.filter(m=>(m.onboarding||[]).length<ONBOARDING.length).length} member{members.filter(m=>(m.onboarding||[]).length<ONBOARDING.length).length!==1?"s":""} with incomplete onboarding
          </div>
          {members.filter(m=>(m.onboarding||[]).length<ONBOARDING.length).map(m=>{
            const pct=Math.round(((m.onboarding||[]).length/ONBOARDING.length)*100);
            return (
              <div key={m.id} style={S_ROSTER.card}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:12}}>
                  <Avatar name={m.name} size={36} />
                  <div style={{flex:1}}>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15}}>{m.name}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{m.subteam} Â· {pct}% complete</div>
                  </div>
                  <span style={S_ROSTER.badge(pct===100?"#16a34a":"#d97706")}>{(m.onboarding||[]).length}/{ONBOARDING.length}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:7,marginBottom:12}}>
                  <div style={{width:(pct) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#059669",borderRadius:99}} />
                </div>
                {isAdmin && (
                  <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
                    {ONBOARDING.map(item=>(
                      <label key={item} style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13}}>
                        <input type="checkbox" checked={(m.onboarding||[]).includes(item)}
                          onChange={e=>updateOnboarding(m.id,item,e.target.checked)}
                          style={{accentColor:"#059669",width:16,height:16}} />
                        <span style={{color:(m.onboarding||[]).includes(item)?"#16a34a":"#374151",textDecoration:(m.onboarding||[]).includes(item)?"line-through":"none"}}>
                          {item}
                        </span>
                      </label>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
                {!isAdmin && (
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>
                    Remaining: {ONBOARDING.filter(i=>!(m.onboarding||[]).includes(i)).map(i=>"â€¢ " + (i)).join(" ")}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
          {members.filter(m=>(m.onboarding||[]).length===ONBOARDING.length).length > 0 && (
            <div style={{...S_ROSTER.card,background:"#f0fdf4",borderColor:"#16a34a"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,color:"#16a34a",marginBottom:8}}>âœ… Fully Onboarded ({members.filter(m=>(m.onboarding||[]).length===ONBOARDING.length).length})</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                {members.filter(m=>(m.onboarding||[]).length===ONBOARDING.length).map(m=>(
                  <span key={m.id} style={{background:"#dcfce7",color:"#16a34a",borderRadius:6,padding:"3px 10px",fontSize:13,fontWeight:600}}>{m.name}</span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit member modal */}
      {modal==="add" && (
        <Modal title={editId?"âœï¸ Edit Member":"âž• Add Member"} onClose={()=>{setModal(null);setEditId(null);}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={S_ROSTER.label}>Full Name*</label><input style={S_ROSTER.inp} value={form.name} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,name:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_ROSTER.label}>Role</label>
                <select style={S_ROSTER.sel} value={form.role} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,role:e.target.value}))}>
                  {ROLES.map(r=><option key={r} value={r}>{r}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={S_ROSTER.label}>Subteam</label>
                <select style={S_ROSTER.sel} value={form.subteam} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,subteam:e.target.value}))}>
                  {SUBTEAMS_SUBTEAMS2.map(s=><option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_ROSTER.label}>Email</label><input style={S_ROSTER.inp} type="email" value={form.email} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,email:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={S_ROSTER.label}>Grade (if student)</label><input style={S_ROSTER.inp} placeholder="e.g. 10" value={form.grade} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,grade:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_ROSTER.label}>GitHub Username</label><input style={S_ROSTER.inp} placeholder="e.g. octocat" value={form.github} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,github:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div><label style={S_ROSTER.label}>Skills / Interests</label><input style={S_ROSTER.inp} placeholder="e.g. CAD, Java, drive team" value={form.skills} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,skills:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div><label style={S_ROSTER.label}>Bio</label><textarea style={{...S_ROSTER.inp,minHeight:60}} value={form.bio} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,bio:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <button style={S_ROSTER.btnSolid()} onClick={saveMember}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Add"} Member</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* View member modal */}
      {modal==="view" && viewMember && (
        <Modal title=" " onClose={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
            <Avatar name={viewMember.name} size={64} />
            <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,marginTop:10}}>{viewMember.name}</div>
            <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:14}}>{viewMember.role}</div>
            <div style={{marginTop:8,display:"flex",justifyContent:"center",gap:8}}>
              <span style={{background:SUBTEAM_COLORS[viewMember.subteam]+"18",color:SUBTEAM_COLORS[viewMember.subteam]||"#6b7280",borderRadius:6,padding:"3px 12px",fontSize:13,fontWeight:700}}>{viewMember.subteam}</span>
              {viewMember.grade && <span style={S_ROSTER.badge()}>Grade {viewMember.grade}</span>}
            </div>
          </div>
          {viewMember.bio && <div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.6,marginBottom:14}}>{viewMember.bio}</div>}
          {viewMember.skills && (
            <div style={{marginBottom:14}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:6}}>Skills & Interests</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151"}}>{viewMember.skills}</div>
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            {viewMember.email && <a href={"mailto:" + (viewMember.email)} style={{...S_ROSTER.badge("#1d4ed8"),textDecoration:"none"}}>ðŸ“§ Email</a>}
            {viewMember.github && <a href={"https://github.com/" + (viewMember.github)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" style={{...S_ROSTER.badge("#374151"),textDecoration:"none"}}>ðŸ™ GitHub</a>}
          </div>
          {isAdmin && (
            <div style={{marginTop:16,paddingTop:16,borderTop:"1px solid #e2e8f0",display:"flex",gap:8}}>
              <button style={S_ROSTER.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{startEdit(viewMember);setViewMember(null);}}>âœï¸ Edit</button>
              <button style={S_ROSTER.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2")} onClick={()=>{deleteMember(viewMember.id);setModal(null);}}>ðŸ—‘ï¸ Remove</button>
            </div>
          )}
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ OUTREACHMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *



const EVENT_TYPES = ["Demo","School Visit","FLL Coaching","Volunteer","Workshop","Community Fair","Other"];
const TYPE_ICONS  = { Demo:"ðŸ¤–", "School Visit":"ðŸ«", "FLL Coaching":"ðŸŸ§", Volunteer:"ðŸ™‹", Workshop:"ðŸ”§", "Community Fair":"ðŸŽª", Other:"ðŸŒ" };

const S_OUTREA = {
  card: { background:"#fff", border:"1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:14, padding:"18px 20px", boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn: (color="#0891b2", bg="#ecfeff") => ({ background:bg, color, border:"1.5px solid " + (color) + "30", borderRadius:8, padding:"8px 18px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnSolid: (bg="#0891b2") => ({ background:bg, color:"#fff", border:"none", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 20px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp: { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", outline:"none" },
  sel: { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", background:"#fff" },
  label: { fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, color:"#374151", marginBottom:4, display:"block" },
  badge: (c="#0891b2") => ({ background:c+"18", color:c, borderRadius:6, padding:"2px 10px", fontSize:12, fontWeight:700, display:"inline-block" }),
};

function Modal({ title, onClose, children }) {
  return (
    <div style={{ position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999 }} onClick={onClose}>
      <div style={{ background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:540,maxHeight:"88vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24 }} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div style={{ display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:18 }}>
          <div style={{ fontWeight:800,fontSize:17 }}>{title}</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{ background:"none",border:"none",fontSize:20,cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af" }}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const EMPTY_EVENT = { name:"", date:"", type:"Demo", location:"", studentsReached:"", volunteerHours:"", description:"", highlights:"", photos:"" };

function OutreachModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [events, setEvents] = useState([]);
  const [myHours, setMyHours] = useState([]);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("events");
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY_EVENT);
  const [hoursForm, setHoursForm] = useState({ eventId:"", hours:"", role:"" });
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState("All");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setEvents((await moduleStoreGet("outreach-events", true)) || []);
    setMyHours((await moduleStoreGet("outreach-hours:" + (user.name), false)) || []);
    setLoading(false);
  }, [user.name]);

  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const saveEvent = async () => {
    if (!form.name || !form.date) return alert("Event name and date are required.");
    let updated;
    if (editId) {
      updated = events.map(e => e.id===editId ? { ...form, id:editId, updatedBy:user.name } : e);
    } else {
      updated = [...events, { ...form, id:Date.now().toString(), addedBy:user.name }];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("outreach-events", updated, true);
    setEvents(updated);
    setForm(EMPTY_EVENT);
    setEditId(null);
    setModal(null);
  };

  const deleteEvent = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Delete this event?")) return;
    const updated = events.filter(e=>e.id!==id);
    await moduleStoreSet("outreach-events", updated, true);
    setEvents(updated);
  };

  const logHours = async () => {
    if (!hoursForm.hours || !hoursForm.eventId) return alert("Select an event and enter hours.");
    const updated = [...myHours, { ...hoursForm, date:new Date().toISOString(), id:Date.now().toString() }];
    await moduleStoreSet("outreach-hours:" + (user.name), updated, false);
    setMyHours(updated);
    setHoursForm({ eventId:"", hours:"", role:"" });
    setModal(null);
  };

  const startEdit = (ev) => {
    setForm({ name:ev.name, date:ev.date, type:ev.type||"Demo", location:ev.location||"", studentsReached:ev.studentsReached||"", volunteerHours:ev.volunteerHours||"", description:ev.description||"", highlights:ev.highlights||"", photos:ev.photos||"" });
    setEditId(ev.id);
    setModal("event");
  };

  // Stats
  const totalStudents  = events.reduce((s,e)=>s+Number(e.studentsReached||0),0);
  const totalTeamHours = events.reduce((s,e)=>s+Number(e.volunteerHours||0),0);
  const myTotalHours   = myHours.reduce((s,h)=>s+Number(h.hours||0),0);
  const filtered       = events.filter(e => filterType==="All" || e.type===filterType).sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));

  // Hours logged per event by this user
  const hoursByEvent   = {};
  myHours.forEach(h => { hoursByEvent[h.eventId] = (hoursByEvent[h.eventId]||0) + Number(h.hours||0); });

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading outreach dataâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸŒ Outreach & Community</div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["events","ðŸ“… Events"],["myhours","â±ï¸ My Hours"],["impact","ðŸ“Š Impact"]].map(([t,label])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?S_OUTREA.btnSolid():S_OUTREA.btn()}>{label}</button>
        ))}
        <div style={{flex:1}} />
        {(isAdmin) && (
          <button style={S_OUTREA.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{setForm(EMPTY_EVENT);setEditId(null);setModal("event");}}>+ Add Event</button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Events tab */}
      {tab==="events" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {/* Filter bar */}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            {["All",...EVENT_TYPES].map(t=>(
              <button key={t} onClick={()=>setFilterType(t)}
                style={filterType===t ? {...S_OUTREA.btnSolid("#0891b2"),padding:"5px 14px",fontSize:12} : {...S_OUTREA.btn(),padding:"5px 14px",fontSize:12}}>
                {TYPE_ICONS[t]||""} {t}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {filtered.length===0 && <div style={{...S_OUTREA.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No outreach events yet.</div>}

          {filtered.map(ev=>(
            <div key={ev.id} style={{...S_OUTREA.card,borderLeft:"4px solid #0891b2"}}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:10}}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,marginBottom:4}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:22}}>{TYPE_ICONS[ev.type]||"ðŸŒ"}</span>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17}}>{ev.name}</span>
                    <span style={S_OUTREA.badge()}>{ev.type}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>
                    ðŸ“… {fmt(ev.date)}{ev.location && <span> Â· ðŸ“ {ev.location}</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"flex-end"}}>
                  {/* Log my hours for this event */}
                  <button style={{...S_OUTREA.btn(),padding:"5px 12px",fontSize:12}}
                    onClick={()=>{setHoursForm({eventId:ev.id,hours:"",role:""});setModal("hours");}}>
                    + Log My Hours
                  </button>
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
                      <button style={{background:"#fff7ed",color:"#ea580c",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12}} onClick={()=>startEdit(ev)}>âœï¸</button>
                      <button style={{background:"#fef2f2",color:"#dc2626",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12}} onClick={()=>deleteEvent(ev.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:ev.description?10:0}}>
