                {ev.studentsReached && <span style={S_OUTREA.badge("#7c3aed")}>ðŸ‘©â€ðŸŽ“ {ev.studentsReached} students</span>}
                {ev.volunteerHours && <span style={S_OUTREA.badge("#059669")}>â±ï¸ {ev.volunteerHours} hrs logged</span>}
                {hoursByEvent[ev.id] && <span style={S_OUTREA.badge("#d97706")}>You: {hoursByEvent[ev.id]} hrs</span>}
              </div>

              {ev.description && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:8}}>{ev.description}</div>}
              {ev.highlights && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#0891b2",marginTop:6,fontStyle:"italic"}}>âœ¨ {ev.highlights}</div>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* My hours tab */}
      {tab==="myhours" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{...S_OUTREA.card,display:"flex",gap:20,alignItems:"center"}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:40}}>â±ï¸</div>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:28,color:"#0891b2"}}>{myTotalHours} hrs</div>
              <div style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}}>Total volunteer hours logged</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button style={S_OUTREA.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>setModal("hours")}>+ Log Hours</button>
          {myHours.length===0 && <div style={{...S_OUTREA.card,textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No hours logged yet.</div>}
          {[...myHours].reverse().map(h=>{
            const ev=events.find(e=>e.id===h.eventId);
            return (
              <div key={h.id} style={{...S_OUTREA.card,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{ev?.name || "Unknown Event"}</div>
                  {h.role && <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>Role: {h.role}</div>}
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{fmt(h.date)}</div>
                </div>
                <span style={{...S_OUTREA.badge(),fontSize:16,padding:"4px 14px"}}>{h.hours} hrs</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Impact tab */}
      {tab==="impact" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(2,1fr)",gap:12}}>
            {[
              {icon:"ðŸŒ",label:"Total Events",value:events.length,color:"#0891b2"},
              {icon:"ðŸ‘©â€ðŸŽ“",label:"Students Reached",value:totalStudents.toLocaleString(),color:"#7c3aed"},
              {icon:"â±ï¸",label:"Team Volunteer Hours",value:totalTeamHours,color:"#059669"},
              {icon:"ðŸ”§",label:"Types of Outreach",value:new Set(events.map(e=>e.type)).size,color:"#d97706"},
            ].map(k=>(
              <div key={k.label} style={{...S_OUTREA.card,textAlign:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:32,marginBottom:6}}>{k.icon}</div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:26,color:k.color}}>{k.value}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{k.label}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Events by type breakdown */}
          <div style={S_OUTREA.card}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:14}}>Events by Type</div>
            {EVENT_TYPES.map(type=>{
              const count=events.filter(e=>e.type===type).length;
              if (!count) return null;
              const pct=events.length>0?Math.round(count/events.length*100):0;
              return (
                <div key={type} style={{marginBottom:12}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",fontSize:13,marginBottom:4}}>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:600}}>{TYPE_ICONS[type]} {type}</span>
                    <span style={{color:"#6b7280"}}>{count} event{count!==1?"s":""} ({pct}%)</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:7}}>
                    <div style={{width:(pct) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#0891b2",borderRadius:99}} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {/* Recent events */}
          <div style={S_OUTREA.card}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12}}>Recent Events</div>
            {[...events].sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date)).slice(0,5).map(ev=>(
              <div key={ev.id} style={{display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",padding:"8px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
                <span style={{fontSize:22}}>{TYPE_ICONS[ev.type]||"ðŸŒ"}</span>
                <div style={{flex:1}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{ev.name}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{fmt(ev.date)}</div>
                </div>
                {ev.studentsReached && <span style={S_OUTREA.badge("#7c3aed")}>{ev.studentsReached} students</span>}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Event Modal */}
      {modal==="event" && (
        <Modal title={editId?"âœï¸ Edit Event":"ðŸŒ Add Outreach Event"} onClose={()=>{setModal(null);setEditId(null);}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Event Name*</label><input style={S_OUTREA.inp} value={form.name} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,name:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Date*</label><input style={S_OUTREA.inp} type="date" value={form.date} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,date:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Location</label><input style={S_OUTREA.inp} value={form.location} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,location:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Event Type</label>
              <select style={S_OUTREA.sel} value={form.type} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,type:e.target.value}))}>
                {EVENT_TYPES.map(t=><option key={t} value={t}>{TYPE_ICONS[t]} {t}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Students Reached</label><input style={S_OUTREA.inp} type="number" value={form.studentsReached} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,studentsReached:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Volunteer Hours (total)</label><input style={S_OUTREA.inp} type="number" value={form.volunteerHours} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,volunteerHours:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Description</label><textarea style={{...S_OUTREA.inp,minHeight:60}} value={form.description} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,description:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Highlights / Best moments</label><textarea style={{...S_OUTREA.inp,minHeight:50}} value={form.highlights} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,highlights:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <button style={S_OUTREA.btnSolid()} onClick={saveEvent}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Save"} Event</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* Log Hours Modal */}
      {modal==="hours" && (
        <Modal title="â±ï¸ Log Volunteer Hours" onClose={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Event</label>
              <select style={S_OUTREA.sel} value={hoursForm.eventId} onChange={e=>setHoursForm(p=>({...p,eventId:e.target.value}))}>
                <option value="">â€” select event â€”</option>
                {[...events].sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date)).map(ev=>(
                  <option key={ev.id} value={ev.id}>{ev.name} ({fmt(ev.date)})</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Hours</label><input style={S_OUTREA.inp} type="number" min="0.5" step="0.5" value={hoursForm.hours} onChange={e=>setHoursForm(p=>({...p,hours:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div><label style={S_OUTREA.label}>Your Role (optional)</label><input style={S_OUTREA.inp} placeholder="e.g. Robot demo operator" value={hoursForm.role} onChange={e=>setHoursForm(p=>({...p,role:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <button style={S_OUTREA.btnSolid()} onClick={logHours}>ðŸ’¾ Log Hours</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ SCHEDULEMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *


const pad  = n => String(n).padStart(2,"0");
const ymd  = d => (d.getFullYear()) + "-" + (pad(d.getMonth()+1)) + "-" + (pad(d.getDate()));
const fmt_fmt2  = iso => iso ? new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-US",{month:"short",day:"numeric",year:"numeric"}) : "â€”";
const fmtT = iso => iso ? new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString("en-US",{hour:"numeric",minute:"2-digit"}) : "";

const EVENT_TYPES_EVTYPES1 = ["Meeting","Competition","Outreach","Deadline","Scrimmage","Workshop","Other"];
const TYPE_COLORS = {Meeting:"#1d4ed8",Competition:"#dc2626",Outreach:"#0891b2",Deadline:"#d97706",Scrimmage:"#7c3aed",Workshop:"#059669",Other:"#6b7280"};

const MONTHS = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
const DAYS   = ["Sun","Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat"];

const S_SCHEDU = {
  card:    { background:"#fff", border:"1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:14, padding:"18px 20px", boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:     (c="#1d4ed8",b="#eff6ff") => ({ background:b, color:c, border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30", borderRadius:8, padding:"8px 18px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnSolid:(bg="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:bg, color:"#fff", border:"none", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 20px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:     { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", outline:"none" },
  sel:     { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", background:"#fff" },
  label:   { fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, color:"#374151", marginBottom:4, display:"block" },
  badge:   (c="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:c+"18", color:c, borderRadius:6, padding:"2px 10px", fontSize:11, fontWeight:700, display:"inline-block" }),
};

function Modal({title,onClose,children}){
  return (
    <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={onClose}>
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:500,maxHeight:"88vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:18}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17}}>{title}</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{background:"none",border:"none",fontSize:20,cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af"}}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const EMPTY = { title:"", date:"", time:"", endTime:"", type:"Meeting", location:"", description:"", recurring:"none" };

function ScheduleModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [events, setEvents] = useState([]);
  const [rsvps,  setRsvps]  = useState({});
  const [tab,    setTab]    = useState("upcoming");
  const [modal,  setModal]  = useState(null);
  const [form,   setForm]   = useState(EMPTY);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [calDate, setCalDate] = useState(new Date());
  const [selDay, setSelDay]   = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setEvents((await moduleStoreGet("schedule-events", true)) || []);
    setRsvps((await moduleStoreGet("schedule-rsvps:" + (user.name), false)) || {});
    setLoading(false);
  }, [user.name]);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const saveEvent = async () => {
    if (!form.title || !form.date) return alert("Title and date are required.");
    let updated;
    if (editId) {
      updated = events.map(e => e.id===editId ? {...form, id:editId, by:user.name} : e);
    } else {
      updated = [...events, {...form, id:Date.now().toString(), by:user.name, createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("schedule-events", updated, true);
    setEvents(updated); setForm(EMPTY); setEditId(null); setModal(null);
  };

  const deleteEvent = async (id) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Delete this event?")) return;
    const u = events.filter(e=>e.id!==id);
    await moduleStoreSet("schedule-events", u, true); setEvents(u);
  };

  const toggleRsvp = async (id) => {
    const updated = {...rsvps, [id]: rsvps[id]==="yes" ? "no" : "yes"};
    await moduleStoreSet("schedule-rsvps:" + (user.name), updated, false);
    setRsvps(updated);
    // Update shared rsvp count
    const allRsvps = (await moduleStoreGet("schedule-rsvp-all:" + (id), true)) || {};
    allRsvps[user.name] = updated[id];
    await moduleStoreSet("schedule-rsvp-all:" + (id), allRsvps, true);
  };

  const now = new Date();
  const upcoming = events.filter(e => new Date(e.date) >= new Date(ymd(now))).sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  const past     = events.filter(e => new Date(e.date) <  new Date(ymd(now))).sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));

  // Build season countdown (kickoff ~Jan 4 each year, championship ~Apr 17)
  const nextKickoff = new Date(now.getFullYear() + (now.getMonth() >= 1 ? 1 : 0), 0, 4);
  const daysToKickoff = Math.ceil((nextKickoff - now) / 86400000);

  // Calendar helpers
  const calYear  = calDate.getFullYear();
  const calMonth = calDate.getMonth();
  const firstDay = new Date(calYear, calMonth, 1).getDay();
  const daysInMonth = new Date(calYear, calMonth+1, 0).getDate();
  const eventsByDate = {};
  events.forEach(e => { if (!eventsByDate[e.date]) eventsByDate[e.date] = []; eventsByDate[e.date].push(e); });

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading scheduleâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸ“… Schedule</div>

      {/* Countdown strip */}
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(3,1fr)",gap:12,marginBottom:20}}>
        {[
          {label:"Days to Kickoff",   value:daysToKickoff,  icon:"ðŸš€", color:"#1d4ed8"},
          {label:"Upcoming Events",   value:upcoming.length, icon:"ðŸ“…", color:"#7c3aed"},
          {label:"This Week",         value:upcoming.filter(e=>{ const d=new Date(e.date); return (d-now)/86400000<=7; }).length, icon:"âš¡", color:"#059669"},
        ].map(s=>(
          <div key={s.label} style={{...S_SCHEDU.card,textAlign:"center"}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:24}}>{s.icon}</div>
            <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,color:s.color}}>{s.value}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.label}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["upcoming","ðŸ“‹ Upcoming"],["calendar","ðŸ“† Calendar"],["past","ðŸ•°ï¸ Past"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?S_SCHEDU.btnSolid():S_SCHEDU.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
        <div style={{flex:1}}/>
        {isAdmin && <button style={S_SCHEDU.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{setForm(EMPTY);setEditId(null);setModal("event");}}>+ Add Event</button>}
      </div>

      {/* Upcoming list */}
      {tab==="upcoming" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          {upcoming.length===0 && <div style={{...S_SCHEDU.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No upcoming events. Add some!</div>}
          {upcoming.map(ev => {
            const c = TYPE_COLORS[ev.type]||"#6b7280";
            const days = Math.ceil((new Date(ev.date)-now)/86400000);
            return (
              <div key={ev.id} style={{...S_SCHEDU.card,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (c)}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
                  <div style={{flex:1}}>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,marginBottom:4}}>
                      <span style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16}}>{ev.title}</span>
                      <span style={S_SCHEDU.badge(c)}>{ev.type}</span>
                      {days===0 && <span style={S_SCHEDU.badge("#dc2626")}>TODAY</span>}
                      {days===1 && <span style={S_SCHEDU.badge("#d97706")}>TOMORROW</span>}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>
                      ðŸ“… {fmt_fmt2(ev.date)}{ev.time && " Â· â° " + (ev.time) + "\"}{ev.endTime && \" â€“ " + (ev.endTime)}
                      {ev.location && <span> Â· ðŸ“ {ev.location}</span>}
                    </div>
                    {ev.description && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:6}}>{ev.description}</div>}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6,alignItems:"flex-end",flexShrink:0,marginLeft:12}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af",fontWeight:600}}>
                      {days===0?"Today":days===1?"Tomorrow":"In " + (days) + "d"}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      style={rsvps[ev.id]==="yes" ? S_SCHEDU.btnSolid("#16a34a") : S_SCHEDU.btn("#16a34a","#f0fdf4")}
                      onClick={()=>toggleRsvp(ev.id)}>
                      {rsvps[ev.id]==="yes" ? "âœ… Going" : "RSVP"}
                    </button>
                    {isAdmin && (
                      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4}}>
                        <button style={{background:"#fff7ed",color:"#ea580c",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>{setForm({title:ev.title,date:ev.date,time:ev.time||"",endTime:ev.endTime||"",type:ev.type,location:ev.location||"",description:ev.description||"",recurring:ev.recurring||"none"});setEditId(ev.id);setModal("event");}}>âœï¸</button>
                        <button style={{background:"#fef2f2",color:"#dc2626",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>deleteEvent(ev.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Calendar view */}
      {tab==="calendar" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:16}}>
          {/* Month nav */}
          <div style={{...S_SCHEDU.card,padding:"12px 16px"}}>
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:14}}>
              <button style={S_SCHEDU.btn()} onClick={()=>setCalDate(new Date(calYear,calMonth-1,1))}>â† Prev</button>
              <span style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17}}>{MONTHS[calMonth]} {calYear}</span>
              <button style={S_SCHEDU.btn()} onClick={()=>setCalDate(new Date(calYear,calMonth+1,1))}>Next â†’</button>
            </div>
            {/* Day headers */}
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(7,1fr)",gap:2,marginBottom:4}}>
              {DAYS.map(d=><div key={d} style={{textAlign:"center",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,color:"#9ca3af",padding:"4px 0"}}>{d}</div>)}
            </div>
            {/* Calendar grid */}
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(7,1fr)",gap:2}}>
              {Array.from({length:firstDay},(_,i)=><div key={"e" + (i)}/>)}
              {Array.from({length:daysInMonth},(_,i)=>{
                const day = i+1;
                const key = (calYear) + "-" + (pad(calMonth+1)) + "-" + (pad(day));
                const dayEvs = eventsByDate[key]||[];
                const isToday = key===ymd(now);
                const isSel = key===selDay;
                return (
                  <div key={day} onClick={()=>setSelDay(isSel?null:key)}
                    style={{minHeight:52,borderRadius:8,padding:"4px 6px",cursor:"pointer",
                      background:isSel?"#eff6ff":isToday?"#fef9c3":"transparent",
                      border:"1.5px solid " + (isSel?"#1d4ed8":isToday?"#d97706":"#f1f5f9"),
                      transition:"all 0.12s"}}>
                    <div style={{fontSize:12,fontWeight:isToday?800:400,color:isToday?"#d97706":"#374151"}}>{day}</div>
                    {dayEvs.slice(0,2).map(ev=>(
                      <div key={ev.id} style={{fontSize:9,background:(TYPE_COLORS[ev.type]||"#6b7280")+"22",color:TYPE_COLORS[ev.type]||"#6b7280",borderRadius:3,padding:"1px 4px",marginTop:2,overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap",fontWeight:700}}>
                        {ev.title}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    {dayEvs.length>2 && <div style={{fontSize:9,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:1}}>+{dayEvs.length-2} more</div>}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
          {/* Selected day events */}
          {selDay && (eventsByDate[selDay]||[]).length>0 && (
            <div style={S_SCHEDU.card}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12}}>{fmt_fmt2(selDay)}</div>
              {(eventsByDate[selDay]||[]).map(ev=>(
                <div key={ev.id} style={{padding:"10px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{ev.title}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{ev.time && "â° " + (ev.time) + "\"}{ev.location && \" Â· ðŸ“ " + (ev.location)}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Past events */}
      {tab==="past" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
          {past.length===0 && <div style={{...S_SCHEDU.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No past events yet.</div>}
          {past.slice(0,30).map(ev=>(
            <div key={ev.id} style={{...S_SCHEDU.card,opacity:0.75}}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                <div>
                  <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{ev.title}</span>
                  <span style={{...S_SCHEDU.badge(TYPE_COLORS[ev.type]||"#6b7280"),marginLeft:8}}>{ev.type}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{fmt_fmt2(ev.date)}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Modal */}
      {modal==="event" && (
        <Modal title={editId?"âœï¸ Edit Event":"ðŸ“… Add Event"} onClose={()=>{setModal(null);setEditId(null);}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={S_SCHEDU.label}>Title*</label><input style={S_SCHEDU.inp} value={form.title} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,title:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_SCHEDU.label}>Date*</label><input style={S_SCHEDU.inp} type="date" value={form.date} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,date:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={S_SCHEDU.label}>Type</label>
                <select style={S_SCHEDU.sel} value={form.type} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,type:e.target.value}))}>
                  {EVENT_TYPES_EVTYPES1.map(t=><option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={S_SCHEDU.label}>Start Time</label><input style={S_SCHEDU.inp} type="time" value={form.time} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,time:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={S_SCHEDU.label}>End Time</label><input style={S_SCHEDU.inp} type="time" value={form.endTime} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,endTime:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_SCHEDU.label}>Location</label><input style={S_SCHEDU.inp} value={form.location} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,location:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div><label style={S_SCHEDU.label}>Description</label><textarea style={{...S_SCHEDU.inp,minHeight:60,resize:"vertical"}} value={form.description} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,description:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div><label style={S_SCHEDU.label}>Recurring</label>
              <select style={S_SCHEDU.sel} value={form.recurring} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,recurring:e.target.value}))}>
                {["none","weekly","biweekly","monthly"].map(r=><option key={r} value={r}>{r.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+r.slice(1)}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <button style={S_SCHEDU.btnSolid()} onClick={saveEvent}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Save"} Event</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ AWARDSMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *



const AWARDS = [
  { id:"impact",    name:"Impact Award",         icon:"ðŸŒŸ", program:"FRC", desc:"Formerly Chairman's â€” most prestigious, recognizing community impact." },
  { id:"inspire",   name:"Inspire Award",        icon:"âœ¨", program:"FTC", desc:"FTC's top award for overall excellence and inspiration." },
  { id:"engineering",name:"Engineering Excellence",icon:"âš™ï¸", program:"Both", desc:"Outstanding robot design and engineering process." },
  { id:"connect",   name:"Connect Award",        icon:"ðŸ¤", program:"FTC", desc:"Engaging with engineering community & mentors." },
  { id:"think",     name:"Think Award",          icon:"ðŸ§ ", program:"FTC", desc:"Best engineering journal / documentation." },
  { id:"innovate",  name:"Innovate Award",       icon:"ðŸ’¡", program:"FTC", desc:"Most innovative and creative robot feature." },
  { id:"motivate",  name:"Motivate Award",       icon:"ðŸŽ‰", program:"FTC", desc:"Spreading FIRST spirit and enthusiasm." },
  { id:"sustainability",name:"Sustainability Award",icon:"ðŸŒ¿", program:"FRC", desc:"Long-term sustainability and community involvement." },
  { id:"rookie",    name:"Rookie of the Year",   icon:"ðŸŒ±", program:"Both", desc:"Best first-year team." },
  { id:"woodie",    name:"Woodie Flowers Award", icon:"ðŸŒº", program:"FRC", desc:"Exceptional mentor nominated by students." },
];

const SUBMISSION_STATUS = ["Not Started","Drafting","In Review","Submitted","Won","Finalist"];
const STATUS_COLORS_STATCOL2 = { "Not Started":"#9ca3af","Drafting":"#d97706","In Review":"#7c3aed","Submitted":"#1d4ed8","Won":"#16a34a","Finalist":"#0891b2" };

const S_AWARDS = {
  card:    { background:"#fff", border:"1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:14, padding:"18px 20px", boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:     (c="#d97706",b="#fffbeb") => ({ background:b, color:c, border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30", borderRadius:8, padding:"8px 18px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnSolid:(bg="#d97706") => ({ background:bg, color:"#fff", border:"none", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 20px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:     { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", outline:"none" },
  sel:     { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", background:"#fff" },
  label:   { fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, color:"#374151", marginBottom:4, display:"block" },
  badge:   (c="#d97706") => ({ background:c+"18", color:c, borderRadius:6, padding:"2px 10px", fontSize:11, fontWeight:700, display:"inline-block" }),
  ta:      { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", outline:"none", fontFamily:"inherit", resize:"vertical" },
};

function Modal({title,onClose,children}){
  return (
    <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={onClose}>
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:680,maxHeight:"90vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:18}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17}}>{title}</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{background:"none",border:"none",fontSize:20,cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af"}}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AwardsModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [submissions, setSubmissions] = useState([]);
  const [history,     setHistory]     = useState([]);
  const [tab,    setTab]    = useState("tracker");
  const [modal,  setModal]  = useState(null); // "essay"|"history"|"award"
  const [selAward, setSelAward] = useState(null);
  const [form,   setForm]   = useState({});
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setSubmissions((await moduleStoreGet("awards-submissions", true)) || []);
    setHistory((await moduleStoreGet("awards-history", true)) || []);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const saveSubmission = async () => {
    if (!form.awardId) return alert("Select an award.");
    let updated;
    const entry = { ...form, updatedBy:user.name, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString() };
    if (editId) {
      updated = submissions.map(s => s.id===editId ? {...entry, id:editId} : s);
    } else {
      updated = [...submissions, {...entry, id:Date.now().toString(), createdBy:user.name, createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("awards-submissions", updated, true);
    setSubmissions(updated); setForm({}); setEditId(null); setModal(null);
  };

  const saveHistory = async () => {
    if (!form.awardId || !form.year || !form.event) return alert("Award, year and event are required.");
    const updated = [...history, {...form, id:Date.now().toString(), addedBy:user.name}];
    await moduleStoreSet("awards-history", updated, true);
    setHistory(updated); setForm({}); setModal(null);
  };

  const deleteSubmission = async (id) => {
    const u = submissions.filter(s=>s.id!==id);
    await moduleStoreSet("awards-submissions", u, true); setSubmissions(u);
  };

  const wordCount = text => text ? text.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length : 0;

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading awardsâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸ† Awards & Documentation</div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["tracker","ðŸ“‹ Submission Tracker"],["essays","âœï¸ Essay Drafts"],["history","ðŸŽ–ï¸ Award History"],["awards","ðŸ“– Award Guide"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?S_AWARDS.btnSolid():S_AWARDS.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Submission Tracker */}
      {tab==="tracker" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"flex-end"}}>
            {isAdmin && <button style={S_AWARDS.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{setForm({status:"Not Started"});setEditId(null);setModal("submission");}}>+ Track Award</button>}
          </div>
          {submissions.length===0 && <div style={{...S_AWARDS.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No awards being tracked. Add one to start!</div>}
          {SUBMISSION_STATUS.map(status => {
            const group = submissions.filter(s=>s.status===status);
            if (!group.length) return null;
            const c = STATUS_COLORS_STATCOL2[status];
            return (
              <div key={status}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:c,marginBottom:8,display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center"}}>
                  <span>{status}</span>
                  <span style={{background:c+"20",color:c,borderRadius:20,padding:"1px 8px",fontSize:11}}>{group.length}</span>
                </div>
                {group.map(sub => {
                  const award = AWARDS.find(a=>a.id===sub.awardId);
                  return (
                    <div key={sub.id} style={{...S_AWARDS.card,marginBottom:10,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (c)}}>
                      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
                        <div>
                          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16}}>{award?.icon} {award?.name || sub.awardId}</div>
                          <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:2}}>
                            {sub.event && <span>ðŸ“ {sub.event} Â· </span>}
                            {sub.deadline && <span>â° Due {fmt(sub.deadline)}</span>}
                          </div>
                          {sub.notes && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>{sub.notes}</div>}
                          <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>Updated by {sub.updatedBy} Â· {fmt(sub.updatedAt)}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6,alignItems:"flex-end"}}>
                          <span style={{...S_AWARDS.badge(c)}}>{status}</span>
                          {isAdmin && (
                            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4}}>
                              <button style={{background:"#fff7ed",color:"#ea580c",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>{setForm({awardId:sub.awardId,status:sub.status,event:sub.event||"",deadline:sub.deadline||"",notes:sub.notes||""});setEditId(sub.id);setModal("submission");}}>âœï¸</button>
                              <button style={{background:"#fef2f2",color:"#dc2626",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>deleteSubmission(sub.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Essay Drafts */}
      {tab==="essays" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"flex-end"}}>
            <button style={S_AWARDS.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{setForm({awardId:"impact",title:"",body:"",version:1});setEditId(null);setModal("essay");}}>+ New Essay Draft</button>
          </div>
          {submissions.filter(s=>s.essay).length===0 && (
            <div style={{...S_AWARDS.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No essay drafts saved yet.</div>
          )}
          {submissions.filter(s=>s.essay).map(sub => {
            const award = AWARDS.find(a=>a.id===sub.awardId);
            const wc = wordCount(sub.essay);
            return (
              <div key={sub.id} style={S_AWARDS.card}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:10}}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16}}>{award?.icon} {award?.name}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>v{sub.version||1} Â· {wc} words Â· Last edited {fmt(sub.updatedAt)} by {sub.updatedBy}</div>
                  </div>
                  <button style={S_AWARDS.btn()} onClick={()=>{setForm({awardId:sub.awardId,title:sub.essayTitle||"",body:sub.essay||"",version:(sub.version||1)+1});setEditId(sub.id);setModal("essay");}}>âœï¸ Edit</button>
                </div>
                <div style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:8,padding:"12px 14px",fontSize:14,lineHeight:1.7,color:"#374151",maxHeight:200,overflow:"hidden",position:"relative"}}>
                  {sub.essay?.slice(0,400)}
                  {sub.essay?.length>400 && "â€¦"}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Award history */}
      {tab==="history" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"flex-end"}}>
            {isAdmin && <button style={S_AWARDS.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{setForm({});setModal("history");}}>+ Log Award Won</button>}
          </div>
          {history.length===0 && <div style={{...S_AWARDS.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No award history yet.</div>}
          {[...history].sort((a,b)=>b.year-a.year).map(h=>{
            const award=AWARDS.find(a=>a.id===h.awardId);
            return (
              <div key={h.id} style={{...S_AWARDS.card,borderLeft:"4px solid #d97706",display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16}}>{award?.icon} {award?.name||h.awardId}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ“ {h.event} Â· ðŸ—“ï¸ {h.year}</div>
                  {h.notes && <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>{h.notes}</div>}
                </div>
                <span style={S_AWARDS.badge("#d97706")}>{h.placement||"Won"} ðŸ†</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Award guide */}
      {tab==="awards" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:4}}>Click any award to see description and tips.</div>
          {AWARDS.map(award => (
            <div key={award.id} style={{...S_AWARDS.card,cursor:"pointer",transition:"all 0.15s"}}
              onClick={()=>{ setSelAward(selAward?.id===award.id?null:award); }}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center"}}>
                  <span style={{fontSize:28}}>{award.icon}</span>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>{award.name}</div>
                    <span style={S_AWARDS.badge(award.program==="FRC"?"#dc2626":award.program==="FTC"?"#1d4ed8":"#7c3aed")}>{award.program}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <span style={{color:"#9ca3af"}}>{selAward?.id===award.id?"â–²":"â–¼"}</span>
              </div>
              {selAward?.id===award.id && (
                <div style={{marginTop:12,paddingTop:12,borderTop:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
                  <p style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.7,margin:"0 0 12px"}}>{award.desc}</p>
                  <button style={S_AWARDS.btn()} onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();setForm({awardId:award.id,status:"Not Started"});setEditId(null);setModal("submission");}}>
                    + Start Tracking This Award
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Track award modal */}
      {modal==="submission" && (
        <Modal title={editId?"âœï¸ Edit Submission":"ðŸ“‹ Track Award"} onClose={()=>{setModal(null);setEditId(null);}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Award</label>
              <select style={S_AWARDS.sel} value={form.awardId||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,awardId:e.target.value}))}>
                <option value="">â€” select award â€”</option>
                {AWARDS.map(a=><option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.icon} {a.name} ({a.program})</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Status</label>
              <select style={S_AWARDS.sel} value={form.status||"Not Started"} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,status:e.target.value}))}>
                {SUBMISSION_STATUS.map(s=><option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Event / Competition</label><input style={S_AWARDS.inp} value={form.event||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,event:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Submission Deadline</label><input style={S_AWARDS.inp} type="date" value={form.deadline||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,deadline:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Notes</label><textarea style={{...S_AWARDS.ta,minHeight:60}} value={form.notes||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,notes:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <button style={S_AWARDS.btnSolid()} onClick={saveSubmission}>ðŸ’¾ Save</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* Essay editor modal */}
      {modal==="essay" && (
        <Modal title="âœï¸ Essay Draft" onClose={()=>{setModal(null);setEditId(null);}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Award</label>
              <select style={S_AWARDS.sel} value={form.awardId||"impact"} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,awardId:e.target.value}))}>
                {AWARDS.map(a=><option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.icon} {a.name}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Essay / Submission Text</label>
              <textarea style={{...S_AWARDS.ta,minHeight:240}} value={form.body||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,body:e.target.value}))} placeholder="Start writing your essay hereâ€¦" />
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>{wordCount(form.body||"")} words</div>
            </div>
            <button style={S_AWARDS.btnSolid()} onClick={async ()=>{
              // Save as essay field on existing or new submission
              const awardSubs = submissions.filter(s=>s.awardId===form.awardId);
              let updated;
              if (editId) {
                updated = submissions.map(s => s.id===editId ? {...s, essay:form.body, essayTitle:form.title, version:form.version, updatedBy:user.name, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()} : s);
              } else if (awardSubs.length>0) {
                updated = submissions.map(s => s.awardId===form.awardId ? {...s, essay:form.body, updatedBy:user.name, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()} : s);
              } else {
                updated = [...submissions, {id:Date.now().toString(), awardId:form.awardId, status:"Drafting", essay:form.body, version:1, createdBy:user.name, createdAt:new Date().toISOString(), updatedBy:user.name, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
              }
              await moduleStoreSet("awards-submissions", updated, true);
              setSubmissions(updated); setModal(null); setEditId(null); setForm({});
            }}>ðŸ’¾ Save Draft</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {/* Log history modal */}
      {modal==="history" && (
        <Modal title="ðŸŽ–ï¸ Log Award Won" onClose={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Award</label>
              <select style={S_AWARDS.sel} value={form.awardId||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,awardId:e.target.value}))}>
                <option value="">â€” select award â€”</option>
                {AWARDS.map(a=><option key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.icon} {a.name}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Year</label><input style={S_AWARDS.inp} type="number" placeholder="2024" value={form.year||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,year:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Placement</label>
                <select style={S_AWARDS.sel} value={form.placement||"Won"} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,placement:e.target.value}))}>
                  {["Won","Finalist","Semifinalist"].map(p=><option key={p} value={p}>{p}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Event / Competition</label><input style={S_AWARDS.inp} value={form.event||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,event:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div><label style={S_AWARDS.label}>Notes</label><textarea style={{...S_AWARDS.ta,minHeight:50}} value={form.notes||""} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,notes:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <button style={S_AWARDS.btnSolid()} onClick={saveHistory}>ðŸ’¾ Save</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ TASKBOARDMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
 *


const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);

const COLUMNS = ["Backlog","To Do","In Progress","Review","Done"];
const COL_COLORS = { Backlog:"#9ca3af","To Do":"#1d4ed8","In Progress":"#d97706",Review:"#7c3aed",Done:"#16a34a" };
const PRIORITIES = ["Low","Medium","High","Critical"];
const PRIORITY_COLORS = { Low:"#9ca3af",Medium:"#1d4ed8",High:"#d97706",Critical:"#dc2626" };
const SUBTEAMS_SUBTEAMS1 = ["All","Mechanical","Electrical","Programming","Business","Drive Team","Leadership"];

const S_TASKBO = {
  card:    { background:"#fff", border:"1px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:14, padding:"18px 20px", boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:     (c="#1d4ed8",b="#eff6ff") => ({ background:b, color:c, border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30", borderRadius:8, padding:"8px 18px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnSolid:(bg="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:bg, color:"#fff", border:"none", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 20px", fontWeight:700, fontSize:13, cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:     { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", outline:"none" },
  sel:     { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0", borderRadius:8, padding:"9px 14px", fontSize:14, width:"100%", boxSizing:"border-box", background:"#fff" },
  label:   { fontWeight:600, fontSize:13, color:"#374151", marginBottom:4, display:"block" },
  badge:   (c="#1d4ed8") => ({ background:c+"18", color:c, borderRadius:6, padding:"2px 8px", fontSize:11, fontWeight:700, display:"inline-block" }),
};

function Modal({title,onClose,children}){
  return (
    <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={onClose}>
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:500,maxHeight:"88vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:18}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17}}>{title}</div>
          <button onClick={onClose} style={{background:"none",border:"none",fontSize:20,cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af"}}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const EMPTY_EMPTY2 = { title:"", description:"", status:"To Do", priority:"Medium", subteam:"Mechanical", assignee:"", dueDate:"", tags:"" };

function TaskBoardModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [tasks,  setTasks]  = useState([]);
  const [view,   setView]   = useState("board"); // "board"|"list"|"mine"
  const [modal,  setModal]  = useState(false);
  const [form,   setForm]   = useState(EMPTY_EMPTY2);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState(null);
  const [filterSub, setFilterSub] = useState("All");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setTasks((await moduleStoreGet("tasks-board", true)) || []);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const saveTask = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return alert("Title is required.");
    let updated;
    if (editId) {
      updated = tasks.map(t => t.id===editId ? {...form, id:editId, updatedBy:user.name, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()} : t);
    } else {
      updated = [...tasks, {...form, id:Date.now().toString(), createdBy:user.name, createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("tasks-board", updated, true);
    setTasks(updated); setForm(EMPTY_EMPTY2); setEditId(null); setModal(false);
  };

  const moveTask = async (id, newStatus) => {
    const updated = tasks.map(t => t.id===id ? {...t, status:newStatus, updatedBy:user.name, updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()} : t);
    await moduleStoreSet("tasks-board", updated, true); setTasks(updated);
  };

  const deleteTask = async (id) => {
    const u = tasks.filter(t=>t.id!==id);
    await moduleStoreSet("tasks-board", u, true); setTasks(u);
  };

  const openEdit = (task) => {
    setForm({title:task.title,description:task.description||"",status:task.status,priority:task.priority||"Medium",subteam:task.subteam||"Mechanical",assignee:task.assignee||"",dueDate:task.dueDate||"",tags:task.tags||""});
    setEditId(task.id); setModal(true);
  };

  const isOverdue = task => task.dueDate && task.dueDate < today() && task.status !== "Done";

  const filtered = tasks.filter(t =>
    (filterSub==="All" || t.subteam===filterSub) &&
    (!search || t.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || (t.assignee||"").toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  );

  const myTasks  = tasks.filter(t => t.assignee?.toLowerCase() === user.name?.toLowerCase() && t.status !== "Done");
  const overdue  = tasks.filter(t => isOverdue(t));

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading tasksâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24}}>ðŸ“Œ Task Board</div>
        <button style={S_TASKBO.btnSolid()} onClick={()=>{setForm(EMPTY_EMPTY2);setEditId(null);setModal(true);}}>+ New Task</button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats strip */}
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(4,1fr)",gap:10,marginBottom:18}}>
        {[
          {label:"Total",   value:tasks.length,                                  color:"#374151"},
          {label:"My Tasks",value:myTasks.length,                                color:"#1d4ed8"},
          {label:"In Prog", value:tasks.filter(t=>t.status==="In Progress").length, color:"#d97706"},
          {label:"Overdue", value:overdue.length,                                color:"#dc2626"},
        ].map(s=>(
          <div key={s.label} style={{...S_TASKBO.card,textAlign:"center",padding:"12px 8px"}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,color:s.color}}>{s.value}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.label}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Controls */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:18,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["board","ðŸ—‚ï¸ Board"],["list","ðŸ“‹ List"],["mine","ðŸ‘¤ My Tasks"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setView(t)} style={view===t?S_TASKBO.btnSolid():S_TASKBO.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
        <div style={{flex:1}}/>
        <input style={{...S_TASKBO.inp,width:200,margin:0}} placeholder="ðŸ” Searchâ€¦" value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} />
        <select style={{...S_TASKBO.sel,width:160}} value={filterSub} onChange={e=>setFilterSub(e.target.value)}>
          {SUBTEAMS_SUBTEAMS1.map(s=><option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* Board view */}
      {view==="board" && (
        <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(5,1fr)",gap:12,overflowX:"auto"}}>
          {COLUMNS.map(col => {
            const c = COL_COLORS[col];
            const colTasks = filtered.filter(t=>t.status===col);
            return (
              <div key={col} style={{minWidth:160}}>
                <div style={{background:c+"15",border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:10,padding:"8px 12px",marginBottom:10,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                  <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,color:c}}>{col}</span>
                  <span style={{background:c,color:"#fff",borderRadius:20,padding:"1px 8px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700}}>{colTasks.length}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
                  {colTasks.map(task => {
                    const pc = PRIORITY_COLORS[task.priority]||"#9ca3af";
                    const ov = isOverdue(task);
                    return (
                      <div key={task.id} style={{background:"#fff",border:"1px solid " + (ov?"#fca5a5":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 12px",boxShadow:"0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)",cursor:"pointer"}} onClick={()=>openEdit(task)}>
                        {ov && <div style={{fontSize:10,color:"#dc2626",fontWeight:700,marginBottom:4}}>âš ï¸ OVERDUE</div>}
                        <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:6,lineHeight:1.3}}>{task.title}</div>
                        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:6}}>
                          <span style={{...S_TASKBO.badge(pc),fontSize:10}}>{task.priority}</span>
                          {task.subteam && <span style={{...S_TASKBO.badge("#7c3aed"),fontSize:10}}>{task.subteam}</span>}
                        </div>
                        {task.assignee && <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¤ {task.assignee}</div>}
                        {task.dueDate && <div style={{fontSize:11,color:ov?"#dc2626":"#9ca3af"}}>ðŸ“… {fmt(task.dueDate)}</div>}
                        {/* Move buttons */}
                        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4,marginTop:8}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
                          {col !== COLUMNS[0] && (
                            <button style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#6b7280",border:"none",borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 6px",fontSize:10,cursor:"pointer"}}
                              onClick={()=>moveTask(task.id, COLUMNS[COLUMNS.indexOf(col)-1])}>â†</button>
                          )}
                          {col !== COLUMNS[COLUMNS.length-1] && (
                            <button style={{background:c+"18",color:c,border:"none",borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 6px",fontSize:10,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700}}
                              onClick={()=>moveTask(task.id, COLUMNS[COLUMNS.indexOf(col)+1])}>â†’</button>
                          )}
                          {isAdmin && (
                            <button style={{background:"#fef2f2",color:"#dc2626",border:"none",borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 6px",fontSize:10,cursor:"pointer",marginLeft:"auto"}}
                              onClick={()=>deleteTask(task.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                  {/* Add quick task */}
                  <button style={{background:"transparent",border:"1.5px dashed #e2e8f0",borderRadius:10,padding:"8px",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,width:"100%"}}
                    onClick={()=>{setForm({...EMPTY_EMPTY2,status:col});setEditId(null);setModal(true);}}>
                    + Add
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* List view */}
      {view==="list" && (
        <div style={S_TASKBO.card}>
          {filtered.length===0 && <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No tasks found.</div>}
          {filtered.map(task => {
            const pc = PRIORITY_COLORS[task.priority]||"#9ca3af";
            const cc = COL_COLORS[task.status]||"#9ca3af";
            const ov = isOverdue(task);
            return (
              <div key={task.id} style={{display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",padding:"10px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",cursor:"pointer"}} onClick={()=>openEdit(task)}>
                <div style={{flex:1}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6}}>
                    {task.title}
                    {ov && <span style={{fontSize:10,color:"#dc2626",fontWeight:800}}>âš ï¸ OVERDUE</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>
                    {task.assignee && <span>ðŸ‘¤ {task.assignee} Â· </span>}
                    {task.subteam && <span>{task.subteam} Â· </span>}
                    {task.dueDate && <span>ðŸ“… {fmt(task.dueDate)}</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexShrink:0}}>
                  <span style={S_TASKBO.badge(pc)}>{task.priority}</span>
                  <span style={S_TASKBO.badge(cc)}>{task.status}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* My tasks view */}
      {view==="mine" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          {myTasks.length===0 && <div style={{...S_TASKBO.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No tasks assigned to you right now! ðŸŽ‰</div>}
          {myTasks.map(task => {
            const pc = PRIORITY_COLORS[task.priority]||"#9ca3af";
            const cc = COL_COLORS[task.status]||"#9ca3af";
            const ov = isOverdue(task);
            return (
              <div key={task.id} style={{...S_TASKBO.card,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (pc),cursor:"pointer"}} onClick={()=>openEdit(task)}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:4}}>{task.title}</div>
                    {task.description && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:6}}>{task.description}</div>}
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
                      <span style={S_TASKBO.badge(pc)}>{task.priority}</span>
                      <span style={S_TASKBO.badge(cc)}>{task.status}</span>
                      {task.subteam && <span style={S_TASKBO.badge("#7c3aed")}>{task.subteam}</span>}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {task.dueDate && <span style={{fontSize:13,color:ov?"#dc2626":"#9ca3af",fontWeight:ov?700:400}}>ðŸ“… {fmt(task.dueDate)}{ov?" âš ï¸":""}</span>}
                </div>
                {/* Quick move */}
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,marginTop:10}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
                  {COLUMNS.filter(c=>c!==task.status).slice(0,3).map(col=>(
                    <button key={col} style={{...S_TASKBO.btn(COL_COLORS[col]),padding:"4px 10px",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>moveTask(task.id, col)}>â†’ {col}</button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit task modal */}
      {modal && (
        <Modal title={editId?"âœï¸ Edit Task":"ðŸ“Œ New Task"} onClose={()=>{setModal(false);setEditId(null);}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={S_TASKBO.label}>Title*</label><input style={S_TASKBO.inp} value={form.title} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,title:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div><label style={S_TASKBO.label}>Description</label><textarea style={{...S_TASKBO.inp,minHeight:70,resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}} value={form.description} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,description:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_TASKBO.label}>Status</label>
                <select style={S_TASKBO.sel} value={form.status} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,status:e.target.value}))}>
                  {COLUMNS.map(c=><option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={S_TASKBO.label}>Priority</label>
                <select style={S_TASKBO.sel} value={form.priority} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,priority:e.target.value}))}>
                  {PRIORITIES.map(p=><option key={p} value={p}>{p}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={S_TASKBO.label}>Subteam</label>
                <select style={S_TASKBO.sel} value={form.subteam} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,subteam:e.target.value}))}>
                  {SUBTEAMS_SUBTEAMS1.filter(s=>s!=="All").map(s=><option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={S_TASKBO.label}>Assigned To</label><input style={S_TASKBO.inp} placeholder="Member name" value={form.assignee} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,assignee:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_TASKBO.label}>Due Date</label><input style={S_TASKBO.inp} type="date" value={form.dueDate} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,dueDate:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8}}>
              <button style={S_TASKBO.btnSolid()} onClick={saveTask}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Create"} Task</button>
              {editId && isAdmin && <button style={S_TASKBO.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2")} onClick={async()=>{await deleteTask(editId);setModal(false);setEditId(null);}}>ðŸ—‘ï¸ Delete</button>}
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Modal({title,onClose,children}){

    <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={onClose}>

function SafetyModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [myCerts, setMyCerts]   = useState([]);
  const [allCerts, setAllCerts] = useState({});  // { uid: [toolIds] }
  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState([]);
  const [checklist, setChecklist] = useState([]);
  const [tab,    setTab]    = useState("certs");
  const [modal,  setModal]  = useState(null);
  const [incForm, setIncForm] = useState({ type:"Near Miss", description:"", location:"", severity:"Low", action:"" });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const uid = user.name;

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setMyCerts((await moduleStoreGet("safety-certs:" + (uid))) || []);
    setAllCerts((await moduleStoreGet("safety-all-certs", true)) || {});
    setIncidents((await moduleStoreGet("safety-incidents", true)) || []);
    setChecklist((await moduleStoreGet("safety-checklist:" + (uid))) || []);
    setLoading(false);
  }, [uid]);
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);

  const certifyTool = async (toolId) => {
    const updated = [...new Set([...myCerts, toolId])];
    await moduleStoreSet("safety-certs:" + (uid), updated);
    // Update shared cert map
    const all = { ...allCerts, [uid]: updated };
    await moduleStoreSet("safety-all-certs", all, true);
    setMyCerts(updated); setAllCerts(all);
  };

  const revokeCert = async (memberName, toolId) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Revoke " + (memberName) + "'s certification for this tool?")) return;
    const memberCerts = (allCerts[memberName]||[]).filter(t=>t!==toolId);
    const all = { ...allCerts, [memberName]: memberCerts };
    await moduleStoreSet("safety-all-certs", all, true);
    setAllCerts(all);
    if (memberName===uid) setMyCerts(memberCerts);
  };

  const certifyMember = async (memberName, toolId) => {
    const memberCerts = [...new Set([...(allCerts[memberName]||[]), toolId])];
    const all = { ...allCerts, [memberName]: memberCerts };
    await moduleStoreSet("safety-all-certs", all, true);
    setAllCerts(all);
  };

  const fileIncident = async () => {
    if (!incForm.description.trim()) return alert("Description is required.");
    const updated = [...incidents, { ...incForm, id:Date.now().toString(), reportedBy:uid, date:new Date().toISOString() }];
    await moduleStoreSet("safety-incidents", updated, true);
    setIncidents(updated); setModal(null); setIncForm({type:"Near Miss",description:"",location:"",severity:"Low",action:""});
  };

  const toggleChecklist = async (item) => {
    const updated = checklist.includes(item) ? checklist.filter(i=>i!==item) : [...checklist, item];
    await moduleStoreSet("safety-checklist:" + (uid), updated);
    setChecklist(updated);
  };

  const certPct = myCerts.length / TOOLS.length * 100;

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading safety dataâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸ¦º Safety</div>

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["certs","ðŸ”§ My Certifications"],["checklist","âœ… Safety Checklist"],["incidents","ðŸ“‹ Incidents"],
          ...(isAdmin ? [["admin","ðŸ‘‘ Admin View"]] : [])
        ].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?S_SAFETY.btnSolid():S_SAFETY.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
        <div style={{flex:1}}/>
        <button style={S_SAFETY.btnSolid("#d97706")} onClick={()=>setModal("incident")}>âš ï¸ Report Incident</button>
      </div>

      {/* My Certifications */}
      {tab==="certs" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {/* Progress */}
          <div style={S_SAFETY.card}>
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:8}}>
              <span style={{fontWeight:700}}>Tool Certifications</span>
              <span style={{fontWeight:700,color:"#dc2626"}}>{myCerts.length} / {TOOLS.length}</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:10,overflow:"hidden"}}>
              <div style={{width:(certPct) + "%",height:"100%",background:"linear-gradient(90deg,#dc2626,#ea580c)",borderRadius:99,transition:"width 0.5s"}} />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Tool grid */}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
            {TOOLS.map(tool => {
              const certified = myCerts.includes(tool.id);
              return (
                <div key={tool.id} style={{...S_SAFETY.card,padding:"14px 16px",border:"1.5px solid " + (certified?"#16a34a":"#e2e8f0"),background:certified?"#f0fdf4":"#fff"}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:8}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:24}}>{tool.icon}</span>
                    <span style={{...S_SAFETY.badge(tool.level==="Basic"?"#16a34a":tool.level==="Intermediate"?"#d97706":"#dc2626"),fontSize:10}}>{tool.level}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:8}}>{tool.name}</div>
                  {certified
                    ? <div style={{color:"#16a34a",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13}}>âœ… Certified</div>
                    : isAdmin
                      ? <button style={{...S_SAFETY.btnSolid("#16a34a"),padding:"5px 12px",fontSize:12,width:"100%"}} onClick={()=>certifyTool(tool.id)}>Certify Self</button>
                      : <div style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12}}>Not yet certified â€” ask a mentor</div>
                  }
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Safety Checklist */}
      {tab==="checklist" && (
        <div style={S_SAFETY.card}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:6}}>Daily Shop Safety Checklist</div>
          <div style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16}}>Complete before starting work each day.</div>
          <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:8,marginBottom:18,overflow:"hidden"}}>
            <div style={{width:(checklist.length/SAFETY_CHECKLIST.length*100) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#16a34a",borderRadius:99,transition:"width 0.3s"}} />
          </div>
          {SAFETY_CHECKLIST.map(item => (
            <label key={item} style={{display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",padding:"10px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14}}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={checklist.includes(item)} onChange={()=>toggleChecklist(item)}
                style={{accentColor:"#16a34a",width:18,height:18,flexShrink:0}} />
              <span style={{color:checklist.includes(item)?"#16a34a":"#374151",textDecoration:checklist.includes(item)?"line-through":"none"}}>
                {item}
              </span>
            </label>
          ))}
          {checklist.length===SAFETY_CHECKLIST.length && (
            <div style={{marginTop:16,background:"#dcfce7",borderRadius:8,padding:"12px 16px",color:"#15803d",fontWeight:700,textAlign:"center"}}>
              âœ… All safety checks complete! Safe working!
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Incidents */}
      {tab==="incidents" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          {incidents.length===0 && <div style={{...S_SAFETY.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No incidents reported. Stay safe! ðŸ¦º</div>}
          {[...incidents].reverse().map(inc => {
            const sc = {Low:"#16a34a",Medium:"#d97706",High:"#ea580c",Critical:"#dc2626"}[inc.severity]||"#9ca3af";
            return (
              <div key={inc.id} style={{...S_SAFETY.card,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (sc)}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:8}}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15}}>{inc.type}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{fmt(inc.date)} Â· Reported by {inc.reportedBy}{inc.location&&" Â· ðŸ“ " + (inc.location)}</div>
                  </div>
                  <span style={S_SAFETY.badge(sc)}>{inc.severity}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.6}}>{inc.description}</div>
                {inc.action && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#7c3aed",marginTop:8}}>âœ… Action taken: {inc.action}</div>}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Admin view */}
      {tab==="admin" && isAdmin && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15}}>Team Certification Status</div>
          {Object.entries(allCerts).map(([name, certs]) => (
            <div key={name} style={S_SAFETY.card}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:10}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15}}>{name}</div>
                <span style={S_SAFETY.badge("#1d4ed8")}>{certs.length}/{TOOLS.length} tools</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:6,marginBottom:10}}>
                <div style={{width:(certs.length/TOOLS.length*100) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#dc2626",borderRadius:99}} />
              </div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:6}}>
                {TOOLS.map(tool => (
                  <span key={tool.id}
                    style={{background:certs.includes(tool.id)?"#dcfce7":"#f1f5f9",color:certs.includes(tool.id)?"#16a34a":"#9ca3af",borderRadius:6,padding:"3px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,cursor:"pointer"}}
                    onClick={()=>certs.includes(tool.id)?revokeCert(name,tool.id):certifyMember(name,tool.id)}>
                    {tool.icon} {tool.name}{certs.includes(tool.id)?" âœ…":" +"}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Report Incident Modal */}
      {modal==="incident" && (
        <Modal title="âš ï¸ Report Safety Incident" onClose={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div style={{background:"#fff7ed",border:"1px solid #fed7aa",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 14px",fontSize:13,color:"#c2410c"}}>
              For medical emergencies, call 911 first. This form is for documentation purposes.
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_SAFETY.label}>Incident Type</label>
              <select style={S_SAFETY.sel} value={incForm.type} onChange={e=>setIncForm(p=>({...p,type:e.target.value}))}>
                {["Near Miss","Minor Injury","Property Damage","Equipment Failure","Other"].map(t=><option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={S_SAFETY.label}>Severity</label>
                <select style={S_SAFETY.sel} value={incForm.severity} onChange={e=>setIncForm(p=>({...p,severity:e.target.value}))}>
                  {["Low","Medium","High","Critical"].map(s=><option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={S_SAFETY.label}>Location</label><input style={S_SAFETY.inp} placeholder="e.g. Machine shop" value={incForm.location} onChange={e=>setIncForm(p=>({...p,location:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <div><label style={S_SAFETY.label}>Description*</label><textarea style={{...S_SAFETY.inp,minHeight:80,resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}} value={incForm.description} onChange={e=>setIncForm(p=>({...p,description:e.target.value}))} placeholder="What happened? What was the cause?" /></div>
            <div><label style={S_SAFETY.label}>Corrective Action Taken</label><textarea style={{...S_SAFETY.inp,minHeight:50,resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}} value={incForm.action} onChange={e=>setIncForm(p=>({...p,action:e.target.value}))} placeholder="What was done to address the situation?" /></div>
            <button style={S_SAFETY.btnSolid("#d97706")} onClick={fileIncident}>ðŸ“‹ File Report</button>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}



// â”€â”€â”€ ROBOTSPECMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Robot spec sheet, battery log, match configs, and inspection checklist.

const RS = {
  card:    { background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:     (c="#0284c7",b="#f0f9ff")=>({ background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnS:    (bg="#0284c7")=>({ background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:     { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none" },
  sel:     { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",background:"#fff" },
  lbl:     { fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block" },
  badge:   (c="#0284c7")=>({ background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block" }),
};

const INSPECTION_ITEMS = [
  { cat:"Frame", items:["Frame perimeter within rules","Frame material legal","Bumpers properly attached","Bumper numbers visible"] },
  { cat:"Electrical", items:["Main breaker accessible","Battery secured","All wires protected","Motor controllers legal","CAN bus wired correctly","RoboRIO/Control Hub mounted securely"] },
  { cat:"Mechanical", items:["No sharp edges","All mechanisms within frame when retracted","Weight within limit","Starting configuration within size rules"] },
  { cat:"Software", items:["Robot code loaded","Driver Station connected","Motors respond correctly","Pneumatics tested (if applicable)","Robot disabled and enabled successfully"] },
  { cat:"Safety", items:["Emergency stop tested","Bumpers cover perimeter","No exposed spinning parts near humans","Battery fully charged"] },
];

function RobotSpecModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [spec,    setSpec]    = React.useState({});
  const [batteries, setBatteries] = React.useState([]);
  const [configs, setConfigs] = React.useState([]);
  const [inspection, setInspection] = React.useState([]);
  const [tab,  setTab]  = React.useState("spec");
  const [editing, setEditing] = React.useState(false);
  const [specForm, setSpecForm] = React.useState({});
  const [batForm, setBatForm]   = React.useState({ label:"", capacity:"18", age:"", notes:"" });
  const [cfgForm, setCfgForm]   = React.useState({ name:"", description:"", matchType:"Quals" });
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      const s = (await moduleStoreGet("robot-spec", true)) || {};
      const b = (await moduleStoreGet("robot-batteries", true)) || [];
      const c = (await moduleStoreGet("robot-configs", true)) || [];
      const i = (await moduleStoreGet("robot-inspection:" + (user.name))) || [];
      setSpec(s); setBatteries(b); setConfigs(c); setInspection(i); setSpecForm(s);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  }, [user.name]);

  const saveSpec = async () => {
    await moduleStoreSet("robot-spec", specForm, true);
    setSpec(specForm); setEditing(false);
  };

  const addBattery = async () => {
    if (!batForm.label) return alert("Battery label required.");
    const b = [...batteries, { ...batForm, id:Date.now().toString(), addedAt:new Date().toISOString(), cycles:0, lastCharge:null }];
    await moduleStoreSet("robot-batteries", b, true); setBatteries(b); setBatForm({label:"",capacity:"18",age:"",notes:""});
  };

  const logCharge = async (id) => {
    const b = batteries.map(bat => bat.id===id ? {...bat, cycles:(bat.cycles||0)+1, lastCharge:new Date().toISOString()} : bat);
    await moduleStoreSet("robot-batteries", b, true); setBatteries(b);
  };

  const addConfig = async () => {
    if (!cfgForm.name) return alert("Config name required.");
