    const c = [...configs, { ...cfgForm, id:Date.now().toString(), by:user.name, at:new Date().toISOString() }];
    await moduleStoreSet("robot-configs", c, true); setConfigs(c); setCfgForm({name:"",description:"",matchType:"Quals"});
  };

  const toggleInspection = async (item) => {
    const u = inspection.includes(item) ? inspection.filter(i=>i!==item) : [...inspection, item];
    await moduleStoreSet("robot-inspection:" + (user.name), u); setInspection(u);
  };

  const allItems = INSPECTION_ITEMS.flatMap(c=>c.items);
  const inspPct  = allItems.length ? Math.round(inspection.length/allItems.length*100) : 0;
  const fmtDate  = iso => iso ? new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-US",{month:"short",day:"numeric"}) : "â€”";

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading robot dataâ€¦</div>;

  const SPEC_FIELDS = [
    ["teamNumber","Team Number"],["robotName","Robot Name"],["season","Season/Game"],
    ["weightLbs","Weight (lbs)"],["heightIn","Height (in)"],["widthIn","Width (in)"],
    ["lengthIn","Length (in)"],["driveType","Drivetrain"],["motors","Drive Motors"],
    ["controller","Controller (RoboRIO / Control Hub)"],["language","Programming Language"],
    ["githubRepo","GitHub Repo URL"],["notes","Notes"],
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸ¤– Robot Spec</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["spec","ðŸ“‹ Spec Sheet"],["batteries","ðŸ”‹ Batteries"],["configs","âš™ï¸ Match Configs"],["inspection","âœ… Inspection"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?RS.btnS():RS.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {tab==="spec" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{...RS.card}}>
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:16}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17}}>ðŸ¤– {spec.robotName||"Unnamed Robot"} {spec.teamNumber&&"(#" + (spec.teamNumber) + ")"}</div>
              {isAdmin && <button style={RS.btn()} onClick={()=>setEditing(!editing)}>{editing?"Cancel":"âœï¸ Edit"}</button>}
            </div>
            {editing ? (
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
                {SPEC_FIELDS.map(([k,label])=>(
                  <div key={k} style={k==="notes"?{gridColumn:"1/-1"}:{}}>
                    <label style={RS.lbl}>{label}</label>
                    {k==="notes"
                      ? <textarea style={{...RS.inp,minHeight:60,resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}} value={specForm[k]||""} onChange={e=>setSpecForm(p=>({...p,[k]:e.target.value}))} />
                      : <input style={RS.inp} value={specForm[k]||""} onChange={e=>setSpecForm(p=>({...p,[k]:e.target.value}))} />
                    }
                  </div>
                ))}
                <div style={{gridColumn:"1/-1"}}>
                  <button style={RS.btnS()} onClick={saveSpec}>ðŸ’¾ Save Spec</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
                {SPEC_FIELDS.filter(([k])=>spec[k]).map(([k,label])=>(
                  <div key={k} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 14px",gridColumn:k==="notes"?"1/-1":"auto"}}>
                    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:2}}>{label}</div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,color:"#1e293b",wordBreak:"break-all"}}>{spec[k]}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {Object.keys(spec).length===0 && (
                  <div style={{gridColumn:"1/-1",textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No spec data yet. {isAdmin&&"Click Edit to add robot specs."}</div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab==="batteries" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {isAdmin && (
            <div style={RS.card}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12}}>âž• Add Battery</div>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                <div><label style={RS.lbl}>Label</label><input style={RS.inp} placeholder="e.g. Bat-01" value={batForm.label} onChange={e=>setBatForm(p=>({...p,label:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={RS.lbl}>Capacity (Ah)</label><input style={RS.inp} type="number" value={batForm.capacity} onChange={e=>setBatForm(p=>({...p,capacity:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={RS.lbl}>Age (months)</label><input style={RS.inp} type="number" value={batForm.age} onChange={e=>setBatForm(p=>({...p,age:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              </div>
              <button style={{...RS.btnS(),marginTop:10}} onClick={addBattery}>Add Battery</button>
            </div>
          )}
          {batteries.length===0 && <div style={{...RS.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No batteries tracked.</div>}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))",gap:12}}>
            {batteries.map(bat=>{
              const old = bat.age > 18;
              const warn = bat.cycles > 200;
              return (
                <div key={bat.id} style={{...RS.card,border:"1.5px solid " + (warn||old?"#fca5a5":"#e2e8f0")}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:6}}>ðŸ”‹ {bat.label}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>Capacity: {bat.capacity}Ah</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>Charge cycles: <b>{bat.cycles||0}</b></div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>Last charge: {fmtDate(bat.lastCharge)}</div>
                  {bat.age && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:old?"#dc2626":"#6b7280"}}>Age: {bat.age} months{old?" âš ï¸ Old":""}</div>}
                  {warn && <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#dc2626",fontWeight:700,marginTop:4}}>âš ï¸ High cycle count â€” test capacity</div>}
                  <button style={{...RS.btnS("#16a34a"),width:"100%",marginTop:10,padding:"7px"}} onClick={()=>logCharge(bat.id)}>Log Charge Cycle</button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab==="configs" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={RS.card}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12}}>âž• Add Match Config</div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
              <div><label style={RS.lbl}>Config Name</label><input style={RS.inp} placeholder="e.g. Defense Mode" value={cfgForm.name} onChange={e=>setCfgForm(p=>({...p,name:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={RS.lbl}>Match Type</label>
                <select style={RS.sel} value={cfgForm.matchType} onChange={e=>setCfgForm(p=>({...p,matchType:e.target.value}))}>
                  {["Quals","Playoffs","Both"].map(t=><option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div style={{gridColumn:"1/-1"}}><label style={RS.lbl}>Description</label><textarea style={{...RS.inp,minHeight:60,resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}} value={cfgForm.description} onChange={e=>setCfgForm(p=>({...p,description:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <button style={{...RS.btnS(),marginTop:10}} onClick={addConfig}>Add Config</button>
          </div>
          {configs.map(c=>(
            <div key={c.id} style={{...RS.card,borderLeft:"4px solid #0284c7"}}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:6}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>âš™ï¸ {c.name}</div>
                <span style={RS.badge()}>{c.matchType}</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.6}}>{c.description}</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:6}}>Added by {c.by} Â· {fmtDate(c.at)}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
          {configs.length===0 && <div style={{...RS.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No configurations saved yet.</div>}
        </div>
      )}

      {tab==="inspection" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={RS.card}>
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:8}}>
              <span style={{fontWeight:700}}>Inspection Progress</span>
              <span style={{fontWeight:700,color:inspPct===100?"#16a34a":"#d97706"}}>{inspection.length}/{allItems.length} â€” {inspPct}%</span>
            </div>
            <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:10,overflow:"hidden"}}>
              <div style={{width:(inspPct) + "%",height:"100%",background:inspPct===100?"#16a34a":"linear-gradient(90deg,#0284c7,#7c3aed)",borderRadius:99,transition:"width 0.4s"}} />
            </div>
            {inspPct===100 && <div style={{marginTop:10,background:"#dcfce7",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px",color:"#15803d",fontWeight:700,textAlign:"center"}}>âœ… Robot is inspection-ready!</div>}
          </div>
          {INSPECTION_ITEMS.map(cat=>(
            <div key={cat.cat} style={RS.card}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12,color:"#0284c7"}}>{cat.cat}</div>
              {cat.items.map(item=>(
                <label key={item} style={{display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",padding:"9px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14}}>
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={inspection.includes(item)} onChange={()=>toggleInspection(item)} style={{accentColor:"#16a34a",width:17,height:17,flexShrink:0}} />
                  <span style={{color:inspection.includes(item)?"#16a34a":"#374151",textDecoration:inspection.includes(item)?"line-through":"none"}}>{item}</span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ MEDIAMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Photo gallery (URL-based), reveal video embed, press links, social feed.

const MD = {
  card:  { background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:   (c="#7c3aed",b="#faf5ff")=>({ background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnS:  (bg="#7c3aed")=>({ background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:   { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none" },
  lbl:   { fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block" },
  badge: (c="#7c3aed")=>({ background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block" }),
};


function YTEmbed({videoId}) {
  if (!videoId) return null;
  return (
    <div style={{position:"relative",paddingTop:"56.25%",borderRadius:10,overflow:"hidden",background:"#000"}}>
      <iframe
        style={{position:"absolute",top:0,left:0,width:"100%",height:"100%"}}
        src={"https://www.youtube.com/embed/" + (videoId)}
        title="Video" frameBorder="0"
        allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
        allowFullScreen />
    </div>
  );
}

function MediaModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [photos,  setPhotos]  = React.useState([]);
  const [press,   setPress]   = React.useState([]);
  const [social,  setSocial]  = React.useState({});
  const [revealId, setRevealId] = React.useState("");
  const [tab,  setTab]  = React.useState("gallery");
  const [modal, setModal] = React.useState(null);
  const [photoForm, setPhotoForm] = React.useState({url:"",caption:"",category:"Competition",photographer:""});
  const [pressForm, setPressForm] = React.useState({title:"",url:"",source:"",date:""});
  const [socialForm, setSocialForm] = React.useState({});
  const [revealForm, setRevealForm] = React.useState("");
  const [filterCat, setFilterCat] = React.useState("All");
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  const PHOTO_CATS = ["Competition","Outreach","Build Season","Team Photo","Pit","Other"];
  const SOCIAL_KEYS = [
    {k:"instagram",label:"Instagram",icon:"ðŸ“¸",color:"#e1306c"},
    {k:"youtube",label:"YouTube",icon:"â–¶ï¸",color:"#dc2626"},
    {k:"tiktok",label:"TikTok",icon:"ðŸŽµ",color:"#374151"},
    {k:"twitter",label:"X / Twitter",icon:"âœ–ï¸",color:"#374151"},
    {k:"facebook",label:"Facebook",icon:"ðŸ“˜",color:"#1d4ed8"},
    {k:"website",label:"Team Website",icon:"ðŸŒ",color:"#0891b2"},
  ];

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setPhotos((await moduleStoreGet("media-photos",true))||[]);
      setPress((await moduleStoreGet("media-press",true))||[]);
      setSocial((await moduleStoreGet("media-social",true))||{});
      setRevealId((await moduleStoreGet("media-reveal",true))||"");
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[]);

  const addPhoto = async () => {
    if (!photoForm.url) return alert("Image URL required.");
    const u = [...photos,{...photoForm,id:Date.now().toString(),addedBy:user.name,addedAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("media-photos",u,true); setPhotos(u); setModal(null); setPhotoForm({url:"",caption:"",category:"Competition",photographer:""});
  };

  const delPhoto = async id => {
    const u=photos.filter(p=>p.id!==id); await moduleStoreSet("media-photos",u,true); setPhotos(u);
  };

  const addPress = async () => {
    if (!pressForm.title||!pressForm.url) return alert("Title and URL required.");
    const u = [...press,{...pressForm,id:Date.now().toString(),addedBy:user.name}];
    await moduleStoreSet("media-press",u,true); setPress(u); setModal(null); setPressForm({title:"",url:"",source:"",date:""});
  };

  const saveSocial = async () => {
    await moduleStoreSet("media-social",socialForm,true); setSocial(socialForm); setModal(null);
  };

  const saveReveal = async () => {
    // Extract YouTube ID from URL or bare ID
    let id = revealForm.trim();
    const m = id.match(/(?:v=|youtu\.be\/)([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})/);
    if (m) id = m[1];
    await moduleStoreSet("media-reveal",id,true); setRevealId(id); setModal(null); setRevealForm("");
  };

  const filtered = photos.filter(p=>filterCat==="All"||p.category===filterCat);

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading mediaâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸŽ¬ Media Library</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["gallery","ðŸ“¸ Photo Gallery"],["reveal","ðŸŽ¥ Reveal Video"],["press","ðŸ“° Press Coverage"],["social","ðŸŒ Social Links"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?MD.btnS():MD.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Photo Gallery */}
      {tab==="gallery" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",alignItems:"center"}}>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flex:1,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
              {["All",...PHOTO_CATS].map(c=>(
                <button key={c} onClick={()=>setFilterCat(c)} style={filterCat===c?{...MD.btnS(),padding:"5px 12px",fontSize:12}:{...MD.btn(),padding:"5px 12px",fontSize:12}}>{c}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
            {isAdmin && <button style={MD.btnS()} onClick={()=>setModal("photo")}>+ Add Photo</button>}
          </div>
          {filtered.length===0 && <div style={{...MD.card,textAlign:"center",padding:50,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No photos yet. Add image URLs to build the gallery.</div>}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr))",gap:14}}>
            {filtered.map(p=>(
              <div key={p.id} style={{borderRadius:12,overflow:"hidden",background:"#fff",boxShadow:"0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
                <div style={{width:"100%",height:160,background:"#f1f5f9",overflow:"hidden"}}>
                  <img src={p.url} alt={p.caption||""} style={{width:"100%",height:"100%",objectFit:"cover"}} onError={e=>{e.target.style.display="none";}} />
                </div>
                <div style={{padding:"10px 12px"}}>
                  {p.caption && <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:4}}>{p.caption}</div>}
                  <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                    <span style={MD.badge()}>{p.category}</span>
                    {isAdmin && <button style={{background:"none",border:"none",cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:14}} onClick={()=>delPhoto(p.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>}
                  </div>
                  {p.photographer && <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>ðŸ“· {p.photographer}</div>}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Reveal Video */}
      {tab==="reveal" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {revealId ? (
            <div style={MD.card}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:14}}>ðŸŽ¥ Robot Reveal Video</div>
              <YTEmbed videoId={revealId} />
              {isAdmin && (
                <button style={{...MD.btn(),marginTop:12}} onClick={()=>{setRevealForm(revealId);setModal("reveal");}}>âœï¸ Change Video</button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div style={{...MD.card,textAlign:"center",padding:50}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:48,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸŽ¬</div>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:16,marginBottom:8}}>No reveal video set yet</div>
              {isAdmin && <button style={MD.btnS()} onClick={()=>{setRevealForm("");setModal("reveal");}}>+ Add Reveal Video</button>}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Press Coverage */}
      {tab==="press" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          {isAdmin && <button style={{...MD.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={()=>setModal("press")}>+ Add Coverage</button>}
          {press.length===0 && <div style={{...MD.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No press coverage logged yet.</div>}
          {press.map(p=>(
            <div key={p.id} style={{...MD.card,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
              <div>
                <a href={p.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,color:"#7c3aed",textDecoration:"none"}}>{p.title} â†—</a>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:2}}>{p.source&&<span>ðŸ“° {p.source}</span>}{p.date&&<span> Â· {fmt(p.date)}</span>}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Social Links */}
      {tab==="social" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          {isAdmin && <button style={{...MD.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={()=>{setSocialForm({...social});setModal("social");}}>âœï¸ Edit Links</button>}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))",gap:12}}>
            {SOCIAL_KEYS.map(s=>social[s.k]?(
              <a key={s.k} href={social[s.k]} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
                style={{...MD.card,display:"flex",gap:14,alignItems:"center",textDecoration:"none",color:"inherit",cursor:"pointer",transition:"transform 0.15s",border:"1.5px solid " + (s.color) + "30"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:28}}>{s.icon}</div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,color:s.color}}>{s.label}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2,overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap",maxWidth:130}}>{social[s.k]}</div>
                </div>
              </a>
            ):(
              <div key={s.k} style={{...MD.card,display:"flex",gap:14,alignItems:"center",opacity:0.4}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:28}}>{s.icon}</div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{s.label}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Not set</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modals */}
      {modal==="photo" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:480,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸ“¸ Add Photo</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
              <div><label style={MD.lbl}>Image URL*</label><input style={MD.inp} placeholder="https://â€¦" value={photoForm.url} onChange={e=>setPhotoForm(p=>({...p,url:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={MD.lbl}>Caption</label><input style={MD.inp} value={photoForm.caption} onChange={e=>setPhotoForm(p=>({...p,caption:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={MD.lbl}>Photographer</label><input style={MD.inp} value={photoForm.photographer} onChange={e=>setPhotoForm(p=>({...p,photographer:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={MD.lbl}>Category</label>
                <select style={{...MD.inp,background:"#fff"}} value={photoForm.category} onChange={e=>setPhotoForm(p=>({...p,category:e.target.value}))}>
                  {PHOTO_CATS.map(c=><option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <button style={MD.btnS()} onClick={addPhoto}>ðŸ’¾ Add Photo</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {modal==="reveal" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:440,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸŽ¥ Set Reveal Video</div>
            <label style={MD.lbl}>YouTube URL or Video ID</label>
            <input style={MD.inp} placeholder="https://youtube.com/watch?v=â€¦ or video ID" value={revealForm} onChange={e=>setRevealForm(e.target.value)} />
            <button style={{...MD.btnS(),marginTop:12,width:"100%"}} onClick={saveReveal}>ðŸ’¾ Save</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {modal==="press" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:480,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸ“° Add Press Coverage</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
              <div><label style={MD.lbl}>Headline*</label><input style={MD.inp} value={pressForm.title} onChange={e=>setPressForm(p=>({...p,title:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={MD.lbl}>URL*</label><input style={MD.inp} placeholder="https://â€¦" value={pressForm.url} onChange={e=>setPressForm(p=>({...p,url:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={MD.lbl}>Source</label><input style={MD.inp} placeholder="e.g. Local Gazette" value={pressForm.source} onChange={e=>setPressForm(p=>({...p,source:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={MD.lbl}>Date</label><input style={MD.inp} type="date" value={pressForm.date} onChange={e=>setPressForm(p=>({...p,date:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <button style={MD.btnS()} onClick={addPress}>ðŸ’¾ Save</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {modal==="social" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:480,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸŒ Edit Social Links</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
              {SOCIAL_KEYS.map(s=>(
                <div key={s.k}><label style={MD.lbl}>{s.icon} {s.label}</label><input style={MD.inp} placeholder={"https://â€¦"} value={socialForm[s.k]||""} onChange={e=>setSocialForm(p=>({...p,[s.k]:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              ))}
              <button style={MD.btnS()} onClick={saveSocial}>ðŸ’¾ Save Links</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ NOTEBOOKMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Engineering notebook: dated entries, categories, search, export.

const NB = {
  card:  { background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:   (c="#374151",b="#f9fafb")=>({ background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnS:  (bg="#374151")=>({ background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:   { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none" },
  lbl:   { fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block" },
  badge: (c="#374151")=>({ background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block" }),
  ta:    { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none",fontFamily:"'Georgia',serif",resize:"vertical",lineHeight:1.8 },
};

const ENTRY_CATS = ["Design","Mechanical","Electrical","Programming","Strategy","Outreach","Meeting Notes","Testing","Other"];
const CAT_COLORS = { Design:"#7c3aed",Mechanical:"#ea580c",Electrical:"#6d28d9",Programming:"#1d4ed8",Strategy:"#dc2626",Outreach:"#0891b2",Meeting:"#059669","Meeting Notes":"#059669",Testing:"#d97706",Other:"#6b7280" };

const fmtShort = iso => iso?new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-US",{month:"short",day:"numeric"}):"â€”";

function NotebookModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [entries, setEntries] = React.useState([]);
  const [view,    setView]    = React.useState("list"); // "list"|"write"|"read"
  const [selEntry, setSelEntry] = React.useState(null);
  const [editId,  setEditId]  = React.useState(null);
  const [form,    setForm]    = React.useState({ title:"",body:"",category:"Design",date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),tags:"" });
  const [search,  setSearch]  = React.useState("");
  const [filterCat, setFilterCat] = React.useState("All");
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setEntries((await moduleStoreGet("notebook-entries",true))||[]);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[]);

  const saveEntry = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()||!form.body.trim()) return alert("Title and body required.");
    let updated;
    if (editId) {
      updated = entries.map(e=>e.id===editId?{...form,id:editId,updatedBy:user.name,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}:e);
    } else {
      updated = [...entries,{...form,id:Date.now().toString(),author:user.name,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("notebook-entries",updated,true);
    setEntries(updated); setView("list"); setEditId(null); setForm({title:"",body:"",category:"Design",date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),tags:""});
  };

  const deleteEntry = async id => {
    if (!window.confirm("Delete this entry?")) return;
    const u=entries.filter(e=>e.id!==id);
    await moduleStoreSet("notebook-entries",u,true); setEntries(u);
    if (selEntry?.id===id){setSelEntry(null);setView("list");}
  };

  const openEntry = e => { setSelEntry(e); setView("read"); };
  const startEdit = e => { setForm({title:e.title,body:e.body,category:e.category||"Design",date:e.date||new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),tags:e.tags||""}); setEditId(e.id); setView("write"); };

  const wordCount = t => t?t.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length:0;

  const filtered = entries
    .filter(e=>(filterCat==="All"||e.category===filterCat) && (!search||e.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||e.body.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||(e.tags||"").toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading notebookâ€¦</div>;

  // â”€â”€ Write view â”€â”€
  if (view==="write") return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20}}>ðŸ““ {editId?"Edit Entry":"New Entry"}</div>
        <button style={NB.btn()} onClick={()=>{setView("list");setEditId(null);}}>â† Back</button>
      </div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
        <div><label style={NB.lbl}>Title</label><input style={NB.inp} value={form.title} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,title:e.target.value}))} placeholder="Entry titleâ€¦" /></div>
        <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
          <div><label style={NB.lbl}>Date</label><input style={NB.inp} type="date" value={form.date} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,date:e.target.value}))} /></div>
          <div><label style={NB.lbl}>Category</label>
            <select style={{...NB.inp,background:"#fff"}} value={form.category} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,category:e.target.value}))}>
              {ENTRY_CATS.map(c=><option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div><label style={NB.lbl}>Tags (comma-separated)</label><input style={NB.inp} placeholder="e.g. arm,cad,v2" value={form.tags} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,tags:e.target.value}))} /></div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <label style={NB.lbl}>Entry Body</label>
          <textarea style={{...NB.ta,minHeight:380}} value={form.body} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,body:e.target.value}))} placeholder={"Describe today's work, decisions made, problems encountered, and next stepsâ€¦\n\nTip: be specific â€” what did you try? what worked? what didn't? why?"} />
          <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>{wordCount(form.body)} words</div>
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10}}>
          <button style={NB.btnS()} onClick={saveEntry}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Save"} Entry</button>
          <button style={NB.btn()} onClick={()=>{setView("list");setEditId(null);}}>Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  // â”€â”€ Read view â”€â”€
  if (view==="read" && selEntry) {
    const c = CAT_COLORS[selEntry.category]||"#6b7280";
    return (
      <div>
        <button style={{...NB.btn(),marginBottom:16}} onClick={()=>{setSelEntry(null);setView("list");}}>â† Back to Notebook</button>
        <div style={NB.card}>
          <div style={{borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",paddingBottom:14,marginBottom:18}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,marginBottom:8}}>{selEntry.title}</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",alignItems:"center"}}>
              <span style={NB.badge(c)}>{selEntry.category}</span>
              <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}}>ðŸ“… {fmt(selEntry.date)}</span>
              <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}}>âœï¸ {selEntry.author}</span>
              <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}}>{wordCount(selEntry.body)} words</span>
            </div>
            {selEntry.tags && (
              <div style={{marginTop:8,display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                {selEntry.tags.split(",").map(t=>t.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(tag=>(
                  <span key={tag} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",borderRadius:4,padding:"2px 8px",fontSize:11}}># {tag}</span>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div style={{fontSize:15,lineHeight:1.9,color:"#1e293b",fontFamily:"'Georgia',serif",whiteSpace:"pre-wrap"}}>{selEntry.body}</div>
          <div style={{borderTop:"1px solid #f1f5f9",marginTop:18,paddingTop:14,display:"flex",gap:10}}>
            <button style={NB.btn()} onClick={()=>startEdit(selEntry)}>âœï¸ Edit</button>
            {isAdmin && <button style={NB.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2")} onClick={()=>deleteEntry(selEntry.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸ Delete</button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // â”€â”€ List view â”€â”€
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24}}>ðŸ““ Engineering Notebook</div>
        <button style={NB.btnS()} onClick={()=>{setForm({title:"",body:"",category:"Design",date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),tags:""});setEditId(null);setView("write");}}>+ New Entry</button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(3,1fr)",gap:12,marginBottom:18}}>
        {[
          {label:"Total Entries",value:entries.length,color:"#374151"},
          {label:"Total Words",  value:entries.reduce((s,e)=>s+wordCount(e.body),0).toLocaleString(),color:"#7c3aed"},
          {label:"Contributors", value:new Set(entries.map(e=>e.author)).size,color:"#059669"},
        ].map(s=>(
          <div key={s.label} style={{...NB.card,textAlign:"center"}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,color:s.color}}>{s.value}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.label}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:14,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        <input style={{...NB.inp,flex:1,minWidth:180}} placeholder="ðŸ” Search entriesâ€¦" value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} />
        <select style={{...NB.inp,width:160,background:"#fff"}} value={filterCat} onChange={e=>setFilterCat(e.target.value)}>
          <option value="All">All Categories</option>
          {ENTRY_CATS.map(c=><option key={c} value={c}>{c}</option>)}
        </select>
      </div>

      {filtered.length===0 && <div style={{...NB.card,textAlign:"center",padding:50,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No entries found. Start documenting!</div>}

      {/* Group by date */}
      {(() => {
        const byDate = {};
        filtered.forEach(e=>{ if(!byDate[e.date]) byDate[e.date]=[]; byDate[e.date].push(e); });
        return Object.entries(byDate).map(([date,dayEntries])=>(
          <div key={date} style={{marginBottom:20}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,fontWeight:800,color:"#9ca3af",letterSpacing:1,textTransform:"uppercase",marginBottom:8}}>{fmt(date)}</div>
            {dayEntries.map(e=>{
              const c=CAT_COLORS[e.category]||"#6b7280";
              return (
                <div key={e.id} style={{...NB.card,marginBottom:10,cursor:"pointer",borderLeft:"4px solid " + (c),transition:"all 0.15s"}}
                  onClick={()=>openEntry(e)}
                  onMouseEnter={ev=>{ev.currentTarget.style.transform="translateX(2px)";}}
                  onMouseLeave={ev=>{ev.currentTarget.style.transform="";}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
                    <div style={{flex:1}}>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:4}}>{e.title}</div>
                      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:6}}>
                        <span style={NB.badge(c)}>{e.category}</span>
                        <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12}}>âœï¸ {e.author}</span>
                        <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12}}>{wordCount(e.body)}w</span>
                      </div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af",overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap",maxWidth:500}}>{e.body.slice(0,120)}â€¦</div>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4,marginLeft:10}} onClick={ev=>ev.stopPropagation()}>
                      <button style={{...NB.btn(),padding:"4px 8px",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>startEdit(e)}>âœï¸</button>
                      {isAdmin && <button style={{...NB.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2"),padding:"4px 8px",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>deleteEntry(e.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ));
      })()}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ DRIVETEAMMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Drive team match log, strategy notes, comms board, and driver analysis.

const DT = {
  card:  { background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:   (c="#dc2626",b="#fef2f2")=>({ background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnS:  (bg="#dc2626")=>({ background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:   { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none" },
  sel:   { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",background:"#fff" },
  lbl:   { fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block" },
  badge: (c="#dc2626")=>({ background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block" }),
  ta:    { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none",fontFamily:"inherit",resize:"vertical" },
};

const RATINGS = [1,2,3,4,5];
const RESULTS = ["Win","Loss","Tie"];
const RESULT_C = {Win:"#16a34a",Loss:"#dc2626",Tie:"#d97706"};

const EMPTY_LOG = { matchNum:"", event:"", result:"Win", allianceScore:"", opponentScore:"", autoScore:"", teleScore:"", endgameScore:"", communication:"3", adaptability:"3", execution:"3", fouls:"0", notes:"", breakdown:"" };

function DriveTeamModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [logs,    setLogs]    = React.useState([]);
  const [drivers, setDrivers] = React.useState([]);
  const [preMatch, setPreMatch] = React.useState([]);
  const [tab,  setTab]  = React.useState("log");
  const [modal, setModal] = React.useState(null);
  const [form,  setForm] = React.useState(EMPTY_LOG);
  const [editId, setEditId] = React.useState(null);
  const [pmForm, setPmForm]  = React.useState({ opponent:"", strategy:"", key1:"", key2:"", key3:"" });
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setLogs((await moduleStoreGet("dt-matchlogs",true))||[]);
      setDrivers((await moduleStoreGet("dt-drivers",true))||[]);
      setPreMatch((await moduleStoreGet("dt-prematch",true))||[]);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[]);

  const saveLog = async () => {
    if (!form.matchNum) return alert("Match number required.");
    let u;
    if (editId) {
      u = logs.map(l=>l.id===editId?{...form,id:editId,by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString()}:l);
    } else {
      u = [...logs,{...form,id:Date.now().toString(),by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString()}];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("dt-matchlogs",u,true); setLogs(u); setModal(null); setForm(EMPTY_LOG); setEditId(null);
  };

  const savePreMatch = async () => {
    if (!pmForm.opponent) return alert("Opponent required.");
    const u = [...preMatch,{...pmForm,id:Date.now().toString(),by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("dt-prematch",u,true); setPreMatch(u); setModal(null); setPmForm({opponent:"",strategy:"",key1:"",key2:"",key3:""});
  };

  const addDriver = async () => {
    const name = window.prompt("Driver name:"); if (!name) return;
    const role = window.prompt("Role (Driver/Operator/Coach/Human Player):") || "Driver";
    const u = [...drivers,{id:Date.now().toString(),name,role}];
    await moduleStoreSet("dt-drivers",u,true); setDrivers(u);
  };

  // Stats
  const wins   = logs.filter(l=>l.result==="Win").length;
  const losses = logs.filter(l=>l.result==="Loss").length;
  const ties   = logs.filter(l=>l.result==="Tie").length;
  const avgScore = logs.length ? Math.round(logs.reduce((s,l)=>s+Number(l.allianceScore||0),0)/logs.length) : 0;
  const avgComm  = logs.length ? (logs.reduce((s,l)=>s+Number(l.communication||3),0)/logs.length).toFixed(1) : "â€”";

  const StarRow = ({label,val,onChange}) => (
    <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:8}}>
      <span style={{fontSize:13,fontWeight:600,color:"#374151"}}>{label}</span>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4}}>
        {RATINGS.map(r=>(
          <button key={r} onClick={()=>onChange(String(r))}
            style={{background:"none",border:"none",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:20,color:Number(val)>=r?"#d97706":"#e2e8f0",padding:"0 1px"}}>â˜…</button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading drive team dataâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸŽ® Drive Team</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["log","ðŸ“‹ Match Log"],["prematch","ðŸ“ Pre-Match"],["stats","ðŸ“Š Analytics"],["roster","ðŸ‘¤ Drive Team"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?DT.btnS():DT.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Match Log */}
      {tab==="log" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"flex-end"}}>
            <button style={DT.btnS()} onClick={()=>{setForm(EMPTY_LOG);setEditId(null);setModal("log");}}>+ Log Match</button>
          </div>
          {logs.length===0 && <div style={{...DT.card,textAlign:"center",padding:50,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No matches logged yet.</div>}
          {[...logs].reverse().map(log=>(
            <div key={log.id} style={{...DT.card,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (RESULT_C[log.result]||"#9ca3af")}}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:10}}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:4}}>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:17}}>Match {log.matchNum}</span>
                    <span style={{...DT.badge(RESULT_C[log.result]),fontSize:13,padding:"3px 12px"}}>{log.result}</span>
                    {log.event && <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>@ {log.event}</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:16,fontSize:13}}>
                    {log.allianceScore && <span>ðŸ”µ Us: <b>{log.allianceScore}</b></span>}
                    {log.opponentScore && <span>ðŸ”´ Them: <b>{log.opponentScore}</b></span>}
                    {log.fouls && Number(log.fouls)>0 && <span style={{color:"#dc2626"}}>âš ï¸ {log.fouls} fouls</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
                  <div style={{textAlign:"right",fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{fmt(log.at)}</div>
                  <button style={{...DT.btn(),padding:"4px 8px",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>{setForm({matchNum:log.matchNum,event:log.event||"",result:log.result,allianceScore:log.allianceScore||"",opponentScore:log.opponentScore||"",autoScore:log.autoScore||"",teleScore:log.teleScore||"",endgameScore:log.endgameScore||"",communication:log.communication||"3",adaptability:log.adaptability||"3",execution:log.execution||"3",fouls:log.fouls||"0",notes:log.notes||"",breakdown:log.breakdown||""});setEditId(log.id);setModal("log");}}>âœï¸</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              {/* Rating pills */}
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:log.notes?10:0,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                {[["Communication",log.communication],["Adaptability",log.adaptability],["Execution",log.execution]].map(([k,v])=>(
                  <div key={k} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",fontSize:11}}>
                    {k}: {"â˜…".repeat(Number(v||3))}{"â˜†".repeat(5-Number(v||3))}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {log.notes && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.6}}>{log.notes}</div>}
              {log.breakdown && <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#dc2626",marginTop:6}}>âš ï¸ Breakdown: {log.breakdown}</div>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pre-match strategy */}
      {tab==="prematch" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <button style={{...DT.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={()=>setModal("prematch")}>+ Pre-Match Note</button>
          {preMatch.length===0 && <div style={{...DT.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No pre-match notes yet.</div>}
          {[...preMatch].reverse().map(p=>(
            <div key={p.id} style={{...DT.card,borderLeft:"4px solid #d97706"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:8}}>vs {p.opponent}</div>
              {p.strategy && <div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.6,marginBottom:10}}>{p.strategy}</div>}
              {[p.key1,p.key2,p.key3].filter(Boolean).map((k,i)=>(
                <div key={i} style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:6}}>
                  <span style={{background:"#d97706",color:"#fff",borderRadius:4,padding:"1px 7px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:800,flexShrink:0}}>KEY {i+1}</span>
                  <span style={{fontSize:13,color:"#374151"}}>{k}</span>
                </div>
              ))}
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:6}}>by {p.by} Â· {fmt(p.at)}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Analytics */}
      {tab==="stats" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {/* W/L record */}
          <div style={{...DT.card}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:14}}>Season Record</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,justifyContent:"center",marginBottom:16}}>
              {[[wins,"Wins","#16a34a"],[losses,"Losses","#dc2626"],[ties,"Ties","#d97706"]].map(([v,l,c])=>(
                <div key={l} style={{flex:1,textAlign:"center",background:c+"10",borderRadius:10,padding:"14px 8px",border:"2px solid " + (c) + "30"}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:28,color:c}}>{v}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:c,fontWeight:700}}>{l}</div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {logs.length>0 && (
              <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:14,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                <div style={{width:(Math.round(wins/logs.length*100)) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#16a34a",borderRadius:"99px 0 0 99px"}} />
              </div>
            )}
            {logs.length>0 && <div style={{textAlign:"center",fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:6}}>{Math.round(wins/logs.length*100)}% win rate</div>}
          </div>

          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
            {[
              {label:"Avg Alliance Score",value:avgScore,color:"#1d4ed8",icon:"ðŸ†"},
              {label:"Avg Communication â˜…",value:avgComm,color:"#d97706",icon:"ðŸ—£ï¸"},
            ].map(s=>(
              <div key={s.label} style={{...DT.card,textAlign:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:28}}>{s.icon}</div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,color:s.color}}>{s.value}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.label}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Score trend */}
          {logs.length>1 && (
            <div style={DT.card}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:12}}>Score Trend (last 10)</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4,alignItems:"flex-end",height:80}}>
                {[...logs].slice(-10).map((l,i)=>{
                  const maxScore=Math.max(...logs.map(x=>Number(x.allianceScore||0)),1);
                  const h=Math.max(8,Math.round((Number(l.allianceScore||0)/maxScore)*72));
                  return (
                    <div key={l.id} style={{flex:1,display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",gap:2}}>
                      <div title={"M" + (l.matchNum) + ": " + (l.allianceScore)} style={{width:"100%",height:h,background:RESULT_C[l.result]||"#9ca3af",borderRadius:"3px 3px 0 0",transition:"height 0.3s"}} />
                      <div style={{fontSize:9,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{l.matchNum}</div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Drive team roster */}
      {tab==="roster" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <button style={{...DT.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={addDriver}>+ Add Driver</button>
          {drivers.length===0 && <div style={{...DT.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No drive team members added.</div>}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr))",gap:12}}>
            {drivers.map(d=>{
              const ROLE_ICONS = {Driver:"ðŸ•¹ï¸",Operator:"âš™ï¸",Coach:"ðŸ“‹","Human Player":"ðŸƒ"};
              return (
                <div key={d.id} style={{...DT.card,textAlign:"center"}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:40,marginBottom:6}}>{ROLE_ICONS[d.role]||"ðŸ‘¤"}</div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16}}>{d.name}</div>
                  <span style={DT.badge()}>{d.role}</span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Log match modal */}
      {modal==="log" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:560,maxHeight:"90vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸ“‹ {editId?"Edit":"Log"} Match</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Match #*</label><input style={DT.inp} type="number" value={form.matchNum} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,matchNum:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Event</label><input style={DT.inp} placeholder="e.g. Regional" value={form.event} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,event:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Result</label>
                  <select style={DT.sel} value={form.result} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,result:e.target.value}))}>
                    {RESULTS.map(r=><option key={r} value={r}>{r}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Fouls Committed</label><input style={DT.inp} type="number" value={form.fouls} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,fouls:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Alliance Score</label><input style={DT.inp} type="number" value={form.allianceScore} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,allianceScore:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Opponent Score</label><input style={DT.inp} type="number" value={form.opponentScore} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,opponentScore:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              </div>
              <div style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:10,color:"#374151"}}>Drive Team Ratings</div>
                <StarRow label="ðŸ—£ï¸ Communication" val={form.communication} onChange={v=>setForm(p=>({...p,communication:v}))} />
                <StarRow label="ðŸ”„ Adaptability"  val={form.adaptability}  onChange={v=>setForm(p=>({...p,adaptability:v}))} />
                <StarRow label="ðŸŽ¯ Execution"      val={form.execution}     onChange={v=>setForm(p=>({...p,execution:v}))} />
              </div>
              <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Match Notes</label><textarea style={{...DT.ta,minHeight:80}} value={form.notes} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,notes:e.target.value}))} placeholder="What went well? What could improve?" /></div>
              <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Robot Breakdown / Issues</label><textarea style={{...DT.ta,minHeight:50}} value={form.breakdown} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,breakdown:e.target.value}))} placeholder="Any mechanical/electrical/software issues during match?" /></div>
              <button style={DT.btnS()} onClick={saveLog}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Save"} Match</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pre-match modal */}
      {modal==="prematch" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:500,maxHeight:"88vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸ“ Pre-Match Strategy</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Opponent / Alliance*</label><input style={DT.inp} value={pmForm.opponent} onChange={e=>setPmForm(p=>({...p,opponent:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={DT.lbl}>Overall Strategy</label><textarea style={{...DT.ta,minHeight:80}} value={pmForm.strategy} onChange={e=>setPmForm(p=>({...p,strategy:e.target.value}))} placeholder="What's the game plan?" /></div>
              {["key1","key2","key3"].map((k,i)=>(
                <div key={k}><label style={DT.lbl}>Key Point {i+1}</label><input style={DT.inp} placeholder={["Focus on auto","Watch for defense","Communicate on endgame timing"][i]} value={pmForm[k]} onChange={e=>setPmForm(p=>({...p,[k]:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              ))}
              <button style={DT.btnS()} onClick={savePreMatch}>ðŸ’¾ Save Notes</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ MENTORDASHBOARDMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Mentor-only dashboard: team health, student progress, notes, and alerts.

const MN = {
  card:  { background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:   (c="#1e3a8a",b="#eff6ff")=>({ background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnS:  (bg="#1e3a8a")=>({ background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:   { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none" },
  lbl:   { fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block" },
  badge: (c="#1e3a8a")=>({ background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block" }),
  ta:    { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none",fontFamily:"inherit",resize:"vertical" },
};


const HEALTH_AREAS = [
  {id:"morale",     label:"Team Morale",      icon:"ðŸ˜Š"},
  {id:"technical",  label:"Technical Progress",icon:"âš™ï¸"},
  {id:"schedule",   label:"On Schedule",       icon:"ðŸ“…"},
  {id:"communication",label:"Communication",   icon:"ðŸ’¬"},
  {id:"safety",     label:"Safety Culture",    icon:"ðŸ¦º"},
  {id:"outreach",   label:"Outreach Activity", icon:"ðŸŒ"},
];

function MentorDashboardModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  // Redirect non-mentors/non-admins
  const isMentor = isAdmin; // In real app you'd check user.role === "Mentor" too

  const [health,   setHealth]   = React.useState({});
  const [notes,    setNotes]    = React.useState([]);
  const [goals,    setGoals]    = React.useState([]);
  const [alerts,   setAlerts]   = React.useState([]);
  const [roster,   setRoster]   = React.useState([]);
  const [attSess,  setAttSess]  = React.useState([]);
  const [tasks,    setTasks]    = React.useState([]);
  const [tab,  setTab]  = React.useState("overview");
  const [modal, setModal] = React.useState(null);
  const [noteForm, setNoteForm]  = React.useState({body:"",private:false});
  const [goalForm, setGoalForm]  = React.useState({title:"",deadline:"",assignee:"",priority:"Medium"});
  const [alertForm, setAlertForm] = React.useState({title:"",body:"",severity:"Info"});
  const [healthForm, setHealthForm] = React.useState({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setHealth((await moduleStoreGet("mentor-health",true))||{});
      setNotes((await moduleStoreGet("mentor-notes",true))||[]);
      setGoals((await moduleStoreGet("mentor-goals",true))||[]);
      setAlerts((await moduleStoreGet("mentor-alerts",true))||[]);
      setRoster((await moduleStoreGet("roster-members",true))||[]);
      setAttSess((await moduleStoreGet("attendance-sessions",true))||[]);
      setTasks((await moduleStoreGet("tasks-board",true))||[]);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[]);

  const saveHealth = async () => {
    const u = {...health,...healthForm,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),updatedBy:user.name};
    await moduleStoreSet("mentor-health",u,true); setHealth(u); setModal(null);
  };

  const addNote = async () => {
    if (!noteForm.body.trim()) return;
    const u=[...notes,{...noteForm,id:Date.now().toString(),by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("mentor-notes",u,true); setNotes(u); setModal(null); setNoteForm({body:"",private:false});
  };

  const addGoal = async () => {
    if (!goalForm.title.trim()) return;
    const u=[...goals,{...goalForm,id:Date.now().toString(),status:"Open",by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("mentor-goals",u,true); setGoals(u); setModal(null); setGoalForm({title:"",deadline:"",assignee:"",priority:"Medium"});
  };

  const toggleGoal = async id => {
    const u=goals.map(g=>g.id===id?{...g,status:g.status==="Open"?"Done":"Open"}:g);
    await moduleStoreSet("mentor-goals",u,true); setGoals(u);
  };

  const addAlert = async () => {
    if (!alertForm.title.trim()) return;
    const u=[...alerts,{...alertForm,id:Date.now().toString(),by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("mentor-alerts",u,true); setAlerts(u); setModal(null); setAlertForm({title:"",body:"",severity:"Info"});
  };

  const dismissAlert = async id => {
    const u=alerts.filter(a=>a.id!==id); await moduleStoreSet("mentor-alerts",u,true); setAlerts(u);
  };

  // Derived stats from other modules
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const todayAtt = attSess.filter(s=>s.date===today).length;
  const overdueTasks = tasks.filter(t=>t.dueDate && t.dueDate<today && t.status!=="Done").length;
  const openGoals  = goals.filter(g=>g.status==="Open").length;

  const SEV_COLORS = {Info:"#1d4ed8",Warning:"#d97706",Critical:"#dc2626"};

  const HealthBar = ({id,label,icon}) => {
    const val = health[id] || 3;
    return (
      <div style={{marginBottom:14}}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:6}}>
          <span style={{fontWeight:600,fontSize:14}}>{icon} {label}</span>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:3}}>
            {[1,2,3,4,5].map(n=>(
              <div key={n} style={{width:14,height:14,borderRadius:3,background:n<=val?(val<=2?"#dc2626":val<=3?"#d97706":"#16a34a"):"#e2e8f0",transition:"background 0.2s"}} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:6}}>
          <div style={{width:(val/5*100) + "%",height:"100%",background:val<=2?"#dc2626":val<=3?"#d97706":"#16a34a",borderRadius:99,transition:"width 0.4s"}} />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading mentor dashboardâ€¦</div>;

  if (!isMentor) return (
    <div style={{...MN.card,textAlign:"center",padding:60}}>
      <div style={{fontSize:48,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ”’</div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18,marginBottom:8}}>Mentor Access Required</div>
      <div style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:14}}>This dashboard is only visible to mentors and admins.</div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸŽ“ Mentor Dashboard</div>

      {/* Alert strip */}
      {alerts.filter(a=>a.severity==="Critical").length>0 && (
        <div style={{background:"#fef2f2",border:"2px solid #dc2626",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 16px",marginBottom:16,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
          <span style={{color:"#dc2626",fontWeight:700}}>âš ï¸ {alerts.filter(a=>a.severity==="Critical").length} critical alert{alerts.filter(a=>a.severity==="Critical").length>1?"s":""} â€” check Alerts tab</span>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["overview","ðŸ“Š Overview"],["health","â¤ï¸ Team Health"],["goals","ðŸŽ¯ Mentor Goals"],["notes","ðŸ“ Notes"],["alerts","ðŸ”” Alerts"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?MN.btnS():MN.btn()}>
            {t==="alerts"&&alerts.length>0?"ðŸ”” Alerts (" + (alerts.length) + ")":l}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Overview */}
      {tab==="overview" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(3,1fr)",gap:12}}>
            {[
              {label:"Team Members",value:roster.length,icon:"ðŸ‘¥",color:"#059669"},
              {label:"Here Today",  value:todayAtt,     icon:"âœ…",color:"#16a34a"},
              {label:"Overdue Tasks",value:overdueTasks,icon:"âš ï¸",color:overdueTasks>0?"#dc2626":"#9ca3af"},
            ].map(s=>(
              <div key={s.label} style={{...MN.card,textAlign:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:26}}>{s.icon}</div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,color:s.color}}>{s.value}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.label}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Team health summary */}
          <div style={MN.card}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:14}}>â¤ï¸ Team Health Snapshot</div>
            {HEALTH_AREAS.map(h=><HealthBar key={h.id} {...h} />)}
            {isAdmin && <button style={MN.btn()} onClick={()=>{setHealthForm({...Object.fromEntries(HEALTH_AREAS.map(h=>[h.id,health[h.id]||3]))});setModal("health");}}>âœï¸ Update Health</button>}
            {health.updatedAt && <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:8}}>Updated {fmt(health.updatedAt)} by {health.updatedBy}</div>}
          </div>

          {/* Recent notes */}
          <div style={MN.card}>
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:12}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15}}>ðŸ“ Recent Notes</div>
              <button style={MN.btn()} onClick={()=>setTab("notes")}>See all</button>
            </div>
            {notes.slice(-3).reverse().map(n=>(
              <div key={n.id} style={{padding:"8px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.5}}>{n.body.slice(0,120)}{n.body.length>120?"â€¦":""}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:3}}>{fmt(n.at)} Â· {n.by}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
            {notes.length===0 && <div style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}}>No notes yet.</div>}
          </div>

          {/* Subteam task overview */}
          <div style={MN.card}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ“Œ Task Status by Subteam</div>
            {["Mechanical","Electrical","Programming","Business"].map(sub=>{
              const subT = tasks.filter(t=>t.subteam===sub);
              const done = subT.filter(t=>t.status==="Done").length;
              const pct  = subT.length ? Math.round(done/subT.length*100) : 0;
              return (
                <div key={sub} style={{marginBottom:12}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",fontSize:13,marginBottom:4}}>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:600}}>{sub}</span>
                    <span style={{color:"#6b7280"}}>{done}/{subT.length} done</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:7}}>
                    <div style={{width:(pct) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#1e3a8a",borderRadius:99}} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Team Health */}
      {tab==="health" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          <div style={MN.card}>
            <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:16}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16}}>Team Health Dashboard</div>
              {isAdmin && <button style={MN.btn()} onClick={()=>{setHealthForm({...Object.fromEntries(HEALTH_AREAS.map(h=>[h.id,health[h.id]||3]))});setModal("health");}}>âœï¸ Update</button>}
            </div>
            {HEALTH_AREAS.map(h=><HealthBar key={h.id} {...h} />)}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mentor Goals */}
      {tab==="goals" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          <button style={{...MN.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={()=>setModal("goal")}>+ Add Goal</button>
          {goals.filter(g=>g.status==="Open").length===0 && <div style={{...MN.card,textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No open goals.</div>}
          {goals.filter(g=>g.status==="Open").map(g=>(
            <div key={g.id} style={{...MN.card,display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
              <input type="checkbox" style={{marginTop:3,accentColor:"#1e3a8a",width:17,height:17,flexShrink:0}} onChange={()=>toggleGoal(g.id)} />
              <div style={{flex:1}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{g.title}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>
                  {g.assignee&&<span>ðŸ‘¤ {g.assignee} Â· </span>}
                  {g.deadline&&<span>ðŸ“… by {fmt(g.deadline)}</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
              <span style={MN.badge({High:"#dc2626",Medium:"#d97706",Low:"#9ca3af"}[g.priority]||"#6b7280")}>{g.priority}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          {goals.filter(g=>g.status==="Done").length>0 && (
            <details>
              <summary style={{cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13,fontWeight:600,padding:"6px 0"}}>âœ… {goals.filter(g=>g.status==="Done").length} completed goals</summary>
              {goals.filter(g=>g.status==="Done").map(g=>(
                <div key={g.id} style={{...MN.card,opacity:0.6,marginTop:8,display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center"}}>
                  <span style={{fontSize:18}}>âœ…</span>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,textDecoration:"line-through"}}>{g.title}</div>
                  <button style={{marginLeft:"auto",background:"none",border:"none",cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12}} onClick={()=>toggleGoal(g.id)}>â†© Reopen</button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </details>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Notes */}
      {tab==="notes" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          <button style={{...MN.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={()=>setModal("note")}>+ Add Note</button>
          {notes.length===0 && <div style={{...MN.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No mentor notes yet.</div>}
          {[...notes].reverse().map(n=>(
            <div key={n.id} style={{...MN.card,borderLeft:"4px solid #1e3a8a"}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#1e293b",lineHeight:1.7,marginBottom:8}}>{n.body}</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{fmt(n.at)} Â· {n.by}</div>
                {n.private && <span style={MN.badge()}>ðŸ”’ Private</span>}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Alerts */}
      {tab==="alerts" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          <button style={{...MN.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={()=>setModal("alert")}>+ Create Alert</button>
          {alerts.length===0 && <div style={{...MN.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No active alerts.</div>}
          {alerts.map(a=>{
            const c=SEV_COLORS[a.severity]||"#1d4ed8";
            return (
              <div key={a.id} style={{...MN.card,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (c)}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:4}}>
                      <span style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>{a.title}</span>
                      <span style={MN.badge(c)}>{a.severity}</span>
                    </div>
                    {a.body && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.6}}>{a.body}</div>}
                    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>{fmt(a.at)} Â· {a.by}</div>
                  </div>
                  <button style={{background:"#f1f5f9",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}} onClick={()=>dismissAlert(a.id)}>Dismiss</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modals */}
      {modal==="health" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:460,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>â¤ï¸ Update Team Health</div>
            {HEALTH_AREAS.map(h=>(
              <div key={h.id} style={{marginBottom:12}}>
                <label style={MN.lbl}>{h.icon} {h.label}</label>
                <input type="range" min="1" max="5" value={healthForm[h.id]||3} onChange={e=>setHealthForm(p=>({...p,[h.id]:Number(e.target.value)}))} style={{width:"100%",accentColor:"#1e3a8a"}} />
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>
                  <span>Poor</span><span>Excellent</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
            <button style={{...MN.btnS(),width:"100%",marginTop:8}} onClick={saveHealth}>ðŸ’¾ Save Health Update</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {modal==="note" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:460,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸ“ Add Note</div>
            <textarea style={{...MN.ta,minHeight:100}} value={noteForm.body} onChange={e=>setNoteForm(p=>({...p,body:e.target.value}))} placeholder="Observation, concern, action itemâ€¦" />
            <label style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center",marginTop:10,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={noteForm.private} onChange={e=>setNoteForm(p=>({...p,private:e.target.checked}))} />
              Private note (only visible to you)
            </label>
            <button style={{...MN.btnS(),width:"100%",marginTop:12}} onClick={addNote}>ðŸ’¾ Save Note</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {modal==="goal" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:440,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸŽ¯ Add Goal</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
              <div><label style={MN.lbl}>Goal</label><input style={MN.inp} value={goalForm.title} onChange={e=>setGoalForm(p=>({...p,title:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                <div><label style={MN.lbl}>Assignee</label><input style={MN.inp} value={goalForm.assignee} onChange={e=>setGoalForm(p=>({...p,assignee:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={MN.lbl}>Deadline</label><input style={MN.inp} type="date" value={goalForm.deadline} onChange={e=>setGoalForm(p=>({...p,deadline:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              </div>
              <div><label style={MN.lbl}>Priority</label>
                <select style={{...MN.inp,background:"#fff"}} value={goalForm.priority} onChange={e=>setGoalForm(p=>({...p,priority:e.target.value}))}>
                  {["Low","Medium","High"].map(p=><option key={p} value={p}>{p}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <button style={MN.btnS()} onClick={addGoal}>ðŸ’¾ Add Goal</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {modal==="alert" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:440,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸ”” Create Alert</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
              <div><label style={MN.lbl}>Title</label><input style={MN.inp} value={alertForm.title} onChange={e=>setAlertForm(p=>({...p,title:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={MN.lbl}>Severity</label>
                <select style={{...MN.inp,background:"#fff"}} value={alertForm.severity} onChange={e=>setAlertForm(p=>({...p,severity:e.target.value}))}>
                  {["Info","Warning","Critical"].map(s=><option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={MN.lbl}>Details</label><textarea style={{...MN.ta,minHeight:60}} value={alertForm.body} onChange={e=>setAlertForm(p=>({...p,body:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <button style={MN.btnS()} onClick={addAlert}>ðŸ”” Post Alert</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ ALUMNIMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Alumni directory, mentorship requests, and reunion/event tracker.

const AL = {
  card:  { background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)" },
  btn:   (c="#475569",b="#f8fafc")=>({ background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  btnS:  (bg="#475569")=>({ background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer" }),
  inp:   { border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none" },
  lbl:   { fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block" },
  badge: (c="#475569")=>({ background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block" }),
};

const FIELDS = ["Engineering","Computer Science","Business","Education","Medicine","Law","Arts","Trade","Other"];

function Avatar({name,size=44}){
  const ini=(name||"?").split(" ").map(w=>w[0]).join("").slice(0,2).toUpperCase();
  const hue=(name||"").split("").reduce((s,c)=>s+c.charCodeAt(0),0)%360;
  return <div style={{width:size,height:size,borderRadius:size/2,background:"hsl(" + (hue) + ",50%,55%)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",color:"#fff",fontWeight:800,fontSize:size*0.36,flexShrink:0}}>{ini}</div>;
}
