const EMPTY_EMPTY1 = {name:"",gradYear:"",college:"",field:"Engineering",company:"",role:"",linkedin:"",email:"",bio:"",willingToMentor:false};

function AlumniModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [alumni, setAlumni]     = React.useState([]);
  const [requests, setRequests] = React.useState([]);
  const [tab,   setTab]   = React.useState("directory");
  const [modal, setModal] = React.useState(null);
  const [form,  setForm]  = React.useState(EMPTY_EMPTY1);
  const [editId, setEditId] = React.useState(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = React.useState("");
  const [filterField, setFilterField] = React.useState("All");
  const [reqForm, setReqForm] = React.useState({topic:"",message:""});
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setAlumni((await moduleStoreGet("alumni-directory",true))||[]);
      setRequests((await moduleStoreGet("alumni-requests",true))||[]);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[]);

  const saveAlumni = async () => {
    if (!form.name) return alert("Name required.");
    let u;
    if (editId) {
      u=alumni.map(a=>a.id===editId?{...form,id:editId}:a);
    } else {
      u=[...alumni,{...form,id:Date.now().toString(),addedBy:user.name,addedAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("alumni-directory",u,true); setAlumni(u); setModal(null); setForm(EMPTY_EMPTY1); setEditId(null);
  };

  const deleteAlumni = async id => {
    if (!window.confirm("Remove from alumni directory?")) return;
    const u=alumni.filter(a=>a.id!==id); await moduleStoreSet("alumni-directory",u,true); setAlumni(u);
  };

  const sendRequest = async (alumniId) => {
    if (!reqForm.topic) return alert("Topic required.");
    const u=[...requests,{...reqForm,alumniId,requestedBy:user.name,id:Date.now().toString(),at:new Date().toISOString(),status:"Pending"}];
    await moduleStoreSet("alumni-requests",u,true); setRequests(u); setModal(null); setReqForm({topic:"",message:""});
  };

  const filtered = alumni.filter(a=>
    (filterField==="All"||a.field===filterField)&&
    (!search||a.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||a.college?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||(a.company||"").toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  ).sort((a,b)=>b.gradYear-a.gradYear);

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading alumniâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸŽ“ Alumni Network</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["directory","ðŸ“– Directory"],["mentorship","ðŸ¤ Mentorship Requests"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?AL.btnS():AL.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
        <div style={{flex:1}}/>
        {isAdmin && <button style={AL.btnS()} onClick={()=>{setForm(EMPTY_EMPTY1);setEditId(null);setModal("form");}}>+ Add Alumni</button>}
      </div>

      {tab==="directory" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {/* Stats */}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(3,1fr)",gap:10}}>
            {[
              {label:"Total Alumni",value:alumni.length,color:"#475569"},
              {label:"Willing to Mentor",value:alumni.filter(a=>a.willingToMentor).length,color:"#059669"},
              {label:"Fields Represented",value:new Set(alumni.map(a=>a.field)).size,color:"#7c3aed"},
            ].map(s=>(
              <div key={s.label} style={{...AL.card,textAlign:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,color:s.color}}>{s.value}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.label}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Filters */}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8}}>
            <input style={{...AL.inp,flex:1}} placeholder="ðŸ” Search alumniâ€¦" value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} />
            <select style={{...AL.inp,width:160,background:"#fff"}} value={filterField} onChange={e=>setFilterField(e.target.value)}>
              <option value="All">All Fields</option>
              {FIELDS.map(f=><option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>

          {filtered.length===0 && <div style={{...AL.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No alumni found.</div>}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr))",gap:12}}>
            {filtered.map(a=>(
              <div key={a.id} style={{...AL.card,display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
                  <Avatar name={a.name} size={46} />
                  <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:0}}>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>{a.name}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>Class of {a.gradYear}</div>
                    {a.company && <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#374151",fontWeight:600}}>{a.role ? (a.role) + " @ " : ""}{a.company}</div>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                {a.college && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸŽ“ {a.college}</div>}
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                  <span style={AL.badge()}>{a.field}</span>
                  {a.willingToMentor && <span style={AL.badge("#059669")}>ðŸ¤ Mentor available</span>}
                </div>
                {a.bio && <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",lineHeight:1.5}}>{a.bio.slice(0,100)}{a.bio.length>100?"â€¦":""}</div>}
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,marginTop:"auto"}}>
                  {a.willingToMentor && <button style={{...AL.btn(),fontSize:12,padding:"5px 12px"}} onClick={()=>{setReqForm({topic:"",message:"",alumniId:a.id});setModal("request:"+a.id);}}>Request Mentorship</button>}
                  {a.linkedin && <a href={a.linkedin} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" style={{...AL.btn(),fontSize:12,padding:"5px 12px",textDecoration:"none"}}>LinkedIn â†—</a>}
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <>
                      <button style={{...AL.btn(),padding:"5px 8px",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>{setForm({name:a.name,gradYear:a.gradYear,college:a.college||"",field:a.field||"Engineering",company:a.company||"",role:a.role||"",linkedin:a.linkedin||"",email:a.email||"",bio:a.bio||"",willingToMentor:a.willingToMentor||false});setEditId(a.id);setModal("form");}}>âœï¸</button>
                      <button style={{...AL.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2"),padding:"5px 8px",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>deleteAlumni(a.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab==="mentorship" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          {requests.length===0 && <div style={{...AL.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No mentorship requests yet.</div>}
          {[...requests].reverse().map(r=>{
            const a=alumni.find(x=>x.id===r.alumniId);
            return (
              <div key={r.id} style={{...AL.card}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{r.topic}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:2}}>For: <b>{a?.name||"Unknown"}</b> Â· by {r.requestedBy} Â· {fmt(r.at)}</div>
                    {r.message && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginTop:6}}>{r.message}</div>}
                  </div>
                  <span style={AL.badge(r.status==="Pending"?"#d97706":"#16a34a")}>{r.status}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Modal */}
      {modal==="form" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>{setModal(null);setEditId(null);}}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:520,maxHeight:"88vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>{editId?"âœï¸ Edit":"âž• Add"} Alumni</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:11}}>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Name*</label><input style={AL.inp} value={form.name} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,name:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Grad Year</label><input style={AL.inp} type="number" placeholder="e.g. 2022" value={form.gradYear} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,gradYear:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>College/University</label><input style={AL.inp} value={form.college} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,college:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Field</label>
                  <select style={{...AL.inp,background:"#fff"}} value={form.field} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,field:e.target.value}))}>
                    {FIELDS.map(f=><option key={f} value={f}>{f}</option>)}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Company / Employer</label><input style={AL.inp} value={form.company} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,company:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Job Title / Role</label><input style={AL.inp} value={form.role} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,role:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Email</label><input style={AL.inp} type="email" value={form.email} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,email:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>LinkedIn URL</label><input style={AL.inp} value={form.linkedin} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,linkedin:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              </div>
              <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Bio</label><textarea style={{...AL.inp,minHeight:60,resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}} value={form.bio} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,bio:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <label style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center",fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}}>
                <input type="checkbox" checked={form.willingToMentor} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,willingToMentor:e.target.checked}))} style={{accentColor:"#059669",width:16,height:16}} />
                Willing to mentor current students
              </label>
              <button style={AL.btnS()} onClick={saveAlumni}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Add"} Alumni</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mentorship request modal */}
      {modal && modal.startsWith("request:") && (()=>{
        const alumniId = modal.split(":")[1];
        const a = alumni.find(x=>x.id===alumniId);
        return (
          <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
            <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:440,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ¤ Request Mentorship</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:16}}>from {a?.name}</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Topic / What you'd like help with</label><input style={AL.inp} value={reqForm.topic} onChange={e=>setReqForm(p=>({...p,topic:e.target.value}))} placeholder="e.g. College applications, career advice" /></div>
                <div><label style={AL.lbl}>Message (optional)</label><textarea style={{...AL.inp,minHeight:80,resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}} value={reqForm.message} onChange={e=>setReqForm(p=>({...p,message:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <button style={AL.btnS()} onClick={()=>sendRequest(alumniId)}>ðŸ“¤ Send Request</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })()}
    </div>
  );
}



// â”€â”€â”€ PICKLISTMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Alliance selection picklist â€” rank teams, add notes, mark picked/unavailable.

const PL = {
  card:  {background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)"},
  btn:   (c="#1d4ed8",b="#eff6ff")=>({background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  btnS:  (bg="#1d4ed8")=>({background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  inp:   {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none"},
  lbl:   {fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block"},
  badge: (c="#1d4ed8")=>({background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block"}),
};

const STATUS_COLORS_STATCOL1 = {Available:"#16a34a",Picked:"#dc2626",Alliance:"#1d4ed8",DNP:"#9ca3af"};

function PicklistModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [teams,   setTeams]   = React.useState([]);
  const [alliances, setAlliances] = React.useState([]);
  const [tab,  setTab]  = React.useState("picklist");
  const [addForm, setAddForm] = React.useState({number:"",name:"",opr:"",autoAvg:"",notes:""});
  const [editId,  setEditId]  = React.useState(null);
  const [search,  setSearch]  = React.useState("");
  const [modal,   setModal]   = React.useState(null);
  const [alForm,  setAlForm]  = React.useState({captain:"",pick1:"",pick2:"",color:"Red"});
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setTeams((await moduleStoreGet("picklist-teams",true))||[]);
      setAlliances((await moduleStoreGet("picklist-alliances",true))||[]);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[]);

  const saveTeam = async () => {
    if (!addForm.number) return alert("Team number required.");
    let updated;
    const entry = {...addForm, id:editId||Date.now().toString(), rank:editId?teams.find(t=>t.id===editId)?.rank||(teams.length+1):teams.length+1, status:"Available", updatedBy:user.name};
    if (editId) {
      updated = teams.map(t=>t.id===editId?entry:t);
    } else {
      // check dupe
      if (teams.find(t=>String(t.number)===String(addForm.number))) return alert("Team already on list.");
      updated = [...teams, entry];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("picklist-teams",updated,true);
    setTeams(updated); setAddForm({number:"",name:"",opr:"",autoAvg:"",notes:""}); setEditId(null); setModal(null);
  };

  const moveTeam = async (id, dir) => {
    const sorted = [...teams].sort((a,b)=>a.rank-b.rank);
    const idx = sorted.findIndex(t=>t.id===id);
    const newIdx = idx+dir;
    if (newIdx<0||newIdx>=sorted.length) return;
    // swap ranks
    const temp = sorted[idx].rank;
    sorted[idx] = {...sorted[idx], rank:sorted[newIdx].rank};
    sorted[newIdx] = {...sorted[newIdx], rank:temp};
    await moduleStoreSet("picklist-teams",sorted,true); setTeams(sorted);
  };

  const setStatus = async (id, status) => {
    const updated = teams.map(t=>t.id===id?{...t,status}:t);
    await moduleStoreSet("picklist-teams",updated,true); setTeams(updated);
  };

  const deleteTeam = async id => {
    const u = teams.filter(t=>t.id!==id);
    await moduleStoreSet("picklist-teams",u,true); setTeams(u);
  };

  const saveAlliance = async () => {
    if (!alForm.captain) return alert("Captain required.");
    const u=[...alliances,{...alForm,id:Date.now().toString(),by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("picklist-alliances",u,true); setAlliances(u); setModal(null); setAlForm({captain:"",pick1:"",pick2:"",color:"Red"});
  };

  const sorted = [...teams].sort((a,b)=>a.rank-b.rank).filter(t=>!search||String(t.number).includes(search)||(t.name||"").toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading picklistâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>ðŸ—‚ï¸ Alliance Picklist</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["picklist","ðŸ“‹ Picklist"],["alliances","ðŸ¤ Alliances"],["add","âž• Add Team"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?PL.btnS():PL.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Picklist */}
      {tab==="picklist" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center"}}>
            <input style={{...PL.inp,flex:1}} placeholder="ðŸ” Filter teamsâ€¦" value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} />
            <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af",flexShrink:0}}>{teams.filter(t=>t.status==="Available").length} available Â· {teams.filter(t=>t.status==="Picked").length} picked</div>
          </div>

          {sorted.length===0 && <div style={{...PL.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No teams on picklist yet. Use "Add Team" tab.</div>}

          {sorted.map((team,i)=>{
            const sc = STATUS_COLORS_STATCOL1[team.status]||"#9ca3af";
            const isPicked = team.status==="Picked"||team.status==="DNP";
            return (
              <div key={team.id} style={{...PL.card,opacity:isPicked?0.55:1,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (sc),display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",padding:"12px 16px"}}>
                {/* Rank number */}
                <div style={{width:34,height:34,background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:8,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontWeight:900,fontSize:15,color:"#374151",flexShrink:0}}>{team.rank}</div>
                {/* Move arrows */}
                <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:2,flexShrink:0}}>
                  <button style={{background:"none",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:4,cursor:"pointer",padding:"0 5px",fontSize:11,lineHeight:"16px"}} onClick={()=>moveTeam(team.id,-1)}>â–²</button>
                  <button style={{background:"none",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:4,cursor:"pointer",padding:"0 5px",fontSize:11,lineHeight:"16px"}} onClick={()=>moveTeam(team.id,1)}>â–¼</button>
                </div>
                {/* Team info */}
                <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:0}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>#{team.number} {team.name&&<span style={{fontWeight:500,color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13}}>{team.name}</span>}</div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginTop:3,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                    {team.opr && <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#7c3aed"}}>OPR: {team.opr}</span>}
                    {team.autoAvg && <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#059669"}}>Auto avg: {team.autoAvg}</span>}
                    {team.notes && <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap",maxWidth:200}}>{team.notes}</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                {/* Status + actions */}
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexShrink:0,alignItems:"center"}}>
                  <select value={team.status} onChange={e=>setStatus(team.id,e.target.value)}
                    style={{background:sc+"18",color:sc,border:"1px solid " + (sc) + "40",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px",fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,cursor:"pointer"}}>
                    {Object.keys(STATUS_COLORS_STATCOL1).map(s=><option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
                  </select>
                  <button style={{background:"#fff7ed",color:"#ea580c",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"5px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11}}
                    onClick={()=>{setAddForm({number:team.number,name:team.name||"",opr:team.opr||"",autoAvg:team.autoAvg||"",notes:team.notes||""});setEditId(team.id);setTab("add");}}>âœï¸</button>
                  {isAdmin && <button style={{background:"#fef2f2",color:"#dc2626",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"5px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>deleteTeam(team.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Alliances */}
      {tab==="alliances" && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
          <button style={{...PL.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={()=>setModal("alliance")}>+ Log Alliance</button>
          {alliances.length===0 && <div style={{...PL.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No alliances logged yet.</div>}
          {alliances.map(a=>(
            <div key={a.id} style={{...PL.card,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (a.color==="Red"?"#dc2626":"#1d4ed8")}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:6}}>{a.color} Alliance</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                {[["Captain",a.captain],["1st Pick",a.pick1],["2nd Pick",a.pick2]].filter(([,v])=>v).map(([label,val])=>(
                  <div key={label} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 12px",minWidth:80}}>
                    <div style={{fontSize:10,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:2}}>{label}</div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>#{val}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add Team */}
      {tab==="add" && (
        <div style={PL.card}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:16}}>{editId?"âœï¸ Edit Team":"âž• Add Team to Picklist"}</div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={PL.lbl}>Team Number*</label><input style={PL.inp} type="number" value={addForm.number} onChange={e=>setAddForm(p=>({...p,number:e.target.value}))} placeholder="e.g. 12345" /></div>
            <div><label style={PL.lbl}>Team Name</label><input style={PL.inp} value={addForm.name} onChange={e=>setAddForm(p=>({...p,name:e.target.value}))} placeholder="e.g. Iron Lions" /></div>
            <div><label style={PL.lbl}>OPR / EPA</label><input style={PL.inp} type="number" value={addForm.opr} onChange={e=>setAddForm(p=>({...p,opr:e.target.value}))} placeholder="e.g. 42.3" /></div>
            <div><label style={PL.lbl}>Avg Auto Score</label><input style={PL.inp} type="number" value={addForm.autoAvg} onChange={e=>setAddForm(p=>({...p,autoAvg:e.target.value}))} /></div>
          </div>
          <div style={{marginTop:12}}><label style={PL.lbl}>Notes / Strategy</label><textarea style={{...PL.inp,minHeight:70,resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}} value={addForm.notes} onChange={e=>setAddForm(p=>({...p,notes:e.target.value}))} placeholder="Strengths, weaknesses, match observationsâ€¦" /></div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,marginTop:14}}>
            <button style={PL.btnS()} onClick={saveTeam}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Add"} Team</button>
            {editId && <button style={PL.btn()} onClick={()=>{setEditId(null);setAddForm({number:"",name:"",opr:"",autoAvg:"",notes:""});}}>Cancel</button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Alliance modal */}
      {modal==="alliance" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:400,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸ¤ Log Alliance</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
              <div><label style={PL.lbl}>Alliance Color</label>
                <select style={{...PL.inp,background:"#fff"}} value={alForm.color} onChange={e=>setAlForm(p=>({...p,color:e.target.value}))}>
                  <option value="Red">Red Alliance</option><option value="Blue">Blue Alliance</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              {[["captain","Captain Team #"],["pick1","1st Pick #"],["pick2","2nd Pick #"]].map(([k,l])=>(
                <div key={k}><label style={PL.lbl}>{l}</label><input style={PL.inp} type="number" value={alForm[k]} onChange={e=>setAlForm(p=>({...p,[k]:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              ))}
              <button style={PL.btnS()} onClick={saveAlliance}>ðŸ’¾ Save Alliance</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ TRAVELMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Competition travel: hotel, transport, packing checklist, carpool coordination.

const TV = {
  card:  {background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)"},
  btn:   (c="#0891b2",b="#ecfeff")=>({background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  btnS:  (bg="#0891b2")=>({background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  inp:   {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none"},
  sel:   {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",background:"#fff"},
  lbl:   {fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block"},
  badge: (c="#0891b2")=>({background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block"}),
  ta:    {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none",fontFamily:"inherit",resize:"vertical"},
};


const DEFAULT_PACKING = [
  {cat:"Robot & Tools",items:["Robot (fully assembled)","Spare parts kit","Full tool kit","Battery chargers (x2)","Spare batteries (x3)","Laptop + charger","USB cable / ethernet cable","Driver Station setup","Alliance stop button","Pit decorations & banner"]},
  {cat:"Team Supplies",items:["Team shirts / uniforms","Name badges / lanyards","Safety glasses (everyone)","Closed-toe shoes reminder","Team handbook / binder","Award submission materials","Business cards","Snacks for pit crew","First aid kit","Extension cords / power strip"]},
  {cat:"Travel Essentials",items:["Hotel confirmation","Travel itinerary printed","Emergency contact list","Team waiver copies","Insurance cards","Cash for emergencies","Team roster","Permission slips (if needed)"]},
];

function TravelModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [trips,     setTrips]     = React.useState([]);
  const [packing,   setPacking]   = React.useState({});
  const [carpools,  setCarpools]  = React.useState([]);
  const [selTrip,   setSelTrip]   = React.useState(null);
  const [tab,  setTab]  = React.useState("trips");
  const [modal, setModal] = React.useState(null);
  const [tripForm, setTripForm] = React.useState({name:"",event:"",departDate:"",returnDate:"",hotel:"",hotelAddress:"",hotelConfirm:"",transport:"Bus",notes:""});
  const [cpForm,   setCpForm]   = React.useState({driver:"",seats:"",departure:"",notes:""});
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      const t=(await moduleStoreGet("travel-trips",true))||[];
      setTrips(t);
      setPacking((await moduleStoreGet("travel-packing:" + (user.name)))||{});
      setCarpools((await moduleStoreGet("travel-carpools",true))||[]);
      if(t.length>0&&!selTrip) setSelTrip(t[t.length-1].id);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[user.name]);

  const saveTrip = async () => {
    if (!tripForm.name) return alert("Trip name required.");
    const u=[...trips,{...tripForm,id:Date.now().toString(),by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("travel-trips",u,true); setTrips(u); setSelTrip(u[u.length-1].id); setModal(null); setTripForm({name:"",event:"",departDate:"",returnDate:"",hotel:"",hotelAddress:"",hotelConfirm:"",transport:"Bus",notes:""});
  };

  const togglePacking = async (tripId, item) => {
    const key = (tripId) + ":" + (item);
    const updated = {...packing, [key]: !packing[key]};
    await moduleStoreSet("travel-packing:" + (user.name), updated);
    setPacking(updated);
  };

  const addCarpool = async () => {
    if (!cpForm.driver||!selTrip) return alert("Driver name required.");
    const u=[...carpools,{...cpForm,id:Date.now().toString(),tripId:selTrip,by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString(),passengers:[]}];
    await moduleStoreSet("travel-carpools",u,true); setCarpools(u); setModal(null); setCpForm({driver:"",seats:"",departure:"",notes:""});
  };

  const joinCarpool = async (id) => {
    const u=carpools.map(c=>c.id===id?{...c,passengers:[...new Set([...(c.passengers||[]),user.name])]}:c);
    await moduleStoreSet("travel-carpools",u,true); setCarpools(u);
  };

  const leaveCarpool = async (id) => {
    const u=carpools.map(c=>c.id===id?{...c,passengers:(c.passengers||[]).filter(p=>p!==user.name)}:c);
    await moduleStoreSet("travel-carpools",u,true); setCarpools(u);
  };

  const activeTrip = trips.find(t=>t.id===selTrip);
  const tripCarpools = carpools.filter(c=>c.tripId===selTrip);

  const packingPct = () => {
    if (!selTrip) return 0;
    const allItems = DEFAULT_PACKING.flatMap(c=>c.items);
    const done = allItems.filter(item=>packing[(selTrip) + ":" + (item)]).length;
    return Math.round(done/allItems.length*100);
  };

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading travelâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:20}}>âœˆï¸ Competition Travel</div>

      {/* Trip selector */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap",alignItems:"center"}}>
        {trips.map(t=>(
          <button key={t.id} onClick={()=>setSelTrip(t.id)} style={selTrip===t.id?TV.btnS():TV.btn()}>{t.name}</button>
        ))}
        {isAdmin && <button style={TV.btn()} onClick={()=>setModal("trip")}>+ New Trip</button>}
      </div>

      {!selTrip && <div style={{...TV.card,textAlign:"center",padding:50,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{trips.length===0?"No trips yet. Add one!":"Select a trip above."}</div>}

      {activeTrip && (
        <>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            {[["info","ðŸ“‹ Trip Info"],["packing","ðŸ§³ Packing List"],["carpool","ðŸš— Carpool"]].map(([t,l])=>(
              <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?TV.btnS():TV.btn()}>{l}</button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Trip Info */}
          {tab==="info" && (
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
              <div style={{...TV.card,borderLeft:"4px solid #0891b2"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,marginBottom:10}}>{activeTrip.name}</div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
                  {[
                    ["ðŸ“… Depart",fmt(activeTrip.departDate)],
                    ["ðŸ Return",fmt(activeTrip.returnDate)],
                    ["ðŸ† Event",activeTrip.event],
                    ["ðŸšŒ Transport",activeTrip.transport],
                    ["ðŸ¨ Hotel",activeTrip.hotel],
                    ["ðŸ“ Address",activeTrip.hotelAddress],
                    ["ðŸ”‘ Confirmation",activeTrip.hotelConfirm],
                  ].filter(([,v])=>v).map(([label,value])=>(
                    <div key={label} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 12px"}}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{label}</div>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginTop:2}}>{value}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                {activeTrip.notes && <div style={{marginTop:12,fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.6}}>{activeTrip.notes}</div>}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Packing */}
          {tab==="packing" && (
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
              <div style={TV.card}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:8}}>
                  <span style={{fontWeight:700}}>Packing Progress</span>
                  <span style={{fontWeight:700,color:"#0891b2"}}>{packingPct()}%</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:99,height:8,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                  <div style={{width:(packingPct()) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#0891b2",borderRadius:99,transition:"width 0.3s"}} />
                </div>
              </div>
              {DEFAULT_PACKING.map(cat=>(
                <div key={cat.cat} style={TV.card}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,color:"#0891b2",marginBottom:12}}>{cat.cat}</div>
                  {cat.items.map(item=>{
                    const checked = !!packing[(selTrip) + ":" + (item)];
                    return (
                      <label key={item} style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",padding:"8px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14}}>
                        <input type="checkbox" checked={checked} onChange={()=>togglePacking(selTrip,item)} style={{accentColor:"#0891b2",width:16,height:16,flexShrink:0}} />
                        <span style={{color:checked?"#0891b2":"#374151",textDecoration:checked?"line-through":"none"}}>{item}</span>
                      </label>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Carpool */}
          {tab==="carpool" && (
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
              <button style={{...TV.btnS(),alignSelf:"flex-end"}} onClick={()=>setModal("carpool")}>+ Offer a Ride</button>
              {tripCarpools.length===0 && <div style={{...TV.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No carpools yet.</div>}
              {tripCarpools.map(cp=>{
                const inCar = (cp.passengers||[]).includes(user.name);
                const full  = Number(cp.seats)>0 && (cp.passengers||[]).length >= Number(cp.seats);
                return (
                  <div key={cp.id} style={{...TV.card}}>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:8}}>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>ðŸš— {cp.driver}</div>
                        {cp.seats && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>{(cp.passengers||[]).length}/{cp.seats} seats filled</div>}
                        {cp.departure && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>â° Departs: {cp.departure}</div>}
                        {cp.notes && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>{cp.notes}</div>}
                      </div>
                      {cp.driver!==user.name && (
                        <button style={inCar?TV.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2"):full?TV.btn("#9ca3af","#f1f5f9"):TV.btnS()}
                          disabled={full&&!inCar}
                          onClick={()=>inCar?leaveCarpool(cp.id):joinCarpool(cp.id)}>
                          {inCar?"Leave":"Join"}
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {(cp.passengers||[]).length>0 && (
                      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                        {cp.passengers.map(p=><span key={p} style={TV.badge()}>{p}</span>)}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}

      {/* New Trip Modal */}
      {modal==="trip" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:520,maxHeight:"88vh",overflowY:"auto",padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>âœˆï¸ New Competition Trip</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:11}}>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Trip Name*</label><input style={TV.inp} placeholder="e.g. 2025 State Championship" value={tripForm.name} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,name:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Event Name</label><input style={TV.inp} value={tripForm.event} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,event:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Departure Date</label><input style={TV.inp} type="date" value={tripForm.departDate} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,departDate:e.target.value}))} /></div>
                <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Return Date</label><input style={TV.inp} type="date" value={tripForm.returnDate} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,returnDate:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              </div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Transport</label>
                <select style={TV.sel} value={tripForm.transport} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,transport:e.target.value}))}>
                  {["Bus","Carpool","Train","Flight","Mixed"].map(t=><option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Hotel Name</label><input style={TV.inp} value={tripForm.hotel} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,hotel:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Hotel Address</label><input style={TV.inp} value={tripForm.hotelAddress} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,hotelAddress:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Confirmation #</label><input style={TV.inp} value={tripForm.hotelConfirm} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,hotelConfirm:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Notes</label><textarea style={{...TV.ta,minHeight:60}} value={tripForm.notes} onChange={e=>setTripForm(p=>({...p,notes:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <button style={TV.btnS()} onClick={saveTrip}>ðŸ’¾ Save Trip</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Carpool modal */}
      {modal==="carpool" && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>setModal(null)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:420,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸš— Offer a Ride</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Driver Name</label><input style={TV.inp} value={cpForm.driver||user.name} onChange={e=>setCpForm(p=>({...p,driver:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Available Seats</label><input style={TV.inp} type="number" min="1" max="8" value={cpForm.seats} onChange={e=>setCpForm(p=>({...p,seats:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Departure Time / Location</label><input style={TV.inp} placeholder="e.g. 6:00 AM from school" value={cpForm.departure} onChange={e=>setCpForm(p=>({...p,departure:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <div><label style={TV.lbl}>Notes</label><input style={TV.inp} placeholder="e.g. Can take robot equipment" value={cpForm.notes} onChange={e=>setCpForm(p=>({...p,notes:e.target.value}))} /></div>
              <button style={TV.btnS()} onClick={addCarpool}>ðŸ’¾ Post Carpool</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ MEETINGMINUTESMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Meeting minutes recorder with agenda, attendees, action items, and history.

const MM = {
  card:  {background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)"},
  btn:   (c="#374151",b="#f9fafb")=>({background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  btnS:  (bg="#374151")=>({background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  inp:   {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none"},
  ta:    {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none",fontFamily:"inherit",resize:"vertical"},
  lbl:   {fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block"},
  badge: (c="#374151")=>({background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block"}),
};

const MTG_TYPES = ["Build Session","Subteam","Leadership","Full Team","Competition Debrief","Other"];

function MeetingMinutesModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [meetings, setMeetings] = React.useState([]);
  const [view,  setView]  = React.useState("list"); // "list"|"write"|"read"
  const [selMtg, setSelMtg] = React.useState(null);
  const [editId, setEditId] = React.useState(null);
  const [form,  setForm]  = React.useState({title:"",date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),type:"Full Team",facilitator:"",attendees:"",agenda:"",notes:"",decisions:"",actions:[]});
  const [newAction, setNewAction] = React.useState({text:"",owner:"",due:""});
  const [search, setSearch] = React.useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setMeetings((await moduleStoreGet("minutes-meetings",true))||[]);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[]);

  const addAction = () => {
    if (!newAction.text.trim()) return;
    setForm(p=>({...p,actions:[...p.actions,{...newAction,id:Date.now().toString(),done:false}]}));
    setNewAction({text:"",owner:"",due:""});
  };

  const toggleAction = (id) => {
    setForm(p=>({...p,actions:p.actions.map(a=>a.id===id?{...a,done:!a.done}:a)}));
  };

  const removeAction = (id) => setForm(p=>({...p,actions:p.actions.filter(a=>a.id!==id)}));

  const saveMeeting = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return alert("Meeting title required.");
    let updated;
    const entry = {...form,updatedBy:user.name,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()};
    if (editId) {
      updated = meetings.map(m=>m.id===editId?{...entry,id:editId}:m);
    } else {
      updated = [...meetings,{...entry,id:Date.now().toString(),createdBy:user.name,createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("minutes-meetings",updated,true);
    setMeetings(updated); setView("list"); setEditId(null);
    setForm({title:"",date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),type:"Full Team",facilitator:"",attendees:"",agenda:"",notes:"",decisions:"",actions:[]});
  };

  const deleteMeeting = async id => {
    if (!window.confirm("Delete these minutes?")) return;
    const u=meetings.filter(m=>m.id!==id);
    await moduleStoreSet("minutes-meetings",u,true); setMeetings(u);
    if (selMtg?.id===id){setSelMtg(null);setView("list");}
  };

  // Persist action item done state to shared storage
  const toggleSharedAction = async (mtgId, actionId) => {
    const updated = meetings.map(m=>m.id===mtgId?{...m,actions:m.actions.map(a=>a.id===actionId?{...a,done:!a.done}:a)}:m);
    await moduleStoreSet("minutes-meetings",updated,true); setMeetings(updated);
    if (selMtg?.id===mtgId) setSelMtg(updated.find(m=>m.id===mtgId));
  };

  const filtered = meetings.filter(m=>!search||m.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||(m.notes||"").toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())).sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));

  const allActions = meetings.flatMap(m=>(m.actions||[]).filter(a=>!a.done).map(a=>({...a,meeting:m.title,mtgId:m.id,mtgDate:m.date})));

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading minutesâ€¦</div>;

  // Write view
  if (view==="write") return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20}}>ðŸ“‹ {editId?"Edit Minutes":"New Meeting Minutes"}</div>
        <button style={MM.btn()} onClick={()=>{setView("list");setEditId(null);}}>â† Back</button>
      </div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:13}}>
        <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"2fr 1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
          <div><label style={MM.lbl}>Meeting Title*</label><input style={MM.inp} value={form.title} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,title:e.target.value}))} placeholder="e.g. Weekly Build Session #12" /></div>
          <div><label style={MM.lbl}>Date</label><input style={MM.inp} type="date" value={form.date} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,date:e.target.value}))} /></div>
          <div><label style={MM.lbl}>Type</label>
            <select style={{...MM.inp,background:"#fff"}} value={form.type} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,type:e.target.value}))}>
              {MTG_TYPES.map(t=><option key={t} value={t}>{t}</option>)}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
          <div><label style={MM.lbl}>Facilitator</label><input style={MM.inp} value={form.facilitator} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,facilitator:e.target.value}))} /></div>
          <div><label style={MM.lbl}>Attendees (comma-separated)</label><input style={MM.inp} placeholder="Alex, Jamie, Samâ€¦" value={form.attendees} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,attendees:e.target.value}))} /></div>
        </div>
        <div><label style={MM.lbl}>Agenda</label><textarea style={{...MM.ta,minHeight:70}} value={form.agenda} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,agenda:e.target.value}))} placeholder="1. Kickoff update\n2. Subteam check-ins\n3. Open floor" /></div>
        <div><label style={MM.lbl}>Meeting Notes</label><textarea style={{...MM.ta,minHeight:160}} value={form.notes} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,notes:e.target.value}))} placeholder="Detailed notes from the meetingâ€¦" /></div>
        <div><label style={MM.lbl}>Key Decisions Made</label><textarea style={{...MM.ta,minHeight:70}} value={form.decisions} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,decisions:e.target.value}))} placeholder="â€¢ Decided to use mecanum drive\nâ€¢ Changed reveal date toâ€¦" /></div>

        {/* Action items */}
        <div style={MM.card}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:12}}>âœ… Action Items</div>
          {form.actions.map(a=>(
            <div key={a.id} style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center",padding:"7px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={a.done} onChange={()=>toggleAction(a.id)} style={{accentColor:"#374151",width:15,height:15,flexShrink:0}} />
              <span style={{flex:1,fontSize:13,textDecoration:a.done?"line-through":"none",color:a.done?"#9ca3af":"#374151"}}>{a.text}</span>
              {a.owner && <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¤{a.owner}</span>}
              {a.due && <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#d97706"}}>ðŸ“…{a.due}</span>}
              <button style={{background:"none",border:"none",cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}} onClick={()=>removeAction(a.id)}>âœ•</button>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginTop:10,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            <input style={{...MM.inp,flex:2,minWidth:120}} placeholder="Action itemâ€¦" value={newAction.text} onChange={e=>setNewAction(p=>({...p,text:e.target.value}))} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&addAction()} />
            <input style={{...MM.inp,flex:1,minWidth:80}} placeholder="Owner" value={newAction.owner} onChange={e=>setNewAction(p=>({...p,owner:e.target.value}))} />
            <input style={{...MM.inp,width:120}} type="date" value={newAction.due} onChange={e=>setNewAction(p=>({...p,due:e.target.value}))} />
            <button style={MM.btnS()} onClick={addAction}>+ Add</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10}}>
          <button style={MM.btnS()} onClick={saveMeeting}>ðŸ’¾ {editId?"Update":"Save"} Minutes</button>
          <button style={MM.btn()} onClick={()=>{setView("list");setEditId(null);}}>Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  // Read view
  if (view==="read" && selMtg) return (
    <div>
      <button style={{...MM.btn(),marginBottom:16}} onClick={()=>{setSelMtg(null);setView("list");}}>â† Back</button>
      <div style={MM.card}>
        <div style={{borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",paddingBottom:14,marginBottom:16}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,marginBottom:6}}>{selMtg.title}</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            <span style={MM.badge()}>{selMtg.type}</span>
            <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}}>ðŸ“… {fmt(selMtg.date)}</span>
            {selMtg.facilitator&&<span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}}>ðŸŽ¤ {selMtg.facilitator}</span>}
          </div>
          {selMtg.attendees && <div style={{marginTop:8,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¥ {selMtg.attendees}</div>}
        </div>
        {selMtg.agenda&&<><div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:6}}>Agenda</div><div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.7,whiteSpace:"pre-wrap",marginBottom:16}}>{selMtg.agenda}</div></>}
        {selMtg.notes&&<><div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:6}}>Notes</div><div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.8,whiteSpace:"pre-wrap",marginBottom:16}}>{selMtg.notes}</div></>}
        {selMtg.decisions&&<><div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:6}}>Key Decisions</div><div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.7,whiteSpace:"pre-wrap",marginBottom:16}}>{selMtg.decisions}</div></>}
        {(selMtg.actions||[]).length>0&&(
          <><div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}>Action Items</div>
          {selMtg.actions.map(a=>(
            <label key={a.id} style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",padding:"8px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14}}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={a.done} onChange={()=>toggleSharedAction(selMtg.id,a.id)} style={{accentColor:"#374151",width:15,height:15}} />
              <span style={{flex:1,textDecoration:a.done?"line-through":"none",color:a.done?"#9ca3af":"#374151"}}>{a.text}</span>
              {a.owner&&<span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¤{a.owner}</span>}
              {a.due&&<span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#d97706"}}>ðŸ“…{a.due}</span>}
            </label>
          ))}</>
        )}
        <div style={{borderTop:"1px solid #f1f5f9",marginTop:16,paddingTop:14,display:"flex",gap:10}}>
          <button style={MM.btn()} onClick={()=>{setForm({title:selMtg.title,date:selMtg.date,type:selMtg.type||"Full Team",facilitator:selMtg.facilitator||"",attendees:selMtg.attendees||"",agenda:selMtg.agenda||"",notes:selMtg.notes||"",decisions:selMtg.decisions||"",actions:selMtg.actions||[]});setEditId(selMtg.id);setView("write");}}>âœï¸ Edit</button>
          {isAdmin&&<button style={MM.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2")} onClick={()=>deleteMeeting(selMtg.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸ Delete</button>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  // List view
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24}}>ðŸ“‹ Meeting Minutes</div>
        <button style={MM.btnS()} onClick={()=>{setForm({title:"",date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),type:"Full Team",facilitator:user.name,attendees:"",agenda:"",notes:"",decisions:"",actions:[]});setEditId(null);setView("write");}}>+ New Minutes</button>
      </div>

      {/* Open action items */}
      {allActions.length>0&&(
        <div style={{...MM.card,marginBottom:16,background:"#fffbeb",border:"1px solid #fed7aa"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:10,color:"#d97706"}}>âš¡ {allActions.length} Open Action Item{allActions.length>1?"s":""}</div>
          {allActions.slice(0,5).map(a=>(
            <div key={a.id} style={{display:"flex",gap:8,fontSize:13,padding:"5px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #fef3c7"}}>
              <span style={{flex:1}}>{a.text}</span>
              {a.owner&&<span style={{color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¤{a.owner}</span>}
              <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:11}}>{a.meeting}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <input style={{...MM.inp,marginBottom:14}} placeholder="ðŸ” Search minutesâ€¦" value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} />

      {filtered.length===0&&<div style={{...MM.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No meeting minutes yet.</div>}
      {filtered.map(m=>(
        <div key={m.id} style={{...MM.card,marginBottom:10,cursor:"pointer",transition:"all 0.15s"}} onClick={()=>{setSelMtg(m);setView("read");}}
          onMouseEnter={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.transform="translateY(-1px)";e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow="0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)";}}
          onMouseLeave={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.transform="";e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow="";}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:4}}>{m.title}</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                <span style={MM.badge()}>{m.type}</span>
                <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12}}>ðŸ“… {fmtShort(m.date)}</span>
                {m.facilitator&&<span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12}}>ðŸŽ¤ {m.facilitator}</span>}
                {(m.actions||[]).filter(a=>!a.done).length>0&&<span style={{...MM.badge("#d97706"),fontSize:10}}>{(m.actions||[]).filter(a=>!a.done).length} open actions</span>}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{m.createdBy}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ POLLSMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Team polls & voting â€” multiple choice, yes/no, ranked choice.

const PO = {
  card:  {background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)"},
  btn:   (c="#7c3aed",b="#faf5ff")=>({background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  btnS:  (bg="#7c3aed")=>({background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  inp:   {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none"},
  lbl:   {fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block"},
  badge: (c="#7c3aed")=>({background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block"}),
};

const COLORS = ["#7c3aed","#1d4ed8","#059669","#dc2626","#d97706","#0891b2","#374151","#ea580c"];

function PollsModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [polls,   setPolls]   = React.useState([]);
  const [votes,   setVotes]   = React.useState({});  // { pollId: optionIndex or [indices] }
  const [tab,  setTab]  = React.useState("active");
  const [creating, setCreating] = React.useState(false);
  const [form,  setForm]  = React.useState({question:"",type:"single",options:["",""],anonymous:false,deadline:""});
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setPolls((await moduleStoreGet("polls-list",true))||[]);
      setVotes((await moduleStoreGet("polls-votes:" + (user.name)))||{});
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[user.name]);

  const addOption = () => setForm(p=>({...p,options:[...p.options,""]}));
  const removeOption = i => setForm(p=>({...p,options:p.options.filter((_,j)=>j!==i)}));
  const setOption = (i,v) => setForm(p=>({...p,options:p.options.map((o,j)=>j===i?v:o)}));

  const createPoll = async () => {
    if (!form.question.trim()) return alert("Question required.");
    const opts = form.options.filter(o=>o.trim());
    if (opts.length<2) return alert("At least 2 options required.");
    const poll = {...form,options:opts,id:Date.now().toString(),by:user.name,at:new Date().toISOString(),closed:false,votes:{}};
    const u=[...polls,poll];
    await moduleStoreSet("polls-list",u,true); setPolls(u); setCreating(false); setForm({question:"",type:"single",options:["",""],anonymous:false,deadline:""});
  };

  const castVote = async (pollId, optionIndex) => {
    const poll = polls.find(p=>p.id===pollId);
    if (!poll||poll.closed) return;
    const alreadyVoted = votes[pollId];

    // Update shared poll votes
    const updatedPoll = {...poll};
    if (!updatedPoll.votes) updatedPoll.votes={};
    if (poll.type==="multi") {
      const myVotes = Array.isArray(alreadyVoted)?alreadyVoted:[];
      const newMyVotes = myVotes.includes(optionIndex)?myVotes.filter(v=>v!==optionIndex):[...myVotes,optionIndex];
      // Undo old votes
      myVotes.forEach(i=>{ updatedPoll.votes[i]=(updatedPoll.votes[i]||1)-1; });
      // Add new votes
      newMyVotes.forEach(i=>{ updatedPoll.votes[i]=(updatedPoll.votes[i]||0)+1; });
      const newVotes = {...votes,[pollId]:newMyVotes};
      await moduleStoreSet("polls-votes:" + (user.name),newVotes); setVotes(newVotes);
    } else {
      // Single choice â€” undo old
      if (alreadyVoted!==undefined&&alreadyVoted!==null) {
        updatedPoll.votes[alreadyVoted]=Math.max(0,(updatedPoll.votes[alreadyVoted]||1)-1);
      }
      updatedPoll.votes[optionIndex]=(updatedPoll.votes[optionIndex]||0)+1;
      const newVotes = {...votes,[pollId]:optionIndex};
      await moduleStoreSet("polls-votes:" + (user.name),newVotes); setVotes(newVotes);
    }
    if (!updatedPoll.anonymous) {
      if (!updatedPoll.voters) updatedPoll.voters={};
      updatedPoll.voters[user.name]=true;
    }
    const u=polls.map(p=>p.id===pollId?updatedPoll:p);
    await moduleStoreSet("polls-list",u,true); setPolls(u);
  };

  const closePoll = async id => {
    const u=polls.map(p=>p.id===id?{...p,closed:true}:p);
    await moduleStoreSet("polls-list",u,true); setPolls(u);
  };

  const deletePoll = async id => {
    const u=polls.filter(p=>p.id!==id); await moduleStoreSet("polls-list",u,true); setPolls(u);
  };

  const active = polls.filter(p=>!p.closed);
  const closed = polls.filter(p=>p.closed);

  const PollCard = ({poll}) => {
    const myVote = votes[poll.id];
    const hasVoted = myVote!==undefined&&myVote!==null&&(Array.isArray(myVote)?myVote.length>0:true);
    const totalVotes = Object.values(poll.votes||{}).reduce((s,v)=>s+v,0);
    const showResults = hasVoted||poll.closed;

    return (
      <div style={PO.card}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:12}}>
          <div>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:4}}>{poll.question}</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
              <span style={PO.badge()}>{poll.type==="multi"?"Multi-choice":poll.type==="yesno"?"Yes/No":"Single choice"}</span>
              {poll.closed&&<span style={PO.badge("#9ca3af")}>Closed</span>}
              {poll.anonymous&&<span style={PO.badge("#6b7280")}>Anonymous</span>}
              <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12}}>by {poll.by} Â· {fmt(poll.at)}</span>
              {poll.deadline&&<span style={{color:"#d97706",fontSize:12}}>ðŸ“… Closes {fmt(poll.deadline)}</span>}
            </div>
          </div>
          {isAdmin&&(
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4}}>
              {!poll.closed&&<button style={{...PO.btn(),padding:"4px 8px",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>closePoll(poll.id)}>Close</button>}
              <button style={{...PO.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2"),padding:"4px 8px",fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>deletePoll(poll.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
          {poll.options.map((opt,i)=>{
            const voteCount = poll.votes?.[i]||0;
            const pct = totalVotes>0?Math.round(voteCount/totalVotes*100):0;
            const isMyVote = Array.isArray(myVote)?myVote.includes(i):myVote===i;
            const c = COLORS[i%COLORS.length];

            return (
              <div key={i}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:4}}>
                  {!poll.closed&&(
                    <button onClick={()=>castVote(poll.id,i)}
                      style={{width:22,height:22,borderRadius:poll.type==="multi"?4:"50%",border:"2px solid " + (isMyVote?c:"#e2e8f0"),background:isMyVote?c:"#fff",cursor:"pointer",flexShrink:0,transition:"all 0.15s"}} />
                  )}
                  <span style={{flex:1,fontSize:14,fontWeight:isMyVote?700:400,color:isMyVote?c:"#374151"}}>{opt}</span>
                  {showResults&&<span style={{fontSize:13,fontWeight:700,color:"#6b7280",flexShrink:0}}>{voteCount} ({pct}%)</span>}
                </div>
                {showResults&&(
                  <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:99,height:8,overflow:"hidden",marginLeft:poll.closed?0:32}}>
                    <div style={{width:(pct) + "%",height:"100%",background:c,borderRadius:99,transition:"width 0.5s"}} />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div style={{marginTop:10,fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>
          {totalVotes} vote{totalVotes!==1?"s":""}
          {!poll.anonymous&&poll.voters&&<span> Â· {Object.keys(poll.voters).length} participant{Object.keys(poll.voters).length!==1?"s":""}</span>}
          {!hasVoted&&!poll.closed&&<span style={{color:"#7c3aed",fontWeight:600}}> Â· You haven't voted yet</span>}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading pollsâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24}}>ðŸ—³ï¸ Team Polls</div>
        <button style={PO.btnS()} onClick={()=>setCreating(!creating)}>{creating?"Cancel":"+ Create Poll"}</button>
      </div>

      {/* Create form */}
      {creating&&(
        <div style={{...PO.card,marginBottom:20,border:"2px solid #7c3aed"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:14}}>ðŸ—³ï¸ New Poll</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12}}>
            <div><label style={PO.lbl}>Question*</label><input style={PO.inp} value={form.question} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,question:e.target.value}))} placeholder="What should the team decide?" /></div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12}}>
              <div><label style={PO.lbl}>Type</label>
                <select style={{...PO.inp,background:"#fff"}} value={form.type} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,type:e.target.value}))}>
                  <option value="single">Single choice</option>
                  <option value="multi">Multi-choice</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div><label style={PO.lbl}>Deadline (optional)</label><input style={PO.inp} type="date" value={form.deadline} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,deadline:e.target.value}))} /></div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={PO.lbl}>Options</label>
              {form.options.map((opt,i)=>(
                <div key={i} style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:6}}>
                  <input style={{...PO.inp,flex:1}} value={opt} onChange={e=>setOption(i,e.target.value)} placeholder={"Option " + (i+1)} />
                  {form.options.length>2&&<button style={{background:"#fef2f2",color:"#dc2626",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"0 10px",cursor:"pointer"}} onClick={()=>removeOption(i)}>âœ•</button>}
                </div>
              ))}
              <button style={{...PO.btn(),padding:"5px 12px",fontSize:12,marginTop:4}} onClick={addOption}>+ Add Option</button>
            </div>
            <label style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center",fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={form.anonymous} onChange={e=>setForm(p=>({...p,anonymous:e.target.checked}))} style={{accentColor:"#7c3aed"}} />
              Anonymous voting (names hidden)
            </label>
            <button style={PO.btnS()} onClick={createPoll}>ðŸ—³ï¸ Publish Poll</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab bar */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:16}}>
        {[["active","ðŸŸ¢ Active (" + (active.length) + ")\"],[\\\"closed\\\",\"ðŸ”’ Closed (" + (closed.length) + ")"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?PO.btnS():PO.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
        {tab==="active"&&active.length===0&&<div style={{...PO.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No active polls. Create one!</div>}
        {tab==="closed"&&closed.length===0&&<div style={{...PO.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No closed polls.</div>}
        {(tab==="active"?active:closed).map(p=><PollCard key={p.id} poll={p} />)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ TOOLCHECKOUTMODULE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// Tool inventory, sign-out / sign-in tracking, overdue alerts.

const TC = {
  card:  {background:"#fff",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14,padding:"18px 20px",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)"},
  btn:   (c="#ea580c",b="#fff7ed")=>({background:b,color:c,border:"1.5px solid " + (c) + "30",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  btnS:  (bg="#ea580c")=>({background:bg,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,cursor:"pointer"}),
  inp:   {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",outline:"none"},
  sel:   {border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:14,width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",background:"#fff"},
  lbl:   {fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4,display:"block"},
  badge: (c="#ea580c")=>({background:c+"18",color:c,borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block"}),
};

const fmt_fmt1    = iso=>iso?new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-US",{month:"short",day:"numeric",year:"numeric"}):"â€”";
const fmtT_fmtT1   = iso=>iso?new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString("en-US",{hour:"numeric",minute:"2-digit"}):"";
const today_today1  = ()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
const CATEGORIES = ["Power Tools","Hand Tools","Measurement","Electrical","Safety Gear","Other"];

function ToolCheckoutModule({ user, isAdmin }) {
  const [tools,    setTools]    = React.useState([]);
  const [log,      setLog]      = React.useState([]);
  const [tab,   setTab]   = React.useState("available");
  const [modal, setModal] = React.useState(null);
  const [toolForm, setToolForm] = React.useState({name:"",category:"Power Tools",quantity:"1",serialNum:"",notes:""});
  const [editId,   setEditId]   = React.useState(null);
  const [checkoutTool, setCheckoutTool] = React.useState(null);
  const [dueDate,  setDueDate]  = React.useState("");
  const [search,   setSearch]   = React.useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = React.useState(true);

  React.useEffect(()=>{
    (async()=>{
      setTools((await moduleStoreGet("toolco-tools",true))||[]);
      setLog((await moduleStoreGet("toolco-log",true))||[]);
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  },[]);

  const saveTool = async () => {
    if (!toolForm.name.trim()) return alert("Tool name required.");
    let u;
    if (editId) {
      u=tools.map(t=>t.id===editId?{...toolForm,id:editId,checkedOut:tools.find(t=>t.id===editId)?.checkedOut||false,checkedOutBy:tools.find(t=>t.id===editId)?.checkedOutBy||null}:t);
    } else {
      u=[...tools,{...toolForm,id:Date.now().toString(),checkedOut:false,checkedOutBy:null,dueDate:null,addedBy:user.name,addedAt:new Date().toISOString()}];
    }
    await moduleStoreSet("toolco-tools",u,true); setTools(u); setModal(null); setToolForm({name:"",category:"Power Tools",quantity:"1",serialNum:"",notes:""}); setEditId(null);
  };

  const checkout = async () => {
    if (!checkoutTool) return;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const u = tools.map(t=>t.id===checkoutTool.id?{...t,checkedOut:true,checkedOutBy:user.name,checkedOutAt:now,dueDate:dueDate||null}:t);
    const newLog = [...log,{toolId:checkoutTool.id,toolName:checkoutTool.name,user:user.name,action:"checkout",at:now,dueDate:dueDate||null,id:Date.now().toString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("toolco-tools",u,true); await moduleStoreSet("toolco-log",newLog,true);
    setTools(u); setLog(newLog); setModal(null); setCheckoutTool(null); setDueDate("");
  };

  const checkin = async (toolId) => {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const tool = tools.find(t=>t.id===toolId);
    const u = tools.map(t=>t.id===toolId?{...t,checkedOut:false,checkedOutBy:null,checkedOutAt:null,dueDate:null,lastReturn:now}:t);
    const newLog = [...log,{toolId,toolName:tool?.name,user:user.name,action:"checkin",at:now,id:Date.now().toString()}];
    await moduleStoreSet("toolco-tools",u,true); await moduleStoreSet("toolco-log",newLog,true);
    setTools(u); setLog(newLog);
  };

  const deleteTool = async id => {
    if (!window.confirm("Remove this tool?")) return;
    const u=tools.filter(t=>t.id!==id); await moduleStoreSet("toolco-tools",u,true); setTools(u);
  };

  const isOverdue = t => t.dueDate && t.dueDate < today_today1() && t.checkedOut;

  const available = tools.filter(t=>!t.checkedOut&&(!search||t.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())));
  const checkedOut = tools.filter(t=>t.checkedOut&&(!search||t.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())));
  const overdue = tools.filter(t=>isOverdue(t));
  const myCheckouts = tools.filter(t=>t.checkedOut&&t.checkedOutBy===user.name);

  if (loading) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:60,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading tool inventoryâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24}}>ðŸ”§ Tool Checkout</div>
        {isAdmin&&<button style={TC.btnS()} onClick={()=>{setToolForm({name:"",category:"Power Tools",quantity:"1",serialNum:"",notes:""});setEditId(null);setModal("tool");}}>+ Add Tool</button>}
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(4,1fr)",gap:10,marginBottom:18}}>
        {[
          {label:"Total Tools",value:tools.length,color:"#374151"},
          {label:"Available",  value:available.length,color:"#16a34a"},
          {label:"Checked Out",value:checkedOut.length,color:"#ea580c"},
          {label:"Overdue",    value:overdue.length,color:overdue.length>0?"#dc2626":"#9ca3af"},
        ].map(s=>(
          <div key={s.label} style={{...TC.card,textAlign:"center",padding:"12px 8px"}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,color:s.color}}>{s.value}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.label}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Overdue alert */}
      {overdue.length>0&&(
        <div style={{background:"#fef2f2",border:"2px solid #dc2626",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 16px",marginBottom:16}}>
          <span style={{color:"#dc2626",fontWeight:700}}>âš ï¸ {overdue.length} overdue tool{overdue.length>1?"s":" "}: {overdue.map(t=>(t.name) + " (" + (t.checkedOutBy) + ")").join(", ")}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:16,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {[["available","âœ… Available (" + (available.length) + ")\"],[\\\"checkedout\\\",\"ðŸ“¦ Out (" + (checkedOut.length) + ")\"],[\\\"mine\\\",\"ðŸ‘¤ Mine (" + (myCheckouts.length) + ")"],["history","ðŸ“œ Log"]].map(([t,l])=>(
          <button key={t} onClick={()=>setTab(t)} style={tab===t?TC.btnS():TC.btn()}>{l}</button>
        ))}
        <input style={{...TC.inp,flex:1,minWidth:140}} placeholder="ðŸ” Search toolsâ€¦" value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} />
      </div>

      {/* Available */}
      {tab==="available"&&(
        <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr))",gap:12}}>
          {available.length===0&&<div style={{...TC.card,gridColumn:"1/-1",textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No available tools.</div>}
          {available.map(t=>(
            <div key={t.id} style={{...TC.card,border:"1.5px solid #dcfce7"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14,marginBottom:4}}>{t.name}</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,marginBottom:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                <span style={TC.badge("#059669")}>Available</span>
                <span style={TC.badge("#6b7280")}>{t.category}</span>
                {t.quantity&&Number(t.quantity)>1&&<span style={TC.badge("#374151")}>Qty: {t.quantity}</span>}
              </div>
              {t.serialNum&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:8}}>S/N: {t.serialNum}</div>}
              {t.notes&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:8}}>{t.notes}</div>}
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
                <button style={{...TC.btnS(),flex:1,padding:"7px"}} onClick={()=>{setCheckoutTool(t);setDueDate("");setModal("checkout");}}>Check Out</button>
                {isAdmin&&(
                  <>
                    <button style={{...TC.btn(),padding:"7px 10px"}} onClick={()=>{setToolForm({name:t.name,category:t.category,quantity:t.quantity||"1",serialNum:t.serialNum||"",notes:t.notes||""});setEditId(t.id);setModal("tool");}}>âœï¸</button>
                    <button style={{...TC.btn("#dc2626","#fef2f2"),padding:"7px 10px"}} onClick={()=>deleteTool(t.id)}>ðŸ—‘ï¸</button>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Checked Out */}
      {tab==="checkedout"&&(
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
          {checkedOut.length===0&&<div style={{...TC.card,textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No tools checked out.</div>}
          {checkedOut.map(t=>(
            <div key={t.id} style={{...TC.card,borderLeft:"4px solid " + (isOverdue(t)?"#dc2626":"#ea580c")}}>
              <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>{t.name}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:2}}>
                    ðŸ‘¤ {t.checkedOutBy} Â· Out: {fmtT_fmtT1(t.checkedOutAt)} {fmt_fmt1(t.checkedOutAt)}
                    {t.dueDate&&<span style={{color:isOverdue(t)?"#dc2626":"#d97706"}}> Â· Due: {fmt_fmt1(t.dueDate)}{isOverdue(t)?" âš ï¸ OVERDUE":""}</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                {(t.checkedOutBy===user.name||isAdmin)&&(
                  <button style={TC.btnS("#16a34a")} onClick={()=>checkin(t.id)}>Return</button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mine */}
      {tab==="mine"&&(
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
          {myCheckouts.length===0&&<div style={{...TC.card,textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>You have no tools checked out.</div>}
          {myCheckouts.map(t=>(
            <div key={t.id} style={{...TC.card,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{t.name}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Out since {fmtT_fmtT1(t.checkedOutAt)} {fmt_fmt1(t.checkedOutAt)}{t.dueDate&&(` - Due `+fmt_fmt1(t.dueDate))}</div>
              </div>
              <button style={TC.btnS("#16a34a")} onClick={()=>checkin(t.id)}>Return</button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Log */}
      {tab==="history"&&(
        <div style={TC.card}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:12}}>Recent Activity</div>
          {[...log].reverse().slice(0,50).map(entry=>(
            <div key={entry.id} style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",padding:"8px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",fontSize:13}}>
              <span style={{fontSize:18}}>{entry.action==="checkout"?"ðŸ“¤":"ðŸ“¥"}</span>
              <div style={{flex:1}}>
                <span style={{fontWeight:700}}>{entry.user}</span> {entry.action==="checkout"?"checked out":"returned"} <span style={{fontWeight:700}}>{entry.toolName}</span>
              </div>
              <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12}}>{fmtT_fmtT1(entry.at)} {fmt_fmt1(entry.at)}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          {log.length===0&&<div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:20,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No activity yet.</div>}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Tool Modal */}
      {modal==="tool"&&(
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999}} onClick={()=>{setModal(null);setEditId(null);}}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,width:"100%",maxWidth:440,padding:24}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>{editId?"âœï¸ Edit Tool":"ðŸ”§ Add Tool"}</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
