  {id:"tma_strategic",title:"Multi-Year Strategic Planning",est:"13 min",content:`## This Season's Decisions Shape Next Season's Options
Teams that plan one season at a time make reactive decisions. Teams with a 3-year strategic plan make deliberate ones: they know which competitions to prioritize, which awards to build toward, which programs to launch and when. Strategic plans don't predict the future â€” they make explicit what the team is trying to become.

## The 3-Year Strategic Plan Structure
\`\`\`
Vision (5-10 years): "What does our team look like at its best?"
  â†’ "Team 1234 is the premier STEM education resource in our county,
    running sustainable programs that outlast any individual member,
    and competing at championship level."

3-Year Goals (specific, measurable):
  Year 1: Foundation
    â†’ Reach championship via district points
    â†’ Document all outreach programs (playbooks complete by August)
    â†’ Build financial reserve of $5,000

  Year 2: Growth
    â†’ Win District Chairman's Award for first time
    â†’ Launch 2 new sustained school programs
    â†’ Establish Advisory Board

  Year 3: Excellence
    â†’ Win Chairman's Award at Championship
    â†’ 3 independent school programs running without team support
    â†’ Endowment campaign: raise $20,000

Annual operating plan:
  â†’ Each year's plan is the first year of the strategic plan
  â†’ At year end: was Year 1 achieved? Shift Year 2 to Year 1 position, add new Year 3.
\`\`\`

## Making Strategic Decisions Within the Plan
\`\`\`
When faced with a resource decision, ask:
  "Does this move us toward our 3-year goals or away from them?"

Example: an opportunity to host a regional scrimmage event
  Requires: 40 hours of student/mentor time, $2,000 in expenses
  Toward goals? 
    â†’ Yes: builds relationships, increases regional visibility, outreach hours
    â†’ Maybe: if it pulls 40 hours from engineering notebook development in Year 1
  Decision: take it in Year 2 (foundation is established); defer in Year 1

The plan makes these decisions easier to make consistently.
Without it, every opportunity is evaluated from scratch every time.
\`\`\``,quiz:[
      {q:"What does a rolling 3-year plan mean in practice?",opts:["Planning is done every 3 years","Each year, Year 1 is evaluated, Years 2 and 3 shift forward, and a new Year 3 is added â€” the horizon stays 3 years out while the team is always executing on a 1-year plan grounded in a longer trajectory","Years can be skipped if goals are met","The plan is fixed for 3 years"],ans:1},
    ]},
);

function shuffleArr(a){const b=[...a];for(let i=b.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[b[i],b[j]]=[b[j],b[i]];}return b;}

function pickPlacementQuestions(){
  const bycat={};
  PLACEMENT_BANK.forEach(q=>{if(!bycat[q.cat])bycat[q.cat]=[];bycat[q.cat].push(q);});
  const counts={Programming:16,Mechanics:16,Strategy:4,Safety:4};
  let picks=[];
  Object.keys(counts).forEach(cat=>{
    const pool=shuffleArr(bycat[cat]||[]);
    picks=picks.concat(pool.slice(0,Math.min(counts[cat],pool.length)));
  });
  return shuffleArr(picks).map(q=>{
    const idxs=shuffleArr([0,1,2,3].slice(0,q.opts.length));
    const newOpts=idxs.map(i=>q.opts[i]);
    const newAns=idxs.indexOf(q.ans);
    return {cat:q.cat,q:q.q,opts:newOpts,ans:newAns,exp:q.exp};
  });
}

function calcPlacementRole(catScores){
  const roles={
    Programming:{name:'ðŸ’» Programming Subteam',desc:'Your code knowledge stands out. You would thrive writing robot code, vision systems, or autonomous routines.',color:'#1d4ed8'},
    Mechanics:{name:'ðŸ”§ Build / Mechanical Subteam',desc:'Strong mechanical understanding. You would excel designing mechanisms, fabricating parts, or maintaining the robot.',color:'#b45309'},
    Strategy:{name:'ðŸ“‹ Strategy & Scouting',desc:'Sharp strategic mind. Consider leading scouting, drive team support, or match planning.',color:'#15803d'},
    Safety:{name:'ðŸ¦º Safety Captain / Pit Crew',desc:'Great safety and team awareness. You would be a strong Safety Captain or pit crew lead.',color:'#7c3aed'},
  };
  const cats=Object.keys(catScores).filter(k=>catScores[k].t>0);
  if(!cats.length) return roles.Programming;
  const best=cats.sort((a,b)=>(catScores[b].c/catScores[b].t)-(catScores[a].c/catScores[a].t))[0];
  return {...roles[best],category:best};
}

// â”€â”€â”€ STORAGE HELPERS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// â”€â”€â”€ JSONBIN CONFIG â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
// To enable multi-computer sync:
// 1. Sign up free at https://jsonbin.io (email only, no credit card)
// 2. Click "CREATE BIN", paste {} as content, click Create
// 3. Copy the Bin ID from the URL (looks like 65abc123...)
// 4. Go to API Keys tab, copy your Master Key
// 5. Paste both below and redeploy / refresh
const JSONBIN_KEY = "$2a$10$Cw49V21qOMsbpNh4yD1wa.rNqIVQz1FH4FG..jF2FsG7XeYgFLU4W "; // paste your Master Key here e.g. "$2b$10$abc..."
const JSONBIN_BIN = "69a82a71d0ea881f40ee16bf"; // paste your Bin ID here e.g. "65abc123def456"
const JSONBIN_URL = "https://api.jsonbin.io/v3/b/" + (JSONBIN_BIN);

// In-memory cache so we don't hammer the API on every read
let _sharedCache = null;
let _cacheTs = 0;
const CACHE_TTL = 4000; // 4 seconds

async function _getRemote() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(JSONBIN_URL + "/latest", {
      headers: { "X-Master-Key": JSONBIN_KEY }
    });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
    const d = await r.json();
    _sharedCache = d.record || {};
    _cacheTs = Date.now();
    return _sharedCache;
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn("JSONBin read failed, using localStorage fallback:", e.message);
    return null;
  }
}

async function _setRemote(data) {
  _sharedCache = data;
  _cacheTs = Date.now();
  try {
    const r = await fetch(JSONBIN_URL, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Master-Key": JSONBIN_KEY },
      body: JSON.stringify(data)
    });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + r.status);
  } catch(e) {
    console.warn("JSONBin write failed, using localStorage fallback:", e.message);
    // Fall back to localStorage
    localStorage.setItem("shared:__jsonbin__", JSON.stringify(data));
  }
}

function _useRemote() {
  return JSONBIN_KEY && JSONBIN_BIN && JSONBIN_KEY.length > 10;
}

// storeGet / storeSet â€” drop-in replacements that work both locally and multi-computer
async function storeGet(key, shared=false) {
  try {
    if (shared && _useRemote()) {
      // Use cache if fresh enough
      let db = (_sharedCache && (Date.now() - _cacheTs) < CACHE_TTL) ? _sharedCache : await _getRemote();
      if (!db) db = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("shared:__jsonbin__") || "{}");
      return db[key] !== undefined ? db[key] : null;
    }
    const storageKey = shared ? "shared:" + key : "user:" + key;
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
  } catch(e) { return null; }
}

async function storeSet(key, val, shared=false) {
  try {
    if (shared && _useRemote()) {
      let db = (_sharedCache && (Date.now() - _cacheTs) < CACHE_TTL) ? _sharedCache : await _getRemote();
      if (!db) db = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("shared:__jsonbin__") || "{}");
      db[key] = val;
      await _setRemote(db);
      return;
    }
    const storageKey = shared ? "shared:" + key : "user:" + key;
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(val));
  } catch(e) { console.warn("storeSet failed:", e); }
}

// Helper: clear all hub data
function clearAllHubData() {
  const toRemove = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
    const k = localStorage.key(i);
    if (k && (k.startsWith("shared:") || k.startsWith("user:"))) toRemove.push(k);
  }
  toRemove.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));
  _sharedCache = null;
  window.location.reload();
}

// â”€â”€â”€ TIME TRACKING â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
let _sessionStart = null;
function startLearningTimer() { _sessionStart = Date.now(); }
function stopLearningTimer() {
  if (_sessionStart === null) return 0;
  const elapsed = Math.floor((Date.now() - _sessionStart) / 1000);
  _sessionStart = null;
  return elapsed;
}
async function addLearningTime(username, seconds) {
  if (!username || seconds <= 0) return;
  const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
  if (users[username]) {
    users[username].learningTime = (users[username].learningTime || 0) + seconds;
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
  }
}
function fmtTime(secs) {
  if (!secs) return "0 min";
  const h = Math.floor(secs/3600);
  const m = Math.floor((secs%3600)/60);
  if (h > 0) return h + "h " + m + "m";
  return m > 0 ? m + " min" : secs + "s";
}

async function checkAndUnlockAchievements(username, totalLessons) {
  const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
  const u = users[username];
  if (!u) return [];
  const already = u.achievements || [];
  const newlyUnlocked = [];
  for (const ach of ACHIEVEMENTS) {
    if (!already.includes(ach.id) && ach.check(u, totalLessons)) {
      already.push(ach.id);
      newlyUnlocked.push(ach);
    }
  }
  if (newlyUnlocked.length > 0) {
    u.achievements = already;
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
  }
  return newlyUnlocked;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ STREAK TRACKING â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
async function updateStreak(username) {
  const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
  const u = users[username];
  if (!u) return;
  // Use YYYY-MM-DD format for reliable date comparison
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const yesterdayStr = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  if (u.lastStudyDay === todayStr) return; // already counted today
  u.streak = u.lastStudyDay === yesterdayStr ? (u.streak || 0) + 1 : 1;
  u.lastStudyDay = todayStr;
  users[username] = u;
  await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
}
