                    <div style={{flex:1,background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:999,height:6}}>
                      <div style={{width:(pct) + "%",background:pct>=80?"#10b981":pct>=60?"#f59e0b":"#ef4444",height:"100%",borderRadius:999}}></div>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:pct>=80?"#10b981":pct>=60?"#f59e0b":"#ef4444"}}>{pct}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#94a3b8",marginTop:3}}>{v.score}/{v.total} correct</div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ VIDEO EMBED â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function VideoEmbed({ lessonId }) {
  const v = LESSON_VIDEOS[lessonId];
  if (!v) return null;
  const ytUrl = "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=" + (v.id);
  const thumbUrl = "https://img.youtube.com/vi/" + (v.id) + "/hqdefault.jpg";
  return (
    <div style={{marginBottom:20}}>
      <a href={ytUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style={{textDecoration:"none",display:"block"}}>
        <div style={{position:"relative",borderRadius:12,overflow:"hidden",background:"#0f172a",cursor:"pointer",border:"2px solid #1e3a5f",transition:"border-color 0.2s"}}
          onMouseEnter={e=>e.currentTarget.style.borderColor="#3b82f6"}
          onMouseLeave={e=>e.currentTarget.style.borderColor="#1e3a5f"}>
          {/* Thumbnail */}
          <img src={thumbUrl} alt={v.title} style={{width:"100%",display:"block",opacity:0.85}}
            onError={e=>{e.target.style.display="none";}} />
          {/* Play overlay */}
          <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"}}>
            <div style={{width:56,height:56,background:"#dc2626",borderRadius:"50%",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",boxShadow:"0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)",marginBottom:8}}>
              <div style={{width:0,height:0,borderTop:"12px solid transparent",borderBottom:"12px solid transparent",borderLeft:"20px solid #fff",marginLeft:5}}/>
            </div>
            <div style={{color:"#fff",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,textShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)",textAlign:"center",padding:"0 16px"}}>{v.title}</div>
          </div>
          {/* YouTube badge */}
          <div style={{position:"absolute",bottom:8,right:8,background:"#dc2626",color:"#fff",borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 8px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:4}}>
            â–¶ Watch on YouTube
          </div>
        </div>
      </a>
      <div style={{marginTop:5,fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",textAlign:"right"}}>
        Opens YouTube in a new tab
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ QUIZ COMPONENT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function QuizView({ subjectId, level, username, onClose, onSaveScore }) {
  const questions = QUIZZES[subjectId]?.[level] || [];
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [finished, setFinished] = useState(false);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState([]);
  const sub = SUBJECTS.find(s=>s.id===subjectId);
  const q = questions[current];
  const pct = Math.round(score/questions.length*100);

  function confirm() {
    if (selected===null) return;
    const correct = selected===q.ans;
    setConfirmed(true);
    setAnswers(prev=>[...prev,{correct,selected,q}]);
    if (correct) setScore(s=>s+1);
  }
  function next() {
    if (current+1>=questions.length) { setFinished(true); onSaveScore && onSaveScore(subjectId,level,score+(selected===q.ans?1:0),questions.length); return; }
    setCurrent(c=>c+1); setSelected(null); setConfirmed(false);
  }
  function restart() { setCurrent(0);setSelected(null);setConfirmed(false);setScore(0);setFinished(false);setAnswers([]); }

  if (questions.length===0) return <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No quiz available for this level yet.</div>;

  if (finished) return (
    <div>
      <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,textAlign:"center",padding:36}}>
        <div style={{fontSize:52,marginBottom:12}}>{pct>=80?"ðŸ†":pct>=60?"âœ…":"ðŸ“–"}</div>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:26,marginBottom:6}}>{pct>=80?"Excellent!":pct>=60?"Good job!":"Keep studying!"}</div>
        <div style={{fontSize:18,color:"#374151",marginBottom:4}}>{score}/{questions.length} correct</div>
        <div style={{fontSize:28,fontWeight:900,color:pct>=80?"#16a34a":pct>=60?"#d97706":"#dc2626",margin:"8px 0 16px"}}>{pct}%</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,justifyContent:"center",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
          <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={restart}>Retry Quiz</button>
          <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut()} onClick={onClose}>Back</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={S_HANDBO.card}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:14}}>Review Answers</div>
        {answers.map((a,i)=>(
          <div key={i} style={{borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 16px",marginBottom:10,background:a.correct?"#f0fdf4":"#fef2f2",border:"1.5px solid " + (a.correct?"#bbf7d0":"#fecaca")}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:6}}>{a.correct?"âœ…":"âŒ"} {a.q.q}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#374151"}}>Your answer: <b>{a.q.opts[a.selected]}</b></div>
            {!a.correct && <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#16a34a",marginTop:2}}>Correct: <b>{a.q.opts[a.q.ans]}</b></div>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:16,flexWrap:"wrap",gap:8}}>
        <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut()} onClick={onClose}>â† Back</button>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <span style={{background:sub.color+"15",color:sub.color,padding:"3px 12px",borderRadius:20,fontSize:12,fontWeight:700}}>{sub.icon} {sub.name}</span>
          <span style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#6b7280",padding:"3px 12px",borderRadius:20,fontSize:12,fontWeight:700}}>{level}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:20,height:6,marginBottom:20,overflow:"hidden"}}>
        <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(90deg," + (sub.color) + "," + (sub.color) + "cc)",width:((current/questions.length)*100) + "%",height:"100%",transition:"width 0.4s",borderRadius:20}}/>
      </div>
      <div style={S_HANDBO.card}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:6}}>
          <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13}}>Question {current+1} of {questions.length}</span>
          <span style={{color:"#16a34a",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13}}>Score: {score}</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18,lineHeight:1.4,marginBottom:22,color:"#111"}}>{q.q}</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
          {q.opts.map((opt,i)=>{
            let bg="#f8fafc",border="1.5px solid #e2e8f0",color="#374151";
            if (selected===i&&!confirmed){bg=sub.color+"12";border="1.5px solid " + (sub.color);color=sub.color;}
            if (confirmed&&i===q.ans){bg="#f0fdf4";border="1.5px solid #86efac";color="#15803d";}
            if (confirmed&&selected===i&&i!==q.ans){bg="#fef2f2";border="1.5px solid #fca5a5";color="#dc2626";}
            return (
              <button key={i} onClick={()=>{if(!confirmed)setSelected(i);}}
                style={{background:bg,border,color,padding:"12px 16px",borderRadius:9,cursor:confirmed?"default":"pointer",textAlign:"left",fontWeight:selected===i?700:500,fontSize:14,transition:"all 0.15s",fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                <span style={{fontWeight:700,marginRight:10,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{String.fromCharCode(65+i)}.</span>{opt}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        <div style={{marginTop:20,display:"flex",gap:10}}>
          {!confirmed
            ? <button style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(sub.color),opacity:selected===null?0.5:1}} onClick={confirm} disabled={selected===null}>Confirm Answer</button>
            : <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={next}>{current+1<questions.length?"Next Question â†’":"See Results"}</button>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ PLACEMENT QUIZ COMPONENT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function PlacementQuiz({ user, onComplete }) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("intro"); // intro | quiz | results
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [cur, setCur] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);
  const [catScores, setCatScores] = useState({Programming:{c:0,t:0},Mechanics:{c:0,t:0},Strategy:{c:0,t:0},Safety:{c:0,t:0}});
  const [totalScore, setTotalScore] = useState(0);
  const [role, setRole] = useState(null);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState([]);

  function startPlacement(){
    const qs=pickPlacementQuestions();
    setQuestions(qs);
    setCur(0);setSelected(null);setConfirmed(false);
    setCatScores({Programming:{c:0,t:0},Mechanics:{c:0,t:0},Strategy:{c:0,t:0},Safety:{c:0,t:0}});
    setTotalScore(0);setAnswers([]);
    setPhase("quiz");
  }

  function confirmAns(){
    if(selected===null) return;
    const q=questions[cur];
    const correct=selected===q.ans;
    setConfirmed(true);
    if(correct) setTotalScore(s=>s+1);
    setCatScores(prev=>{
      const n={...prev};
      n[q.cat]={c:n[q.cat].c+(correct?1:0),t:n[q.cat].t+1};
      return n;
    });
    setAnswers(prev=>[...prev,{q,selected,correct}]);
  }

  function nextQ(){
    if(cur+1>=questions.length){
      // finish
      const cs={...catScores};
      // catScores state may lag, recompute
      const finalCats={Programming:{c:0,t:0},Mechanics:{c:0,t:0},Strategy:{c:0,t:0},Safety:{c:0,t:0}};
      [...answers,{q:questions[cur],selected,correct:selected===questions[cur].ans}].forEach(({q,correct})=>{
        finalCats[q.cat].t++;
        if(correct) finalCats[q.cat].c++;
      });
      const r=calcPlacementRole(finalCats);
      const sc=answers.filter(a=>a.correct).length+(selected===questions[cur].ans?1:0);
      setRole(r);
      setTotalScore(sc);
      setCatScores(finalCats);
      setPhase("results");
      onComplete&&onComplete({role:r,score:sc,total:questions.length,catScores:finalCats,ts:Date.now()});
    } else {
      setCur(c=>c+1);setSelected(null);setConfirmed(false);
    }
  }

  if(phase==="intro") return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:8}}>ðŸ§ª Team Placement Assessment</div>
      <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#1d4ed8)",color:"#fff",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontSize:18,fontWeight:800,marginBottom:8}}>Welcome to the Team Placement Quiz</div>
        <div style={{opacity:0.9,lineHeight:1.7,fontSize:14,marginBottom:16}}>
          This 40-question assessment covers Programming, Mechanics, Strategy, and Safety. Your scores determine which subteam you're best suited for â€” and are shared with the team admin to help with role assignments.
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:16}}>
          {[["ðŸ’»","Programming","16 Qs"],["ðŸ”§","Mechanics","16 Qs"],["ðŸ“‹","Strategy","4 Qs"],["ðŸ¦º","Safety","4 Qs"]].map(([ic,lb,ct])=>(
            <div key={lb} style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 16px",textAlign:"center",minWidth:90}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:22}}>{ic}</div>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13}}>{lb}</div>
              <div style={{opacity:0.75,fontSize:11}}>{ct}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <button style={{...S_HANDBO.btn("#fff"),color:"#1d4ed8",fontSize:15,padding:"11px 28px"}} onClick={startPlacement}>Begin Assessment â†’</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if(phase==="quiz"){
    const q=questions[cur];
    const catColors={Programming:"#1d4ed8",Mechanics:"#b45309",Strategy:"#15803d",Safety:"#7c3aed"};
    const pct=Math.round((cur/questions.length)*100);
    return (
      <div>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ§ª Placement Assessment</div>
        <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:20,height:8,marginBottom:6,overflow:"hidden"}}>
          <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(90deg,#1d4ed8,#7c3aed)",width:(pct) + "%",height:"100%",transition:"width 0.4s",borderRadius:20}}/>
        </div>
        <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:18}}>Question {cur+1} of {questions.length}</div>
        <div style={S_HANDBO.card}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,marginBottom:14}}>
            <span style={{background:catColors[q.cat]+"15",color:catColors[q.cat],padding:"3px 12px",borderRadius:20,fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,textTransform:"uppercase"}}>
              {q.cat}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,lineHeight:1.5,marginBottom:22,color:"#111"}}>{q.q}</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
            {q.opts.map((opt,i)=>{
              let bg="#f8fafc",border="1.5px solid #e2e8f0",color="#374151";
              if(selected===i&&!confirmed){bg=catColors[q.cat]+"12";border="1.5px solid " + (catColors[q.cat]);color=catColors[q.cat];}
              if(confirmed&&i===q.ans){bg="#f0fdf4";border="1.5px solid #86efac";color="#15803d";}
              if(confirmed&&selected===i&&i!==q.ans){bg="#fef2f2";border="1.5px solid #fca5a5";color="#dc2626";}
              return (
                <button key={i} onClick={()=>{if(!confirmed)setSelected(i);}}
                  style={{background:bg,border,color,padding:"12px 16px",borderRadius:9,cursor:confirmed?"default":"pointer",textAlign:"left",fontWeight:selected===i?700:500,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit",transition:"all 0.15s"}}>
                  <span style={{fontWeight:700,marginRight:10,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{String.fromCharCode(65+i)}.</span>{opt}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          {confirmed && (
            <div style={{marginTop:14,padding:"10px 14px",borderRadius:8,background:selected===q.ans?"#f0fdf4":"#fff7ed",border:"1px solid " + (selected===q.ans?"#86efac":"#fed7aa"),fontSize:13,color:selected===q.ans?"#15803d":"#9a3412",lineHeight:1.5}}>
              {selected===q.ans?"âœ… Correct! ":"ðŸ’¡ "}{q.exp}
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{marginTop:20}}>
            {!confirmed
              ? <button style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(catColors[q.cat]),opacity:selected===null?0.5:1}} onClick={confirmAns} disabled={selected===null}>Confirm Answer</button>
              : <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={nextQ}>{cur+1<questions.length?"Next Question â†’":"See My Results"}</button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if(phase==="results"){
    const total=questions.length;
    const pct=Math.round((totalScore/total)*100);
    const passed=pct>=80;
    return (
      <div>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:16}}>ðŸ§ª Placement Results</div>
        {/* Banner */}
        <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,background:pct>=80?"linear-gradient(135deg,#166534,#16a34a)":pct>=60?"linear-gradient(135deg,#92400e,#d97706)":"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#1d4ed8)",color:"#fff",textAlign:"center",padding:32,marginBottom:20}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:48,marginBottom:8}}>{pct>=80?"ðŸ†":pct>=60?"âœ…":"ðŸ“š"}</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:28,fontWeight:900,marginBottom:4}}>{totalScore} / {total}</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:20,opacity:0.9,marginBottom:8}}>{pct}% Correct</div>
          <div style={{opacity:0.85,fontSize:14}}>{pct>=80?"Excellent performance! Top marks.":pct>=60?"Good job â€” solid knowledge base.":"Keep studying! Every attempt helps you improve."}</div>
        </div>
        {/* Role recommendation */}
        {role && (
          <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,borderLeft:"5px solid " + (role.color),marginBottom:20}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,textTransform:"uppercase",color:"#9ca3af",letterSpacing:1,marginBottom:6}}>ðŸŽ¯ Recommended Team Role</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:20,fontWeight:900,color:role.color,marginBottom:6}}>{role.name}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#4b5563",lineHeight:1.6}}>{role.desc}</div>
          </div>
        )}
        {/* Category breakdown */}
        <div style={S_HANDBO.card}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:14}}>ðŸ“Š Category Breakdown</div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
            {Object.entries(catScores).filter(([,v])=>v.t>0).map(([cat,v])=>{
              const cp=Math.round((v.c/v.t)*100);
              const col=cp>=80?"#16a34a":cp>=60?"#d97706":"#dc2626";
              const bg=cp>=80?"#f0fdf4":cp>=60?"#fffbeb":"#fef2f2";
              const label=cp>=80?"Strong âœ…":cp>=60?"Developing ðŸŸ¡":"Needs work ðŸ”´";
              return (
                <div key={cat} style={{background:bg,borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",border:"1.5px solid " + (col) + "30"}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,textTransform:"uppercase",color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:4}}>{cat}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:18,fontWeight:900,color:col}}>{v.c}/{v.t} <span style={{fontSize:13,fontWeight:600}}>({cp}%)</span></div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:col,marginTop:2}}>{label}</div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
          <div style={{borderTop:"1px solid #e2e8f0",paddingTop:14,display:"flex",gap:10,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={()=>{setPhase("intro");}}>Retake Assessment</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return null;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ REGISTRATION GATE: FULL 40-QUESTION PLACEMENT TEST â”€â”€
const FULL_GATE_PASS_SCORE_DEFAULT = 25; // fallback if not set in storage

function FullRegistrationTest({ onPass, onBack, passScore }) {
  const gatePassScore = passScore || FULL_GATE_PASS_SCORE_DEFAULT;
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("intro"); // intro | test | done
  const [questions] = useState(() => pickPlacementQuestions());
  const [cur, setCur] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [catScores, setCatScores] = useState({Programming:{c:0,t:0},Mechanics:{c:0,t:0},Strategy:{c:0,t:0},Safety:{c:0,t:0}});
  const [gateResult, setGateResult] = useState(null);

  // â”€â”€ PRE-TEST INTRO PAGE â”€â”€
  if (phase === "intro") {
    return (
      <div>
        <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:48,marginBottom:8}}>ðŸ§ </div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,marginBottom:6,color:"#1e293b"}}>Entry Knowledge Test</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",lineHeight:1.6,maxWidth:380,margin:"0 auto"}}>
            Before creating your account, take this short placement test. It helps us understand your background and assigns you to the right learning track.
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:10,padding:16,marginBottom:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:10,color:"#374151"}}>ðŸ“‹ What to Expect</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:7}}>
            {[
              ["ðŸ”¢","40 questions across 4 categories"],
              ["â±","No time limit â€” take your time"],
              ["ðŸ“š","Topics: Programming, Mechanics, Strategy, Safety"],
              ["âœ…","Need "+gatePassScore+"/40 ("+Math.round(gatePassScore/40*100)+"%) to register"],
              ["ðŸŽ¯","Your score determines your learning track"],
            ].map(([ic,txt])=>(
              <div key={txt} style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,fontSize:13,color:"#475569"}}>
                <span style={{fontSize:16}}>{ic}</span><span>{txt}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style={{background:"#fffbeb",border:"1px solid #fde68a",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 14px",marginBottom:18,fontSize:12,color:"#92400e"}}>
          ðŸ’¡ <b>Tip:</b> Don't worry if you don't know everything! This test places you â€” it's not pass/fail for advanced knowledge. Study the lessons first if you want.
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10}}>
          <button style={{flex:1,background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1d4ed8,#7c3aed)",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"12px 0",fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit"}}
            onClick={()=>setPhase("test")}>
            Start Test â†’
          </button>
          <button style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#475569",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:8,padding:"12px 18px",fontWeight:600,fontSize:14,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit"}}
            onClick={onBack}>
            Cancel
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const q = questions[cur];
  const catColors={Programming:"#1d4ed8",Mechanics:"#b45309",Strategy:"#15803d",Safety:"#7c3aed"};

  function confirm() {
    if (selected === null) return;
    const correct = selected === q.ans;
    setConfirmed(true);
    const newScore = correct ? score + 1 : score;
    if (correct) setScore(s => s + 1);
    setCatScores(prev => {
      const n = {...prev};
      n[q.cat] = {c: n[q.cat].c + (correct?1:0), t: n[q.cat].t + 1};
      return n;
    });
  }

  function next() {
    if (cur + 1 >= questions.length) {
      const finalScore = score + (selected === q.ans ? 1 : 0);
      const passed = finalScore >= gatePassScore;
      const finalCats = {...catScores};
      if (selected === q.ans) finalCats[q.cat] = {...finalCats[q.cat], c: finalCats[q.cat].c + 1, t: finalCats[q.cat].t + 1};
      else finalCats[q.cat] = {...finalCats[q.cat], t: finalCats[q.cat].t + 1};
      setGateResult({ score: finalScore, total: questions.length, passed, catScores: finalCats, role: calcPlacementRole(finalCats) });
      setDone(true);
    } else {
      setCur(c => c + 1); setSelected(null); setConfirmed(false);
    }
  }

  if (done && gateResult) {
    const { score: sc, total, passed, catScores: cs, role } = gateResult;
    const pct = Math.round(sc / total * 100);
    return (
      <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 48, marginBottom: 8 }}>{passed ? "ðŸŽ‰" : "ðŸ“š"}</div>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 20, marginBottom: 6, color: passed ? "#16a34a" : "#dc2626" }}>
          {passed ? "Test Passed! Welcome to the team." : "Not quite â€” keep studying!"}
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 900, color: passed?"#16a34a":"#dc2626", marginBottom: 8 }}>
          {sc} / {total} ({pct}%)
        </div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#6b7280", marginBottom: 12 }}>
          {passed ? "You scored " + (pct) + "% â€” above the " + (Math.round(gatePassScore/total*100)) + "% minimum." : "You need " + (gatePassScore) + "/" + (total) + " (" + (Math.round(gatePassScore/total*100)) + "%) to register. Study the learning modules and try again!"}
        </div>
        {passed && role && (
          <div style={{ marginBottom: 14, padding: "10px 14px", borderRadius: 10, background: role.color+"12", border: "1.5px solid " + (role.color), textAlign: "left" }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#9ca3af", fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", marginBottom: 3 }}>Your Best Area</div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: role.color, fontSize: 15 }}>{role.name}</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#6b7280", marginTop: 2 }}>{role.desc}</div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 8, marginBottom: 16, textAlign: "left" }}>
          {Object.entries(cs).filter(([,v])=>v.t>0).map(([cat, v]) => {
            const cp = Math.round(v.c/v.t*100);
            const col = cp>=80?"#16a34a":cp>=60?"#d97706":"#dc2626";
            return (
              <div key={cat} style={{ background: col+"12", borderRadius: 8, padding: "8px 10px", border: "1px solid " + (col) + "30" }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, textTransform: "uppercase", color: "#6b7280" }}>{cat}</div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, color: col, fontSize: 15 }}>{v.c}/{v.t} ({cp}%)</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {passed ? (
          <button style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btn("#16a34a"), width: "100%", padding: "11px", fontSize: 15 }} onClick={() => onPass(gateResult)}>
            Create My Account â†’
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btn(), width: "100%", padding: "11px", fontSize: 15 }} onClick={() => {
            setCur(0); setSelected(null); setConfirmed(false); setScore(0); setDone(false);
            setCatScores({Programming:{c:0,t:0},Mechanics:{c:0,t:0},Strategy:{c:0,t:0},Safety:{c:0,t:0}});
            setGateResult(null);
          }}>â†º Try Again</button>
        )}
        <button style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btnOut(), width: "100%", marginTop: 10, padding: "9px" }} onClick={onBack}>â† Back to Login</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const pct = Math.round((cur / questions.length) * 100);
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", marginBottom: 8 }}>
        <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 14, color: "#1d4ed8" }}>Entry Test</div>
        <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#9ca3af" }}>{cur+1} / {questions.length} Â· Score: {score}</div>
      </div>
      <div style={{ background: "#e2e8f0", borderRadius: 20, height: 6, marginBottom: 14, overflow: "hidden" }}>
        <div style={{ background: "linear-gradient(90deg,#1d4ed8,#7c3aed)", width: (pct) + "%", height: "100%", transition: "width 0.4s", borderRadius: 20 }} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: "inline-block", background: catColors[q.cat]+"18", color: catColors[q.cat], padding: "2px 10px", borderRadius: 20, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 10, textTransform: "uppercase" }}>{q.cat}</div>
      <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 14, lineHeight: 1.5, marginBottom: 14, color: "#111" }}>{q.q}</div>
      <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 7, marginBottom: 14 }}>
        {q.opts.map((opt, i) => {
          let bg="#f8fafc",border="1.5px solid #e2e8f0",color="#374151";
          if(selected===i&&!confirmed){bg=catColors[q.cat]+"12";border="1.5px solid " + (catColors[q.cat]);color=catColors[q.cat];}
          if(confirmed&&i===q.ans){bg="#f0fdf4";border="1.5px solid #86efac";color="#15803d";}
          if(confirmed&&selected===i&&i!==q.ans){bg="#fef2f2";border="1.5px solid #fca5a5";color="#dc2626";}
          return (
            <button key={i} onClick={()=>{if(!confirmed)setSelected(i);}}
              style={{background:bg,border,color,padding:"9px 13px",borderRadius:8,cursor:confirmed?"default":"pointer",textAlign:"left",fontWeight:selected===i?700:500,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",transition:"all 0.15s"}}>
              <span style={{fontWeight:700,marginRight:8,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{String.fromCharCode(65+i)}.</span>{opt}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {confirmed && (
        <div style={{marginBottom:10,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,background:selected===q.ans?"#f0fdf4":"#fff7ed",border:"1px solid " + (selected===q.ans?"#86efac":"#fed7aa"),fontSize:12,color:selected===q.ans?"#15803d":"#9a3412",lineHeight:1.5}}>
          {selected===q.ans?"âœ… Correct! ":"ðŸ’¡ "}{q.exp}
        </div>
      )}
      {!confirmed
        ? <button style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(),width:"100%",opacity:selected===null?0.5:1}} onClick={confirm} disabled={selected===null}>Confirm Answer</button>
        : <button style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(),width:"100%"}} onClick={next}>{cur+1<questions.length?"Next Question â†’":"See My Score"}</button>}
      <div style={{marginTop:10,textAlign:"center"}}>
        <button onClick={onBack}
          style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12,cursor:"pointer",textDecoration:"underline",fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
          Cancel test
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ AUTH SCREEN â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function AuthScreen({ onLogin }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState("welcome"); // login | gate | register | join-team | create-team
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [teamCode, setTeamCode] = useState("");
  const [teamJoinOpt, setTeamJoinOpt] = useState("none"); // "none" | "create" | "join"
  const [newTeamName, setNewTeamName] = useState("");
  const [newTeamCode, setNewTeamCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [gateResult, setGateResult] = useState(null);
  const [gateThreshold, setGateThreshold] = useState(25);

  useEffect(() => {
    getGateThreshold().then(t => setGateThreshold(t));
  }, []);

  async function handleLogin() {
    if (!username.trim() || !password.trim()) { setError("Please fill in all fields."); return; }
    setLoading(true); setError("");
    if (username.trim() === ADMIN_USER) {
      const adminPass = await getAdminPass();
      if (password === adminPass) { onLogin({ username: "admin", name: "Admin", isAdmin: true }); return; }
      setError("Incorrect admin password."); setLoading(false); return;
    }
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    const u = users[username.toLowerCase().trim()];
    if (!u) { setError("Account not found. Please register first."); setLoading(false); return; }
    if (u.password !== password) { setError("Incorrect password."); setLoading(false); return; }
    onLogin({ ...u, username: username.toLowerCase().trim(), isAdmin: false });
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleRegister() {
    if (!username.trim() || !password.trim() || !name.trim()) { setError("Please fill in all fields."); return; }
    if (username.toLowerCase().trim() === ADMIN_USER) { setError("That username is reserved."); return; }
    if (password.length < 4) { setError("Password must be at least 4 characters."); return; }
    setLoading(true); setError("");
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    if (users[username.toLowerCase().trim()]) { setError("Username already taken. Choose another."); setLoading(false); return; }
    const uname = username.toLowerCase().trim();
    let teamData = {};
    // Optional team setup during registration
    if (teamJoinOpt === "create") {
      if (!newTeamName.trim() || !newTeamCode.trim()) { setError("Fill in team name and code."); setLoading(false); return; }
      if (newTeamCode.length < 4) { setError("Team code must be at least 4 characters."); setLoading(false); return; }
      const teams = await storeGet("hub-teams", true) || {};
      if (Object.values(teams).some(t => t.code === newTeamCode.toUpperCase())) { setError("Team code taken. Choose another."); setLoading(false); return; }
      const teamId = "team_" + Date.now();
      const team = { id: teamId, name: newTeamName.trim(), code: newTeamCode.toUpperCase(), createdBy: uname, createdAt: Date.now(), members: [uname] };
      teams[teamId] = team;
      await storeSet("hub-teams", teams, true);
      teamData = { teamId, teamIds: [teamId], activeTeamId: teamId, teamName: team.name, isTeamAdmin: true };
    } else if (teamJoinOpt === "join") {
      if (!teamCode.trim()) { setError("Enter a team join code."); setLoading(false); return; }
      const teams = await storeGet("hub-teams", true) || {};
      const team = Object.values(teams).find(t => t.code === teamCode.toUpperCase());
      if (!team) { setError("Team code not found."); setLoading(false); return; }
      team.members = [...new Set([...(team.members||[]), uname])];
      teams[team.id] = team;
      await storeSet("hub-teams", teams, true);
      teamData = { teamId: team.id, teamIds: [team.id], activeTeamId: team.id, teamName: team.name };
    }
    const newUser = { name: name.trim(), password, joinedAt: Date.now(), done: {}, quizScores: {}, placementResult: gateResult, ...teamData };
    users[uname] = newUser;
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    onLogin({ ...newUser, username: uname, isAdmin: false });
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleJoinTeam() {
    if (!teamCode.trim() || !username.trim() || !password.trim() || !name.trim()) { setError("Fill in all fields."); return; }
    setLoading(true); setError("");
    // Check team exists
    const teams = await storeGet("hub-teams", true) || {};
    const team = Object.values(teams).find(t => t.code === teamCode.trim().toUpperCase());
    if (!team) { setError("Team code not found. Check the code and try again."); setLoading(false); return; }
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    if (users[username.toLowerCase().trim()]) { setError("Username already taken."); setLoading(false); return; }
    const newUser = { name: name.trim(), password, joinedAt: Date.now(), done: {}, quizScores: {}, teamId: team.id, teamIds: [team.id], activeTeamId: team.id, teamName: team.name, placementResult: gateResult };
    users[username.toLowerCase().trim()] = newUser;
    // Add user to team
    team.members = [...(team.members||[]), username.toLowerCase().trim()];
    teams[team.id] = team;
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    await storeSet("hub-teams", teams, true);
    onLogin({ ...newUser, username: username.toLowerCase().trim(), isAdmin: false });
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function handleCreateTeam() {
    if (!newTeamName.trim() || !newTeamCode.trim() || !username.trim() || !password.trim() || !name.trim()) { setError("Fill in all fields."); return; }
    if (newTeamCode.length < 4) { setError("Team code must be at least 4 characters."); return; }
    setLoading(true); setError("");
    const teams = await storeGet("hub-teams", true) || {};
    const codeExists = Object.values(teams).some(t => t.code === newTeamCode.trim().toUpperCase());
    if (codeExists) { setError("That team code is already taken. Choose another."); setLoading(false); return; }
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    if (users[username.toLowerCase().trim()]) { setError("Username already taken."); setLoading(false); return; }
    const teamId = "team_" + Date.now();
    const team = { id: teamId, name: newTeamName.trim(), code: newTeamCode.trim().toUpperCase(), createdBy: username.toLowerCase().trim(), createdAt: Date.now(), members: [username.toLowerCase().trim()] };
    teams[teamId] = team;
    const newUser = { name: name.trim(), password, joinedAt: Date.now(), done: {}, quizScores: {}, teamId, teamIds: [teamId], activeTeamId: teamId, teamName: team.name, isTeamAdmin: true, placementResult: gateResult };
    users[username.toLowerCase().trim()] = newUser;
    await storeSet("hub-teams", teams, true);
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    onLogin({ ...newUser, username: username.toLowerCase().trim(), isAdmin: false });
    setLoading(false);
  }

  const isGatePassed = !!gateResult;

  return (
    <div style={{ minHeight: "100vh", background: "#060b18", fontFamily:"'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif", position:"relative", overflow:"hidden" }}>

      {/* â”€â”€ Animated background grid â”€â”€ */}
      <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,backgroundImage:"linear-gradient(rgba(37,99,235,0.07) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(37,99,235,0.07) 1px,transparent 1px)",backgroundSize:"60px 60px",pointerEvents:"none"}}/>
      {/* Glow orbs */}
      <div style={{position:"absolute",top:"-10%",left:"20%",width:500,height:500,background:"radial-gradient(circle,rgba(37,99,235,0.18) 0%,transparent 70%)",pointerEvents:"none"}}/>
      <div style={{position:"absolute",bottom:"10%",right:"10%",width:400,height:400,background:"radial-gradient(circle,rgba(124,58,237,0.15) 0%,transparent 70%)",pointerEvents:"none"}}/>

      {/* â”€â”€ TOP NAV â”€â”€ */}
      <nav style={{position:"fixed",top:0,left:0,right:0,zIndex:100,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between",padding:"0 40px",height:64,background:"rgba(6,11,24,0.85)",backdropFilter:"blur(16px)",borderBottom:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)"}}>
        {/* Logo */}
        <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10}}>
          <div style={{width:34,height:34,background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)",borderRadius:9,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:17,fontWeight:900,color:"#fff",boxShadow:"0 0 16px rgba(37,99,235,0.5)"}}>âš¡</div>
          <span style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18,color:"#fff",letterSpacing:-0.3}}>FIRST Hub</span>
          <span style={{marginLeft:6,padding:"2px 10px",background:"rgba(37,99,235,0.15)",border:"1px solid rgba(37,99,235,0.3)",borderRadius:20,fontSize:10,color:"#60a5fa",fontWeight:700,letterSpacing:0.5,textTransform:"uppercase"}}>Beta</span>
        </div>
        {/* Nav links + auth buttons */}
        <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8}}>
          <button onClick={()=>setMode("login")}
            style={{background:"transparent",border:"1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",color:"#cbd5e1",borderRadius:9,padding:"8px 20px",fontSize:13,fontWeight:600,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",transition:"all 0.15s"}}
            onMouseEnter={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.borderColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";e.currentTarget.style.color="#fff";}}
            onMouseLeave={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.borderColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)";e.currentTarget.style.color="#cbd5e1";}}>
            Log In
          </button>
          <button onClick={()=>setMode("gate")}
            style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)",border:"none",color:"#fff",borderRadius:9,padding:"8px 20px",fontSize:13,fontWeight:700,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",boxShadow:"0 0 20px rgba(37,99,235,0.35)",transition:"all 0.15s"}}

      {/* â”€â”€ WELCOME / HERO â”€â”€ */}
      {mode === "welcome" && (

            </div>
            <div style={{position:"absolute",bottom:"22%",left:"2%",background:"rgba(124,58,237,0.12)",border:"1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.3)",borderRadius:12,padding:"8px 14px",backdropFilter:"blur(8px)",animation:"floatRobot 5s ease-in-out infinite"}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#a78bfa",fontWeight:700}}>âš™ï¸ Mechanics</div>

            <FullRegistrationTest
              onPass={(result) => { setGateResult(result); setMode("register"); }}

              <button onClick={() => { setMode("login"); setError(""); }} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer", color: "#1d4ed8", fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 14, padding: 0 }}>â† Back</button>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 4 }}>ðŸ‘¥ Join a Team Account</div>

              {!isGatePassed ? (
                <div style={{ padding: "12px 14px", background: "#fffbeb", borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid #fde68a", fontSize: 13, color: "#92400e", marginBottom: 12 }}>

                  <button style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btn(), display: "block", width: "100%", marginTop: 10 }} onClick={() => setMode("gate")}>Take Entry Test â†’</button>
                </div>
              ) : (

                  <div style={{ marginBottom: 12, padding: "8px 12px", background: "#f0fdf4", borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid #86efac", fontSize: 12, color: "#15803d", fontWeight: 600 }}>âœ… Test passed! Create your account below.</div>
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Team Code (from your captain)" value={teamCode} onChange={e => setTeamCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} />
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Your full name" value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} />
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Choose a username" value={username} onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)} />
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} type="password" placeholder="Choose a password (4+ chars)" value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
                  {error && <div style={{ color: "#dc2626", fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 10, padding: "8px 12px", background: "#fef2f2", borderRadius: 7, border: "1px solid #fecaca" }}>{error}</div>}
                  <button style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btn(), width: "100%", padding: "11px", fontSize: 15, opacity: loading ? 0.7 : 1 }} onClick={handleJoinTeam} disabled={loading}>
                    {loading ? "Joiningâ€¦" : "Join Team â†’"}
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : mode === "create-team" ? (
            <div>
              <button onClick={() => { setMode("login"); setError(""); }} style={{ background: "none", border: "none", cursor: "pointer", color: "#1d4ed8", fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 14, padding: 0 }}>â† Back</button>
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 900, fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 4 }}>ðŸš€ Create a Team Account</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: 13, color: "#6b7280", marginBottom: 16 }}>Set up a team space. You'll get a code to share with teammates so they can join your team.</div>
              {!isGatePassed ? (
                <div style={{ padding: "12px 14px", background: "#fffbeb", borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid #fde68a", fontSize: 13, color: "#92400e", marginBottom: 12 }}>
                  ðŸ§  You need to <b>pass the entry test first</b> before creating a team.
                  <button style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btn(), display: "block", width: "100%", marginTop: 10 }} onClick={() => setMode("gate")}>Take Entry Test â†’</button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <div style={{ marginBottom: 12, padding: "8px 12px", background: "#f0fdf4", borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid #86efac", fontSize: 12, color: "#15803d", fontWeight: 600 }}>âœ… Test passed! Set up your team below.</div>
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Team name (e.g. 'Team 1234 â€” Iron Eagles')" value={newTeamName} onChange={e => setNewTeamName(e.target.value)} />
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Team join code (e.g. EAGLE24) â€” share this with teammates" value={newTeamCode} onChange={e => setNewTeamCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} />
                  <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#9ca3af", marginBottom: 10, marginTop: -6 }}>Team code: letters and numbers only, min 4 chars. You'll share this with teammates.</div>
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Your full name" value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} />
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Choose a username" value={username} onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)} />
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} type="password" placeholder="Choose a password (4+ chars)" value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
                  {error && <div style={{ color: "#dc2626", fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 10, padding: "8px 12px", background: "#fef2f2", borderRadius: 7, border: "1px solid #fecaca" }}>{error}</div>}
                  <button style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btn("#15803d"), width: "100%", padding: "11px", fontSize: 15, opacity: loading ? 0.7 : 1 }} onClick={handleCreateTeam} disabled={loading}>
                    {loading ? "Creatingâ€¦" : "Create Team â†’"}
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Login / Register tabs */}
              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 4, background: "#f1f5f9", borderRadius: 10, padding: 4, marginBottom: 20 }}>
                {[["login", "Sign In"], ["register", "Create Account"]].map(([m, l]) => (
                  <button key={m} onClick={() => { m === "register" ? (!isGatePassed ? setMode("gate") : setMode("register")) : (setMode("login"), setError("")); }}
                    style={{ flex: 1, padding: "8px 0", borderRadius: 8, border: "none", background: mode === m ? "#fff" : "transparent", fontWeight: mode === m ? 800 : 500, fontSize: 14, cursor: "pointer", color: mode === m ? "#1d4ed8" : "#6b7280", boxShadow: mode === m ? "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)" : "none", fontFamily: "inherit", transition: "all 0.2s" }}>
                    {l}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              {mode === "register" && isGatePassed && (
                <div style={{ marginBottom: 12, padding: "8px 12px", background: "#f0fdf4", borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid #86efac", fontSize: 12, color: "#15803d", fontWeight: 600 }}>
                  âœ… Entry test passed! Fill in your details to finish registering.
                </div>
              )}
              {mode === "register" && (
                <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Your full name" value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} />
              )}
              <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Username" value={username} onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={e => e.key === "Enter" && (mode === "login" ? handleLogin() : handleRegister())} />
              <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} type="password" placeholder="Password" value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={e => e.key === "Enter" && (mode === "login" ? handleLogin() : handleRegister())} />

                            {mode === "register" && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 12, padding: "14px", background: "#f8fafc", borderRadius: 10, border: "1px solid #e2e8f0" }}>
                  <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 10 }}>ðŸ‘¥ Join a team? <span style={{ fontWeight: 400, color: "#9ca3af" }}>(optional â€” you can do this later)</span></div>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: 6, flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
                    {[["none","â­ Skip for now"],["create","ðŸš€ Create a team"],["join","ðŸ¤ Join a team"]].map(([v,l])=>(
                      <button key={v} onClick={()=>setTeamJoinOpt(v)}
                        style={{ background: teamJoinOpt===v ? "#1d4ed8" : "#fff", color: teamJoinOpt===v ? "#fff" : "#374151",
                                 border: "1.5px solid " + (teamJoinOpt===v ? "#1d4ed8" : "#e2e8f0"), borderRadius: 8,
                                 padding: "6px 12px", cursor: "pointer", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, fontFamily: "inherit" }}>
                        {l}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {teamJoinOpt === "create" && (
                    <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                      <input style={{ ...S_HANDBO.inp, marginBottom: 8 }} placeholder="Team name (e.g. 'Team 1234 â€” Iron Eagles')" value={newTeamName} onChange={e => setNewTeamName(e.target.value)} />
                      <input style={{ ...S_HANDBO.inp, marginBottom: 0 }} placeholder="Team join code (e.g. EAGLE24) â€” share with teammates" value={newTeamCode} onChange={e => setNewTeamCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, ""))} />
                      <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: "#9ca3af", marginTop: 4 }}>Letters + numbers only, min 4 chars. Share this code with teammates.</div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {teamJoinOpt === "join" && (
                    <div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                      <input style={{ ...S_HANDBO.inp, marginBottom: 0 }} placeholder="Team join code (ask your team captain)" value={teamCode} onChange={e => setTeamCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, ""))} />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
{error && <div style={{ color: "#dc2626", fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 10, padding: "8px 12px", background: "#fef2f2", borderRadius: 7, border: "1px solid #fecaca" }}>{error}</div>}

              <button style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btn(), width: "100%", padding: "11px", fontSize: 15, opacity: loading ? 0.7 : 1 }} onClick={mode === "login" ? handleLogin : handleRegister} disabled={loading}>
                {loading ? "Loadingâ€¦" : mode === "login" ? "Sign In â†’" : "Create Account â†’"}
              </button>

              {/* Team options */}
              <div style={{ marginTop: 14, borderTop: "1px solid #f1f5f9", paddingTop: 14 }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: "#9ca3af", textAlign: "center", marginBottom: 10 }}>â€” or â€”</div>
                <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: 8 }}>
                  <button onClick={() => setMode("join-team")}
                    style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btnOut(), padding: "9px 8px", fontSize: 12, textAlign: "center" }}>
                    ðŸ‘¥ Join a Team
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={() => setMode("create-team")}
                    style={{ ...S_HANDBO.btnOut("#15803d"), padding: "9px 8px", fontSize: 12, textAlign: "center", color:"#15803d" }}>
                    ðŸš€ Create Team
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {mode === "login" && (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 12, padding: "8px 12px", background: "#fffbeb", borderRadius: 8, border: "1px solid #fde68a", fontSize: 11, color: "#92400e" }}>
                  ðŸ§  New members must <b>pass the full 40-question entry test</b> to register. Click <b>Create Account</b> to begin.
                </div>
              )}

          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
      )}

  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ MY TEAM PANEL â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€


// â”€â”€â”€ TEAM HELPERS â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function getActiveTeamId(user) {
  if (!user) return null;
  // Support both old single teamId and new multi-team teamIds
  if (user.activeTeamId) return user.activeTeamId;
  if (user.teamIds?.length) return user.teamIds[0];
  return user.teamId || null; // backward compat
}
function getAllTeamIds(user) {
  if (!user) return [];
  if (user.teamIds?.length) return user.teamIds;
  if (user.teamId) return [user.teamId];
  return [];
}


// â”€â”€â”€ TEAM SETUP PANEL (for logged-in users without a team) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function TeamSetupPanel({ user, onTeamJoined }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState("choose"); // choose | create | join
  const [teamName, setTeamName] = useState("");
  const [teamCode, setTeamCode] = useState("");
  const [joinCode, setJoinCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleCreate() {
    if (!teamName.trim()) { setError("Enter a team name."); return; }
    if (teamCode.trim().length < 4) { setError("Team code must be at least 4 characters."); return; }
    if (!/^[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(teamCode.trim())) { setError("Team code: letters and numbers only."); return; }
    setLoading(true); setError("");
    const teams = await storeGet("hub-teams", true) || {};
    const codeExists = Object.values(teams).some(t => t.code === teamCode.trim().toUpperCase());
    if (codeExists) { setError("That team code is already taken. Choose another."); setLoading(false); return; }
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    const teamId = "team_" + Date.now();
    const team = { id: teamId, name: teamName.trim(), code: teamCode.trim().toUpperCase(), createdBy: user.username, createdAt: Date.now(), members: [user.username] };
    teams[teamId] = team;
    const existingIds = getAllTeamIds(user);
    users[user.username] = { ...users[user.username], teamId, teamIds: [...new Set([...existingIds, teamId])], activeTeamId: teamId, teamName: team.name, isTeamAdmin: true };
    await storeSet("hub-teams", teams, true);
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    setLoading(false);
    onTeamJoined({ ...user, teamId, teamName: team.name, isTeamAdmin: true });
  }

  async function handleJoin() {
    if (!joinCode.trim()) { setError("Enter the team join code."); return; }
    setLoading(true); setError("");
    const teams = await storeGet("hub-teams", true) || {};
    const team = Object.values(teams).find(t => t.code === joinCode.trim().toUpperCase());
    if (!team) { setError("Team code not found. Ask your team captain for the correct code."); setLoading(false); return; }
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    const existingIds2 = getAllTeamIds(user);
    users[user.username] = { ...users[user.username], teamId: team.id, teamIds: [...new Set([...existingIds2, team.id])], activeTeamId: team.id, teamName: team.name };
    team.members = [...new Set([...(team.members||[]), user.username])];
    teams[team.id] = team;
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    await storeSet("hub-teams", teams, true);
    setLoading(false);
    onTeamJoined({ ...user, teamId: team.id, teamName: team.name });
  }

  return (
    <div style={{minHeight:"100vh",background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a 0%,#1e1b4b 50%,#0f172a 100%)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",padding:"20px",fontFamily:"'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif"}}>
      <div style={{width:"100%",maxWidth: mode==="gate"?520:460}}>

        {/* â”€â”€ WELCOME SCREEN â”€â”€ */}
        {mode==="welcome" && (
          <div style={{textAlign:"center"}}>
            {/* Robot SVG graphic */}
            <div style={{marginBottom:24,position:"relative",display:"inline-block"}}>
              <svg width="160" height="160" viewBox="0 0 160 160" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                {/* Glow */}
                <circle cx="80" cy="80" r="72" fill="url(#glow)" opacity="0.15"/>
                {/* Body */}
                <rect x="42" y="70" width="76" height="56" rx="10" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
                <rect x="50" y="78" width="60" height="40" rx="7" fill="#1e3a8a"/>
                {/* Screen */}
                <rect x="58" y="84" width="44" height="26" rx="5" fill="#0f172a"/>
                <rect x="62" y="88" width="12" height="8" rx="2" fill="#22d3ee" opacity="0.9"/>
                <rect x="78" y="88" width="8" height="8" rx="2" fill="#34d399" opacity="0.9"/>
                <rect x="90" y="88" width="8" height="8" rx="2" fill="#f59e0b" opacity="0.9"/>
                <rect x="62" y="100" width="36" height="4" rx="2" fill="#1d4ed8" opacity="0.7"/>
                <rect x="62" y="106" width="24" height="4" rx="2" fill="#1d4ed8" opacity="0.4"/>
                {/* Head */}
                <rect x="54" y="40" width="52" height="34" rx="9" fill="#2563eb"/>
                <circle cx="68" cy="56" r="8" fill="#0f172a"/>
                <circle cx="68" cy="56" r="5" fill="#60a5fa"/>
                <circle cx="70" cy="54" r="2" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"/>
                <circle cx="92" cy="56" r="8" fill="#0f172a"/>
                <circle cx="92" cy="56" r="5" fill="#60a5fa"/>
                <circle cx="94" cy="54" r="2" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"/>
                {/* Antenna */}
                <line x1="80" y1="40" x2="80" y2="26" stroke="#60a5fa" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round"/>
                <circle cx="80" cy="22" r="5" fill="#f59e0b"/>
                <circle cx="80" cy="22" r="2.5" fill="#fff" opacity="0.8"/>
                {/* Arms */}
                <rect x="18" y="72" width="24" height="10" rx="5" fill="#2563eb"/>
                <rect x="118" y="72" width="24" height="10" rx="5" fill="#2563eb"/>
                <circle cx="14" cy="77" r="8" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
                <circle cx="146" cy="77" r="8" fill="#1d4ed8"/>
                {/* Wheels */}
                <rect x="44" y="124" width="20" height="14" rx="4" fill="#374151"/>
                <rect x="96" y="124" width="20" height="14" rx="4" fill="#374151"/>
                <circle cx="54" cy="131" r="5" fill="#6b7280"/>
                <circle cx="106" cy="131" r="5" fill="#6b7280"/>
                {/* FIRST badge */}
                <rect x="56" y="116" width="48" height="8" rx="4" fill="#f59e0b"/>
                <text x="80" y="123" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="5.5" fontWeight="bold" fill="#0f172a">FIRST HUB</text>
                <defs>
                  <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
                    <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#3b82f6"/>
                    <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#0f172a"/>
                  </radialGradient>
                </defs>
              </svg>
            </div>

            <div style={{fontSize:36,fontWeight:900,color:"#fff",letterSpacing:-0.5,marginBottom:6}}>FIRST Hub</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:17,color:"#94a3b8",marginBottom:6}}>The all-in-one learning platform for</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:17,color:"#60a5fa",fontWeight:700,marginBottom:32}}>FTC & FRC robotics teams ðŸ¤–</div>

            {/* Main CTAs */}
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12,marginBottom:20}}>
              <button onClick={()=>setMode("gate")}
                style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:14,
                        padding:"16px 24px",fontSize:17,fontWeight:800,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",
                        boxShadow:"0 4px 20px rgba(37,99,235,0.4)",transition:"transform 0.15s"}}
                onMouseEnter={e=>e.currentTarget.style.transform="translateY(-2px)"}
                onMouseLeave={e=>e.currentTarget.style.transform="none"}>
                ðŸš€ Get Started â€” Create Account
              </button>
              <button onClick={()=>setMode("login")}
                style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",color:"#fff",border:"1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
                        borderRadius:14,padding:"14px 24px",fontSize:16,fontWeight:700,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",
                        backdropFilter:"blur(4px)"}}>
                Sign In â†’
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Team options */}
            <div style={{borderTop:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",paddingTop:20,marginTop:4}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#64748b",marginBottom:12,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:1,fontWeight:600}}>Join your team</div>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                <button onClick={()=>setMode("join-team")}
                  style={{background:"rgba(5,150,105,0.15)",border:"1.5px solid rgba(5,150,105,0.4)",color:"#34d399",
                          borderRadius:12,padding:"14px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",textAlign:"left"}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:20,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ¤</div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14}}>Join a Team</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.8,marginTop:2}}>Enter your team's code</div>
                </button>
                <button onClick={()=>setMode("create-team")}
                  style={{background:"rgba(124,58,237,0.15)",border:"1.5px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.4)",color:"#a78bfa",
                          borderRadius:12,padding:"14px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",textAlign:"left"}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:20,marginBottom:4}}>âš¡</div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14}}>Create a Team</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.8,marginTop:2}}>Set up your team space</div>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{marginTop:20,fontSize:12,color:"#475569"}}>
              By signing up you agree to use this platform for FIRST robotics learning.
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* â”€â”€ HEADER for non-welcome screens â”€â”€ */}
        {mode !== "welcome" && (
          <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginBottom:24}}>
            <button onClick={()=>setMode("welcome")} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#60a5fa",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16,padding:0,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>â† Back</button>
            <div style={{fontSize:40,marginBottom:6}}>âš¡</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:26,fontWeight:900,color:"#fff"}}>FIRST Hub</div>
            <div style={{color:"#94a3b8",fontSize:13,marginTop:2}}>
              {mode==="login" && "Welcome back"}
              {mode==="register" && "Create your account"}
              {(mode==="create-team"||mode==="join-team") && "Join your team"}
              {mode==="gate" && "Entry test"}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* â”€â”€ CARD for all non-welcome screens â”€â”€ */}
        {mode !== "welcome" && (
          <div style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.97)",borderRadius:20,padding:"28px 30px",boxShadow:"0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)"}}>

        {/* LOGIN */}
        {mode === "login" && (
          <div>
            <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Username" value={username} onChange={e=>setUsername(e.target.value)} autoFocus/>
            <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} type="password" placeholder="Password" value={password} onChange={e=>setPassword(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&handleLogin()}/>
            {error&&<div style={{color:"#dc2626",fontSize:13,marginBottom:10,padding:"8px 12px",background:"#fef2f2",borderRadius:8}}>{error}</div>}
            <button onClick={handleLogin} disabled={loading} style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(),width:"100%",padding:"12px",fontSize:15,borderRadius:10,opacity:loading?0.7:1}}>
              {loading?"Signing inâ€¦":"Sign In â†’"}
            </button>
            <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginTop:14,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>
              No account? <button onClick={()=>setMode("gate")} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#1d4ed8",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Create one â†’</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* GATE / ENTRY TEST */}
        {mode === "gate" && (
          <FullRegistrationTest gateResult={gateResult} setGateResult={setGateResult}
            onPass={r=>{setGateResult(r); setMode("register");}} />
        )}

        {/* REGISTER */}
        {mode === "register" && isGatePassed && (
          <div>
            <div style={{padding:"8px 12px",background:"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #86efac",fontSize:12,color:"#15803d",fontWeight:600,marginBottom:14}}>
              âœ… Test passed! Fill in your details below.
            </div>
            <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Your full name" value={name} onChange={e=>setName(e.target.value)}/>
            <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Choose a username" value={username} onChange={e=>setUsername(e.target.value)}/>
            <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} type="password" placeholder="Password (4+ chars)" value={password} onChange={e=>setPassword(e.target.value)}/>
            {/* Optional team */}
            <div style={{marginBottom:12,padding:"14px",background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:10,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:10}}>ðŸ‘¥ Join a team? <span style={{fontWeight:400,color:"#9ca3af"}}>(optional)</span></div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                {[["none","â­ Skip"],["create","ðŸš€ Create"],["join","ðŸ¤ Join"]].map(([v,l])=>(
                  <button key={v} onClick={()=>setTeamJoinOpt(v)}
                    style={{background:teamJoinOpt===v?"#1d4ed8":"#fff",color:teamJoinOpt===v?"#fff":"#374151",
                            border:"1.5px solid " + (teamJoinOpt===v?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:8,
                            padding:"6px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,fontWeight:600,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                    {l}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
              {teamJoinOpt==="create" && (
                <div style={{marginTop:10}}>
                  <input style={{...S_HANDBO.inp,marginBottom:8}} placeholder="Team name (e.g. 'Team 1234 â€” Iron Eagles')" value={newTeamName} onChange={e=>setNewTeamName(e.target.value)}/>
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Team join code (e.g. EAGLE24)" value={newTeamCode} onChange={e=>setNewTeamCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,""))}/>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:-6}}>Letters + numbers, min 4 chars. Share with teammates.</div>
                </div>
              )}
              {teamJoinOpt==="join" && (
                <div style={{marginTop:10}}>
                  <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Team join code (ask your captain)" value={teamCode} onChange={e=>setTeamCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,""))}/>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            {error&&<div style={{color:"#dc2626",fontSize:13,marginBottom:10,padding:"8px 12px",background:"#fef2f2",borderRadius:8}}>{error}</div>}
            <button onClick={handleRegister} disabled={loading} style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(),width:"100%",padding:"12px",fontSize:15,borderRadius:10,opacity:loading?0.7:1}}>
              {loading?"Creating accountâ€¦":"Create Account â†’"}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* CREATE TEAM (from welcome page - goes to gate first if not registered) */}
        {mode === "create-team" && (
          <div>
            {!isGatePassed ? (
              <div>
                <div style={{padding:"12px 14px",background:"#fffbeb",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #fde68a",fontSize:13,color:"#92400e",marginBottom:14}}>
                  ðŸ§  You need to <b>create an account first</b> before creating a team.
                </div>
                <button onClick={()=>setMode("gate")} style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(),width:"100%"}}>Create Account â†’</button>
                <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginTop:10,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>
                  Already have an account? <button onClick={()=>setMode("login")} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#1d4ed8",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Sign In</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div>
                <div style={{padding:"8px 12px",background:"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #86efac",fontSize:12,color:"#15803d",fontWeight:600,marginBottom:14}}>âœ… Signed in. Set up your team below.</div>
                <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Team name" value={newTeamName} onChange={e=>setNewTeamName(e.target.value)}/>
                <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Team join code (e.g. EAGLE24)" value={newTeamCode} onChange={e=>setNewTeamCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,""))}/>
                {error&&<div style={{color:"#dc2626",fontSize:13,marginBottom:10,padding:"8px 12px",background:"#fef2f2",borderRadius:8}}>{error}</div>}
                <button onClick={handleCreateTeam} disabled={loading} style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(),width:"100%",padding:"12px",fontSize:15,borderRadius:10,opacity:loading?0.7:1}}>
                  {loading?"Creatingâ€¦":"Create Team â†’"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* JOIN TEAM (from welcome page) */}
        {mode === "join-team" && (
          <div>
            {!isGatePassed ? (
              <div>
                <div style={{padding:"12px 14px",background:"#fffbeb",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #fde68a",fontSize:13,color:"#92400e",marginBottom:14}}>
                  ðŸ§  You need to <b>create an account first</b> before joining a team.
                </div>
                <button onClick={()=>setMode("gate")} style={{...S_HANDBO.btn(),width:"100%"}}>Create Account â†’</button>
                <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginTop:10,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>
                  Already have an account? <button onClick={()=>setMode("login")} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#1d4ed8",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Sign In</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div>
                <div style={{padding:"8px 12px",background:"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #86efac",fontSize:12,color:"#15803d",fontWeight:600,marginBottom:14}}>âœ… Signed in. Enter your team code below.</div>
                <input style={S_HANDBO.inp} placeholder="Team join code (e.g. EAGLE24)" value={teamCode} onChange={e=>setTeamCode(e.target.value.toUpperCase())} autoFocus/>
                {error&&<div style={{color:"#dc2626",fontSize:13,marginBottom:10,padding:"8px 12px",background:"#fef2f2",borderRadius:8}}>{error}</div>}
                <button onClick={handleJoinTeam} disabled={loading} style={{...S_HANDBO.btn("#059669"),width:"100%",padding:"12px",fontSize:15,borderRadius:10,opacity:loading?0.7:1}}>
                  {loading?"Joiningâ€¦":"Join Team â†’"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MyTeamPanel({ user, onUserUpdate }) {
  const [team, setTeam] = useState(null);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("overview");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [allTeams, setAllTeams] = useState([]);
  const [showJoinMore, setShowJoinMore] = useState(false);

  // Chat state
  const [chatMsg, setChatMsg] = useState("");
  const [chatMsgs, setChatMsgs] = useState([]);
  const chatEndRef = useRef(null);
  const chatPollRef = useRef(null);

  // Team goals state
  const [goals, setGoals] = useState([]);
  const [newGoal, setNewGoal] = useState("");

  const activeTeamId = getActiveTeamId(user);
  const teamIds = getAllTeamIds(user);

  useEffect(() => { loadTeam(); }, [activeTeamId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === "chat") {
      loadChat();
      chatPollRef.current = setInterval(loadChat, 4000);
      return () => clearInterval(chatPollRef.current);
    } else {
      clearInterval(chatPollRef.current);
    }
  }, [tab, activeTeamId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    chatEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  }, [chatMsgs]);

  async function loadTeam() {
    setLoading(true);
    const teams = await storeGet("hub-teams", true) || {};
    // Load all teams user is in
    const myTeams = teamIds.map(id => teams[id]).filter(Boolean);
    setAllTeams(myTeams);
    const t = teams[activeTeamId];
    if (!t) { setLoading(false); return; }
    setTeam(t);
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    const memberList = (t.members || []).map(uname => {
      const u = users[uname] || {};
      return { username: uname, name: u.name || uname, done: u.done || {}, streak: u.streak || 0,
               quizScores: u.quizScores || {}, learningTime: u.learningTime || 0,
               placement: u.placementResult, isTeamAdmin: u.isTeamAdmin };
    });
    setMembers(memberList);
    const tgoals = await storeGet("hub-team-goals-" + activeTeamId, true) || [];
    setGoals(tgoals);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function loadChat() {
    try {
      const data = await storeGet("hub-team-chat-" + activeTeamId, true) || [];
      setChatMsgs(data);
    } catch(e) {}
  }

  async function sendChat() {
    if (!chatMsg.trim()) return;
    const msg = { id: Date.now(), author: user.name || user.username, username: user.username,
                  text: chatMsg.trim(), ts: Date.now() };
    const updated = [...chatMsgs, msg].slice(-100);
    await storeSet("hub-team-chat-" + activeTeamId, updated, true);
    setChatMsgs(updated);
    setChatMsg("");
  }

  async function addGoal() {
    if (!newGoal.trim()) return;
    const g = { id: Date.now(), text: newGoal.trim(), done: false, by: user.name || user.username, ts: Date.now() };
    const updated = [...goals, g];
    await storeSet("hub-team-goals-" + activeTeamId, updated, true);
    setGoals(updated);
    setNewGoal("");
  }

  async function toggleGoal(id) {
    const updated = goals.map(g => g.id === id ? { ...g, done: !g.done } : g);
    await storeSet("hub-team-goals-" + activeTeamId, updated, true);
    setGoals(updated);
  }

  async function deleteGoal(id) {
    const updated = goals.filter(g => g.id !== id);
    await storeSet("hub-team-goals-" + activeTeamId, updated, true);
    setGoals(updated);
  }

  async function switchTeam(teamId) {
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    users[user.username] = { ...users[user.username], activeTeamId: teamId };
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    onUserUpdate?.({ ...user, activeTeamId: teamId });
  }

  async function leaveTeam() {
    if (!window.confirm("Leave " + (team?.name || "this team") + "? You can rejoin with the team code.")) return;
    const teams = await storeGet("hub-teams", true) || {};
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    if (teams[activeTeamId]) {
      teams[activeTeamId].members = (teams[activeTeamId].members || []).filter(u => u !== user.username);
      await storeSet("hub-teams", teams, true);
    }
    const newTeamIds = teamIds.filter(id => id !== activeTeamId);
    const newActiveId = newTeamIds[0] || null;
    if (users[user.username]) {
      users[user.username].teamIds = newTeamIds;
      users[user.username].activeTeamId = newActiveId;
      users[user.username].teamId = newActiveId;
      if (!newActiveId) {
        delete users[user.username].teamName;
        delete users[user.username].isTeamAdmin;
      }
      await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    }
    onUserUpdate?.({ ...user, teamIds: newTeamIds, activeTeamId: newActiveId, teamId: newActiveId });
  }

  function copyCode() {
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(team?.code || "").catch(()=>{});
    setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  }

  function fmtTs(ts) {
    const d = new Date(ts); const now = new Date();
    if (d.toDateString() === now.toDateString()) return d.toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit"});
    return d.toLocaleDateString([], {month:"short",day:"numeric"});
  }

  if (showJoinMore) {
    return (
      <div>
        <button onClick={()=>setShowJoinMore(false)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#6b7280",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16,padding:0,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>â† Back to Team</button>
        <TeamSetupPanel user={user} onTeamJoined={async updatedUser => {
          await loadTeam();
          setShowJoinMore(false);
          onUserUpdate?.(updatedUser);
        }} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (loading) return <div style={{padding:40,textAlign:"center",color:"#9ca3af"}}>Loading teamâ€¦</div>;
  if (!team) return (
    <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,textAlign:"center",padding:40}}>
      <div style={{fontSize:40,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ¤”</div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:8}}>Team not found</div>
      <button onClick={()=>setShowJoinMore(true)} style={S_HANDBO.btn()}>Join a Team</button>
    </div>
  );

  const TABS = [{id:"overview",l:"ðŸ“Š Overview"},{id:"chat",l:"ðŸ’¬ Chat"},{id:"leaderboard",l:"ðŸ† Leaderboard"},{id:"goals",l:"ðŸŽ¯ Goals"},{id:"manage",l:"âš™ï¸ Manage"}];

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Multi-team switcher */}
      {allTeams.length > 1 && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:12,padding:"10px 14px",background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:12,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",fontWeight:600,marginRight:4}}>Your teams:</span>
          {allTeams.map(t => (
            <button key={t.id} onClick={()=>switchTeam(t.id)}
              style={{background:t.id===activeTeamId?"#1d4ed8":"#fff",color:t.id===activeTeamId?"#fff":"#374151",
                      border:"1.5px solid " + (t.id===activeTeamId?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:8,
                      padding:"5px 12px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,fontWeight:600,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
              {t.name}
            </button>
          ))}
          <button onClick={()=>setShowJoinMore(true)}
            style={{background:"none",border:"1.5px dashed #cbd5e1",borderRadius:8,padding:"5px 12px",
                    cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
            + Join Another
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#1d4ed8)",borderRadius:16,padding:"20px 24px",marginBottom:16,color:"#fff"}}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"space-between",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:12}}>
          <div>
            <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.7,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:1,marginBottom:2}}>Active Team</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:24,fontWeight:900,marginBottom:2}}>ðŸ‘¥ {team.name}</div>
            <div style={{opacity:0.8,fontSize:13}}>{members.length} member{members.length!==1?"s":""}</div>
          </div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8,alignItems:"flex-end"}}>
            {user.isTeamAdmin && (
              <div style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",borderRadius:12,padding:"10px 16px",textAlign:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:10,opacity:0.7,marginBottom:2,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:1}}>Join Code</div>
                <div style={{fontFamily:"monospace",fontSize:22,fontWeight:900,letterSpacing:3}}>{team.code}</div>
                <button onClick={copyCode} style={{...S_HANDBO.btn("#fff"),color:"#1d4ed8",fontSize:11,padding:"4px 12px",marginTop:6}}>
                  {copied?"âœ… Copied!":"ðŸ“‹ Copy Code"}
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
            {allTeams.length <= 1 && (
              <button onClick={()=>setShowJoinMore(true)}
                style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",border:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3)",
                        color:"#fff",borderRadius:8,padding:"6px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                + Join Another Team
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tab nav */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:18}}>
