    setTermLines([{type:"info",text:"Python 3.11 ready â€” press â–¶ Run or Ctrl+Enter"}]);
  }

  // â”€â”€ Editor key handling â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const handleKey = (e) => {
    if ((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey) && e.key==="Enter") { e.preventDefault(); runPython(); return; }
    if ((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey) && e.key==="s")     { e.preventDefault(); setShowSave(s=>!s); return; }
    if (e.key==="Tab") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const ta=e.target, s=ta.selectionStart, end=ta.selectionEnd;
      if (e.shiftKey) {
        let pos=0;
        setCode(code.split("\n").map(line=>{
          const ls=pos; pos+=line.length+1;
          if(ls<=s&&pos>s) return line.startsWith("    ")?line.slice(4):line.replace(/^ +/,"");
          return line;
        }).join("\n"));
      } else {
        setCode(code.slice(0,s)+"    "+code.slice(end));
        setTimeout(()=>{ta.selectionStart=ta.selectionEnd=s+4;},0);
      }
      return;
    }
    const r = smartEdit(code, e.target.selectionStart, e.target.selectionEnd, e.key);
    if (r) {
      e.preventDefault(); setCode(r.code);
      setTimeout(()=>{
        const ta=taRef.current; if(!ta) return;
        ta.selectionStart=r.cursor; ta.selectionEnd=r.cursorEnd??r.cursor;
      },0);
    }
  };

  const syncScroll = () => {
    const ta=taRef.current, ln=lnRef.current, hl=hlRef.current;
    if(ln&&ta) ln.scrollTop=ta.scrollTop;
    if(hl&&ta) { hl.scrollTop=ta.scrollTop; hl.scrollLeft=ta.scrollLeft; }
  };

  // â”€â”€ Python input() promise â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const askUser = (prompt) => new Promise(resolve => {
    setCurPrompt(prompt);
    setTermInput("");
    setWaiting(true);
    resolveRef.current = resolve;
  });

  const submitInput = () => {
    if (!waiting) return;
    const val = termInput;
    setWaiting(false);
    setTermInput("");
    setCurPrompt("");
    addLine("inp", curPrompt + val);
    resolveRef.current?.(val);
    resolveRef.current = null;
  };

  // â”€â”€ Run Python via Pyodide â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const runPython = async () => {
    if (isRunning || pyStatus !== "ready") return;
    const py = pyodideRef.current;
    setIsRunning(true);
    setTermLines([{type:"info",text:"$ python main.py"}]);

    try {
      py.runPython(`
import sys, importlib
_keep = set(sys.stdlib_module_names) | {'_pyodide', 'pyodide', 'js', 'builtins', 'sys', '__future__'}
for _mod in list(sys.modules.keys()):
    if not any(_mod == k or _mod.startswith(k + '.') for k in _keep):
        del sys.modules[_mod]
for _k in list(globals().keys()):
    if not _k.startswith('__'):
        del globals()[_k]
`);
      py.setStdout({ batched: (text) => {
        text.split("\n").forEach((line, i, arr) => {
          if (i < arr.length - 1 || line !== "") addLine("out", line);
        });
      }});
      py.setStderr({ batched: (text) => {
        text.split("\n").filter(Boolean).forEach(l => addLine("err", l));
      }});

      window._pyrunner_input = (prompt) => askUser(prompt || "");
      window._pyrunner_clear = () => { setTermLines([{type:"info",text:"$ python main.py"}]); return null; };

      const asyncCode = code
        .replace(/(?<!await\s)\binput\s*\(/g, "await input(")
        .replace(/(?<!await\s)\btime\.sleep\s*\(/g, "await time.sleep(");

      const indented = asyncCode.split("\n").map(l => "    " + l).join("\n");
      const wrapped = `\nimport builtins, sys\nfrom js import _pyrunner_input, _pyrunner_clear\n\nasync def _async_input(prompt=""):\n    if prompt:\n        sys.stdout.write(str(prompt))\n        sys.stdout.flush()\n    result = await _pyrunner_input(str(prompt))\n    return result\n\nbuiltins.input = _async_input\n\ndef clear():\n    _pyrunner_clear()\n\nbuiltins.clear = clear\n\nimport time as _time_module\nimport asyncio, sys\n\nclass _AsyncTime:\n    async def sleep(self, secs):\n        await asyncio.sleep(secs)\n    def __getattr__(self, name):\n        return getattr(_time_module, name)\n\nsys.modules["time"] = _AsyncTime()\n\nasync def _main():\n` + (indented) + `\n\nawait _main()\n`;
      await py.runPythonAsync(wrapped);
      addLine("info", "");
      addLine("info", "Process finished.");
    } catch(err) {
      const msg = err.message || String(err);
      msg.split("\n").forEach(l => addLine("err", l));
    }

    setIsRunning(false);
    setWaiting(false);
  };

  // â”€â”€ Run non-Python langs (static analysis) â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  function runAnalyze() {
    const lines = code.split("\n").filter(l => l.trim()).length;
    const issues = [];
    if (lang === "java") {
      if (!code.includes(";")) issues.push("âš   Missing semicolons â€” every Java statement needs a semicolon.");
      if (code.includes("setpower")||code.includes("SetPower")) issues.push("âš   Case-sensitive: use .setPower() not .setpower()");
      if (!code.includes("hardwareMap")&&code.includes("DcMotor")) issues.push("ðŸ’¡  Initialize motors with hardwareMap.get(DcMotor.class, name)");
    }
    if (lang === "html") { setOutput("__HTML_PREVIEW__"); return; }
    const summary = [
      "ðŸ“Š Code Analysis", "â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€",
      "Lines of code: " + lines, "",
      issues.length > 0 ? "âš   Issues found:" : "âœ… No obvious issues found",
      ...issues, "",
      "â„¹ï¸  This is a static analyzer.",
      "   Use Android Studio (FTC) or WPILib VSCode (FRC) for real execution.",
    ].join("\n");
    setOutput(summary);
  }

  // â”€â”€ Theme colors â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
  const d = theme === "dark";
  const C = {
    bg:d?"#0e0e12":"#f5f5f2", brd:d?"#1c1c28":"#c2c1bd",
    text:d?"#cbc7be":"#1a1a1a", muted:d?"#3e3e56":"#999",
    acc:"#f0c330", edBg:d?"#06060a":"#fafaf8",
    lnBg:d?"#08080c":"#e2e1dd", lnC:d?"#25253a":"#bbb",
    green:"#88c888", red:"#ff7070", yel:"#f0c330", dim:d?"#404055":"#888",
    termBg:d?"#040407":"#111",
  };
  const statusColor = pyStatus==="ready"?C.green:pyStatus==="error"?C.red:C.yel;
  const isPython = lang === "python";

  // FTC ref categories
  const refCategories = ["All", ...new Set(FTC_REFERENCE.map(r => r.category))];
  const filteredRef = refFilter === "All" ? FTC_REFERENCE : FTC_REFERENCE.filter(r => r.category === refFilter);

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Shared code feed */}
      {showShared && (
        <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card, marginBottom:18, background:"#f8fafc"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800, fontSize:15, marginBottom:12}}>ðŸŒ Team Code Posts</div>
          {sharedPosts.length === 0 && <div style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13,textAlign:"center",padding:20}}>No shared code yet â€” be the first to post!</div>}
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10,maxHeight:400,overflowY:"auto"}}>
            {sharedPosts.map(p=>(
              <div key={p.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",overflow:"hidden"}}>
                <div style={{padding:"10px 14px",display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
                  <div>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13}}>{p.title}</span>
                    <span style={{background:p.lang==="java"?"#fffbeb":p.lang==="python"?"#f0fdf4":p.lang==="html"?"#ecfeff":"#f5f3ff",color:p.lang==="java"?"#b45309":p.lang==="python"?"#15803d":p.lang==="html"?"#0891b2":"#7c3aed",borderRadius:6,padding:"1px 8px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,marginLeft:8}}>{p.lang}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center"}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>by {p.author} Â· {new Date(p.ts).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
                    <button onClick={()=>likePost(p.id)} style={{background:"none",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,color:(p.likes||[]).includes(user.username)?"#dc2626":"#6b7280",fontWeight:700}}>
                      â™¥ {(p.likes||[]).length}
                    </button>
                    <button onClick={()=>{setCode(p.code);setLang(p.lang);setShowShared(false);}} style={{...S_HANDBO.btnSm("#1d4ed8"),fontSize:11}}>Load</button>
                    {p.username===user.username && <button onClick={()=>deleteSharedPost(p.id)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",cursor:"pointer",color:"#dc2626",fontSize:13}}>ðŸ—‘</button>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <pre style={{margin:0,padding:"10px 14px",fontFamily:"monospace",fontSize:11,color:"#94a3b8",background:"#0f172a",overflowX:"auto",maxHeight:120}}>
                  {p.code.split("\n").slice(0,8).join("\n")}{p.code.split("\n").length>8?"\n...":""}
                </pre>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* FTC Reference panel */}
      {showRef && (
        <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card, marginBottom:18, background:"#f8fafc"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800, fontSize:15, marginBottom:10}}>ðŸ“š FTC OpMode Reference</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:12}}>
            {refCategories.map(cat=>(
              <button key={cat} onClick={()=>setRefFilter(cat)}
                style={{...S_HANDBO.chip(refFilter===cat), padding:"4px 12px", fontSize:11}}>{cat}</button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr))",gap:8,maxHeight:320,overflowY:"auto"}}>
            {filteredRef.map(ref=>(
              <div key={ref.id} onClick={()=>{setCode(ref.code);setLang("java");setShowRef(false);}}
                style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",cursor:"pointer",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:2}}>{ref.icon} {ref.label}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:4}}>{ref.description}</div>
                <span style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:4,padding:"1px 7px",fontSize:10,color:"#6b7280",fontWeight:700}}>{ref.category}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{display:"grid", gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 260px", gap:16, alignItems:"start"}}>
        <div>
          {/* Language tabs */}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,marginBottom:8,flexWrap:"wrap",alignItems:"center"}}>
            {Object.entries(CODE_TEMPLATES).map(([k,v])=>(
              <button key={k} onClick={()=>handleLangChange(k)}
                style={{...S_HANDBO.chip(lang===k), padding:"5px 12px", fontSize:12}}>
                {k==="java"?"â˜•":k==="python"?"ðŸ":k==="html"?"ðŸŒ":"ðŸ“"} {v.label}
              </button>
            ))}
            <div style={{marginLeft:"auto",display:"flex",gap:6,alignItems:"center"}}>
              {isPython && (
                <>
                  <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut("#6b7280")} onClick={()=>setFs(f=>Math.max(11,f-1))}>Aâˆ’</button>
                  <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut("#6b7280")} onClick={()=>setFs(f=>Math.min(20,f+1))}>A+</button>
                  <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut("#6b7280")} onClick={()=>setTheme(t=>t==="dark"?"light":"dark")}>{d?"â˜€":"â˜¾"}</button>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Find bar */}
          {showFind && (
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,marginBottom:6,alignItems:"center"}}>
              <input style={{...S_HANDBO.inp,marginBottom:0,flex:1,fontSize:12,padding:"6px 12px"}} placeholder="Find in codeâ€¦"
                value={findText} onChange={e=>setFindText(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&findInCode()} autoFocus />
              <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={findInCode}>Find</button>
              <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut("#6b7280")} onClick={()=>{setShowFind(false);setFindText("");}}>âœ•</button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* â”€â”€ Python editor (Pyodide) â”€â”€ */}
          {isPython && (
            <div>
              <style>{`\n                *{box-sizing:border-box}\n                @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0}}\n                .py-caret{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:.9em;background:${C.acc};vertical-align:text-bottom;animation:blink .9s step-end infinite;margin-left:1px}\n                @keyframes rot{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}\n                .py-spin{display:inline-block;animation:rot 1s linear infinite}\n                .hl-wrap{position:relative;flex:1;overflow:hidden}\n                .hl-back{position:absolute;inset:0;padding:14px 12px;font-size:${fontSize}px;line-height:1.65;white-space:pre;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;font-family:"Fira Code","Consolas",monospace}\n                .hl-ta{position:absolute;inset:0;resize:none;border:none;outline:none;font-size:${fontSize}px;line-height:1.65;padding:14px 12px;font-family:"Fira Code","Consolas",monospace;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:auto;tab-size:4;white-space:pre;color:transparent!important;background:transparent!important;caret-color:${C.acc}}\n                .hl-ta::selection{background:rgba(240,195,48,.15)}\n              `}</style>

              {/* Python status bar */}
              <div style={{background:"#0a0a0e",padding:"4px 12px",fontSize:10,color:C.muted,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",borderRadius:"8px 8px 0 0"}}>
                <span style={{color:C.acc}}>main.py</span>
                <span style={{color:statusColor}} className={pyStatus==="loading"?"loading":""}>
                  â— {pyStatus==="ready"?"Python 3.11 ready":pyStatus==="error"?"load failed":"Loading Pythonâ€¦"}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Editor */}
              <div style={{display:"flex",borderRadius:"0 0 0 0",overflow:"hidden",border:"1px solid " + (C.brd),height:340,background:C.edBg}}>
                <div ref={lnRef} style={{flexShrink:0,width:40,background:C.lnBg,borderRight:"1px solid " + (C.brd),color:C.lnC,fontSize,lineHeight:"1.65",padding:"14px 6px 14px 0",textAlign:"right",userSelect:"none",overflowY:"hidden",fontFamily:"'Fira Code','Consolas',monospace"}}>
                  {Array.from({length:lineCount},(_,i)=><div key={i}>{i+1}</div>)}
                </div>
                <div className="hl-wrap">
                  <div ref={hlRef} className="hl-back" style={{color:C.text}} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html:pyHighlight(code)}}/>
                  <textarea ref={taRef} className="hl-ta"
                    value={code}
                    onChange={e=>setCode(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={handleKey}
                    onScroll={syncScroll}
                    spellCheck={false} autoComplete="off" autoCorrect="off" autoCapitalize="off"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Terminal */}
              <div style={{background:C.termBg,borderRadius:"0 0 10px 10px",border:"1px solid " + (C.brd),borderTop:"none",marginBottom:8}}>
                <div style={{background:"#040406",padding:"4px 12px",fontSize:10,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",borderBottom:"1px solid #111"}}>
                  <span style={{color:"#5ec4ff",letterSpacing:1}}>TERMINAL</span>
                  <button onClick={()=>setTermLines([{type:"info",text:"Python 3.11 ready â€” press â–¶ Run or Ctrl+Enter"}])}
                    style={{background:"none",border:"1px solid #1a1a1a",color:"#555",fontSize:10,padding:"2px 8px",cursor:"pointer",borderRadius:3,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>clear</button>
                </div>
                <div style={{height:160,overflowY:"auto",padding:"8px 12px",fontFamily:"'Fira Code','Consolas',monospace",fontSize:12,lineHeight:1.7,cursor:waiting?"text":"default"}}
                  onClick={()=>waiting&&inRef.current?.focus()}>
                  {termLines.map((line,i)=>(
                    <div key={i} style={{color:line.type==="err"?C.red:line.type==="info"?C.dim:line.type==="inp"?C.yel:C.green,whiteSpace:"pre-wrap",wordBreak:"break-all"}}>{line.text}</div>
                  ))}
                  {waiting&&(
                    <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center"}}>
                      <span style={{color:C.yel,whiteSpace:"pre"}}>{curPrompt}</span>
                      <input ref={inRef}
                        value={termInput}
                        onChange={e=>setTermInput(e.target.value)}
                        onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&submitInput()}
                        style={{background:"transparent",border:"none",outline:"none",color:C.acc,fontFamily:"'Fira Code','Consolas',monospace",fontSize:12,flex:1,caretColor:C.acc,minWidth:10}}
                        autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false}
                      />
                      <span className="py-caret"/>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {isRunning&&!waiting&&(
                    <div style={{color:C.dim,marginTop:2}}><span className="py-spin" style={{marginRight:6}}>â—Œ</span>executingâ€¦</div>
                  )}
                  <div ref={endRef}/>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* â”€â”€ Non-Python editor (Java / HTML / Notes) â”€â”€ */}
          {!isPython && (
            <div>
              <div style={{position:"relative",display:"flex",borderRadius:10,overflow:"hidden",border:"1px solid #334155",marginBottom:8}}>
                <div style={{background:"#0a1525",color:"#475569",fontFamily:"'Fira Code','Consolas',monospace",fontSize:13,lineHeight:1.6,padding:"14px 10px",userSelect:"none",minWidth:36,textAlign:"right",borderRight:"1px solid #1e293b"}}>
                  {Array.from({length:lineCount},(_,i)=><div key={i} style={{lineHeight:"20.8px"}}>{i+1}</div>)}
                </div>
                <textarea
                  ref={taRef}
                  value={code}
                  onChange={e=>setCode(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={handleKey}
                  spellCheck={false}
                  style={{flex:1,minHeight:340,fontFamily:"'Fira Code','Consolas','Monaco',monospace",fontSize:13,lineHeight:1.6,background:"#0f172a",color:"#e2e8f0",border:"none",padding:"14px 14px",resize:"vertical",outline:"none",boxSizing:"border-box",width:"100%"}}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Status bar */}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,padding:"4px 12px",background:"#1e293b",borderRadius:"0 0 8px 8px",fontSize:11,color:"#64748b",marginBottom:8}}>
            <span>Ln {lineCount}</span>
            <span>Ch {code.length}</span>
            <span>{lang}</span>
            <button onClick={()=>setShowFind(s=>!s)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#64748b",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11,padding:0,fontFamily:"inherit",marginLeft:"auto"}}>ðŸ” Find (Ctrl+F)</button>
          </div>

          {/* Action bar */}
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",alignItems:"center"}}>
            {isPython ? (
              <button
                onClick={runPython}
                disabled={isRunning||pyStatus!=="ready"}
                style={{...S_HANDBO.btn("#16a34a"), opacity:isRunning||pyStatus!=="ready"?0.5:1, cursor:isRunning||pyStatus!=="ready"?"not-allowed":"pointer"}}>
                {pyStatus==="loading"?<><span className="py-spin">â—Œ</span> Loadingâ€¦</>:
                 isRunning&&!waiting?<><span className="py-spin">â—Œ</span> Runningâ€¦</>:
                 "â–¶ Run Python"}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button style={S_HANDBO.btn("#16a34a")} onClick={runAnalyze}>â–¶ Run / Analyze</button>
            )}
            <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut()} onClick={()=>setShowSave(s=>!s)}>ðŸ’¾ Save</button>
            <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut("#7c3aed")} onClick={()=>{setShowShared(s=>!s);loadSharedCode();}}>ðŸŒ {showShared?"Hide":"Share"}</button>
            <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut("#0891b2")} onClick={()=>setShowRef(s=>!s)}>ðŸ“š FTC Ref</button>
            <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut("#6b7280")} onClick={()=>{setCode(CODE_TEMPLATES[lang].starter);setOutput("");setTermLines([{type:"info",text:"Python 3.11 ready â€” press â–¶ Run or Ctrl+Enter"}]);setActiveSnippet(null);}}>â†º Reset</button>
            {saved && <span style={{color:"#16a34a",fontSize:13,fontWeight:700}}>âœ… Saved!</span>}
            {shareMsg && <span style={{color:shareMsg.startsWith("âœ…")?"#16a34a":"#dc2626",fontSize:13,fontWeight:700}}>{shareMsg}</span>}
          </div>

          {/* Save snippet row */}
          {showSave && (
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginTop:8}}>
              <input style={{...S_HANDBO.inp,marginBottom:0,flex:1}} placeholder="Snippet nameâ€¦" value={snippetName}
                onChange={e=>setSnippetName(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&saveSnippet()} />
              <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={saveSnippet}>Save</button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Share row */}
          {showShared && (
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginTop:8,padding:12,background:"#f5f3ff",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #ddd6fe"}}>
              <input style={{...S_HANDBO.inp,marginBottom:0,flex:1}} placeholder="Title for shared post (e.g. 'My mecanum drive code')â€¦" value={shareTitle}
                onChange={e=>setShareTitle(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&shareCode()} />
              <button style={S_HANDBO.btn("#7c3aed")} onClick={shareCode} disabled={sharing}>{sharing?"Sharingâ€¦":"Post to Team"}</button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Output for non-Python */}
          {output && !isPython && (
            <div style={{marginTop:14}}>
              {output === "__HTML_PREVIEW__" ? (
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:6}}>ðŸŒ HTML Preview:</div>
                  <iframe srcDoc={code} title="HTML Preview"
                    style={{width:"100%",height:320,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:10,background:"#fff"}}
                    sandbox="allow-scripts" />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <pre style={{background:"#0f172a",color:"#94a3b8",borderRadius:10,padding:14,fontSize:12,lineHeight:1.7,overflowX:"auto",whiteSpace:"pre-wrap",margin:0}}>
                  {output}
                </pre>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Right panel: snippets */}
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:10,color:"#374151"}}>ðŸ“‚ My Snippets ({savedSnippets.length}/20)</div>
          {savedSnippets.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:13,textAlign:"center",padding:20,border:"1px dashed #e2e8f0",borderRadius:10}}>
              No saved snippets yet!<br/>Write code and click Save.
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8,maxHeight:600,overflowY:"auto"}}>
            {savedSnippets.map(s=>(
              <div key={s.id}
                style={{background:activeSnippet===s.id?"#eff6ff":"#f8fafc",border:"1.5px solid " + (activeSnippet===s.id?"#bfdbfe":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 12px",cursor:"pointer",transition:"all 0.15s"}}
                onClick={()=>{setCode(s.code);setLang(s.lang);setActiveSnippet(s.id);setOutput("");}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",gap:6}}>
                  <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:0}}>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{s.name}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>{s.lang} Â· {new Date(s.ts).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={e=>{e.stopPropagation();deleteSnippet(s.id);}}
                    style={{background:"none",border:"none",cursor:"pointer",color:"#dc2626",fontSize:14,padding:2,flexShrink:0}}>ðŸ—‘</button>
                </div>
                <pre style={{marginTop:5,fontFamily:"monospace",fontSize:11,color:"#475569",overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis",whiteSpace:"nowrap",maxWidth:"100%",background:"transparent",padding:0,border:"none"}}>
                  {s.code.split("\n")[0]}
                </pre>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ ACHIEVEMENTS PAGE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function AchievementsPage({ user, done, totalLessons }) {
  const [userData, setUserData] = useState(null);
  const [newUnlocked, setNewUnlocked] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    storeGet("hub-users", true).then(users => {
      if (users?.[user.username]) setUserData(users[user.username]);
    });
    checkAndUnlockAchievements(user.username, totalLessons).then(setNewUnlocked);
  }, [done]);

  const earned = userData?.achievements || [];
  const earnedCount = earned.length;

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ† Achievements</div>
      <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:20}}>
        {earnedCount} / {ACHIEVEMENTS.length} earned
        {userData?.streak > 0 && <span style={{marginLeft:12,background:"#fef3c7",color:"#b45309",padding:"2px 10px",borderRadius:20,fontWeight:700,fontSize:12}}>ðŸ”¥ {userData.streak}-day streak</span>}
      </div>

      {/* Progress bar */}
      <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:20,height:8,marginBottom:24,overflow:"hidden"}}>
        <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(90deg,#f59e0b,#d97706)",width:(Math.round(earnedCount/ACHIEVEMENTS.length*100)) + "%",height:"100%",borderRadius:20,transition:"width 0.5s"}}/>
      </div>

      {/* Newly unlocked banner */}
      {newUnlocked.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#fef3c7,#fde68a)",border:"2px solid #f59e0b",borderRadius:12,padding:"14px 18px",marginBottom:20,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:28}}>ðŸŽ‰</div>
          <div>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,color:"#92400e"}}>New achievement{newUnlocked.length>1?"s":""} unlocked!</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#78350f"}}>{newUnlocked.map(a=>a.icon+" "+a.name).join("  Â·  ")}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Achievement grid */}
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(260px,1fr))",gap:12}}>
        {ACHIEVEMENTS.map(ach => {
          const unlocked = earned.includes(ach.id);
          return (
            <div key={ach.id} style={{
              background: unlocked ? "#fff" : "#f8fafc",
              border: "2px solid " + (unlocked ? "#f59e0b" : "#e2e8f0"),
              borderRadius:12, padding:"14px 16px",
              opacity: unlocked ? 1 : 0.55,
              transition:"all 0.2s",
              display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12,
            }}>
              <div style={{fontSize:32,filter:unlocked?"none":"grayscale(1)"}}>{ach.icon}</div>
              <div style={{flex:1}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14,color:unlocked?"#1e293b":"#64748b"}}>{ach.name}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>{ach.desc}</div>
                {unlocked && <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#f59e0b",fontWeight:700,marginTop:3}}>âœ“ Unlocked</div>}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ LEADERBOARD PAGE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function LeaderboardPage({ user }) {
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("lessons");

  useEffect(() => {
    storeGet("hub-users", true).then(users => {
      if (!users) { setLoading(false); return; }
      const rows = Object.entries(users)
        .filter(([uname]) => uname !== "admin")
        .map(([uname, u]) => ({
          username: uname,
          name: u.name || uname,
          lessons: Object.keys(u.done || {}).length,
          time: u.learningTime || 0,
          streak: u.streak || 0,
          achievements: (u.achievements || []).length,
          quizzes: Object.keys(u.quizScores || {}).length,
          team: u.teamName || null,
        }));
      setEntries(rows);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const sorted = [...entries].sort((a, b) => b[sortBy] - a[sortBy]);

  const SORT_OPTIONS = [
    {key:"lessons",    label:"ðŸ“š Lessons"},
    {key:"time",       label:"â± Time"},
    {key:"streak",     label:"ðŸ”¥ Streak"},
    {key:"achievements",label:"ðŸ† Badges"},
    {key:"quizzes",    label:"ðŸ§  Quizzes"},
  ];

  const medals = ["ðŸ¥‡","ðŸ¥ˆ","ðŸ¥‰"];

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ¥‡ Leaderboard</div>
      <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:18}}>Rankings are visible to all team members.</div>

      {/* Sort tabs */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:18,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {SORT_OPTIONS.map(o => (
          <button key={o.key} onClick={()=>setSortBy(o.key)}
            style={{...S_HANDBO.chip(sortBy===o.key),fontSize:12,padding:"5px 14px"}}>
            {o.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {loading && <div style={{textAlign:"center",color:"#9ca3af",padding:40}}>Loadingâ€¦</div>}

      {/* Top 3 podium */}
      {sorted.length >= 3 && (
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,marginBottom:20,alignItems:"flex-end",justifyContent:"center"}}>
          {[sorted[1],sorted[0],sorted[2]].map((entry, idx) => {
            const rank = idx === 1 ? 1 : idx === 0 ? 2 : 3;
            const heights = [100, 130, 85];
            const isMe = entry.username === user.username;
            return (
              <div key={entry.username} style={{
                flex:1,maxWidth:160,display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",
                background: isMe ? "#eff6ff" : "#f8fafc",
                border: "2px solid " + (isMe ? "#bfdbfe" : rank===1?"#f59e0b":"#e2e8f0"),
                borderRadius:"12px 12px 0 0",
                minHeight: heights[idx],
                padding:"14px 10px",
                justifyContent:"flex-start",
              }}>
                <div style={{fontSize:28,marginBottom:4}}>{medals[rank-1]}</div>
                <div style={{width:36,height:36,background:"hsl(" + (entry.username.charCodeAt(0)*13%360) + ",60%,50%)",
                  borderRadius:9,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",
                  fontWeight:900,fontSize:18,color:"#fff",marginBottom:6}}>
                  {entry.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                </div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:13,textAlign:"center",wordBreak:"break-word"}}>{entry.name}</div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,color:"#1d4ed8",marginTop:4}}>
                  {sortBy==="time" ? fmtTime(entry[sortBy]) : entry[sortBy]}
                </div>
                <div style={{fontSize:10,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{SORT_OPTIONS.find(o=>o.key===sortBy)?.label}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Full table */}
      <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,padding:0,overflow:"hidden"}}>
        {sorted.map((entry, i) => {
          const isMe = entry.username === user.username;
          return (
            <div key={entry.username} style={{
              display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12,padding:"12px 16px",
              background: isMe ? "#eff6ff" : i%2===0 ? "#fff" : "#f8fafc",
              borderBottom: i < sorted.length-1 ? "1px solid #f1f5f9" : "none",
            }}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,width:28,textAlign:"center",color:i<3?"#f59e0b":"#9ca3af"}}>
                {i < 3 ? medals[i] : "#" + (i+1)}
              </div>
              <div style={{width:32,height:32,background:"hsl(" + (entry.username.charCodeAt(0)*13%360) + ",60%,50%)",
                borderRadius:8,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",
                fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,color:"#fff",flexShrink:0}}>
                {entry.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
              </div>
              <div style={{flex:1}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{entry.name} {isMe && <span style={{background:"#dbeafe",color:"#1d4ed8",borderRadius:6,padding:"1px 6px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700}}>You</span>}</div>
                {entry.team && <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¥ {entry.team}</div>}
              </div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:14,fontSize:12,color:"#64748b",flexWrap:"wrap",justifyContent:"flex-end"}}>
                <span title="Lessons">ðŸ“š {entry.lessons}</span>
                <span title="Time">â± {fmtTime(entry.time)}</span>
                <span title="Streak">ðŸ”¥ {entry.streak}d</span>
                <span title="Badges">ðŸ† {entry.achievements}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
        {sorted.length === 0 && !loading && (
          <div style={{textAlign:"center",color:"#9ca3af",padding:40}}>No learners yet!</div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ NOTES PAGE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function NotesPage({ user }) {
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState({});
  const [bookmarks, setBookmarks] = useState([]);
  const [activeNote, setActiveNote] = useState(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("notes"); // notes | bookmarks
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { loadData(); }, []);

  async function loadData() {
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    const u = users[user.username] || {};
    setNotes(u.notes || {});
    setBookmarks(u.bookmarks || []);
  }

  async function saveNote(lessonId) {
    setSaving(true);
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    if (!users[user.username]) { setSaving(false); return; }
    const updated = { ...notes, [lessonId]: editing };
    users[user.username].notes = updated;
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    setNotes(updated);
    setSaving(false);
    setActiveNote(null);
  }

  async function deleteNote(lessonId) {
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    if (!users[user.username]) return;
    const updated = { ...notes };
    delete updated[lessonId];
    users[user.username].notes = updated;
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    setNotes(updated);
    if (activeNote === lessonId) setActiveNote(null);
  }

  async function removeBookmark(lessonId) {
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users", true) || {};
    if (!users[user.username]) return;
    const updated = bookmarks.filter(id => id !== lessonId);
    users[user.username].bookmarks = updated;
    await storeSet("hub-users", users, true);
    setBookmarks(updated);
  }

  // Build lookup: lessonId â†’ lesson object
  const lessonMap = {};
  Object.values(LESSONS).forEach(subject => {
    Object.values(subject).forEach(arr => {
      arr.forEach(l => { lessonMap[l.id] = l; });
    });
  });

  const noteEntries = Object.entries(notes).filter(([,v]) => v?.trim());
  const bookmarkLessons = bookmarks.map(id => lessonMap[id]).filter(Boolean);

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ“ My Notes & Bookmarks</div>
      <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:18}}>Notes and bookmarks are private to your account.</div>

      {/* Filter */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:18}}>
        {[["notes","ðŸ“ Notes",noteEntries.length],["bookmarks","â­ Bookmarks",bookmarkLessons.length]].map(([key,label,count]) => (
          <button key={key} onClick={()=>setFilter(key)}
            style={{...S_HANDBO.chip(filter===key),fontSize:13,padding:"6px 16px"}}>
            {label} {count > 0 && <span style={{background:filter===key?"rgba(255,255,255,0.3)":"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:20,padding:"0 6px",fontSize:11,marginLeft:4}}>{count}</span>}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* NOTES VIEW */}
      {filter === "notes" && (
        <div>
          {noteEntries.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:48,color:"#9ca3af",border:"2px dashed #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:40,marginBottom:10}}>ðŸ“</div>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:16,marginBottom:6}}>No notes yet</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:13}}>Open any lesson and click "Add Note" to start.</div>
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
            {noteEntries.map(([lessonId, noteText]) => {
              const lesson = lessonMap[lessonId];
              const isEditing = activeNote === lessonId;
              return (
                <div key={lessonId} style={{...S_HANDBO.card,padding:16}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",gap:8,marginBottom:8}}>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{lesson?.title || lessonId}</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Lesson note</div>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
                      {!isEditing && <button style={{...S_HANDBO.btnSm(),fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>{setEditing(noteText);setActiveNote(lessonId);}}>Edit</button>}
                      <button style={{...S_HANDBO.btnSm("#dc2626"),fontSize:11}} onClick={()=>deleteNote(lessonId)}>Delete</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {isEditing ? (
                    <div>
                      <textarea value={editing} onChange={e=>setEditing(e.target.value)}
                        style={{...S_HANDBO.ta,minHeight:100,marginBottom:8}} placeholder="Your notesâ€¦" />
                      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8}}>
                        <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={()=>saveNote(lessonId)} disabled={saving}>{saving?"Savingâ€¦":"Save Note"}</button>
                        <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut()} onClick={()=>setActiveNote(null)}>Cancel</button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 12px",fontSize:13,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.6,whiteSpace:"pre-wrap"}}>{noteText}</div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* BOOKMARKS VIEW */}
      {filter === "bookmarks" && (
        <div>
          {bookmarkLessons.length === 0 && (
            <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:48,color:"#9ca3af",border:"2px dashed #e2e8f0",borderRadius:14}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:40,marginBottom:10}}>â­</div>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:16,marginBottom:6}}>No bookmarks yet</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:13}}>Star any lesson to save it here for quick access.</div>
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
            {bookmarkLessons.map(lesson => (
              <div key={lesson.id} style={{...S_HANDBO.card,padding:14,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12}}>
                <div style={{flex:1}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{lesson.title}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>â± {lesson.est}</div>
                </div>
                <button onClick={()=>removeBookmark(lesson.id)}
                  style={{background:"none",border:"none",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:20,color:"#f59e0b",padding:4}}>â­</button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


// â”€â”€â”€ FIRST TOOLS PAGE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

function ToolScouting({ analysisTeam, autoConsistency, autoScore, brokeDown, climbTime, climbed, cycleCount, defenseEffective, defenseNotes, defensePenalties, defenseTarget, driverSkill, offenseRating, playedDefense, reliability, robotSpeed, scoringZone, scoutMatch, scoutNotes, scoutTeam, scoutView, teleopScore, scoutSaved, scoutReset, setAnalysisTeam, setAutoConsistency, setAutoScore, setBrokeDown, setClimbTime, setClimbed, setCycleCount, setDefenseEffective, setDefenseNotes, setDefensePenalties, setDefenseTarget, setDriverSkill, setOffenseRating, setPlayedDefense, setReliability, setRobotSpeed, setScoringZone, setScoutMatch, setScoutNotes, setScoutTeam, setScoutView, setTeleopScore }) {
  // â”€â”€ helpers â”€â”€
const RatingBar = ({val,max=5,color="#1d4ed8"})=>(
  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:3,alignItems:"center"}}>
    {Array.from({length:max},(_, i)=>(
      <div key={i} style={{width:18,height:8,borderRadius:3,background:i<val?color:"#e2e8f0",transition:"background 0.15s"}}/>
    ))}
    <span style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginLeft:4}}>{val}/{max}</span>
  </div>
);
const RatingPicker = ({val,set,max=5,color="#1d4ed8",label})=>(
  <div>
    <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:6,fontWeight:600}}>{label} <span style={{color,fontWeight:800}}>{val}/{max}</span></div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4}}>
      {Array.from({length:max},(_,i)=>(
        <button key={i} onClick={()=>set(i+1)}
          style={{width:32,height:32,borderRadius:7,border:"2px solid " + (i<val?color:"#e2e8f0"),background:i<val?color:"#f8fafc",color:i<val?"#fff":"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",transition:"all 0.1s"}}>
          {i+1}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  </div>
);

const overallColor = r => r>=8?"#059669":r>=6?"#16a34a":r>=4?"#f59e0b":r>=2?"#ea580c":"#dc2626";
const overallLabel = r => r>=8?"ðŸ† Elite":r>=6?"âœ… Good Pick":r>=4?"âš ï¸ Average":r>=2?"ðŸ”´ Weak":"âŒ Avoid";

// Analysis: group by team
const byTeam = {};
scoutSaved.forEach(e => {
  if (!byTeam[e.team]) byTeam[e.team] = [];
  byTeam[e.team].push(e);
});
const teamSummaries = Object.entries(byTeam).map(([team, entries]) => {
  const avgOff = entries.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.offenseRating||3),0)/entries.length;
  const avgDef = entries.filter(e=>e.playedDefense).length>0
    ? entries.filter(e=>e.playedDefense).reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.defenseEffective||3),0)/entries.filter(e=>e.playedDefense).length : null;
  const avgRel = entries.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.reliability||3),0)/entries.length;
  const climbPct = entries.filter(e=>e.climbed==="success").length/entries.length*100;
  const avgOvr = entries.reduce((s,e)=>s+(e.overallRating||5),0)/entries.length;
  const avgAuto = entries.filter(e=>e.auto).length>0
    ? entries.filter(e=>e.auto).reduce((s,e)=>s+parseFloat(e.auto||0),0)/entries.filter(e=>e.auto).length : null;
  return {team,entries,avgOff,avgDef,avgRel,climbPct,avgOvr,avgAuto};
}).sort((a,b)=>b.avgOvr-a.avgOvr);

return (
  <div>
    {/* Header */}
    <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#1e293b)",borderRadius:14,padding:20,color:"#fff",marginBottom:18}}>
      <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:10}}>
        <div>
          <div style={{fontSize:20,fontWeight:900,marginBottom:3}}>ðŸ“‹ Advanced Scout Sheet</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:13,opacity:0.7}}>Rate teams on offense, defense, reliability & more â€” automatic overall score</div>
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
          {[["form","ðŸ“ Form"],["list","ðŸ“Š Entries"],["analysis","ðŸ”¬ Analysis"]].map(([v,l])=>(
            <button key={v} onClick={()=>setScoutView(v)}
              style={{background:scoutView===v?"rgba(255,255,255,0.2)":"transparent",color:"#fff",border:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",borderRadius:8,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
              {l}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    {/* FORM VIEW */}
    {scoutView==="form" && (
      <div>
        {/* Match info */}
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:12}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:12,color:"#1e293b"}}>ðŸ“Œ Match Info</div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Team Number *</div>
              <input value={scoutTeam} onChange={e=>setScoutTeam(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 4512"
                style={{width:"100%",padding:"10px 12px",borderRadius:9,border:"2px solid " + (scoutTeam?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),fontSize:15,fontWeight:700,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Match</div>
              <input value={scoutMatch} onChange={e=>setScoutMatch(e.target.value)} placeholder="Qual 12"
                style={{width:"100%",padding:"10px 12px",borderRadius:9,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* OFFENSE */}
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"2px solid #dbeafe",marginBottom:12}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,color:"#1e40af",marginBottom:14}}>âš¡ Offense</div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12,marginBottom:14}}>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Auto Score (pts)</div>
              <input type="number" value={autoScore} onChange={e=>setAutoScore(e.target.value)} placeholder="0"
                style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Teleop Score (pts)</div>
              <input type="number" value={teleopScore} onChange={e=>setTeleopScore(e.target.value)} placeholder="0"
                style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Cycles / Game Pieces</div>
              <input type="number" value={cycleCount} onChange={e=>setCycleCount(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 8"
                style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:6}}>Auto Consistency</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
                {[["fail","âŒ Failed"],["partial","âš ï¸ Partial"],["full","âœ… Full"]].map(([v,l])=>(
                  <button key={v} onClick={()=>setAutoConsistency(v)}
                    style={{flex:1,background:autoConsistency===v?{fail:"#fef2f2",partial:"#fffbeb",full:"#f0fdf4"}[v]:"#f8fafc",
                      border:"2px solid " + (autoConsistency===v?{fail:"#fca5a5",partial:"#fcd34d",full:"#86efac"}[v]:"#e2e8f0"),
                      borderRadius:7,padding:"6px 4px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit",textAlign:"center"}}>
                    {l}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{marginBottom:14}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:6}}>Scoring Zones Used</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
              {["Low Goal","Mid Goal","High Goal","Speaker","Amp","Trap","Ground Intake","Feeder Station"].map(z=>(
                <button key={z} onClick={()=>setScoringZone(prev=>prev.includes(z)?prev.filter(x=>x!==z):[...prev,z])}
                  style={{background:scoringZone.includes(z)?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:scoringZone.includes(z)?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"6px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:600,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                  {z}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <RatingPicker val={offenseRating} set={setOffenseRating} max={5} color="#1d4ed8" label="Offense Rating"/>
        </div>

        {/* DEFENSE */}
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"2px solid " + (playedDefense?"#fed7aa":"#e2e8f0"),marginBottom:12,transition:"border-color 0.2s"}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:playedDefense?14:0}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,color:"#ea580c"}}>ðŸ›¡ï¸ Defense</div>
            <button onClick={()=>setPlayedDefense(!playedDefense)}
              style={{background:playedDefense?"#fff7ed":"#f1f5f9",border:"2px solid " + (playedDefense?"#f97316":"#e2e8f0"),color:playedDefense?"#ea580c":"#6b7280",borderRadius:8,padding:"6px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
              {playedDefense?"âœ… Played Defense":"â¬œ Did Not Play Defense"}
            </button>
          </div>
          {playedDefense && (
            <div>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12,marginBottom:14}}>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Who Did They Target?</div>
                  <input value={defenseTarget} onChange={e=>setDefenseTarget(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 1678, top scorer"
                    style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Penalties Taken</div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,alignItems:"center"}}>
                    <button onClick={()=>setDefensePenalties(p=>Math.max(0,p-1))}
                      style={{width:32,height:32,borderRadius:7,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",background:"#f8fafc",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>-</button>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18,minWidth:28,textAlign:"center",color:defensePenalties>2?"#dc2626":"#374151"}}>{defensePenalties}</span>
                    <button onClick={()=>setDefensePenalties(p=>p+1)}
                      style={{width:32,height:32,borderRadius:7,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",background:"#f8fafc",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{marginBottom:12}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Defense Style Notes</div>
                <input value={defenseNotes} onChange={e=>setDefenseNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Bumper to bumper, pushed them out of shooting zone, was effective"
                  style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
              </div>
              <RatingPicker val={defenseEffective} set={setDefenseEffective} max={5} color="#ea580c" label="Defense Effectiveness"/>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ENDGAME */}
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"2px solid #d1fae5",marginBottom:12}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,color:"#059669",marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ§— Endgame / Climb</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:10,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            {[["no","âŒ No Climb"],["attempted","âš ï¸ Attempted"],["success","âœ… Climbed"],["harmony","ðŸ¤ Harmony"]].map(([val,lbl])=>(
              <button key={val} onClick={()=>setClimbed(val)}
                style={{background:climbed===val?{no:"#fef2f2",attempted:"#fffbeb",success:"#f0fdf4",harmony:"#eff6ff"}[val]:"#f8fafc",
                  border:"2px solid " + (climbed===val?{no:"#fca5a5",attempted:"#fcd34d",success:"#86efac",harmony:"#93c5fd"}[val]:"#e2e8f0"),
                  borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                {lbl}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {climbed!=="no" && (
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Climb Time (seconds from endgame start)</div>
              <input type="number" value={climbTime} onChange={e=>setClimbTime(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 12"
                style={{width:120,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* OVERALL RATINGS */}
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:12}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,color:"#374151",marginBottom:14}}>â­ Overall Assessment</div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:14,marginBottom:14}}>
            <RatingPicker val={reliability} set={setReliability} max={5} color="#7c3aed" label="Reliability (no breakdowns, consistent)"/>
            <RatingPicker val={robotSpeed} set={setRobotSpeed} max={5} color="#0891b2" label="Robot Speed (movement, cycle time)"/>
            <RatingPicker val={driverSkill} set={setDriverSkill} max={5} color="#0d9488" label="Driver Skill (control, positioning)"/>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:8,fontWeight:600}}>Robot broke down / had issues?</div>
              <button onClick={()=>setBrokeDown(!brokeDown)}
                style={{background:brokeDown?"#fef2f2":"#f0fdf4",border:"2px solid " + (brokeDown?"#fca5a5":"#86efac"),color:brokeDown?"#991b1b":"#166534",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit",fontSize:13}}>
                {brokeDown?"ðŸ’€ Yes â€” broke down":"âœ… No issues"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Scouter Notes</div>
            <textarea value={scoutNotes} onChange={e=>setScoutNotes(e.target.value)} rows={2}
              placeholder="e.g. Very fast shooter, jammed intake in Q2, climbed in 8 sec, excellent driver..."
              style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* PREVIEW SCORE */}
        {scoutTeam && (() => {
          const preview = {offenseRating,playedDefense,defenseEffective,defensePenalties,climbed,reliability};
          const r = calcOverallRating(preview);
          return (
            <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg," + (overallColor(r)) + "15," + (overallColor(r)) + "05)",border:"2px solid " + (overallColor(r)) + "40",borderRadius:12,padding:14,marginBottom:12,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:14}}>
              <div style={{width:56,height:56,borderRadius:"50%",background:overallColor(r),color:"#fff",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,flexShrink:0}}>{r}</div>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,color:overallColor(r)}}>{overallLabel(r)}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>Predicted overall rating for Team #{scoutTeam}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })()}

        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10}}>
          <button onClick={saveScoutEntry}
            style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",padding:"12px 28px",borderRadius:10,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,fontFamily:"inherit",opacity:scoutTeam?"1":"0.5"}}>
            ðŸ’¾ Save Scout Entry
          </button>
          <button onClick={scoutReset}
            style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",padding:"12px 16px",borderRadius:10,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
            Clear
          </button>
          {scoutSaved.length>0 && (
            <button onClick={()=>{
              const hdr="Team,Match,Auto,Teleop,Cycles,OffenseRating,PlayedDefense,DefenseRating,Penalties,Climb,Reliability,Speed,DriverSkill,Overall,Notes\n";
              const rows=scoutSaved.map(e=>(e.team) + "," + (e.match) + "," + (e.auto||0) + "," + (e.teleop||0) + "," + (e.cycleCount||0) + "," + (e.offenseRating||0) + "," + (e.playedDefense?1:0) + "," + (e.defenseEffective||0) + "," + (e.defensePenalties||0) + "," + (e.climbed) + "," + (e.reliability||0) + "," + (e.robotSpeed||0) + "," + (e.driverSkill||0) + "," + (e.overallRating||0) + ",\"" + ((e.notes||"").replace(/"/g,"'")) + "\"").join("\n");
              const blob=new Blob([hdr+rows],{type:"text/csv"});
              const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
              const a=document.createElement("a");a.href=url;a.download="scout_data.csv";a.click();
            }}
            style={{background:"#059669",color:"#fff",border:"none",padding:"12px 18px",borderRadius:10,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
            â¬‡ CSV
          </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    )}

    {/* LIST VIEW */}
    {scoutView==="list" && (
      <div>
        {scoutSaved.length===0 ? (
          <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No entries yet â€” fill out the form first!</div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
            {scoutSaved.map((e,i)=>{
              const c=overallColor(e.overallRating||5);
              return (
                <div key={i} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 16px",border:"2px solid " + (c) + "30",display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"flex-start",flexWrap:"wrap",position:"relative"}}>
                  <div style={{width:44,height:44,borderRadius:10,background:c,color:"#fff",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontWeight:900,fontSize:18,flexShrink:0}}>{e.overallRating||"?"}</div>
                  <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:150}}>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,color:"#1e293b"}}>Team #{e.team}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{e.match} Â· {new Date(e.ts).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",fontSize:12}}>
                    <div style={{background:"#dbeafe",color:"#1e40af",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px"}}>âš¡ Off: {e.offenseRating}/5</div>
                    {e.playedDefense&&<div style={{background:"#fff7ed",color:"#c2410c",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px"}}>ðŸ›¡ï¸ Def: {e.defenseEffective}/5</div>}
                    <div style={{background:{success:"#d1fae5",attempted:"#fef9c3",no:"#fee2e2",harmony:"#dbeafe"}[e.climbed]||"#f3f4f6",
                      color:{success:"#065f46",attempted:"#854d0e",no:"#991b1b",harmony:"#1e40af"}[e.climbed]||"#374151",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px"}}>
                      {e.climbed==="success"?"âœ…":e.climbed==="harmony"?"ðŸ¤":e.climbed==="attempted"?"âš ï¸":"âŒ"} Climb
                    </div>
                    <div style={{background:"#f3e8ff",color:"#6d28d9",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px"}}>â­ Rel: {e.reliability}/5</div>
                    {e.brokeDown&&<div style={{background:"#fef2f2",color:"#991b1b",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 8px"}}>ðŸ’€ Broke Down</div>}
                  </div>
                  {e.notes&&<div style={{width:"100%",fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:4}}>{e.notes}</div>}
                  <div style={{position:"absolute",top:10,right:10,fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,color:c}}>{overallLabel(e.overallRating||5)}</div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    )}

    {/* ANALYSIS VIEW */}
    {scoutView==="analysis" && (
      <div>
        {teamSummaries.length===0 ? (
          <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Scout some teams first!</div>
        ) : (
          <div>
            <div style={{marginBottom:16}}>
              <input value={analysisTeam} onChange={e=>setAnalysisTeam(e.target.value)} placeholder="Filter by team number..."
                style={{width:"100%",padding:"10px 14px",borderRadius:9,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
            </div>
            {teamSummaries.filter(t=>!analysisTeam||t.team.includes(analysisTeam)).map(t=>{
              const c=overallColor(t.avgOvr);
              return (
                <div key={t.team} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"2px solid " + (c) + "30",marginBottom:12,boxShadow:"0 2px 12px " + (c) + "10"}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:14,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:14,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                    <div style={{width:56,height:56,borderRadius:12,background:"linear-gradient(135deg," + (c) + "," + (c) + "cc)",color:"#fff",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,flexShrink:0}}>{t.avgOvr.toFixed(1)}</div>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18}}>Team #{t.team}</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:13,color:c,fontWeight:700}}>{overallLabel(t.avgOvr)}</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{t.entries.length} match{t.entries.length>1?"es":""} scouted</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
                    {[
                      ["âš¡ Offense",t.avgOff.toFixed(1)+"/5","#1d4ed8"],
                      t.avgDef!==null?["ðŸ›¡ï¸ Defense",t.avgDef.toFixed(1)+"/5","#ea580c"]:null,
                      ["â­ Reliability",t.avgRel.toFixed(1)+"/5","#7c3aed"],
                      ["ðŸ§— Climb Rate",Math.round(t.climbPct)+"%","#059669"],
                      t.avgAuto!==null?["ðŸ¤– Avg Auto",t.avgAuto.toFixed(0)+" pts","#0891b2"]:null,
                      ["ðŸ’€ Breakdown",t.entries.filter(e=>e.brokeDown).length+" of "+t.entries.length,"#dc2626"],
                    ].filter(Boolean).map(([l,v,c2])=>(
                      <div key={l} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:9,padding:"10px 12px",border:"1px solid " + (c2) + "20"}}>
                        <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>{l}</div>
                        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18,color:c2}}>{v}</div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {t.entries.some(e=>e.scoringZone?.length>0) && (
                    <div style={{marginTop:10}}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:5}}>Scoring Zones Used</div>
                      <div style={{display:"flex",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:4}}>
                        {[...new Set(t.entries.flatMap(e=>e.scoringZone||[]))].map(z=>(
                          <span key={z} style={{fontSize:11,background:"#eff6ff",color:"#1e40af",borderRadius:5,padding:"2px 7px",fontWeight:600}}>{z}</span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {t.entries.some(e=>e.notes) && (
                    <div style={{marginTop:10,fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:7,padding:"8px 12px"}}>
                      {t.entries.filter(e=>e.notes).map((e,i)=><div key={i}>{e.notes}</div>)}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}

            {/* Alliance Recommendation */}
            {teamSummaries.length>=3 && (
              <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#4f46e5)",borderRadius:14,padding:18,color:"#fff",marginTop:8}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ¤ Top Alliance Recommendation</div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                  {teamSummaries.slice(0,3).map((t,i)=>(
                    <div key={t.team} style={{flex:1,minWidth:100,background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.12)",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",textAlign:"center"}}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.7,marginBottom:3}}>#{i+1} Pick</div>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18}}>Team {t.team}</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:14,fontWeight:700,color:"#fbbf24"}}>{t.avgOvr.toFixed(1)}/10</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.6,marginTop:10}}>Based on overall rating across all scouted matches. Always combine with live observations.</div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    )}
  </div>
);
}


function ToolFastenref() {
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState("imperial");
const [filter, setFilter] = useState("all");
const FASTENERS = {
  imperial: [
    {size:"#6-32",od:"3.5mm",drill:"#36",clearance:"#28",use:"Electronics mounting, light panels",strength:"Low",color:"#6b7280"},
    {size:"#8-32",od:"4.2mm",drill:"#29",clearance:"#18",use:"Servo mounts, sensor brackets",strength:"Low",color:"#6b7280"},
    {size:"#10-32",od:"4.8mm",drill:"#21",clearance:"#10",use:"Most robot structure, motor mounts",strength:"Medium",color:"#1d4ed8"},
    {size:"1/4-20",od:"6.4mm",drill:"#7",clearance:"F",use:"Heavy structure, wheel hubs, arm pivots",strength:"High",color:"#059669"},
    {size:"5/16-18",od:"7.9mm",drill:"F",clearance:"21/64",use:"Drivetrain, heavy load pivots",strength:"High",color:"#059669"},
    {size:"3/8-16",od:"9.5mm",drill:"5/16",clearance:"25/64",use:"Main shaft bearings, large pivots",strength:"Very High",color:"#dc2626"},
  ],
  metric: [
    {size:"M3",od:"3mm",drill:"2.5mm",clearance:"3.2mm",use:"Electronics, sensors, light panels",strength:"Low",color:"#6b7280"},
    {size:"M4",od:"4mm",drill:"3.3mm",clearance:"4.3mm",use:"Servo brackets, limit switches",strength:"Low",color:"#6b7280"},
    {size:"M5",od:"5mm",drill:"4.2mm",clearance:"5.3mm",use:"General robot structure",strength:"Medium",color:"#1d4ed8"},
    {size:"M6",od:"6mm",drill:"5.0mm",clearance:"6.4mm",use:"Motor mounts, arm pivots",strength:"High",color:"#059669"},
    {size:"M8",od:"8mm",drill:"6.8mm",clearance:"8.4mm",use:"Drivetrain, heavy mechanisms",strength:"High",color:"#059669"},
    {size:"M10",od:"10mm",drill:"8.5mm",clearance:"10.5mm",use:"Main shafts, large pivots",strength:"Very High",color:"#dc2626"},
  ]
};
const TIPS = [
  "ðŸ”µ Blue Loctite (243) on any bolt that might vibrate loose. Red Loctite only for permanent joints.",
  "âš¡ Use nyloc nuts or Loctite â€” never plain nuts on a robot. Vibration WILL loosen them.",
  "ðŸ“ Drill size is for tapping threads. Clearance size is for a through-hole (bolt passes through).",
  "ðŸ”© #10-32 and 1/4-20 cover 90% of FRC robot needs. Stock lots of both.",
  "ðŸª› Stainless steel bolts into aluminum can gall â€” use a drop of anti-seize or oil.",
];
const strengthFilter = filter === "all" ? FASTENERS[platform] : FASTENERS[platform].filter(f => f.strength === filter);
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ”© Fastener Reference Guide</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Quick reference for bolt sizes, drill bits, and typical uses on robots.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:14,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
      {[["imperial","ðŸ‡ºðŸ‡¸ Imperial (UNC)"],["metric","ðŸŒ Metric"]].map(([v,l])=>(
        <button key={v} onClick={()=>setPlatform(v)} style={{background:platform===v?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:platform===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{l}</button>
      ))}
      <div style={{marginLeft:"auto",display:"flex",gap:6}}>
        {["all","Low","Medium","High","Very High"].map(s=>(
          <button key={s} onClick={()=>setFilter(s)} style={{background:filter===s?"#374151":"#f1f5f9",color:filter===s?"#fff":"#6b7280",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"5px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{s}</button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",overflow:"hidden",marginBottom:14}}>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 2fr 1fr",background:"#f8fafc",padding:"10px 16px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,color:"#6b7280",textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:0.8,borderBottom:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
        <span>Size</span><span>Tap Drill</span><span>Clear Drill</span><span>Strength</span><span>Common Use</span><span>OD</span>
      </div>
      {strengthFilter.map((f,i)=>(
        <div key={f.size} style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 2fr 1fr",padding:"12px 16px",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",background:i%2===0?"#fff":"#fafafa",alignItems:"center"}}>
          <span style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:15,color:f.color,fontFamily:"monospace"}}>{f.size}</span>
          <span style={{fontFamily:"monospace",fontSize:13}}>{f.drill}</span>
          <span style={{fontFamily:"monospace",fontSize:13}}>{f.clearance}</span>
          <span style={{background:f.color+"15",color:f.color,borderRadius:5,padding:"2px 7px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block"}}>{f.strength}</span>
          <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#374151"}}>{f.use}</span>
          <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{f.od}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:7}}>
      {TIPS.map((tip,i)=>(
        <div key={i} style={{background:"#fffbeb",borderRadius:9,padding:"9px 13px",fontSize:12,color:"#92400e",border:"1px solid #fde68a"}}>{tip}</div>
      ))}
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolMaterialsel() {
  const [compare, setCompare] = useState(["aluminum","polycarb"]);
const MATERIALS = [
  {id:"aluminum",name:"6061 Aluminum",icon:"ðŸ”˜",density:2.7,tensile:276,cost:"Medium",machinability:"Excellent",weldable:true,notes:"The FRC standard. Strong, light, easy to machine. T-slot extrusion everywhere.",tags:["structure","arm","tube","plate"],color:"#6b7280"},
  {id:"steel",name:"Mild Steel",icon:"â¬›",density:7.85,tensile:400,cost:"Low",machinability:"Good",weldable:true,notes:"Heavy but cheap. Good for high-stress pivots or when you need to weld.",tags:["pivot","bracket","weld"],color:"#374151"},
  {id:"polycarb",name:"Polycarbonate",icon:"ðŸ”·",density:1.2,tensile:65,cost:"Medium",machinability:"Excellent",weldable:false,notes:"Impact-resistant panels and bumper backing. Can be bent with a heat gun.",tags:["panel","bumper","cover"],color:"#1d4ed8"},
  {id:"hdpe",name:"HDPE",icon:"ðŸŸ©",density:0.95,tensile:25,cost:"Low",machinability:"Excellent",weldable:false,notes:"Self-lubricating â€” great for bearings, slides, intake rollers. Very light.",tags:["bearing","slide","intake"],color:"#059669"},
  {id:"delrin",name:"Delrin (Acetal)",icon:"â¬œ",density:1.41,tensile:70,cost:"Medium-High",machinability:"Excellent",weldable:false,notes:"Best plastic for precision parts â€” gears, pulleys, bushings. Low friction.",tags:["gear","pulley","bushing"],color:"#9ca3af"},
  {id:"carbon",name:"Carbon Fiber Tube",icon:"ðŸ–¤",density:1.55,tensile:600,cost:"High",machinability:"Hard",weldable:false,notes:"Lightest strong option for arms. Cut with diamond blade only.",tags:["arm","lightweight","tube"],color:"#0f172a"},
  {id:"fiberglass",name:"Fiberglass Sheet",icon:"ðŸŸ¡",density:1.8,tensile:300,cost:"Medium",machinability:"Good",weldable:false,notes:"Stiff and light panels when weight matters.",tags:["panel","electronics","stiff"],color:"#d97706"},
  {id:"tpu",name:"TPU (3D Printed)",icon:"ðŸŸ ",density:1.21,tensile:50,cost:"Low",machinability:"N/A",weldable:false,notes:"Flexible, grippy â€” perfect for intake fingers, bumper edges, custom rollers.",tags:["intake","grip","custom"],color:"#f59e0b"},
];
const toggleCompare = id => setCompare(prev => prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter(x=>x!==id) : prev.length<3 ? [...prev,id] : [prev[1],id]);
const selected = MATERIALS.filter(m => compare.includes(m.id));
const PROPS = [{key:"density",label:"Density (g/cmÂ³)",unit:"g/cmÂ³"},{key:"tensile",label:"Tensile Strength",unit:"MPa"},{key:"cost",label:"Cost",unit:""},{key:"machinability",label:"Machinability",unit:""},{key:"weldable",label:"Weldable",unit:"",bool:true}];
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ§ª Build Material Selector</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Compare materials for robot construction. Click up to 3 to compare side-by-side.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:16}}>
      {MATERIALS.map(m=>(
        <button key={m.id} onClick={()=>toggleCompare(m.id)} style={{background:compare.includes(m.id)?m.color:"#fff",color:compare.includes(m.id)?"#fff":"#374151",border:"2px solid " + (compare.includes(m.id)?m.color:"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:10,padding:"8px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{m.icon} {m.name}</button>
      ))}
    </div>
    {selected.length > 0 && (
      <div>
        <div style={{overflowX:"auto"}}>
          <table style={{width:"100%",borderCollapse:"collapse",marginBottom:14}}>
            <thead><tr style={{background:"#f8fafc"}}>
              <th style={{padding:"10px 14px",textAlign:"left",fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",fontWeight:700,borderBottom:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>Property</th>
              {selected.map(m=><th key={m.id} style={{padding:"10px 14px",textAlign:"center",fontSize:13,fontWeight:800,borderBottom:"1px solid #e2e8f0",color:m.color}}>{m.icon} {m.name}</th>)}
            </tr></thead>
            <tbody>
              {PROPS.map(prop=>(
                <tr key={prop.key} style={{borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
                  <td style={{padding:"10px 14px",fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",fontWeight:600}}>{prop.label}</td>
                  {selected.map(m=><td key={m.id} style={{padding:"10px 14px",textAlign:"center",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>{prop.bool?(m[prop.key]?"âœ…":"âŒ"):(m[prop.key]) + (prop.unit?" "+prop.unit:"")}</td>)}
                </tr>
              ))}
              <tr><td style={{padding:"10px 14px",fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",fontWeight:600}}>Best For</td>
                {selected.map(m=><td key={m.id} style={{padding:"10px 14px",textAlign:"center"}}><div style={{display:"flex",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:4,justifyContent:"center"}}>{m.tags.map(t=><span key={t} style={{background:m.color+"15",color:m.color,borderRadius:4,padding:"2px 7px",fontSize:10,fontWeight:700}}>{t}</span>)}</div></td>)}
              </tr>
              <tr><td style={{padding:"10px 14px",fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",fontWeight:600}}>Notes</td>
                {selected.map(m=><td key={m.id} style={{padding:"10px 14px",textAlign:"center",fontSize:11,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.5}}>{m.notes}</td>)}
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <div style={{background:"#f0f9ff",borderRadius:10,padding:12,border:"1px solid #bae6fd",fontSize:12,color:"#0c4a6e"}}>ðŸ’¡ <strong>Rule of thumb:</strong> Start with 6061 aluminum for structure. Use polycarbonate for panels. Add Delrin/HDPE where parts slide. Only use carbon fiber or steel when aluminum can't do the job.</div>
      </div>
    )}
  </div>
);
}
