  driver1:[{id:"lx",label:"Left Stick X",icon:"â¬…ï¸âž¡ï¸"},{id:"ly",label:"Left Stick Y",icon:"â¬†ï¸â¬‡ï¸"},{id:"rx",label:"Right Stick X",icon:"â¬…ï¸âž¡ï¸"},{id:"ry",label:"Right Stick Y",icon:"â¬†ï¸â¬‡ï¸"},{id:"lt",label:"Left Trigger",icon:"ðŸ¤œ"},{id:"rt",label:"Right Trigger",icon:"ðŸ¤œ"},{id:"lb",label:"Left Bumper",icon:"â¬›"},{id:"rb",label:"Right Bumper",icon:"â¬›"},{id:"a",label:"A Button",icon:"ðŸŸ¢"},{id:"b",label:"B Button",icon:"ðŸ”´"},{id:"x",label:"X Button",icon:"ðŸ”µ"},{id:"y",label:"Y Button",icon:"ðŸŸ¡"},{id:"start",label:"Start",icon:"â–¶ï¸"},{id:"back",label:"Back/Select",icon:"â—€ï¸"},{id:"dpad_u",label:"D-Pad Up",icon:"ðŸ”¼"},{id:"dpad_d",label:"D-Pad Down",icon:"ðŸ”½"},{id:"dpad_l",label:"D-Pad Left",icon:"â—€ï¸"},{id:"dpad_r",label:"D-Pad Right",icon:"â–¶ï¸"}],
  driver2:[{id:"lx2",label:"Left Stick X",icon:"â¬…ï¸âž¡ï¸"},{id:"ly2",label:"Left Stick Y",icon:"â¬†ï¸â¬‡ï¸"},{id:"rx2",label:"Right Stick X",icon:"â¬…ï¸âž¡ï¸"},{id:"ry2",label:"Right Stick Y",icon:"â¬†ï¸â¬‡ï¸"},{id:"lt2",label:"Left Trigger",icon:"ðŸ¤œ"},{id:"rt2",label:"Right Trigger",icon:"ðŸ¤œ"},{id:"lb2",label:"Left Bumper",icon:"â¬›"},{id:"rb2",label:"Right Bumper",icon:"â¬›"},{id:"a2",label:"A Button",icon:"ðŸŸ¢"},{id:"b2",label:"B Button",icon:"ðŸ”´"},{id:"x2",label:"X Button",icon:"ðŸ”µ"},{id:"y2",label:"Y Button",icon:"ðŸŸ¡"},{id:"start2",label:"Start",icon:"â–¶ï¸"}]
};
const current = BUTTONS[driver]||[];
const filled = current.filter(b=>mappings[b.id]?.trim()).length;
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸŽ® Driver Controller Mapper</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Document every button binding. Share with your programmers and drive team.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:14}}>
      {[["driver1","ðŸ‘¤ Driver 1"],["driver2","ðŸ‘¤ Driver 2"]].map(([v,l])=>(
        <button key={v} onClick={()=>setDriver(v)} style={{background:driver===v?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:driver===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{l}</button>
      ))}
      <div style={{marginLeft:"auto",background:"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 14px",fontSize:13,color:"#059669",fontWeight:700}}>{filled}/{current.length} mapped</div>
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr))",gap:8,marginBottom:14}}>
      {current.map(btn=>(
        <div key={btn.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"1.5px solid " + (mappings[btn.id]?.trim()?"#86efac":"#e2e8f0"),display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <span style={{fontSize:18,flexShrink:0}}>{btn.icon}</span>
          <div style={{flex:1}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:3,fontWeight:600}}>{btn.label}</div>

          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>

  </div>
);
}


function ToolOprCalc() {
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState([{id:1,r1:"",r2:"",r3:"",b1:"",b2:"",b3:"",rs:"",bs:""}]);
const [results, setResults] = useState(null);
function addMatch(){ setMatches(p=>[...p,{id:Date.now(),r1:"",r2:"",r3:"",b1:"",b2:"",b3:"",rs:"",bs:""}]); }
function upd(id,k,v){ setMatches(p=>p.map(t=>t.id===id?{...t,[k]:v}:t)); }
function calculate(){
  const tm={};
  matches.forEach(m=>{
    const rs=parseInt(m.rs)||0,bs=parseInt(m.bs)||0;
    [m.r1,m.r2,m.r3].filter(Boolean).forEach(t=>{if(!tm[t])tm[t]={pts:0,g:0};tm[t].pts+=rs/3;tm[t].g++;});
    [m.b1,m.b2,m.b3].filter(Boolean).forEach(t=>{if(!tm[t])tm[t]={pts:0,g:0};tm[t].pts+=bs/3;tm[t].g++;});
  });
  const arr=Object.entries(tm).map(([team,d])=>({team,opr:Math.round(d.pts/d.g*10)/10,g:d.g})).sort((a,b)=>b.opr-a.opr);
  setResults(arr);
}
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ“Š OPR / Alliance Score Calculator</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Enter match results to estimate each team's Offensive Power Rating.</div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",overflow:"hidden",marginBottom:12}}>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"2fr 2fr 1fr 1fr",background:"#f8fafc",padding:"9px 14px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,color:"#6b7280",borderBottom:"1px solid #e2e8f0",textTransform:"uppercase"}}><span>ðŸ”´ Red Alliance</span><span>ðŸ”µ Blue Alliance</span><span>Red Score</span><span>Blue Score</span></div>
      {matches.map(m=>(
        <div key={m.id} style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"2fr 2fr 1fr 1fr",padding:"8px 14px",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",gap:6,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4}}>{["r1","r2","r3"].map(k=><input key={k} value={m[k]} onChange={e=>upd(m.id,k,e.target.value)} placeholder="T#" style={{width:50,padding:"5px 6px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #fecaca",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff7f7"}}/>)}</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4}}>{["b1","b2","b3"].map(k=><input key={k} value={m[k]} onChange={e=>upd(m.id,k,e.target.value)} placeholder="T#" style={{width:50,padding:"5px 6px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #bfdbfe",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#eff6ff"}}/>)}</div>
          <input value={m.rs} onChange={e=>upd(m.id,"rs",e.target.value)} type="number" placeholder="0" style={{padding:"6px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #fecaca",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff7f7"}}/>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,alignItems:"center"}}>
            <input value={m.bs} onChange={e=>upd(m.id,"bs",e.target.value)} type="number" placeholder="0" style={{flex:1,padding:"6px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #bfdbfe",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#eff6ff"}}/>
            {matches.length>1&&<button onClick={()=>setMatches(p=>p.filter(x=>x.id!==m.id))} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13}}>âœ•</button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
      <button onClick={addMatch} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+ Add Match</button>
      <button onClick={calculate} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"9px 22px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>ðŸ“Š Calculate OPR</button>
    </div>
    {results && (
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",overflow:"hidden"}}>
        <div style={{padding:"12px 16px",background:"linear-gradient(90deg,#1d4ed8,#7c3aed)",color:"#fff"}}><div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>OPR Rankings</div><div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.8}}>Estimated contribution per match</div></div>
        {results.map((r,i)=>(
          <div key={r.team} style={{display:"flex",gap:14,padding:"11px 16px",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9",alignItems:"center"}}>
            <div style={{width:28,height:28,borderRadius:8,background:i<3?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:i<3?"#fff":"#374151",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontWeight:900,fontSize:13,flexShrink:0}}>{i+1}</div>
            <div style={{flex:1,fontWeight:700,fontSize:14}}>Team {r.team}</div>
            <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18,color:i<3?"#1d4ed8":"#374151"}}>{r.opr}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{r.g} match{r.g!==1?"es":""}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div style={{padding:"10px 16px",fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",background:"#f8fafc"}}>âš ï¸ Simplified OPR. Use TBA or Statbotics for official values.</div>
      </div>
    )}
  </div>
);
}


function ToolPartsInv() {
  const [parts, setParts] = useState([]);
const [newName,setNewName]=useState(""); const [newQty,setNewQty]=useState(""); const [newMin,setNewMin]=useState("1");
const [newCat,setNewCat]=useState("mechanical"); const [newLoc,setNewLoc]=useState(""); const [newPN,setNewPN]=useState("");
const [search,setSearch]=useState(""); const [sortBy,setSortBy]=useState("name");
const CATS=[{id:"mechanical",l:"âš™ï¸ Mechanical",c:"#374151"},{id:"electronics",l:"âš¡ Electronics",c:"#d97706"},{id:"fasteners",l:"ðŸ”© Fasteners",c:"#6b7280"},{id:"raw",l:"ðŸªµ Raw Material",c:"#059669"},{id:"consumable",l:"ðŸ§´ Consumable",c:"#7c3aed"}];
function add(){ if(!newName.trim())return; setParts(x=>[...x,{id:Date.now(),name:newName,qty:parseInt(newQty)||0,min:parseInt(newMin)||1,cat:newCat,loc:newLoc,pn:newPN}]); setNewName("");setNewQty("");setNewLoc("");setNewPN(""); }
const filtered=parts.filter(p=>p.name.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())||p.pn.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()));
const sorted=[...filtered].sort((a,b)=>sortBy==="low"?(a.qty-a.min)-(b.qty-b.min):sortBy==="cat"?a.cat.localeCompare(b.cat):a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
const lowStock=parts.filter(p=>p.qty<=p.min).length;
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ§© Parts Inventory Tracker</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Track what's on hand, get low-stock alerts, and log part numbers and locations.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,marginBottom:14,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 16px",border:"2px solid #37415120",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,color:"#374151"}}>ðŸ“¦ {parts.length} Total</div>
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 16px",border:"2px solid #dc262620",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,color:"#dc2626"}}>âš ï¸ {lowStock} Low</div>
      <input value={search} onChange={e=>setSearch(e.target.value)} placeholder="ðŸ” Search..." style={{flex:1,minWidth:140,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <select value={sortBy} onChange={e=>setSortBy(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
        <option value="name">Name</option><option value="low">Low Stock First</option><option value="cat">Category</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:12}}>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:8,marginBottom:8}}>
        <input value={newName} onChange={e=>setNewName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Part name *" style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <input type="number" value={newQty} onChange={e=>setNewQty(e.target.value)} placeholder="Qty" style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <input type="number" value={newMin} onChange={e=>setNewMin(e.target.value)} placeholder="Min" style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <select value={newCat} onChange={e=>setNewCat(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>{CATS.map(c=><option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.l}</option>)}</select>
      </div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8}}>
        <input value={newPN} onChange={e=>setNewPN(e.target.value)} placeholder="Part # (optional)" style={{width:140,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <input value={newLoc} onChange={e=>setNewLoc(e.target.value)} placeholder="Location (e.g. Bin A3)" style={{flex:1,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <button onClick={add} style={{background:"#059669",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"7px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Add</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
      {sorted.map(p=>{ const cat=CATS.find(c=>c.id===p.cat)||CATS[0]; const isLow=p.qty<=p.min; return (
        <div key={p.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"1.5px solid " + (isLow?"#fca5a5":"#e2e8f0"),display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <div style={{flex:1}}><div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:isLow?"#dc2626":"#1e293b"}}>{p.name}{isLow&&" âš ï¸"}</div><div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{cat.l}{p.pn&&" Â· " + (p.pn)}{p.loc&&" Â· ðŸ“" + (p.loc)}</div></div>
          <button onClick={()=>setParts(x=>x.map(y=>y.id===p.id?{...y,qty:Math.max(0,y.qty-1)}:y))} style={{width:28,height:28,borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",background:"#f1f5f9",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>âˆ’</button>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,minWidth:32,textAlign:"center",color:isLow?"#dc2626":"#1e293b"}}>{p.qty}</div>
          <button onClick={()=>setParts(x=>x.map(y=>y.id===p.id?{...y,qty:y.qty+1}:y))} style={{width:28,height:28,borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #059669",background:"#059669",color:"#fff",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+</button>
          <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>min {p.min}</div>
          <button onClick={()=>setParts(x=>x.filter(y=>y.id!==p.id))} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13}}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
      );})}
      {sorted.length===0&&<div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No parts found. Add some above!</div>}
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolMaintLog() {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);
const [nd,setNd]=useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)); const [ns,setNs]=useState("drivetrain"); const [nt,setNt]=useState("inspection");
const [ndesc,setNdesc]=useState(""); const [ntech,setNtech]=useState(""); const [ntime,setNtime]=useState("");
const SUBSYSTEMS=["drivetrain","intake","shooter","climber","electronics","software","frame","sensors","pneumatics","other"];
const TYPES=[{id:"inspection",l:"ðŸ” Inspection",c:"#6b7280"},{id:"repair",l:"ðŸ”§ Repair",c:"#dc2626"},{id:"replacement",l:"ðŸ”„ Replacement",c:"#d97706"},{id:"tuning",l:"ðŸŽ›ï¸ Tuning",c:"#7c3aed"},{id:"upgrade",l:"â¬†ï¸ Upgrade",c:"#059669"}];
function add(){ if(!ndesc.trim())return; setLogs(x=>[{id:Date.now(),date:nd,subsystem:ns,type:nt,desc:ndesc,technician:ntech,timeMin:parseInt(ntime)||0},...x]); setNdesc("");setNtech("");setNtime(""); }
const totalTime=logs.reduce((s,l)=>s+(l.timeMin||0),0);
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ”§ Robot Maintenance Log</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Document every repair, inspection, and upgrade. Essential for troubleshooting patterns.</div>
    <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(3,1fr)",gap:8,marginBottom:14}}>
      {[["ðŸ“‹ " + (logs.length) + " Entries","#374151"],["ðŸ”§ " + (logs.filter(l=>l.type==="repair").length) + " Repairs","#dc2626"],["â±ï¸ " + (Math.round(totalTime/60)) + "h " + (totalTime%60) + "m","#1d4ed8"]].map(([l,c])=>(
        <div key={l} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"2px solid " + (c) + "20",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:c,textAlign:"center"}}>{l}</div>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:14}}>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:8,marginBottom:10}}>
        <input type="date" value={nd} onChange={e=>setNd(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <select value={ns} onChange={e=>setNs(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff",textTransform:"capitalize"}}>{SUBSYSTEMS.map(s=><option key={s}>{s}</option>)}</select>
        <select value={nt} onChange={e=>setNt(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>{TYPES.map(t=><option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.l}</option>)}</select>
      </div>
      <textarea value={ndesc} onChange={e=>setNdesc(e.target.value)} rows={2} placeholder="What was done? What caused the issue?" style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,resize:"vertical",boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",marginBottom:8}}/>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8}}>
        <input value={ntech} onChange={e=>setNtech(e.target.value)} placeholder="Technician(s)" style={{flex:1,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <input type="number" value={ntime} onChange={e=>setNtime(e.target.value)} placeholder="Time (min)" style={{width:100,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <button onClick={add} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Log</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
      {logs.map(e=>{ const t=TYPES.find(x=>x.id===e.type)||TYPES[0]; return (
        <div key={e.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 16px",border:"2px solid " + (t.c) + "20",display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"flex-start",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
          <div style={{flexShrink:0,textAlign:"center",minWidth:70}}><div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{e.date}</div><span style={{background:t.c+"15",color:t.c,borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 7px",fontSize:10,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block",marginTop:3}}>{t.l}</span></div>
          <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:150}}><div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:3,textTransform:"capitalize"}}>{e.subsystem}</div><div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#374151",lineHeight:1.5}}>{e.desc}</div>{e.technician&&<div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>ðŸ‘¤ {e.technician}</div>}</div>
          {e.timeMin>0&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",flexShrink:0}}>â±ï¸ {e.timeMin}min</div>}
          <button onClick={()=>setLogs(x=>x.filter(y=>y.id!==e.id))} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13}}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
      );})}
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolProtoTrack() {
  const [protos, setProtos] = useState([]);
const [active, setActive] = useState(null);
const [nn,setNn]=useState(""); const [ng,setNg]=useState("");
const STATUS=[{id:"idea",l:"ðŸ’¡ Idea",c:"#6b7280"},{id:"prototyping",l:"ðŸ”¨ Prototyping",c:"#d97706"},{id:"testing",l:"ðŸ§ª Testing",c:"#7c3aed"},{id:"refining",l:"ðŸ”„ Refining",c:"#1d4ed8"},{id:"done",l:"âœ… Final",c:"#059669"},{id:"cancelled",l:"âŒ Cancelled",c:"#dc2626"}];
const OUTCOMES=[{id:"unknown",l:"â“ TBD"},{id:"success",l:"âœ… Works"},{id:"partial",l:"âš ï¸ Partial"},{id:"fail",l:"âŒ Failed"}];
function addProto(){ if(!nn.trim())return; const p={id:Date.now(),name:nn,goal:ng,status:"prototyping",iterations:[{id:Date.now(),num:1,desc:"Initial concept",result:"",outcome:"unknown"}]}; setProtos(x=>[...x,p]); setActive(p); setNn("");setNg(""); }
function addIter(proto){ const iter={id:Date.now(),num:proto.iterations.length+1,desc:"",result:"",outcome:"unknown"}; const u={...proto,iterations:[...proto.iterations,iter]}; setProtos(x=>x.map(p=>p.id===proto.id?u:p)); setActive(u); }
function updIter(proto,iid,k,v){ const iters=proto.iterations.map(it=>it.id===iid?{...it,[k]:v}:it); const u={...proto,iterations:iters}; setProtos(x=>x.map(p=>p.id===proto.id?u:p)); setActive(u); }
if(active){ const s=STATUS.find(x=>x.id===active.status)||STATUS[0]; return (
  <div>
    <button onClick={()=>setActive(null)} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit",marginBottom:14}}>â† Back</button>
    <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:14,flexWrap:"wrap",gap:10}}>
      <div><div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18}}>{active.name}</div>{active.goal&&<div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:2}}>Goal: {active.goal}</div>}</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        {STATUS.map(st=><button key={st.id} onClick={()=>{const u=protos.map(p=>p.id===active.id?{...p,status:st.id}:p);setProtos(u);setActive({...active,status:st.id});}} style={{background:active.status===st.id?st.c:"#f1f5f9",color:active.status===st.id?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"5px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{st.l}</button>)}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:10}}>ðŸ”„ Iterations ({active.iterations.length})</div>
    {active.iterations.map(iter=>(
      <div key={iter.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:8}}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,marginBottom:8,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <div style={{width:28,height:28,borderRadius:7,background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontWeight:900,fontSize:13,flexShrink:0}}>v{iter.num}</div>
          <input value={iter.desc} onChange={e=>updIter(active,iter.id,"desc",e.target.value)} placeholder="What was changed?" style={{flex:1,padding:"6px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
          <select value={iter.outcome} onChange={e=>updIter(active,iter.id,"outcome",e.target.value)} style={{padding:"6px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>{OUTCOMES.map(o=><option key={o.id} value={o.id}>{o.l}</option>)}</select>
        </div>
        <input value={iter.result} onChange={e=>updIter(active,iter.id,"result",e.target.value)} placeholder="Results observed..." style={{width:"100%",padding:"6px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",boxSizing:"border-box"}}/>
      </div>
    ))}
    <button onClick={()=>addIter(active)} style={{background:"#7c3aed",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+ Add Iteration</button>
  </div>
);}
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ—ï¸ Prototype Tracker</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Log design iterations. Track what worked, what didn't, and why.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:14}}>
      <input value={nn} onChange={e=>setNn(e.target.value)} placeholder="Prototype name" style={{flex:1,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <input value={ng} onChange={e=>setNg(e.target.value)} placeholder="Goal" style={{flex:2,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <button onClick={addProto} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Start</button>
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
      {protos.map(p=>{ const s=STATUS.find(x=>x.id===p.status)||STATUS[0]; return (
        <div key={p.id} onClick={()=>setActive(p)} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:16,border:"2px solid " + (s.c) + "30",cursor:"pointer"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14,marginBottom:4}}>{p.name}</div>
          {p.goal&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:8}}>{p.goal}</div>}
          <span style={{background:s.c+"15",color:s.c,borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 8px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700}}>{s.l}</span>
          <span style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginLeft:8}}>{p.iterations.length} iter.</span>
        </div>
      );})}
      {protos.length===0&&<div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af",gridColumn:"1/-1"}}>No prototypes yet. Start documenting your design process!</div>}
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolInterviewPrep() {
  const [award,setAward]=useState("chairmans"); const [answers,setAnswers]=useState({}); const [practicing,setPracticing]=useState(null);
const [timer,setTimer]=useState(0); const [running,setRunning]=useState(false); const timerRef=useRef(null);
useEffect(()=>{ if(running){ timerRef.current=setInterval(()=>setTimer(t=>t+1),1000); } return ()=>clearInterval(timerRef.current); },[running]);
const AWARDS_AWARDS1={
  chairmans:{name:"Chairman's Award",tl:60,qs:["Describe your team's most impactful outreach activity this year.","How has your team inspired others to embrace STEM?","What makes your team's approach to FIRST's mission unique?","Give an example of a lasting community impact your team has created.","How do your team's alumni continue contributing to STEM and FIRST?","What partnerships has your team built, and how sustainable are they?","If your team could only keep one outreach program, what would it be and why?"]},
  engineering:{name:"Engineering Inspiration",tl:45,qs:["Walk us through your robot's key design decisions.","What was the biggest engineering challenge and how did you solve it?","Describe your design process from kickoff to competition.","What did you prototype, and what did you learn from failures?","How did you use iteration and testing to improve the robot?"]},
  entrepreneur:{name:"Entrepreneurship",tl:45,qs:["Describe your team's business plan for sustainable funding.","How does your team market itself to potential sponsors?","What makes your team's branding professional and consistent?","How do you track and demonstrate ROI for sponsors?"]},
  impact:{name:"Impact Award (FTC)",tl:60,qs:["What is your team's most significant community contribution?","How have you spread the FIRST message beyond your community?","Describe a partnership that grew from your outreach.","What is the legacy your team is building?"]},
};
const qa=AWARDS_AWARDS1[award];
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ“‹ Award Interview Prep</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Practice answering award interview questions with a timer.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:16}}>
      {Object.entries(AWARDS_AWARDS1).map(([id,a])=>(
        <button key={id} onClick={()=>{setAward(id);setPracticing(null);setRunning(false);setTimer(0);}} style={{background:award===id?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:award===id?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{a.name}</button>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#f0f9ff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",marginBottom:14,fontSize:13,color:"#0c4a6e",border:"1px solid #bae6fd"}}>â±ï¸ <strong>{qa.name}</strong> â€” aim for <strong>{qa.tl}â€“{qa.tl+30}s</strong> answers. Judges will cut you off if you run over.</div>
    {practicing!==null ? (
      <div>
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:20,border:"2px solid #1d4ed8",marginBottom:14}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12,color:"#1d4ed8"}}>{qa.qs[practicing]}</div>
          <div style={{background:"#0f172a",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 18px",color:"#fff",textAlign:"center",marginBottom:14}}>
            <div style={{fontFamily:"monospace",fontSize:36,fontWeight:900,color:timer>qa.tl?"#ef4444":"#60a5fa"}}>{Math.floor(timer/60)}:{String(timer%60).padStart(2,"0")}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.6}}>Target: {qa.tl}s</div>
          </div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:14}}>
            <button onClick={()=>setRunning(r=>!r)} style={{flex:1,background:running?"#dc2626":"#059669",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{running?"â¸ Pause":"â–¶ Start"}</button>
            <button onClick={()=>{setTimer(0);setRunning(false);}} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Reset</button>
          </div>
          <textarea value={answers[award+qa.qs[practicing]]||""} onChange={e=>setAnswers(x=>({...x,[award+qa.qs[practicing]]:e.target.value}))} rows={5} placeholder="Type your prepared answer here..." style={{width:"100%",padding:"10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,resize:"vertical",boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        </div>
        <button onClick={()=>{setPracticing(null);setRunning(false);setTimer(0);}} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>â† All Questions</button>
      </div>
    ) : (
      <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
        {qa.qs.map((q,i)=>{ const saved=answers[award+q]; return (
          <div key={i} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"2px solid " + (saved?"#86efac":"#e2e8f0")}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:8}}>{q}</div>
            {saved&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#166534",background:"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:7,padding:"8px 10px",marginBottom:8}}>{saved.slice(0,150)}{saved.length>150?"...":""}</div>}
            <button onClick={()=>{setPracticing(i);setTimer(0);setRunning(false);}} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{saved?"âœï¸ Edit & Practice":"â–¶ Practice"}</button>
          </div>
        );})}
      </div>
    )}
  </div>
);
}


function ToolRevealPlan() {
  const [shots,setShots]=useState([]); const [title,setTitle]=useState(""); const [theme,setTheme]=useState(""); const [music,setMusic]=useState("");
const [ns,setNs]=useState(""); const [nd,setNd]=useState("5"); const [nt,setNt]=useState("broll");
const SHOT_TYPES=[{id:"intro",l:"ðŸŽ¬ Intro",c:"#1d4ed8"},{id:"broll",l:"ðŸŽ¥ B-Roll",c:"#7c3aed"},{id:"mechanism",l:"âš™ï¸ Mechanism",c:"#059669"},{id:"action",l:"ðŸŽ¯ Action",c:"#dc2626"},{id:"team",l:"ðŸ‘¥ Team Shot",c:"#d97706"},{id:"outro",l:"ðŸ Outro",c:"#374151"}];
function add(){ if(!ns.trim())return; setShots(x=>[...x,{id:Date.now(),desc:ns,dur:parseInt(nd)||5,type:nt,done:false}]); setNs("");setNd("5"); }
const totalSec=shots.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.dur,0);
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸŽ¬ Robot Reveal Video Planner</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Plan every shot of your robot reveal. Great reveals drive sponsor interest and team pride.</div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:14}}>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:8}}>
        {[["Video Title",title,setTitle],["Theme/Concept",theme,setTheme],["Background Music",music,setMusic]].map(([l,v,set])=>(
          <div key={l}><div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>{l}</div><input value={v} onChange={e=>set(e.target.value)} placeholder={l} style={{width:"100%",padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#0f172a",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 18px",color:"#fff",marginBottom:14,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
      <div><div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,opacity:0.7}}>Runtime</div><div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:28}}>{Math.floor(totalSec/60)}:{String(totalSec%60).padStart(2,"0")}</div></div>
      <div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.7,textAlign:"right"}}>{shots.length} shots<br/>{totalSec<60?"âš ï¸ Too short":totalSec>180?"âš ï¸ May be long":"âœ… Good length"}</div>
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:14,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
      <input value={ns} onChange={e=>setNs(e.target.value)} placeholder="Shot description..." style={{flex:1,minWidth:200,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <select value={nt} onChange={e=>setNt(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>{SHOT_TYPES.map(t=><option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.l}</option>)}</select>
      <input type="number" value={nd} onChange={e=>setNd(e.target.value)} placeholder="Sec" style={{width:60,padding:"8px 8px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <button onClick={add} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+ Shot</button>
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
      {shots.map((shot,i)=>{ const t=SHOT_TYPES.find(x=>x.id===shot.type)||SHOT_TYPES[1]; return (
        <div key={shot.id} style={{background:shot.done?"#f0fdf4":"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"1.5px solid " + (shot.done?"#86efac":t.c+"30"),display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <div style={{width:24,height:24,borderRadius:6,background:t.c,color:"#fff",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:11,fontWeight:900,flexShrink:0}}>{i+1}</div>
          <div style={{flex:1}}><span style={{background:t.c+"15",color:t.c,borderRadius:4,padding:"1px 6px",fontSize:10,fontWeight:700,marginRight:7}}>{t.l}</span><span style={{fontSize:13}}>{shot.desc}</span></div>
          <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{shot.dur}s</div>
          <button onClick={()=>setShots(x=>x.map(y=>y.id===shot.id?{...y,done:!y.done}:y))} style={{background:shot.done?"#059669":"#f1f5f9",color:shot.done?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"5px 9px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{shot.done?"âœ“ Filmed":"Film"}</button>
          <button onClick={()=>setShots(x=>x.filter(y=>y.id!==shot.id))} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13}}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
      );})}
      {shots.length===0&&<div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No shots planned yet. Start with an intro and a few mechanism highlights!</div>}
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolPracticeLog() {
  const [sessions,setSessions]=useState([]); const [nd,setNd]=useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10));
const [nf,setNf]=useState("full_robot"); const [nsc,setNsc]=useState(""); const [ncy,setNcy]=useState(""); const [nhi,setNhi]=useState(""); const [nis,setNis]=useState("");
const FOCUS=[{id:"full_robot",l:"ðŸ¤– Full Robot"},{id:"auto",l:"ðŸŽ¯ Autonomous"},{id:"teleop",l:"ðŸ•¹ï¸ TeleOp"},{id:"endgame",l:"ðŸ§— Endgame"},{id:"defense",l:"ðŸ›¡ï¸ Defense"},{id:"drive_team",l:"ðŸŽ® Drive Team"}];
function add(){ setSessions(x=>[{id:Date.now(),date:nd,focus:nf,score:parseInt(nsc)||0,cycles:parseInt(ncy)||0,highlights:nhi,issues:nis},...x]); setNsc("");setNcy("");setNhi("");setNis(""); }
const avgScore=sessions.length?Math.round(sessions.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.score,0)/sessions.length):0;
const avgCycles=sessions.length?Math.round(sessions.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.cycles,0)/sessions.length*10)/10:0;
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ‹ï¸ Practice Match Log</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Log every practice session to track improvement over time.</div>
    <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(3,1fr)",gap:8,marginBottom:14}}>
      {[["ðŸ“‹ " + (sessions.length) + " Sessions","#374151"],["ðŸ“Š Avg " + (avgScore) + " pts","#1d4ed8"],["ðŸ”„ Avg " + (avgCycles) + " cycles","#059669"]].map(([l,c])=>(
        <div key={l} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"2px solid " + (c) + "20",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:c,textAlign:"center"}}>{l}</div>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:14}}>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:8,marginBottom:8}}>
        <input type="date" value={nd} onChange={e=>setNd(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <select value={nf} onChange={e=>setNf(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>{FOCUS.map(f=><option key={f.id} value={f.id}>{f.l}</option>)}</select>
        <input type="number" value={nsc} onChange={e=>setNsc(e.target.value)} placeholder="Score (pts)" style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <input type="number" value={ncy} onChange={e=>setNcy(e.target.value)} placeholder="# Cycles" style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      </div>
      <textarea value={nhi} onChange={e=>setNhi(e.target.value)} rows={1} placeholder="What went well? âœ…" style={{width:"100%",padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,resize:"none",boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",marginBottom:5}}/>
      <textarea value={nis} onChange={e=>setNis(e.target.value)} rows={1} placeholder="What needs work? âš ï¸" style={{width:"100%",padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,resize:"none",boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",marginBottom:8}}/>
      <button onClick={add} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 20px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>ðŸ“ Log Session</button>
    </div>
    {sessions.length>0&&<div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
      {sessions.map(s=>{ const f=FOCUS.find(x=>x.id===s.focus)||FOCUS[0]; return (
        <div key={s.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 16px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"flex-start",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
          <div style={{flexShrink:0}}><div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{s.date}</div><div style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,color:"#7c3aed"}}>{f.l}</div></div>
          <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:150}}>{s.highlights&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#166534",marginBottom:3}}>âœ… {s.highlights}</div>}{s.issues&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#92400e"}}>âš ï¸ {s.issues}</div>}</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,fontSize:13,fontWeight:700}}>{s.score>0&&<span style={{color:"#1d4ed8"}}>ðŸ“Š {s.score}pts</span>}{s.cycles>0&&<span style={{color:"#059669"}}>ðŸ”„ {s.cycles}</span>}</div>
          <button onClick={()=>setSessions(x=>x.filter(y=>y.id!==s.id))} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13}}>âœ•</button>
        </div>
      );})}
    </div>}
  </div>
);
}


function ToolAllianceComm() {
  const [activeCard,setActiveCard]=useState(null); const [cc,setCc]=useState([]); const [nt,setNt]=useState(""); const [nb,setNb]=useState(""); const [ne,setNe]=useState("ðŸ“‹"); const [nc,setNc]=useState("#1d4ed8");
const CARDS=[
  {cat:"Roles",title:"We'll Play Defense",emoji:"ðŸ›¡ï¸",body:"We will focus on defense this match. Confirm who scores and who assists.",color:"#dc2626"},
  {cat:"Roles",title:"You Play Defense",emoji:"ðŸ™‹",body:"Please dedicate your robot to defense. We will handle scoring.",color:"#d97706"},
  {cat:"Auto",title:"Stay on Our Side",emoji:"ðŸŽ¯",body:"We have a 4-piece center auto. Do NOT cross center line during auto.",color:"#1d4ed8"},
  {cat:"Auto",title:"Go to Far Side",emoji:"â†”ï¸",body:"Please take the far side. We are taking center and amp side.",color:"#7c3aed"},
  {cat:"Strategy",title:"Prioritize Amp",emoji:"ðŸ”Š",body:"Focus on cycling amp â€” we need amplifier activated frequently.",color:"#059669"},
  {cat:"Strategy",title:"Focus High Goal",emoji:"ðŸŽ¯",body:"Shoot everything in speaker â€” ignore amp this match.",color:"#1d4ed8"},
  {cat:"Endgame",title:"We Take Center Chain",emoji:"ðŸ§—",body:"We climb center chain. You take edge chains. Coordinate timing.",color:"#374151"},
  {cat:"Issues",title:"Robot is Injured",emoji:"âš ï¸",body:"Our robot has limited capability today. Adjust strategy accordingly.",color:"#dc2626"},
];
const allCards=[...CARDS,...cc];
const grouped=allCards.reduce((acc,c)=>{acc[c.cat]=acc[c.cat]||[];acc[c.cat].push(c);return acc;},{});
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ—£ï¸ Alliance Communication Cards</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Quick strategy cards for pre-match alliance meetings. Show partners directly on screen.</div>
    {activeCard&&<div onClick={()=>setActiveCard(null)} style={{background:activeCard.color,borderRadius:16,padding:32,textAlign:"center",marginBottom:16,cursor:"pointer",boxShadow:"0 8px 30px " + (activeCard.color) + "60"}}>
      <div style={{fontSize:64,marginBottom:12}}>{activeCard.emoji}</div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:28,color:"#fff",marginBottom:12}}>{activeCard.title}</div>
      <div style={{fontSize:16,color:"rgba(255,255,255,0.9)",lineHeight:1.6}}>{activeCard.body}</div>
      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"rgba(255,255,255,0.6)",marginTop:20}}>Tap to dismiss</div>
    </div>}
    {Object.entries(grouped).map(([cat,cards])=>(
      <div key={cat} style={{marginBottom:14}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:1,marginBottom:8}}>{cat}</div>
        <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr))",gap:8}}>
          {cards.map((card,i)=>(
            <button key={i} onClick={()=>setActiveCard(card)} style={{background:"#fff",border:"2px solid " + (card.color) + "30",borderRadius:12,padding:"14px 16px",cursor:"pointer",textAlign:"left",fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:20,marginBottom:6}}>{card.emoji}</div>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:card.color,marginBottom:4}}>{card.title}</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#6b7280",lineHeight:1.4}}>{card.body.slice(0,70)}...</div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    ))}
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}>+ Custom Card</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:8}}>
        <input value={ne} onChange={e=>setNe(e.target.value)} style={{width:46,padding:"7px 6px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:20,textAlign:"center",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <input value={nt} onChange={e=>setNt(e.target.value)} placeholder="Card title" style={{flex:1,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <input type="color" value={nc} onChange={e=>setNc(e.target.value)} style={{width:40,height:38,border:"none",cursor:"pointer",borderRadius:7,padding:2}}/>
      </div>
      <textarea value={nb} onChange={e=>setNb(e.target.value)} rows={2} placeholder="Card message..." style={{width:"100%",padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,resize:"none",boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",marginBottom:8}}/>
      <button onClick={()=>{if(!nt.trim())return;setCc(x=>[...x,{cat:"Custom",title:nt,body:nb,emoji:ne,color:nc}]);setNt("");setNb("");setNe("ðŸ“‹");}} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Save Card</button>
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolPreMatchChk() {
  const CHECKLIST={"30 Min Before":[{id:"pm1",text:"Robot fully charged and battery connected"},{id:"pm2",text:"Correct auto mode selected on dashboard"},{id:"pm3",text:"All bumpers installed and legal (correct color, tight)"},{id:"pm4",text:"Robot weight within limit (FRC: 125 lbs)"},{id:"pm5",text:"All access panels closed and secured"},{id:"pm6",text:"Robot passed inspection (verify wristband/sticker)"}],"Queuing Line":[{id:"pm7",text:"Driver station laptop connected and DS communicating"},{id:"pm8",text:"Controller battery checked / controllers paired"},{id:"pm9",text:"Camera feeds working (if applicable)"},{id:"pm10",text:"Auto mode verified with drive coach â€” correct for this alliance"},{id:"pm11",text:"Alliance strategy communicated with all 3 teams"},{id:"pm12",text:"Starting position marked and confirmed with Field Rep"}],"Field Entry":[{id:"pm13",text:"Robot enabled briefly at field entrance to test comms"},{id:"pm14",text:"All team members behind the alliance wall"},{id:"pm15",text:"Robot disabled â€” waiting for field reset signal"},{id:"pm16",text:"Drive team knows their assigned role for this match"}],"Match Start":[{id:"pm17",text:"Watch for field green light â€” DO NOT enable early"},{id:"pm18",text:"Auto path clear of other robots in start zone"},{id:"pm19",text:"Safety glasses on for all team members on field"}]};
const [checked,setChecked]=useState({}); const [matchNum,setMatchNum]=useState("");
const totalItems=Object.values(CHECKLIST).reduce((s,a)=>s+a.length,0);
const checkedCount=Object.values(checked).filter(Boolean).length;
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>âœ… Pre-Match Checklist</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Run through this before every match. Never skip â€” one missed item can cost you the match.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:14,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
      <div style={{flex:1}}><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:3}}>Match Number</div><input value={matchNum} onChange={e=>setMatchNum(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Qual 7" style={{padding:"7px 12px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit",width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box"}}/></div>
      <div style={{background:checkedCount===totalItems?"#059669":checkedCount>totalItems/2?"#d97706":"#dc2626",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 20px",color:"#fff",textAlign:"center",flexShrink:0}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22}}>{checkedCount}/{totalItems}</div>
        <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.8}}>{checkedCount===totalItems?"READY!":"checks done"}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:10,height:8,marginBottom:16,overflow:"hidden"}}><div style={{width:(checkedCount/totalItems*100) + "%",height:"100%",background:checkedCount===totalItems?"#059669":"#1d4ed8",transition:"width 0.3s",borderRadius:10}}/></div>
    {Object.entries(CHECKLIST).map(([section,items])=>{
      const sc=items.filter(i=>checked[i.id]).length;
      return (<div key={section} style={{marginBottom:16}}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:8}}><div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:13,color:"#374151"}}>{section}</div><div style={{fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,color:sc===items.length?"#059669":"#9ca3af"}}>{sc}/{items.length}</div></div>
        {items.map(item=>(
          <div key={item.id} onClick={()=>setChecked(p=>({...p,[item.id]:!p[item.id]}))} style={{background:checked[item.id]?"#f0fdf4":"#fff",borderRadius:9,padding:"10px 14px",marginBottom:6,cursor:"pointer",display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",border:"1.5px solid " + (checked[item.id]?"#86efac":"#e2e8f0")}}>
            <div style={{width:20,height:20,borderRadius:5,border:"2px solid " + (checked[item.id]?"#16a34a":"#d1d5db"),background:checked[item.id]?"#16a34a":"#fff",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",color:"#fff",fontWeight:900,fontSize:12,flexShrink:0}}>{checked[item.id]&&"âœ“"}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:13,color:checked[item.id]?"#166534":"#374151",fontWeight:checked[item.id]?600:400}}>{item.text}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>);
    })}
    <button onClick={()=>setChecked({})} style={{background:"#fee2e2",color:"#991b1b",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 20px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>ðŸ”„ Reset for Next Match</button>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolBatteryLog() {
  const [batteries,setBatteries]=useState([]); const [nl,setNl]=useState(""); const [ncap,setNcap]=useState("18"); const [sel,setSel]=useState(null);
const [cv,setCv]=useState(""); const [cs,setCs]=useState("good"); const [cn,setCn]=useState("");
const STATUSES_STATUSES1=[{id:"good",l:"âœ… Good",c:"#059669"},{id:"low",l:"âš ï¸ Low",c:"#d97706"},{id:"puffed",l:"ðŸ›‘ Puffed",c:"#dc2626"},{id:"dead",l:"ðŸ’€ Dead",c:"#374151"}];
function addBat(){ if(!nl.trim())return; setBatteries(x=>[...x,{id:Date.now(),label:nl,capacity:parseFloat(ncap)||18,cycles:[]}]); setNl(""); }
function addCycle(bid){ const cycle={id:Date.now(),voltage:parseFloat(cv)||0,status:cs,notes:cn,date:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}; setBatteries(x=>x.map(b=>{ if(b.id!==bid)return b; const u={...b,cycles:[cycle,...b.cycles]}; setSel(u); return u; })); setCv("");setCn(""); }
if(sel){ const bat=batteries.find(b=>b.id===sel.id)||sel; const avgV=bat.cycles.length?Math.round(bat.cycles.reduce((s,c)=>s+c.voltage,0)/bat.cycles.length*100)/100:0; return (
  <div>
    <button onClick={()=>setSel(null)} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit",marginBottom:12}}>â† All Batteries</button>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ”‹ {bat.label}</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>{bat.cycles.length} cycles Â· Avg {avgV}V Â· {bat.capacity}Ah</div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:12}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}>Log Cycle</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        <input type="number" step="0.01" value={cv} onChange={e=>setCv(e.target.value)} placeholder="Resting voltage (V)" style={{width:150,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>{STATUSES_STATUSES1.map(s=><button key={s.id} onClick={()=>setCs(s.id)} style={{background:cs===s.id?s.c:"#f1f5f9",color:cs===s.id?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{s.l}</button>)}</div>
        <input value={cn} onChange={e=>setCn(e.target.value)} placeholder="Notes..." style={{flex:1,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <button onClick={()=>addCycle(bat.id)} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Log</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
      {bat.cycles.map(c=>{ const s=STATUSES_STATUSES1.find(x=>x.id===c.status)||STATUSES_STATUSES1[0]; const vc=c.voltage>=12.6?"#059669":c.voltage>=12.0?"#d97706":"#dc2626"; return (
        <div key={c.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"1.5px solid " + (s.c) + "30",display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,color:vc,minWidth:55,fontFamily:"monospace"}}>{c.voltage}V</div>
          <span style={{background:s.c+"15",color:s.c,borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 8px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700}}>{s.l}</span>
          <div style={{flex:1,fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{c.notes}</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{c.date}</div>
        </div>
      );})}
    </div>
  </div>
);}
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ”‹ Battery Health Log</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Track each battery's voltage and cycle history. Know which to trust at competition.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:14}}>
      <input value={nl} onChange={e=>setNl(e.target.value)} placeholder="Battery label (e.g. BAT-01)" style={{flex:1,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <input type="number" value={ncap} onChange={e=>setNcap(e.target.value)} placeholder="Capacity (Ah)" style={{width:110,padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <button onClick={addBat} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Add</button>
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
      {batteries.map(bat=>{ const latest=bat.cycles[0]; const s=latest?STATUSES_STATUSES1.find(x=>x.id===latest.status)||STATUSES_STATUSES1[0]:null; const vc=latest?(latest.voltage>=12.6?"#059669":latest.voltage>=12.0?"#d97706":"#dc2626"):"#9ca3af"; return (
        <div key={bat.id} onClick={()=>setSel(bat)} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:16,border:"2px solid " + (s?s.c+"30":"#e2e8f0"),cursor:"pointer"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:4}}>{bat.label}</div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:28,color:vc,fontFamily:"monospace"}}>{latest?(latest.voltage) + "V":"--"}</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:4}}>{bat.cycles.length} cycles Â· {bat.capacity}Ah</div>
          {s&&<span style={{background:s.c+"15",color:s.c,borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 8px",fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,display:"inline-block",marginTop:6}}>{s.l}</span>}
        </div>
      );})}
      {batteries.length===0&&<div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af",gridColumn:"1/-1"}}>No batteries tracked. Add your first one!</div>}
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolTeamGoals() {
  const [goals,setGoals]=useState([]); const [ng,setNg]=useState(""); const [nc,setNc]=useState("competition"); const [ntgt,setNtgt]=useState(""); const [nby,setNby]=useState("");
const GCATS=[{id:"competition",l:"ðŸ† Competition",c:"#dc2626"},{id:"robot",l:"ðŸ¤– Robot",c:"#1d4ed8"},{id:"team",l:"ðŸ‘¥ Team",c:"#059669"},{id:"outreach",l:"ðŸŒ Outreach",c:"#7c3aed"},{id:"award",l:"ðŸ¥‡ Award",c:"#d97706"},{id:"business",l:"ðŸ’¼ Business",c:"#374151"}];
function add(){ if(!ng.trim())return; setGoals(x=>[...x,{id:Date.now(),goal:ng,cat:nc,target:ntgt,by:nby,progress:0,done:false}]); setNg("");setNtgt("");setNby(""); }
const done=goals.filter(g=>g.done).length;
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ† Season Goals Tracker</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Set and track measurable goals for the season.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:14}}>
      <div style={{flex:1,background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:10,height:10,overflow:"hidden"}}><div style={{width:goals.length?(done/goals.length*100) + "%":"0%",height:"100%",background:"#059669",transition:"width 0.4s",borderRadius:10}}/></div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:"#059669",flexShrink:0}}>{done}/{goals.length} met</div>
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:14}}>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:8}}>
        <input value={ng} onChange={e=>setNg(e.target.value)} placeholder="Goal description *" style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <select value={nc} onChange={e=>setNc(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>{GCATS.map(c=><option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.l}</option>)}</select>
        <input value={ntgt} onChange={e=>setNtgt(e.target.value)} placeholder="Target/Metric" style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}><input type="date" value={nby} onChange={e=>setNby(e.target.value)} style={{flex:1,padding:"7px 8px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/><button onClick={add} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Add</button></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    {GCATS.map(cat=>{ const cg=goals.filter(g=>g.cat===cat.id); if(!cg.length)return null; return (
      <div key={cat.id} style={{marginBottom:14}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:cat.c,marginBottom:8}}>{cat.l} Â· {cg.filter(g=>g.done).length}/{cg.length} done</div>
        {cg.map(g=>(
          <div key={g.id} style={{background:g.done?"#f0fdf4":"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"1.5px solid " + (g.done?"#86efac":cat.c+"30"),marginBottom:6,display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center"}}>
            <button onClick={()=>setGoals(x=>x.map(y=>y.id===g.id?{...y,done:!y.done}:y))} style={{width:22,height:22,borderRadius:6,border:"2px solid " + (g.done?"#16a34a":"#d1d5db"),background:g.done?"#16a34a":"#fff",cursor:"pointer",flexShrink:0,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",color:"#fff",fontWeight:900,fontSize:12}}>{g.done&&"âœ“"}</button>
            <div style={{flex:1}}><div style={{fontSize:13,fontWeight:g.done?600:400,color:g.done?"#166534":"#1e293b",textDecoration:g.done?"line-through":"none"}}>{g.goal}</div>{(g.target||g.by)&&<div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>{g.target&&"Target: " + (g.target)}{g.target&&g.by&&" Â· "}{g.by&&"By " + (g.by)}</div>}</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,alignItems:"center"}}><input type="range" min="0" max="100" value={g.progress} onChange={e=>setGoals(x=>x.map(y=>y.id===g.id?{...y,progress:parseInt(e.target.value)}:y))} style={{width:70,accentColor:cat.c}}/><span style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",minWidth:28}}>{g.progress}%</span></div>
            <button onClick={()=>setGoals(x=>x.filter(y=>y.id!==g.id))} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13}}>âœ•</button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    );})}
  </div>
);
}


function ToolNotesBoard() {
  const [notes,setNotes]=useState([]); const [nt,setNt]=useState(""); const [nc,setNc]=useState("#fef08a"); const [na,setNa]=useState("");
const COLORS_COLORS2=["#fef08a","#bfdbfe","#bbf7d0","#fecaca","#e9d5ff","#fed7aa","#f1f5f9"];
function add(){ if(!nt.trim())return; setNotes(x=>[{id:Date.now(),text:nt,color:nc,author:na,ts:Date.now(),pinned:false},...x]); setNt(""); }
const sorted=[...notes].sort((a,b)=>(b.pinned-a.pinned)||(b.ts-a.ts));
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ“Œ Team Notes Board</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Quick sticky notes for the whole team. Great for pit announcements and reminders.</div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:14}}>
      <textarea value={nt} onChange={e=>setNt(e.target.value)} rows={2} placeholder="Write a note for the team..." style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,resize:"none",boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",marginBottom:10}}/>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,alignItems:"center",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:5}}>{COLORS_COLORS2.map(c=><button key={c} onClick={()=>setNc(c)} style={{width:22,height:22,borderRadius:"50%",background:c,border:nc===c?"2px solid #374151":"2px solid transparent",cursor:"pointer",padding:0}}/>)}</div>
        <input value={na} onChange={e=>setNa(e.target.value)} placeholder="Your name (optional)" style={{flex:1,padding:"6px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <button onClick={add} style={{background:"#374151",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+ Post Note</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style={{columns:"2 280px",gap:12}}>
      {sorted.map(note=>(
        <div key={note.id} style={{background:note.color,borderRadius:12,padding:16,breakInside:"avoid",marginBottom:12,boxShadow:"0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",position:"relative"}}>
          {note.pinned&&<div style={{position:"absolute",top:8,left:-4,background:"#dc2626",color:"#fff",fontSize:10,fontWeight:700,padding:"2px 8px 2px 12px",borderRadius:"0 6px 6px 0"}}>ðŸ“Œ PINNED</div>}
          <div style={{fontSize:14,color:"#1e293b",lineHeight:1.6,marginTop:note.pinned?12:0,marginBottom:10,whiteSpace:"pre-wrap"}}>{note.text}</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"rgba(0,0,0,0.5)"}}>{note.author&&"â€” " + (note.author) + " Â· "}{new Date(note.ts).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:5}}>
              <button onClick={()=>setNotes(x=>x.map(n=>n.id===note.id?{...n,pinned:!n.pinned}:n))} style={{background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",border:"none",borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{note.pinned?"Unpin":"ðŸ“Œ"}</button>
              <button onClick={()=>setNotes(x=>x.filter(n=>n.id!==note.id))} style={{background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.08)",border:"none",borderRadius:5,padding:"3px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>âœ•</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
      {notes.length===0&&<div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:30,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No notes yet. Post the first one!</div>}
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolTimerBank() {
  const [timers,setTimers]=useState([{id:1,name:"Match Timer",seconds:150,remaining:150,running:false,color:"#dc2626"},{id:2,name:"Auto Period",seconds:15,remaining:15,running:false,color:"#1d4ed8"},{id:3,name:"Endgame",seconds:30,remaining:30,running:false,color:"#d97706"},{id:4,name:"Build Session",seconds:3600,remaining:3600,running:false,color:"#059669"}]);
const [nn,setNn]=useState(""); const [nm,setNm]=useState("5"); const [nc,setNc]=useState("#7c3aed");
const refs=useRef({});
function tick(id){ setTimers(prev=>prev.map(t=>{ if(t.id!==id||!t.running)return t; const r=Math.max(0,t.remaining-1); if(r===0){clearInterval(refs.current[id]);return{...t,running:false,remaining:0};} return{...t,remaining:r}; })); }
function toggle(id){ setTimers(prev=>prev.map(t=>{ if(t.id!==id)return t; if(t.running){clearInterval(refs.current[id]);return{...t,running:false};} else{refs.current[id]=setInterval(()=>tick(id),1000);return{...t,running:true};} })); }
function reset(id){ clearInterval(refs.current[id]); setTimers(prev=>prev.map(t=>t.id===id?{...t,remaining:t.seconds,running:false}:t)); }
function fmt(s){return (Math.floor(s/60)) + ":" + (String(s%60).padStart(2,"0"));}
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>â±ï¸ Timer Bank</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Multiple named countdown timers for practice, build sessions, and drills.</div>
    <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(240px,1fr))",gap:12,marginBottom:14}}>
      {timers.map(t=>{ const pct=t.remaining/t.seconds; const urgent=t.remaining>0&&t.remaining<=10; return (
        <div key={t.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,padding:20,border:"2px solid " + (t.running?t.color:"#e2e8f0"),boxShadow:t.running?"0 4px 20px " + (t.color) + "30":"none"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:8}}>{t.name}</div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:44,color:urgent?"#dc2626":t.running?t.color:"#1e293b",fontFamily:"monospace",letterSpacing:2,marginBottom:10,textAlign:"center"}}>{fmt(t.remaining)}</div>
          <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:999,height:6,marginBottom:12,overflow:"hidden"}}><div style={{width:(pct*100) + "%",height:"100%",background:urgent?"#dc2626":t.color,borderRadius:999,transition:"width 0.5s"}}/></div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8}}>
            <button onClick={()=>toggle(t.id)} style={{flex:1,background:t.running?"#dc2626":t.color,color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:9,padding:"10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{t.running?"â¸":"â–¶"}</button>
            <button onClick={()=>reset(t.id)} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:9,padding:"10px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>â†º</button>
            <button onClick={()=>{clearInterval(refs.current[t.id]);setTimers(p=>p.filter(x=>x.id!==t.id));}} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14}}>âœ•</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      );})}
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
      <input value={nn} onChange={e=>setNn(e.target.value)} placeholder="Timer name" style={{flex:1,minWidth:150,padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <input type="number" value={nm} onChange={e=>setNm(e.target.value)} placeholder="Minutes" style={{width:80,padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
      <input type="color" value={nc} onChange={e=>setNc(e.target.value)} style={{width:40,height:38,border:"none",cursor:"pointer",borderRadius:7,padding:2}}/>
      <button onClick={()=>{if(!nn.trim())return;const s=parseInt(nm)*60;setTimers(p=>[...p,{id:Date.now(),name:nn,seconds:s,remaining:s,running:false,color:nc}]);setNn("");setNm("5");}} style={{background:"#374151",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+ Timer</button>
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolGearCalc2() {
  const [stages,setStages]=useState([{id:1,type:"gear",input:12,output:60},{id:2,type:"chain",input:18,output:36}]);
const [motorRPM,setMotorRPM]=useState("5880"); const [motorTorque,setMotorTorque]=useState("2.6"); const [wheelDia,setWheelDia]=useState("4"); const [eff,setEff]=useState("85");
const STAGE_TYPES=[{id:"gear",l:"âš™ï¸ Gear"},{id:"chain",l:"â›“ï¸ Chain/Sprocket"},{id:"belt",l:"ðŸ”„ Belt/Pulley"}];
function addStage(){ setStages(p=>[...p,{id:Date.now(),type:"gear",input:12,output:60}]); }
function updStage(id,k,v){ setStages(p=>p.map(s=>s.id===id?{...s,[k]:k==="type"?v:parseInt(v)||1}:s)); }
const ratio=stages.reduce((r,s)=>r*(s.output/s.input),1);
const eta=(parseFloat(eff)||85)/100;
const outRPM=(parseFloat(motorRPM)||5880)/ratio;
const outTorque=(parseFloat(motorTorque)||2.6)*ratio*eta;
const fps=outRPM*Math.PI*(parseFloat(wheelDia)||4)/12/60;
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>âš™ï¸ Multi-Stage Gear Calculator</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Chain multi-stage gearboxes and instantly see output RPM, torque, and robot speed.</div>
    <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:14}}>
      {[["Motor Free RPM",motorRPM,setMotorRPM],["Stall Torque (NÂ·m)",motorTorque,setMotorTorque],["Wheel Dia (in)",wheelDia,setWheelDia],["Efficiency %",eff,setEff]].map(([l,v,set])=>(
        <div key={l}><div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>{l}</div><input type="number" value={v} onChange={e=>set(e.target.value)} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div style={{marginBottom:14}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}>Reduction Stages</div>
      {stages.map((stage,i)=>(
        <div key={stage.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:8,display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:13,color:"#9ca3af",minWidth:20}}>S{i+1}</div>
          <select value={stage.type} onChange={e=>updStage(stage.id,"type",e.target.value)} style={{padding:"6px 10px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>{STAGE_TYPES.map(t=><option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.l}</option>)}</select>
          <input type="number" value={stage.input} onChange={e=>updStage(stage.id,"input",e.target.value)} style={{width:60,padding:"6px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",textAlign:"center"}}/>
          <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontWeight:700}}>:</span>
          <input type="number" value={stage.output} onChange={e=>updStage(stage.id,"output",e.target.value)} style={{width:60,padding:"6px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",textAlign:"center"}}/>
          <div style={{background:"#eff6ff",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",fontSize:13,fontWeight:700,color:"#1d4ed8"}}>{(stage.output/stage.input).toFixed(2)}:1</div>
          {stages.length>1&&<button onClick={()=>setStages(p=>p.filter(s=>s.id!==stage.id))} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14,marginLeft:"auto"}}>âœ•</button>}
        </div>
      ))}
      <button onClick={addStage} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+ Add Stage</button>
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#1e3a8a)",borderRadius:16,padding:20,color:"#fff"}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,opacity:0.7,marginBottom:12,fontSize:12,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:1}}>Overall Results</div>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
        {[["Overall Ratio",(ratio.toFixed(2)) + ":1","#60a5fa"],["Output RPM",outRPM.toFixed(0),"#34d399"],["Output Torque",(outTorque.toFixed(2)) + " NÂ·m","#fbbf24"],["Speed (ft/s)",fps.toFixed(1),"#f87171"],["Speed (mph)",(fps*0.6818).toFixed(1),"#a78bfa"]].map(([l,v,c])=>(
          <div key={l} style={{textAlign:"center"}}><div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,color:c}}>{v}</div><div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.6,marginTop:2}}>{l}</div></div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{marginTop:14,fontSize:12,opacity:0.7}}>{fps>20?"âš¡ Very fast! Verify motors have enough torque.":fps>14?"âœ… Excellent competition speed.":fps>8?"âš ï¸ Moderate speed â€” consider adjusting.":"ðŸ¢ Slow â€” increase ratio or wheel size."}</div>
    </div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolScouting2() {
  const [fields,setFields]=useState([]); const [responses,setResponses]=useState([]); const [tab,setTab]=useState("form");
const [nf,setNf]=useState(""); const [nt,setNt]=useState("number"); const [cur,setCur]=useState({}); const [teamNum,setTeamNum]=useState("");
const FIELD_TYPES=[{id:"number",l:"ðŸ”¢ Number"},{id:"boolean",l:"âœ… Yes/No"},{id:"scale",l:"â­ 1-5 Scale"},{id:"text",l:"âœï¸ Text"}];
const DEFAULT_FIELDS=[{id:"d1",label:"Auto Score (pts)",type:"number"},{id:"d2",label:"TeleOp Cycles",type:"number"},{id:"d3",label:"Endgame Success",type:"boolean"},{id:"d4",label:"Defense Rating",type:"scale"},{id:"d5",label:"Driving Skill",type:"scale"}];
const activeFields=fields.length>0?fields:DEFAULT_FIELDS;
function addField(){ if(!nf.trim())return; setFields(x=>[...x,{id:Date.now(),label:nf,type:nt}]); setNf(""); }
function submit(){ if(!teamNum.trim())return; setResponses(x=>[{id:Date.now(),team:teamNum,data:{...cur}},...x]); setCur({});setTeamNum(""); }
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸŽ¯ Custom Scout Form Builder</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Build your own scouting form with custom fields.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,marginBottom:14}}>
      {[["form","ðŸ“ Scout"],["build","ðŸ”§ Build Form"],["data","ðŸ“Š Data"]].map(([v,l])=>(
        <button key={v} onClick={()=>setTab(v)} style={{background:tab===v?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:tab===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{l}</button>
      ))}
    </div>
    {tab==="build"&&<div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:12}}>
        <input value={nf} onChange={e=>setNf(e.target.value)} placeholder="Field label" style={{flex:1,padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        <select value={nt} onChange={e=>setNt(e.target.value)} style={{padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>{FIELD_TYPES.map(t=><option key={t.id} value={t.id}>{t.l}</option>)}</select>
        <button onClick={addField} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Add</button>
      </div>
      {activeFields.map(f=>(
        <div key={f.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:9,padding:"10px 14px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:6,display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13}}>{f.label}</span>
          <span style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:5,padding:"2px 8px",fontSize:11,color:"#6b7280"}}>{FIELD_TYPES.find(t=>t.id===f.type)?.l}</span>
          {fields.some(x=>x.id===f.id)&&<button onClick={()=>setFields(x=>x.filter(y=>y.id!==f.id))} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13,marginLeft:"auto"}}>âœ•</button>}
        </div>
      ))}
      {fields.length===0&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:8}}>Using default fields. Add custom fields to override.</div>}
    </div>}
    {tab==="form"&&<div>
      <div style={{marginBottom:12}}><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Team Number *</div><input value={teamNum} onChange={e=>setTeamNum(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 4512" style={{padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #1d4ed8",fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit",fontWeight:700,width:150,boxSizing:"border-box"}}/></div>
      {activeFields.map(f=>(
        <div key={f.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:8}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:8}}>{f.label}</div>
          {f.type==="number"&&<input type="number" value={cur[f.id]||""} onChange={e=>setCur(p=>({...p,[f.id]:e.target.value}))} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit",boxSizing:"border-box"}}/>}
          {f.type==="boolean"&&<div style={{display:"flex",gap:10}}>{[["Yes","#059669"],["No","#dc2626"]].map(([v,c])=><button key={v} onClick={()=>setCur(p=>({...p,[f.id]:v}))} style={{flex:1,background:cur[f.id]===v?c:"#f1f5f9",color:cur[f.id]===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{v}</button>)}</div>}
          {f.type==="scale"&&<div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>{[1,2,3,4,5].map(v=><button key={v} onClick={()=>setCur(p=>({...p,[f.id]:v}))} style={{flex:1,background:cur[f.id]===v?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:cur[f.id]===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{v}</button>)}</div>}
          {f.type==="text"&&<textarea value={cur[f.id]||""} onChange={e=>setCur(p=>({...p,[f.id]:e.target.value}))} rows={2} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,resize:"none",boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>}
        </div>
      ))}
      <button onClick={submit} style={{background:"#059669",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 28px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,fontFamily:"inherit",width:"100%"}}>âœ… Submit Scout Report</button>
    </div>}
    {tab==="data"&&<div>
      {responses.length===0?<div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#9ca3af"}}>No scouting data yet. Submit some forms first!</div>:<div>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}>{responses.length} reports collected</div>
        {responses.map(r=>(
          <div key={r.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:8}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:8}}>Team {r.team}</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:8}}>
              {Object.entries(r.data).map(([k,v])=>{ const f=activeFields.find(x=>x.id===k); return f?<div key={k} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",fontSize:12}}><span style={{color:"#6b7280"}}>{f.label}:</span> <span style={{fontWeight:700}}>{String(v)}</span></div>:null; })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>}
    </div>}
  </div>
);
}


function ToolKnowledgeQuiz() {
  const QS=[
  {q:"What is the maximum weight for an FRC robot (excluding battery and bumpers)?",opts:["100 lbs","125 lbs","150 lbs","175 lbs"],correct:1,explain:"FRC rules allow 125 lbs excluding battery and bumpers. Always weigh early and often!"},
  {q:"What does CAN stand for in FRC wiring?",opts:["Controller Area Network","Central Actuator Node","Circuit Automation Network","Component Analog Network"],correct:0,explain:"CAN (Controller Area Network) allows motor controllers, PDH, and other devices to communicate on a shared 1Mbps bus."},
  {q:"Which language is NOT officially supported by WPILib for FRC?",opts:["Java","Python","C++","LabVIEW"],correct:1,explain:"WPILib officially supports Java, C++, and LabVIEW. Python has community support but is not officially supported for FRC."},
  {q:"What does the P (Proportional) term in a PID controller do?",opts:["Eliminates steady-state error","Corrects for accumulated past error","Corrects proportional to current error","Predicts future error"],correct:2,explain:"The P term applies correction proportional to the current error. Higher kP = faster response but can cause oscillation."},
  {q:"In FRC, what color bumpers does the red alliance use?",opts:["Orange","Red","Crimson","The alliance color assigned at each event"],correct:3,explain:"Teams swap bumper covers based on alliance assignment at each event. You must bring both red AND blue covers."},
