  {q:"What is the typical voltage of an FRC competition battery?",opts:["9V","12V","18V","24V"],correct:1,explain:"FRC uses a 12V, 18Ah NiMH battery. A fully charged battery reads ~13V; below 12V is considered weak."},
  {q:"What does 'OPR' stand for in FRC scouting?",opts:["Overall Performance Rating","Offensive Power Rating","Optimized Point Ratio","Operator Position Record"],correct:1,explain:"OPR (Offensive Power Rating) estimates each team's contribution to alliance score using linear regression."},
  {q:"Which FRC motor is an integrated motor+controller on CAN?",opts:["NEO 550","Falcon 500 / Kraken X60","CIM Motor","775 Pro"],correct:1,explain:"The Falcon 500 (now Kraken X60) has a built-in TalonFX controller. Connects directly to CAN â€” no separate controller needed."},
  {q:"What is the purpose of a 'deadband' in drive code?",opts:["Limit maximum speed","Prevent movement when joystick is near neutral","Filter encoder noise","Set PID setpoint"],correct:1,explain:"A deadband (e.g. Â±0.05) ignores tiny joystick inputs near zero. Without it, motors jitter when driver isn't touching sticks."},
  {q:"In FTC, how many motors can a single REV Control Hub support?",opts:["2","4","6","8"],correct:1,explain:"Each REV Control Hub has 4 motor ports. Add an Expansion Hub for 4 more, giving a maximum of 8 motors."},
  {q:"What is 'gracious professionalism' in FIRST?",opts:["Winning with extra points","Treating everyone with respect while competing hard","Keeping robot designs secret","Only helping your alliance"],correct:1,explain:"Gracious Professionalism is a core FIRST value: compete intensely while maintaining respect, sharing knowledge, and building community."},
  {q:"What does the 'I' term in a PID controller primarily help with?",opts:["Reduce overshoot","Eliminate steady-state error","Improve response speed","Dampen oscillations"],correct:1,explain:"The Integral term accumulates error over time, eliminating steady-state error where the P term alone can't quite reach setpoint."},
];
const [idx,setIdx]=useState(0); const [sel,setSel]=useState(null); const [score,setScore]=useState(0); const [done,setDone]=useState(false); const [ans,setAns]=useState([]);
function answer(i){ if(sel!==null)return; setSel(i); if(i===QS[idx].correct)setScore(s=>s+1); setAns(p=>[...p,{q:QS[idx].q,chosen:i,correct:i===QS[idx].correct,ci:QS[idx].correct}]); }
function next(){ if(idx<QS.length-1){setIdx(i=>i+1);setSel(null);}else setDone(true); }
function restart(){ setIdx(0);setSel(null);setScore(0);setDone(false);setAns([]); }
const q=QS[idx];
if(done) return (
  <div>
    <div style={{background:score>=10?"linear-gradient(135deg,#059669,#047857)":score>=7?"linear-gradient(135deg,#1d4ed8,#7c3aed)":"linear-gradient(135deg,#dc2626,#b91c1c)",borderRadius:16,padding:28,color:"#fff",textAlign:"center",marginBottom:16}}>
      <div style={{fontSize:52,marginBottom:12}}>{score>=10?"ðŸ†":score>=7?"ðŸŽ“":"ðŸ“š"}</div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:26,marginBottom:6}}>{score}/{QS.length} Correct</div>
      <div style={{fontSize:15,opacity:0.9}}>{score>=10?"FRC Expert! Outstanding knowledge.":score>=7?"Strong knowledge â€” keep learning!":"Time to study up! Review the explanations below."}</div>
    </div>
    <div style={{marginBottom:14}}>
      {ans.map((a,i)=>(
        <div key={i} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"1.5px solid " + (a.correct?"#86efac":"#fca5a5"),marginBottom:7}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,color:a.correct?"#059669":"#dc2626",marginBottom:4}}>{a.correct?"âœ…":"âŒ"} Q{i+1}: {a.q.slice(0,60)}...</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#374151"}}>{QS[i].explain}</div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
    <button onClick={restart} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 28px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,fontFamily:"inherit",width:"100%"}}>ðŸ”„ Retake Quiz</button>
  </div>
);
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ§  FRC/FTC Knowledge Quiz</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Test your robotics knowledge â€” rules, electronics, programming, and FIRST culture.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:10}}>
      <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>Question {idx+1} of {QS.length}</div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:"#059669"}}>Score: {score}</div>
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:8,height:6,marginBottom:16,overflow:"hidden"}}><div style={{width:(idx/QS.length*100) + "%",height:"100%",background:"#1d4ed8",borderRadius:8}}/></div>
    <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:20,border:"2px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:14}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:16,lineHeight:1.5,marginBottom:16}}>{q.q}</div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
        {q.opts.map((opt,i)=>{ let bg="#fff",border="1px solid #e2e8f0",color="#374151"; if(sel!==null){if(i===q.correct){bg="#f0fdf4";border="2px solid #059669";color="#166534";}else if(i===sel&&i!==q.correct){bg="#fef2f2";border="2px solid #dc2626";color="#991b1b";}else{bg="#f8fafc";color="#9ca3af";}} return (
          <button key={i} onClick={()=>answer(i)} style={{background:bg,border,borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 16px",cursor:sel!==null?"default":"pointer",textAlign:"left",fontSize:14,fontWeight:sel!==null&&i===q.correct?700:400,color,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
            <span style={{fontWeight:700,color:"#9ca3af",marginRight:8}}>{["A","B","C","D"][i]}.</span>{opt}
          </button>
        );})}
      </div>
      {sel!==null&&<div style={{background:"#fffbeb",borderRadius:9,padding:12,border:"1px solid #fde68a",marginTop:12,fontSize:13,color:"#92400e"}}>ðŸ’¡ {q.explain}</div>}
    </div>
    {sel!==null&&<button onClick={next} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,fontFamily:"inherit",width:"100%"}}>{idx<QS.length-1?"Next Question â†’":"See Results ðŸ"}</button>}
  </div>
);
}


function ToolFieldAnnot() {
  const canvasRef=useRef(null); const [drawTool,setDrawTool]=useState("draw"); const [color,setColor]=useState("#dc2626"); const [lw,setLw]=useState(3);
const [drawing,setDrawing]=useState(false); const [labelText,setLabelText]=useState(""); const lastPos=useRef(null);
const COLORS_COLORS1=["#dc2626","#1d4ed8","#059669","#d97706","#7c3aed","#0f172a","#ffffff"];
function getPos(e,canvas){ const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const scaleX=canvas.width/rect.width; const scaleY=canvas.height/rect.height; const src=e.touches?e.touches[0]:e; return {x:(src.clientX-rect.left)*scaleX,y:(src.clientY-rect.top)*scaleY}; }
function startDraw(e){ if(drawTool!=="draw")return; const pos=getPos(e,canvasRef.current); setDrawing(true); lastPos.current=pos; }
function doDraw(e){ if(!drawing||!canvasRef.current)return; const canvas=canvasRef.current; const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"); const pos=getPos(e,canvas); ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=lw;ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.lineJoin="round"; ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(lastPos.current.x,lastPos.current.y);ctx.lineTo(pos.x,pos.y);ctx.stroke(); lastPos.current=pos; }
function endDraw(){ setDrawing(false); lastPos.current=null; }
function handleClick(e){ if(drawTool==="label"&&labelText.trim()){ const canvas=canvasRef.current; const pos=getPos(e,canvas); const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d"); ctx.font="bold 16px sans-serif";ctx.fillStyle=color; ctx.fillText(labelText,pos.x,pos.y); } }
function clearCanvas(){ const canvas=canvasRef.current;if(!canvas)return; canvasRef.current.getContext("2d").clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height); }
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ—ºï¸ Field Strategy Annotator</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Draw robot paths and strategies on a field diagram for alliance meetings.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:10,alignItems:"center"}}>
      {[["draw","âœï¸ Draw"],["label","ðŸ·ï¸ Label"]].map(([v,l])=>(
        <button key={v} onClick={()=>setDrawTool(v)} style={{background:drawTool===v?"#374151":"#f1f5f9",color:drawTool===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{l}</button>
      ))}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:5}}>{COLORS_COLORS1.map(c=><button key={c} onClick={()=>setColor(c)} style={{width:24,height:24,borderRadius:"50%",background:c,border:color===c?"3px solid #374151":"2px solid #e2e8f0",cursor:"pointer",padding:0}}/>)}</div>
      {[2,4,7].map(w=><button key={w} onClick={()=>setLw(w)} style={{background:lw===w?"#374151":"#f1f5f9",color:lw===w?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"5px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{w}px</button>)}
      {drawTool==="label"&&<input value={labelText} onChange={e=>setLabelText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Label text" style={{padding:"6px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",width:120}}/>}
      <button onClick={clearCanvas} style={{background:"#fee2e2",color:"#991b1b",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",marginLeft:"auto"}}>Clear</button>
    </div>
    <div style={{background:"#1a472a",borderRadius:14,padding:8,position:"relative",userSelect:"none"}}>
      <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:8,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",pointerEvents:"none"}}>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 600 300" style={{width:"100%",height:"auto",opacity:0.3}}>
          <rect x="0" y="0" width="600" height="300" fill="none" stroke="white" strokeWidth="3"/>
          <line x1="300" y1="0" x2="300" y2="300" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2"/>
          <rect x="0" y="75" width="80" height="150" fill="none" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2"/>
          <rect x="520" y="75" width="80" height="150" fill="none" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2"/>
          <text x="50" y="155" fill="white" fontSize="12" textAnchor="middle">RED</text>
          <text x="550" y="155" fill="white" fontSize="12" textAnchor="middle">BLUE</text>
          <circle cx="300" cy="150" r="30" fill="none" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <canvas ref={canvasRef} width={600} height={300}
        style={{width:"100%",height:"auto",display:"block",cursor:drawTool==="draw"?"crosshair":"text",touchAction:"none",borderRadius:9}}
        onMouseDown={startDraw} onMouseMove={doDraw} onMouseUp={endDraw} onMouseLeave={endDraw} onClick={handleClick}
        onTouchStart={e=>{e.preventDefault();startDraw(e);}} onTouchMove={e=>{e.preventDefault();doDraw(e);}} onTouchEnd={endDraw}/>
    </div>
    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:8}}>Draw paths directly on the field. Use different colors for each robot. Label key zones and positions.</div>
  </div>
);
}


function ToolFlashcard2() {
  const allQuizLessons = Object.values(LESSONS).flatMap(s=>Object.values(s).flatMap(l=>l)).filter(l=>l.quiz&&l.quiz.length>0);
const [qqIdx, setQqIdx] = useState(()=>Math.floor(Math.random()*allQuizLessons.length));
const [qqQIdx, setQqQIdx] = useState(0);
const [qqAns, setQqAns] = useState(null);
const [qqScore, setQqScore] = useState(0);
const [qqTotal, setQqTotal] = useState(0);
const [qqFilter, setQqFilter] = useState("all");
const filtered = qqFilter==="all"?allQuizLessons:allQuizLessons.filter(l=>{
  if(qqFilter==="java")return l.id?.match(/^j[ab]/);
  if(qqFilter==="mech")return l.id?.startsWith("m");
  if(qqFilter==="elec")return l.id?.match(/^e[ab]/);
  if(qqFilter==="strat")return l.id?.startsWith("s")&&!l.id?.startsWith("sf");
  if(qqFilter==="python")return l.id?.startsWith("p");
  if(qqFilter==="safety")return l.id?.startsWith("sf");
  return true;
});
const lesson = filtered.length?filtered[qqIdx%filtered.length]:null;
const q = lesson?.quiz[qqQIdx%(lesson?.quiz?.length||1)];
function nextQ(){const n=Math.floor(Math.random()*filtered.length);setQqIdx(n);setQqQIdx(q2=>(q2+1)%(filtered[n]?.quiz?.length||1));setQqAns(null);}
return (
  <div>
    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸƒ Random Quick Quiz</div>
    <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Random questions from all lessons. Perfect for daily practice.</div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:16}}>
      {[["all","ðŸŒ All"],["java","â˜• Java"],["mech","âš™ï¸ Mechanics"],["elec","âš¡ Electrical"],["strat","ðŸ† Strategy"],["python","ðŸ Python"],["safety","ðŸ¦º Safety"]].map(([v,l])=>(
        <button key={v} onClick={()=>{setQqFilter(v);setQqIdx(0);setQqQIdx(0);setQqAns(null);}} style={{background:qqFilter===v?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:qqFilter===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 12px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{l}</button>
      ))}
    </div>
    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:16,marginBottom:14,fontSize:14}}>
      <span style={{color:"#059669",fontWeight:800}}>âœ… {qqScore}</span>
      <span style={{color:"#dc2626",fontWeight:800}}>âŒ {qqTotal-qqScore}</span>
      {qqTotal>0&&<span style={{color:"#6b7280"}}>{Math.round(qqScore/qqTotal*100)}%</span>}
      <button onClick={()=>{setQqScore(0);setQqTotal(0);}} style={{marginLeft:"auto",background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"4px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Reset Score</button>
    </div>
    {lesson&&q?(
      <div>
        <div style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 12px",marginBottom:12,fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>From: {lesson.title}</div>
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,border:"2px solid #e2e8f0",padding:18,marginBottom:14}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,lineHeight:1.6,marginBottom:14}}>{q.q}</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
            {q.opts.map((opt,j)=>{
              let bg="#f8fafc",border="1.5px solid #e2e8f0",col="#374151";
              if(qqAns!==null){if(j===q.ans){bg="#f0fdf4";border="2px solid #86efac";col="#166534";}else if(qqAns===j){bg="#fef2f2";border="2px solid #fca5a5";col="#991b1b";}}
              else if(qqAns===j){bg="#eff6ff";border="2px solid #93c5fd";col="#1e40af";}
              return <button key={j} onClick={()=>{if(qqAns===null){setQqAns(j);setQqTotal(t=>t+1);if(j===q.ans)setQqScore(s=>s+1);}}} style={{background:bg,border,color:col,padding:"11px 16px",borderRadius:9,cursor:qqAns!==null?"default":"pointer",textAlign:"left",fontWeight:600,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>{["A","B","C","D"][j]}. {opt}</button>;
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
        {qqAns!==null&&(
          <div>
            {q.explanation&&<div style={{background:"#f0f9ff",border:"1px solid #bae6fd",borderRadius:9,padding:12,fontSize:13,color:"#0c4a6e",marginBottom:10}}>{q.explanation}</div>}
            <button onClick={nextQ} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:9,padding:"11px 28px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Next Question â†’</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    ):<div style={{color:"#9ca3af",textAlign:"center",padding:40}}>No quiz questions for this filter.</div>}
  </div>
);
}

function FIRSTToolsPage() {
  const [tool, setTool] = useState("inspection");

  // â”€â”€ Robot Inspection Checklist â”€â”€
  const [inspectType, setInspectType] = useState("FRC");
  const [inspectChecked, setInspectChecked] = useState({});

  const FRC_INSPECTION = [
    { id:"i1", cat:"Dimensions", text:"Robot fits in 26\" Ã— 26\" footprint (bumpers excluded)", tip:"Measure at widest point without bumpers. Use a sizing box if available." },
    { id:"i2", cat:"Dimensions", text:"Robot height does not exceed 4'6\" (54 inches) at start", tip:"Starting configuration only. Robot may exceed this after the match begins." },
    { id:"i3", cat:"Weight", text:"Robot weighs â‰¤ 125 lbs (without battery and bumpers)", tip:"Official inspection scale is used. Battery ~13 lbs, bumpers ~8â€“15 lbs each pair." },
    { id:"i4", cat:"Bumpers", text:"Bumpers cover required frame perimeter â€” no gaps > 6 inches", tip:"Bumpers must be rigid mounting, proper pool noodle size, and correct fabric color for your alliance." },
    { id:"i5", cat:"Bumpers", text:"Bumper numbers are clearly visible from the front and back", tip:"Numbers must be â‰¥ 4 inches tall, readable from 100 feet." },
    { id:"i6", cat:"Electrical", text:"Main breaker is accessible and labeled, not obstructed", tip:"Inspector must be able to reach and flip it. Nothing blocking the switch." },
    { id:"i7", cat:"Electrical", text:"All electrical connections are secure â€” no loose wires", tip:"Tug-test all connectors. Especially check battery connector and PDH output wires." },
    { id:"i8", cat:"Electrical", text:"No exposed electrical conductors that could contact frame or other components", tip:"All bare wire ends must be insulated or terminated properly." },
    { id:"i9", cat:"Electrical", text:"Battery is properly secured in robot â€” cannot fall out", tip:"Battery holder/strap must prevent movement. A dropped battery is a safety incident." },
    { id:"i10", cat:"Safety", text:"No sharp edges or protrusions that could injure people or other robots", tip:"File down any sharp aluminum cuts. Check mechanism edges especially." },
    { id:"i11", cat:"Software", text:"Robot properly disables when Driver Station cuts communication", tip:"Test: disconnect DS ethernet. Robot must disable within 1 second." },
    { id:"i12", cat:"Software", text:"Team number programmed into radio â€” passes radio configuration check", tip:"Use the FRC Radio Configuration Tool with your team number each season." },
  ];

  const FTC_INSPECTION = [
    { id:"f1", cat:"Dimensions", text:"Robot fits in 18\" Ã— 18\" Ã— 18\" starting cube", tip:"Measure all three dimensions. Linear slides and arms must be retracted." },
    { id:"f2", cat:"Weight", text:"Robot weighs â‰¤ 42 lbs (including battery)", tip:"FTC weight limit includes everything on the robot." },
    { id:"f3", cat:"Electronics", text:"REV Control Hub is the primary control system", tip:"No other computing devices may be connected to control motors/servos." },
    { id:"f4", cat:"Electronics", text:"One approved 12V NiMH battery â€” properly secured", tip:"Battery must be FIRST-approved model, intact connectors, no swelling." },
    { id:"f5", cat:"Electronics", text:"All wiring is secure and not at risk of entanglement", tip:"Cable management with zip ties. No wires hanging loose that could catch." },
    { id:"f6", cat:"Motors", text:"No more than 8 DC motors (plus servos within limits)", tip:"Count every motor. Check your configuration file matches physical hardware." },
    { id:"f7", cat:"Safety", text:"No pneumatics (not allowed in FTC)", tip:"Any pneumatic components cause immediate disqualification." },
    { id:"f8", cat:"Safety", text:"No hazardous materials â€” no sharp edges or dangerous mechanisms", tip:"Inspect all exposed edges. Lexan and sheet metal often have sharp burrs." },
    { id:"f9", cat:"Software", text:"Robot connects to Driver Hub and passes network test", tip:"Test at least 30 min before inspection. WiFi issues take time to diagnose." },
    { id:"f10", cat:"Software", text:"Autonomous routines tested on field tile surface", tip:"Competition field tiles have different grip than most practice surfaces." },
  ];

  const inspectionItems = inspectType === "FRC" ? FRC_INSPECTION : FTC_INSPECTION;
  const inspectDone = inspectionItems.filter(item => inspectChecked[item.id]).length;
  const inspectPct = Math.round(inspectDone / inspectionItems.length * 100);
  const inspectCats = [...new Set(inspectionItems.map(i => i.cat))];

  // â”€â”€ Gear Ratio Calculator â”€â”€
  const [gearIn, setGearIn] = useState("12");
  const [gearOut, setGearOut] = useState("84");
  const [freeRPM, setFreeRPM] = useState("6000");

  const ratio = parseFloat(gearOut) / parseFloat(gearIn) || 1;
  const outputRPM = parseFloat(freeRPM) / ratio || 0;
  const reductionStr = ratio >= 1 ? (ratio.toFixed(2)) + ":1 reduction" : "1:" + ((1/ratio).toFixed(2)) + " increase";

  const MOTOR_PRESETS = [
    {name:"NEO (Spark MAX)", rpm:5880}, {name:"Falcon 500", rpm:6380},
    {name:"NEO 550", rpm:11000}, {name:"CIM", rpm:5310},
    {name:"775pro", rpm:18730}, {name:"goBILDA 5202 (312rpm)", rpm:312},
    {name:"goBILDA 5202 (435rpm)", rpm:435}, {name:"REV Core Hex", rpm:125},
  ];

  // â”€â”€ Match Timer â”€â”€
  const [matchPhase, setMatchPhase] = useState("pre");
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);
  const timerRef = useRef(null);

  const MATCH_TIMELINE = [
    {t:0,   label:"Match Start",         phase:"auto",    note:"Auto begins â€” no driver control"},
    {t:15,  label:"Auto Ends",            phase:"teleop",  note:"Teleop starts â€” driver control active"},
    {t:105, label:"30-Second Warning",    phase:"endgame", note:"Endgame / climb time â€” start climb sequence!"},
    {t:130, label:"10-Second Warning",    phase:"endgame", note:"Final 10 seconds â€” no new climbs can be started"},
    {t:140, label:"Match End",            phase:"done",    note:"All motors stop"},

  useEffect(() => {
    if (running) {
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => setElapsed(e => {
        if (e >= 150) { setRunning(false); return 150; }
        return e + 1;
      }), 1000);
    }
    return () => clearInterval(timerRef.current);
  }, [running]);

  const currentPhaseInfo = MATCH_TIMELINE.reduce((prev, curr) => elapsed >= curr.t ? curr : prev, MATCH_TIMELINE[0]);
  const timeRemaining = 150 - elapsed;
  const phaseColor = {auto:"#1d4ed8", teleop:"#16a34a", endgame:"#dc2626", done:"#374151"}[currentPhaseInfo.phase] || "#1d4ed8";

    {id:"buildlog", label:"ðŸ““ Build Log", desc:"Daily progress journal"},
    {id:"partscalc", label:"ðŸ”© Parts Calculator", desc:"Gear, belt, chain math"},

    {id:"fieldmap", label:"ðŸ—ºï¸ Field Zones", desc:"Zone scoring reference"},
    {id:"awards", label:"ðŸ† Awards Tracker", desc:"Track award submissions"},
    {id:"outreach", label:"ðŸŒ Outreach Log", desc:"Log community events"},
    {id:"pitstop", label:"â±ï¸ Pit Stop Timer", desc:"Time robot repairs"},
    {id:"checklist", label:"ðŸ“‹ Competition Checklist", desc:"Don't forget anything"},
    {id:"cycletracker", label:"ðŸ” Cycle Counter", desc:"Live match cycle counting"},

  const [defensePenalties, setDefensePenalties] = useState(0);

  function scoutReset() {
    setScoutTeam(""); setScoutMatch(""); setAutoScore(""); setAutoConsistency(3);
    setTeleopScore(""); setCycleCount(""); setScoringZone([]); setOffenseRating(3);
    setPlayedDefense(false); setDefenseTarget(""); setDefenseEffective(3);
    setDefensePenalties(0); setDefenseNotes(""); setClimbed("no"); setClimbTime("");
    setReliability(3); setRobotSpeed(3); setDriverSkill(3); setBrokeDown(false); setScoutNotes("");
  }

  function calcOverallRating(entry) {
    const offense = (entry.offenseRating||3)*2;
    const defense = entry.playedDefense ? (entry.defenseEffective||3) : 0;
    const endgame = entry.climbed==="success"?5:entry.climbed==="attempted"?2:0;
    const rel = (entry.reliability||3);
    const penalties = Math.max(0, 3-(entry.defensePenalties||0));
    const score = (offense + defense + endgame + rel + penalties);
    return Math.min(10, Math.round(score/3.5*10)/10);
  }

  function saveScoutEntry() {
    if (!scoutTeam.trim()) return;
    const entry = {
      team: scoutTeam, match: scoutMatch,
      // offense
      auto: autoScore, autoConsistency, teleop: teleopScore, cycleCount, scoringZone, offenseRating,
      // defense
      playedDefense, defenseTarget, defenseEffective, defensePenalties, defenseNotes,
      // endgame
      climbed, climbTime,
      // overall
      reliability, robotSpeed, driverSkill, brokeDown,
      notes: scoutNotes, ts: Date.now()
    };
    entry.overallRating = calcOverallRating(entry);
    const updated = [entry, ...scoutSaved];
    setScoutSaved(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("hub-scout-data", JSON.stringify(updated));
    scoutReset();
  }

  const [cycleMatchNum, setCycleMatchNum] = useState("");

  const [cycles, setCycles] = useState([]);
  const [cycleRunning, setCycleRunning] = useState(false);
  const [cycleStart, setCycleStart] = useState(null);
  const [cycleElapsed, setCycleElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [matchTime, setMatchTime] = useState(150); // 2:30 countdown
  const [matchActive, setMatchActive] = useState(false);
  const cycleIntervalRef = useRef(null);
  const matchIntervalRef = useRef(null);
  const [savedCycleData, setSavedCycleData] = useState(() => {

  });

  function startCycle() {
    if (!cycleRunning) {
      setCycleRunning(true);
      setCycleStart(Date.now());
      setCycleElapsed(0);
      cycleIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setCycleElapsed(e => e + 0.1);
      }, 100);
    }
  }
  function recordCycle() {
    if (!cycleRunning) return;
    clearInterval(cycleIntervalRef.current);
    const t = (Date.now() - cycleStart) / 1000;
    setCycles(prev => [...prev, Math.round(t*10)/10]);
    setCycleRunning(false);
    setCycleElapsed(0);
  }
  function saveCycleSession() {
    if (!cycles.length) return;
    const session = {
      team: cycleTeam, match: cycleMatchNum,
      cycles, avg: (cycles.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/cycles.length).toFixed(1),
      ts: Date.now()
    };
    const updated = [session, ...savedCycleData];
    setSavedCycleData(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("hub-cycles", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setCycles([]); setCycleTeam(""); setCycleMatchNum("");
  }

  const [savedRoutes, setSavedRoutes] = useState(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("hub-auto-routes")||"[]"); } catch(e) { return []; }
  });
  const [autoGameType, setAutoGameType] = useState("ftc");

  // â”€â”€ Strategy Notepad state â”€â”€
  const [notepadText, setNotepadText] = useState(() =>
    localStorage.getItem("hub-notepad") || "");
  const [notepadPinned, setNotepadPinned] = useState(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("hub-notepad-pins")||"[]"); } catch(e){ return []; }
  });

  // â”€â”€ Sponsor Tracker state â”€â”€
  const [sponsors, setSponsors] = useState(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("hub-sponsors")||"[]"); } catch(e){ return []; }
  });
  const [spName, setSpName] = useState("");
  const [spAmount, setSpAmount] = useState("");
  const [spType, setSpType] = useState("monetary");
  const [spStatus, setSpStatus] = useState("prospect");
  const [spContact, setSpContact] = useState("");
  const [spNotes, setSpNotes] = useState("");

  function addSponsor() {
    if (!spName.trim()) return;
    const s = {id:Date.now(), name:spName, amount:parseFloat(spAmount)||0, type:spType, status:spStatus, contact:spContact, notes:spNotes};
    const updated = [...sponsors, s];
    setSponsors(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("hub-sponsors", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setSpName(""); setSpAmount(""); setSpContact(""); setSpNotes("");
  }
  function updateSponsorStatus(id, newStatus) {
    const updated = sponsors.map(s => s.id===id ? {...s, status:newStatus} : s);
    setSponsors(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("hub-sponsors", JSON.stringify(updated));
  }

  // â”€â”€ Incident Log state â”€â”€
  const [incidents, setIncidents] = useState(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("hub-incidents")||"[]"); } catch(e){ return []; }
  });
  const [incType, setIncType] = useState("near_miss");
  const [incDesc, setIncDesc] = useState("");
  const [incDate, setIncDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10));
  const [incPerson, setIncPerson] = useState("");
  const [incAction, setIncAction] = useState("");

  function addIncident() {
    if (!incDesc.trim()) return;
    const inc = {id:Date.now(), type:incType, desc:incDesc, date:incDate, person:incPerson, action:incAction};
    const updated = [inc, ...incidents];
    setIncidents(updated);
    localStorage.setItem("hub-incidents", JSON.stringify(updated));
    setIncDesc(""); setIncPerson(""); setIncAction("");
  }

  function downloadCSV() {
    const header = "Team,Match,Auto,Teleop,Climbed,Reliability,Notes,Time\n";
    const rows = scoutSaved.map(e => (e.team) + "," + (e.match) + "," + (e.auto) + "," + (e.teleop) + "," + (e.climbed) + "," + (e.reliability) + ",\"" + (e.notes) + "\"," + (new Date(e.ts).toLocaleString())).join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([header + rows], {type:"text/csv"});
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = url; a.download = "scouting_data.csv"; a.click();
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ› ï¸ FIRST Tools</div>
      <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:20}}>Practical tools for competition day, build season, and practice.</div>

      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:22}}>
        {TOOLS.map(t => (
          <button key={t.id} onClick={()=>setTool(t.id)}
            style={{background:tool===t.id?"#1d4ed8":"#fff",border:"2px solid " + (tool===t.id?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),color:tool===t.id?"#fff":"#374151",padding:"10px 16px",borderRadius:10,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",transition:"all 0.15s"}}>
            <div>{t.label}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:400,opacity:0.8,marginTop:2}}>{t.desc}</div>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* â”€â”€ ROBOT INSPECTION â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="inspection" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,marginBottom:16,alignItems:"center",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17}}>ðŸ” Robot Inspection Checklist</div>
            <div style={{marginLeft:"auto",display:"flex",gap:8}}>
              {["FRC","FTC"].map(t => (
                <button key={t} onClick={()=>{setInspectType(t);setInspectChecked({});}}
                  style={{background:inspectType===t?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:inspectType===t?"#fff":"#6b7280",border:"none",padding:"6px 18px",borderRadius:8,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                  {t}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(90deg,#1d4ed8,#7c3aed)",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 18px",color:"#fff",marginBottom:18,display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
            <div>
              <div style={{fontSize:22,fontWeight:900}}>{inspectDone}/{inspectionItems.length} items</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.8}}>{inspectPct}% complete</div>
            </div>
            <div style={{fontSize:inspectPct===100?40:28}}>{inspectPct===100?"ðŸ†":"ðŸ“‹"}</div>
          </div>
          {inspectPct===100 && (
            <div style={{background:"#f0fdf4",border:"2px solid #86efac",borderRadius:12,padding:14,marginBottom:16,fontWeight:700,color:"#166534",fontSize:15,textAlign:"center"}}>
              âœ… All {inspectionItems.length} inspection items verified. Your robot is ready for inspection!
            </div>
          )}
          {inspectCats.map(cat => (
            <div key={cat} style={{marginBottom:18}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:1,marginBottom:8}}>ðŸ“‚ {cat}</div>
              {inspectionItems.filter(i=>i.cat===cat).map(item => {
                const isChecked = !!inspectChecked[item.id];
                return (
                  <div key={item.id} onClick={()=>setInspectChecked(p=>({...p,[item.id]:!isChecked}))}
                    style={{background:isChecked?"#f0fdf4":"#fff",border:"2px solid " + (isChecked?"#86efac":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 16px",marginBottom:8,cursor:"pointer",display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"flex-start",transition:"all 0.2s"}}>
                    <div style={{width:22,height:22,borderRadius:6,border:"2px solid " + (isChecked?"#16a34a":"#d1d5db"),background:isChecked?"#16a34a":"#fff",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",flexShrink:0,color:"#fff",fontWeight:900,fontSize:13,marginTop:1,transition:"all 0.2s"}}>
                      {isChecked && "âœ“"}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:14,fontWeight:isChecked?700:400,color:isChecked?"#166534":"#1e293b",lineHeight:1.5}}>{item.text}</div>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:3}}>{item.tip}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ))}
          <button onClick={()=>setInspectChecked({})} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12,cursor:"pointer",textDecoration:"underline",fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Reset checklist</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ GEAR CALCULATOR â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="gear" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>âš™ï¸ Gear Ratio & RPM Calculator</div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:14,marginBottom:18}}>
            <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:10}}>MOTOR PRESET</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
                {MOTOR_PRESETS.map(m=>(
                  <button key={m.name} onClick={()=>setFreeRPM(String(m.rpm))}
                    style={{background:freeRPM===String(m.rpm)?"#eff6ff":"#f8fafc",border:"1.5px solid " + (freeRPM===String(m.rpm)?"#93c5fd":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:7,padding:"6px 10px",cursor:"pointer",textAlign:"left",fontSize:12,fontWeight:freeRPM===String(m.rpm)?700:400,fontFamily:"inherit",color:freeRPM===String(m.rpm)?"#1d4ed8":"#374151"}}>
                    {m.name} â€” {m.rpm} RPM
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:12}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:10}}>INPUTS</div>
                <div style={{marginBottom:10}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Input (driver) teeth / diameter</div>
                  <input type="number" value={gearIn} onChange={e=>setGearIn(e.target.value)} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}} />
                </div>
                <div style={{marginBottom:10}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Output (driven) teeth / diameter</div>
                  <input type="number" value={gearOut} onChange={e=>setGearOut(e.target.value)} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Motor free speed (RPM)</div>
                  <input type="number" value={freeRPM} onChange={e=>setFreeRPM(e.target.value)} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#1d4ed8)",borderRadius:14,padding:18,color:"#fff"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.7,marginBottom:6,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:1}}>Results</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:26,fontWeight:900,marginBottom:4}}>{outputRPM.toFixed(0)} RPM</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:14,opacity:0.85,marginBottom:8}}>{reductionStr}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,opacity:0.75}}>
                  Operating speed (80%): <b>{(outputRPM*0.8).toFixed(0)} RPM</b>
                </div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.65,marginTop:6}}>
                  Surface speed (4" wheel): {((outputRPM * Math.PI * 4) / 12 / 60 * 0.8).toFixed(1)} ft/s
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",lineHeight:1.7}}>
            <strong>Tips:</strong> For drive trains, target 12â€“16 ft/s. For arms/lifts, prioritize torque over speed. A higher gear ratio = more torque, lower speed. The 80% operating speed is a common approximation for loaded operation.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ MATCH TIMER â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="timer" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:16}}>â± FRC Match Timer (2:30)</div>
          <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg," + (phaseColor) + "dd," + (phaseColor) + ")",borderRadius:18,padding:28,color:"#fff",textAlign:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:13,opacity:0.8,textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:2,marginBottom:6}}>{currentPhaseInfo.phase?.toUpperCase() || "PRE-MATCH"}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:72,fontWeight:900,fontFamily:"monospace",lineHeight:1,marginBottom:8}}>
              {String(Math.floor(timeRemaining/60)).padStart(1,"0")}:{String(timeRemaining%60).padStart(2,"0")}
            </div>
            <div style={{fontSize:15,opacity:0.9,marginBottom:16}}>{currentPhaseInfo.note}</div>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,justifyContent:"center"}}>
              <button onClick={()=>setRunning(r=>!r)}
                style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.25)",border:"2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5)",color:"#fff",padding:"10px 28px",borderRadius:10,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                {running?"â¸ Pause":"â–¶ Start"}
              </button>
              <button onClick={()=>{setElapsed(0);setRunning(false);}}
                style={{background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",border:"2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3)",color:"#fff",padding:"10px 20px",borderRadius:10,cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                â†º Reset
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:12,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",overflow:"hidden"}}>
            <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",padding:"10px 16px",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",textTransform:"uppercase",letterSpacing:1}}>Match Timeline</div>
            {MATCH_TIMELINE.map((event,i) => {
              const isPast = elapsed >= event.t;
              const isCurrent = MATCH_TIMELINE.indexOf(currentPhaseInfo) === i;
              return (
                <div key={i} style={{padding:"12px 16px",borderBottom:i<MATCH_TIMELINE.length-1?"1px solid #e2e8f0":"none",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12,background:isCurrent?"#eff6ff":"transparent"}}>
                  <div style={{width:10,height:10,borderRadius:"50%",background:isPast?phaseColor:"#d1d5db",flexShrink:0}}/>
                  <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 10px",fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,color:"#374151",flexShrink:0,minWidth:50,textAlign:"center",fontFamily:"monospace"}}>
                    {String(Math.floor(event.t/60)).padStart(1,"0")}:{String(event.t%60).padStart(2,"0")}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:isCurrent?phaseColor:"#374151"}}>{event.label}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af"}}>{event.note}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ SCOUT SHEET â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="scouting" && <ToolScouting analysisTeam={analysisTeam} autoConsistency={autoConsistency} autoScore={autoScore} brokeDown={brokeDown} climbTime={climbTime} climbed={climbed} cycleCount={cycleCount} defenseEffective={defenseEffective} defenseNotes={defenseNotes} defensePenalties={defensePenalties} defenseTarget={defenseTarget} driverSkill={driverSkill} offenseRating={offenseRating} playedDefense={playedDefense} reliability={reliability} robotSpeed={robotSpeed} scoringZone={scoringZone} scoutMatch={scoutMatch} scoutNotes={scoutNotes} scoutTeam={scoutTeam} scoutView={scoutView} teleopScore={teleopScore} scoutSaved={scoutSaved} scoutReset={scoutReset} setAnalysisTeam={setAnalysisTeam} setAutoConsistency={setAutoConsistency} setAutoScore={setAutoScore} setBrokeDown={setBrokeDown} setClimbTime={setClimbTime} setClimbed={setClimbed} setCycleCount={setCycleCount} setDefenseEffective={setDefenseEffective} setDefenseNotes={setDefenseNotes} setDefensePenalties={setDefensePenalties} setDefenseTarget={setDefenseTarget} setDriverSkill={setDriverSkill} setOffenseRating={setOffenseRating} setPlayedDefense={setPlayedDefense} setReliability={setReliability} setRobotSpeed={setRobotSpeed} setScoringZone={setScoringZone} setScoutMatch={setScoutMatch} setScoutNotes={setScoutNotes} setScoutTeam={setScoutTeam} setScoutView={setScoutView} setTeleopScore={setTeleopScore} />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ ALLIANCE PICKER â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="alliance" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ¤ Alliance Picker</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16}}>Enter candidate teams, compare stats, and build your ideal alliance.</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
            {allianceTeams.map((team,i)=>(
              <div key={i} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:10,color:"#1d4ed8"}}>ðŸ¤– Robot {i+1}</div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(120px,1fr))",gap:8}}>
                  {[["Team #","num","e.g. 4512"],["OPR","opr","e.g. 42"],["Auto Pts","auto","e.g. 15"],["Teleop Pts","teleop","e.g. 30"],["Climb","climb","none/low/high"]].map(([label,key,ph])=>(
                    <div key={key}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>{label}</div>
                      <input value={team[key]} onChange={e=>{const t=[...allianceTeams];t[i]={...t[i],[key]:e.target.value};setAllianceTeams(t);}}
                        placeholder={ph} style={{width:"100%",padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>Notes</div>
                    <input value={team.notes} onChange={e=>{const t=[...allianceTeams];t[i]={...t[i],notes:e.target.value};setAllianceTeams(t);}}
                      placeholder="Strengths/weaknesses" style={{width:"100%",padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            <button onClick={()=>setAllianceTeams([...allianceTeams,{num:"",opr:"",auto:"",teleop:"",climb:"",notes:""}])}
              style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+ Add Robot</button>
            {allianceTeams.length>3&&<button onClick={()=>setAllianceTeams(allianceTeams.slice(0,-1))}
              style={{background:"#ef4444",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>âˆ’ Remove Last</button>}
          </div>
          {/* Alliance summary */}
          {allianceTeams.some(t=>t.num) && (
            <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#1d4ed8)",borderRadius:14,padding:20,color:"#fff"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ“Š Alliance Summary</div>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(140px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
                {[
                  ["Total Projected Auto", allianceTeams.reduce((s,t)=>s+(parseFloat(t.auto)||0),0).toFixed(0)+" pts"],
                  ["Total Projected Teleop", allianceTeams.reduce((s,t)=>s+(parseFloat(t.teleop)||0),0).toFixed(0)+" pts"],
                  ["Combined OPR", allianceTeams.reduce((s,t)=>s+(parseFloat(t.opr)||0),0).toFixed(1)],
                  ["Climbers", allianceTeams.filter(t=>t.climb&&t.climb!=="none"&&t.climb!=="").length+"/"+allianceTeams.length],
                ].map(([label,val])=>(
                  <div key={label} style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px"}}>
                    <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.7,marginBottom:2}}>{label}</div>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18}}>{val}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div style={{marginTop:12,fontSize:12,opacity:0.7}}>
                Teams: {allianceTeams.filter(t=>t.num).map(t=>"#"+t.num).join(" + ")}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ PIT SCOUT â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="pitscout" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ—ï¸ Pit Scouting Form</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16}}>Record robot capabilities during pit visits at competition.</div>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:16}}>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:12}}>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Team Number</div>
                <input value={pitTeam} onChange={e=>setPitTeam(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 4512"
                  style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Drive Train</div>
                <select value={pitDrive} onChange={e=>setPitDrive(e.target.value)}
                  style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
                  {["tank","mecanum","swerve","h-drive","other"].map(d=><option key={d} value={d}>{d.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+d.slice(1)}</option>)}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{marginBottom:12}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:6}}>Autonomous Capabilities</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:6}}>
                {["Leave Zone","Score Low","Score High","Multi-element","Vision","Center Spike","Both Spikes"].map(cap=>(
                  <button key={cap} onClick={()=>setPitAuto(prev=>prev.includes(cap)?prev.filter(c=>c!==cap):[...prev,cap])}
                    style={{background:pitAuto.includes(cap)?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:pitAuto.includes(cap)?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"6px 12px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:600,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                    {cap}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{marginBottom:12}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:6}}>Teleop Capabilities</div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:6}}>
                {["Ground Intake","Low Goal","Mid Goal","High Goal","Defense","Fast Cycles","Feeder Station","Amp","Speaker","Trap"].map(cap=>(
                  <button key={cap} onClick={()=>setPitTeleop(prev=>prev.includes(cap)?prev.filter(c=>c!==cap):[...prev,cap])}
                    style={{background:pitTeleop.includes(cap)?"#7c3aed":"#f1f5f9",color:pitTeleop.includes(cap)?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"6px 12px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:600,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                    {cap}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:12}}>
              <div>

                ))}

      {/* â”€â”€ MATCH PLANNER â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="matchplan" && (

          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12,marginBottom:12}}>
            <div style={{background:"#fef2f2",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #fecaca"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,color:"#dc2626",marginBottom:8}}>ðŸ”´ Red Alliance</div>
              {mpRed.map((t,i)=>(
                <input key={i} value={t} onChange={e=>{const a=[...mpRed];a[i]=e.target.value;setMpRed(a);}}

            </div>
            <div style={{background:"#eff6ff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"1px solid #bfdbfe"}}>

          </div>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:12}}>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:10}}>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ¤– Autonomous Plan</div>
                <textarea value={mpAutoStrat} onChange={e=>setMpAutoStrat(e.target.value)} rows={3}

                    {l}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={()=>{

            setMpAutoStrat(""); setMpTeleopStrat(""); setMpPriority(""); setMpDefense("none");
          }} style={{background:"#374151",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 22px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit",marginBottom:20}}>

          </button>
          {mpSaved.length>0&&(

              <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}>ðŸ“ Saved Plans ({mpSaved.length})</div>
              {mpSaved.map((p,i)=>(
                <div key={i} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 16px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:8}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,marginBottom:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:700,color:"#dc2626"}}>ðŸ”´ {p.red.filter(Boolean).join(", ")||"?"}</span>
                    <span style={{color:"#9ca3af"}}>vs</span>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:700,color:"#1d4ed8"}}>ðŸ”µ {p.blue.filter(Boolean).join(", ")||"?"}</span>

      {/* â”€â”€ BATTERY TRACKER â”€â”€ */}

          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
            {batteries.map((bat,i)=>(
              <div key={bat.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:14,border:"2px solid " + (bat.charged?"#16a34a":"#e2e8f0"),display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                <div style={{width:40,height:40,borderRadius:10,background:bat.charged?"#16a34a":"#9ca3af",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",color:"#fff",fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,flexShrink:0}}>

                  <div>

                    <input type="number" step="0.1" value={bat.voltage} onChange={e=>{const b=[...batteries];b[i]={...b[i],voltage:e.target.value};setBatteries(b);}}
                      placeholder="12.5" style={{width:"100%",padding:"6px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                  </div>

                    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>Cycles Used</div>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:6}}>
                      <button onClick={()=>{const b=[...batteries];b[i]={...b[i],cycles:Math.max(0,b[i].cycles-1)};setBatteries(b);}}
                        style={{background:"#f1f5f9",border:"none",borderRadius:5,padding:"4px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700}}>-</button>
                      <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,minWidth:24,textAlign:"center"}}>{bat.cycles}</span>
                      <button onClick={()=>{const b=[...batteries];b[i]={...b[i],cycles:b[i].cycles+1};setBatteries(b);}}
                        style={{background:"#f1f5f9",border:"none",borderRadius:5,padding:"4px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700}}>+</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>Notes</div>
                    <input value={bat.notes} onChange={e=>{const b=[...batteries];b[i]={...b[i],notes:e.target.value};setBatteries(b);}}

                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:5}}>Status</div>
                  <button onClick={()=>{const b=[...batteries];b[i]={...b[i],charged:!b[i].charged,cycles:b[i].charged?b[i].cycles:b[i].cycles};setBatteries(b);}}
                    style={{background:bat.charged?"#16a34a":"#f1f5f9",color:bat.charged?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>
                    {bat.charged?"âœ… Charged":"â¬œ Needs Charge"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

              style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>+ Add Battery</button>
          </div>
          <div style={{marginTop:16,background:"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:10,padding:12,border:"1px solid #bbf7d0",fontSize:13}}>
            <strong>Summary:</strong> {batteries.filter(b=>b.charged).length}/{batteries.length} charged Â· 
            Average voltage: {batteries.filter(b=>b.voltage).length ? (batteries.filter(b=>b.voltage).reduce((s,b)=>s+parseFloat(b.voltage||0),0)/batteries.filter(b=>b.voltage).length).toFixed(2)+"V" : "N/A"}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ WEIGHT ESTIMATOR â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="weight" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>âš–ï¸ Robot Weight Budget</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16}}>Track your robot's weight by component. FRC limit is 125 lbs (without battery). FTC limit is 42 lbs.</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:16,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:13,fontWeight:700}}>Weight Limit:</div>
            {[["125","FRC (125 lbs)"],["42","FTC (42 lbs)"],["custom","Custom"]].map(([v,l])=>(
              <button key={v} onClick={()=>setWeightLimit(v==="custom"?weightLimit:v)}
                style={{background:weightLimit===v?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:weightLimit===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:600,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                {l}
              </button>
            ))}
            <input type="number" value={weightLimit} onChange={e=>setWeightLimit(e.target.value)}
              style={{width:70,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
            <span style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280"}}>lbs</span>
          </div>
          {(() => {
            const total = weightParts.reduce((s,p)=>s+(parseFloat(p.lbs)||0),0);
            const limit = parseFloat(weightLimit)||125;
            const pct = Math.min(100, total/limit*100);
            const over = total > limit;
            return (
              <>
                <div style={{background:over?"#fef2f2":"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"2px solid " + (over?"#fecaca":"#bbf7d0"),marginBottom:16}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:8}}>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18,color:over?"#dc2626":"#16a34a"}}>{total.toFixed(1)} lbs</span>
                    <span style={{fontSize:14,color:"#6b7280"}}>{over?"âš ï¸ OVER by "+(total-limit).toFixed(1)+" lbs":"âœ… "+(limit-total).toFixed(1)+" lbs remaining"}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{background:"#e5e7eb",borderRadius:999,height:12,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                    <div style={{width:pct+"%",background:over?"#ef4444":pct>90?"#f59e0b":"#16a34a",height:"100%",borderRadius:999,transition:"width 0.3s"}}></div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:4}}>{pct.toFixed(0)}% of {limit} lb limit</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6,marginBottom:14}}>
                  {weightParts.map((p,i)=>(
                    <div key={i} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10}}>
                      <div style={{flex:1,background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:6}}>
                        <input value={p.name} onChange={e=>{const parts=[...weightParts];parts[i]={...parts[i],name:e.target.value};setWeightParts(parts);}}
                          style={{width:"100%",padding:"4px 8px",border:"none",background:"transparent",fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                      </div>
                      <input type="number" step="0.1" value={p.lbs} onChange={e=>{const parts=[...weightParts];parts[i]={...parts[i],lbs:e.target.value};setWeightParts(parts);}}
                        style={{width:70,padding:"6px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit",textAlign:"right"}}/>
                      <span style={{fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",width:25}}>lbs</span>
                      <div style={{width:60,background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:5,height:8,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                        <div style={{width:Math.min(100,(parseFloat(p.lbs)||0)/limit*100)+"%",background:"#1d4ed8",height:"100%"}}></div>
                      </div>
                      <button onClick={()=>setWeightParts(weightParts.filter((_,j)=>j!==i))}
                        style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:16}}>âœ•</button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8}}>
                  <input value={newPartName} onChange={e=>setNewPartName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Component name"
                    style={{flex:1,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                  <input type="number" value={newPartLbs} onChange={e=>setNewPartLbs(e.target.value)} placeholder="lbs" step="0.1"
                    style={{width:70,padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                  <button onClick={()=>{if(!newPartName.trim())return;setWeightParts([...weightParts,{name:newPartName,lbs:newPartLbs}]);setNewPartName("");setNewPartLbs("");}}
                    style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>Add</button>
                </div>
              </>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ DRIVER PRACTICE â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="driver" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸŽ® Driver Practice Challenges</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16}}>Time yourself on driving challenges to improve accuracy, speed, and consistency.</div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr))",gap:10,marginBottom:20}}>
            {DP_CHALLENGES.map((ch,i)=>(
              <div key={ch.id} onClick={()=>{setDpChallenge(i);setDpRunning(false);setDpTime(0);}}
                style={{background:dpChallenge===i?"#eff6ff":"#fff",border:"2px solid " + (dpChallenge===i?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:12,padding:14,cursor:"pointer",transition:"all 0.15s"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:dpChallenge===i?"#1d4ed8":"#1e293b",marginBottom:4}}>{ch.name}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#6b7280",lineHeight:1.4,marginBottom:6}}>{ch.desc}</div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
                  <span style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af"}}>Goal: &lt;{ch.goal}s</span>
                  {dpBests[ch.id]&&<span style={{fontSize:12,fontWeight:800,color:dpBests[ch.id]<=ch.goal?"#16a34a":"#f59e0b"}}>Best: {dpBests[ch.id]}s</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {/* Active challenge */}
          {(() => {
            const ch = DP_CHALLENGES[dpChallenge];
            const best = dpBests[ch.id];
            const underGoal = dpTime > 0 && dpTime <= ch.goal;
            return (
              <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a,#1e3a8a)",borderRadius:16,padding:24,color:"#fff",textAlign:"center"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:14,opacity:0.7,marginBottom:4}}>Current Challenge</div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,marginBottom:8}}>{ch.name}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,opacity:0.7,marginBottom:20,maxWidth:400,margin:"0 auto 20px"}}>{ch.desc}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:64,fontWeight:900,fontFamily:"monospace",letterSpacing:-2,color:dpRunning?"#fbbf24":"#fff",marginBottom:20}}>
                  {dpTime.toFixed(1)}s
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,justifyContent:"center",marginBottom:16}}>
                  {!dpRunning ? (
                    <button onClick={startDpChallenge}
                      style={{background:"#10b981",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"14px 32px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                      â–¶ Start Timer
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button onClick={stopDpChallenge}
                      style={{background:"#ef4444",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"14px 32px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                      â¹ Stop
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button onClick={()=>{clearInterval(dpRef.current);setDpRunning(false);setDpTime(0);}}
                    style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",color:"#fff",border:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",borderRadius:10,padding:"14px 20px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                    Reset
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:16,justifyContent:"center",fontSize:13,opacity:0.8}}>
                  <span>ðŸŽ¯ Goal: {ch.goal}s</span>
                  {best&&<span>ðŸ† Best: {best}s {best<=ch.goal?"âœ…":""}</span>}
                  {dpTime>0&&!dpRunning&&<span style={{color:underGoal?"#34d399":"#fbbf24"}}>{underGoal?"ðŸŽ‰ Goal Met!":"Keep practicing!"}</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
      )}
      {/* â”€â”€ BUILD LOG â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="buildlog" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ““ Build Log</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16}}>Record what your team builds, fixes, and learns every meeting. Great for Chairman's Award and engineering notebooks.</div>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:16}}>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:10}}>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Date</div>

                  {[["build","ðŸ”§ Build"],["code","ðŸ’» Code"],["design","ðŸ“ Design"],["test","ðŸ§ª Testing"],["strategy","ðŸŽ¯ Strategy"],["other","ðŸ“ Other"]].map(([v,l])=>
                    <option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
                </select>

            </div>

            </div>

              <div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Who worked on it?</div>
                <input value={logWho} onChange={e=>setLogWho(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Alex, Jamie, whole team"
                  style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Issues / blockers?</div>
                <input value={logIssues} onChange={e=>setLogIssues(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Waiting on bolts, belt keeps slipping"

              </div>
            </div>
            <button onClick={saveLogEntry} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 22px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>

            </button>

                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:6,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13}}>{e.date}</span>
                    <span style={{background:{build:"#dbeafe",code:"#d1fae5",design:"#fef3c7",test:"#fce7f3",strategy:"#ede9fe",other:"#f3f4f6"}[e.category]||"#f3f4f6",
                      color:{build:"#1e40af",code:"#065f46",design:"#92400e",test:"#9d174d",strategy:"#4c1d95",other:"#374151"}[e.category]||"#374151",
                      borderRadius:6,padding:"2px 8px",fontSize:12,fontWeight:700}}>
                      {{build:"ðŸ”§ Build",code:"ðŸ’» Code",design:"ðŸ“ Design",test:"ðŸ§ª Test",strategy:"ðŸŽ¯ Strategy",other:"ðŸ“ Other"}[e.category]}
                    </span>
                    {e.who&&<span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¤ {e.who}</span>}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#1e293b",marginBottom:e.issues?4:0}}>{e.what}</div>
                  {e.issues&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#ef4444"}}>âš ï¸ {e.issues}</div>}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ PARTS CALCULATOR â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="partscalc" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ”© Parts Calculator</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16}}>Calculate gear ratios, belt lengths, chain links, and robot speed.</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
            {[["gear","âš™ï¸ Gear Ratio"],["belt","ðŸ“ Belt Length"],["chain","ðŸ”— Chain Links"],["speed","ðŸš€ Robot Speed"]].map(([v,l])=>(
              <button key={v} onClick={()=>setPartsCalcMode(v)}
                style={{background:partsCalcMode===v?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:partsCalcMode===v?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 18px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                {l}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {partsCalcMode==="gear" && (() => {
            const ratio = (parseFloat(pcGearOut)||1)/(parseFloat(pcGearIn)||1);
            const outRPM = (parseFloat(pcRPM)||0)/ratio;
            const torqueMult = ratio;
            return (
              <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:14}}>âš™ï¸ Gear / Sprocket Ratio</div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
                  {[["Driver Teeth / Radius",pcGearIn,setPcGearIn,"e.g. 12"],["Driven Teeth / Radius",pcGearOut,setPcGearOut,"e.g. 60"],["Motor Free RPM",pcRPM,setPcRPM,"e.g. 6000"]].map(([label,val,set,ph])=>(
                    <div key={label}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>{label}</div>
                      <input type="number" value={val} onChange={e=>set(e.target.value)} placeholder={ph}
                        style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                  {[["Gear Ratio",ratio.toFixed(3)+":1","#1d4ed8"],["Output RPM",outRPM.toFixed(0)+" RPM","#7c3aed"],["Torque Multiplier",torqueMult.toFixed(2)+"Ã—","#059669"]].map(([l,v,c])=>(
                    <div key={l} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:10,padding:14,textAlign:"center",border:"2px solid " + (c) + "20"}}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:4}}>{l}</div>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,color:c}}>{v}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{marginTop:14,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:8,padding:10}}>
                  A {ratio.toFixed(2)}:1 reduction means {ratio.toFixed(1)}Ã— more torque but {ratio.toFixed(1)}Ã— less speed. {ratio>5?"High reduction â€” good for lifting.":ratio>2?"Moderate reduction â€” good for arms.":"Low reduction â€” good for driving fast."}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
          {partsCalcMode==="belt" && (() => {
            const t1 = parseFloat(pcTeeth1)||16, t2 = parseFloat(pcTeeth2)||32;
            const c = parseFloat(pcCenter)||150, pitch = parseFloat(pcPitch)||5;
            const links = Math.round(2*(c/pitch) + (t1+t2)/2 + ((t2-t1)/(2*Math.PI))**2*(pitch/c));
            const actualC = (pitch*(2*links - t1 - t2 + Math.sqrt((2*links-t1-t2)**2 - (t2-t1)**2/Math.PI**2)))/4;
            return (
              <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:14}}>ðŸ“ Belt Length Calculator</div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
                  {[["Pulley 1 Teeth",pcTeeth1,setPcTeeth1,"16"],["Pulley 2 Teeth",pcTeeth2,setPcTeeth2,"32"],["Center Distance (mm)",pcCenter,setPcCenter,"150"],["Belt Pitch (mm)",pcPitch,setPcPitch,"5"]].map(([l,v,s,ph])=>(
                    <div key={l}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>{l}</div>
                      <input type="number" value={v} onChange={e=>s(e.target.value)} placeholder={ph}
                        style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                  {[["Belt Links Needed",links+" links","#1d4ed8"],["Actual Center Distance",actualC.toFixed(1)+" mm","#059669"]].map(([l,v,c])=>(
                    <div key={l} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:10,padding:14,textAlign:"center"}}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:4}}>{l}</div>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,color:c}}>{v}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{marginTop:12,fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>Note: Always round UP to the nearest even number of links for standard belt sizing.</div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
          {partsCalcMode==="chain" && (() => {
            const t1=parseFloat(pcTeeth1)||16, t2=parseFloat(pcTeeth2)||32, c=parseFloat(pcCenter)||150;
            const pitch = 25.4/parseFloat(pcPitch||"1"); // #25 = 6.35mm, #35 = 9.525mm
            const links = Math.round(2*(c/6.35) + (t1+t2)/2);
            return (
              <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:14}}>ðŸ”— Chain Links Calculator (#25 Chain)</div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
                  {[["Sprocket 1 Teeth",pcTeeth1,setPcTeeth1,"16"],["Sprocket 2 Teeth",pcTeeth2,setPcTeeth2,"32"],["Center Distance (mm)",pcCenter,setPcCenter,"150"]].map(([l,v,s,ph])=>(
                    <div key={l}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>{l}</div>
                      <input type="number" value={v} onChange={e=>s(e.target.value)} placeholder={ph}
                        style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                    </div>
                  ))}
