                <div style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:10,padding:14,textAlign:"center"}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:4}}>Chain Links Needed (#25)</div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:28,color:"#1d4ed8"}}>{links} links</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:4}}>Round to even number Â· Ratio: {t2>t1?(t2/t1).toFixed(2):( t1/t2).toFixed(2)}:1</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
          {partsCalcMode==="speed" && (() => {
            const rpm = parseFloat(pcRPM)||6000;
            const ratio = (parseFloat(pcGearOut)||60)/(parseFloat(pcGearIn)||12);
            const dia = parseFloat(pcWheelDia)||4;
            const outRPM = rpm/ratio;
            const speedFPS = outRPM * Math.PI * (dia/12) / 60;
            const speedMPS = speedFPS * 0.3048;
            return (
              <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:18,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:14}}>ðŸš€ Robot Speed Calculator</div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:16}}>
                  {[["Motor Free RPM",pcRPM,setPcRPM,"6000"],["Driver Teeth",pcGearIn,setPcGearIn,"12"],["Driven Teeth",pcGearOut,setPcGearOut,"60"],["Wheel Diameter (in)",pcWheelDia,setPcWheelDia,"4"]].map(([l,v,s,ph])=>(
                    <div key={l}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>{l}</div>
                      <input type="number" value={v} onChange={e=>s(e.target.value)} placeholder={ph}
                        style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10}}>
                  {[["Output RPM",outRPM.toFixed(0)+" RPM","#7c3aed"],["Speed (ft/s)",speedFPS.toFixed(1)+" ft/s","#1d4ed8"],["Speed (m/s)",speedMPS.toFixed(2)+" m/s","#059669"]].map(([l,v,c])=>(
                    <div key={l} style={{background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:10,padding:14,textAlign:"center",border:"2px solid " + (c) + "20"}}>
                      <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginBottom:4}}>{l}</div>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22,color:c}}>{v}</div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div style={{marginTop:14,fontSize:13,color:"#6b7280",background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:8,padding:10}}>
                  {speedFPS>20?"âš¡ Very fast â€” may sacrifice pushing power.":speedFPS>14?"âœ… Good competition speed.":speedFPS>8?"âš ï¸ Moderate â€” consider reducing ratio for more speed.":"ðŸ¢ Slow â€” increase ratio or wheel size for more speed."}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ MOTOR COMPARISON â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="motorcomp" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>âš¡ Motor Comparison</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Compare stall torque, free speed, and weight for common FRC and FTC motors.</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:14}}>
            {["ALL","FRC","FTC"].map(f=>(
              <button key={f} onClick={()=>setMotorFilter(f)}
                style={{background:motorFilter===f?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:motorFilter===f?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                {f}
              </button>
            ))}
            <span style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:12,alignSelf:"center",marginLeft:8}}>Sort by:</span>
            {[["stall","Stall Torque"],["free","Free Speed"],["weight","Weight"]].map(([k,l])=>(
              <button key={k} onClick={()=>setMotorSort(k)}
                style={{background:motorSort===k?"#7c3aed":"#f1f5f9",color:motorSort===k?"#fff":"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:7,padding:"7px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                {l}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6,marginBottom:16}}>
            {[...MOTORS]
              .filter(m=>motorFilter==="ALL"||m.type===motorFilter)
              .sort((a,b)=>motorSort==="weight"?a.weight-b.weight:b[motorSort]-a[motorSort])
              .map((m,i)=>{
                const picked = motorPicked.includes(m.name);
                const maxStall = Math.max(...MOTORS.map(x=>x.stall));
                const maxFree = Math.max(...MOTORS.map(x=>x.free));
                return (
                  <div key={m.name} onClick={()=>setMotorPicked(prev=>prev.includes(m.name)?prev.filter(n=>n!==m.name):[...prev,m.name])}
                    style={{background:picked?"#eff6ff":"#fff",border:"2px solid " + (picked?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 16px",cursor:"pointer",transition:"all 0.15s"}}>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"center",marginBottom:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14,flex:1}}>{m.name}</div>
                      <span style={{fontSize:11,background:m.type==="FRC"?"#dbeafe":"#d1fae5",color:m.type==="FRC"?"#1e40af":"#065f46",borderRadius:5,padding:"2px 7px",fontWeight:700}}>{m.type}</span>
                      <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{m.weight} kg</span>
                    </div>
                    <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:8}}>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>Stall Torque: {m.stall} NÂ·m</div>
                        <div style={{background:"#e5e7eb",borderRadius:999,height:8,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                          <div style={{width:(m.stall/maxStall*100)+"%",background:"#ef4444",height:"100%",borderRadius:999}}/>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:3}}>Free Speed: {m.free.toLocaleString()} RPM</div>
                        <div style={{background:"#e5e7eb",borderRadius:999,height:8,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                          <div style={{width:(m.free/maxFree*100)+"%",background:"#3b82f6",height:"100%",borderRadius:999}}/>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
          </div>
          {motorPicked.length>=2 && (
            <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#4c1d95)",borderRadius:14,padding:18,color:"#fff"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ“Š Comparison: {motorPicked.join(" vs ")}</div>
              <div style={{overflowX:"auto"}}>
                <table style={{width:"100%",borderCollapse:"collapse",fontSize:13}}>
                  <thead>
                    <tr>{["Metric",...motorPicked].map(h=><th key={h} style={{textAlign:"left",padding:"6px 10px",borderBottom:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",fontWeight:700,whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{h}</th>)}</tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {[["Stall Torque (NÂ·m)","stall"],["Free Speed (RPM)","free"],["Stall Current (A)","stallA"],["Free Current (A)","freeA"],["Weight (kg)","weight"]].map(([label,key])=>(
                      <tr key={key}>
                        <td style={{padding:"6px 10px",opacity:0.7,whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{label}</td>
                        {motorPicked.map(name=>{
                          const m = MOTORS.find(x=>x.name===name);
                          const vals = motorPicked.map(n=>MOTORS.find(x=>x.name===n)?.[key]||0);
                          const best = key==="weight"?Math.min(...vals):Math.max(...vals);
                          return <td key={name} style={{padding:"6px 10px",fontWeight:m?.[key]===best?900:400,color:m?.[key]===best?"#fbbf24":"#fff"}}>{m?.[key]}</td>;
                        })}
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.6,marginTop:8}}>ðŸ† Gold = best in category. Click motors above to change selection.</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ RULES QUIZ â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="rulesquiz" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ“œ FIRST Rules Quiz</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:16}}>Test your knowledge of FRC and FTC rules. 8 random questions each time.</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:12,marginBottom:16}}>
            {rqShuffled.map((q,i)=>(
              <div key={i} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"2px solid " + (rqRevealed?(rqAnswers[i]===q.ans?"#16a34a":"#ef4444"):"#e2e8f0")}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:10}}>Q{i+1}. {q.q}</div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
                  {q.opts.map((opt,j)=>{
                    let bg="#f8fafc", color="#374151", border="1px solid #e2e8f0";
                    if (rqRevealed && j===q.ans) { bg="#dcfce7"; color="#166534"; border="1px solid #86efac"; }
                    else if (rqRevealed && rqAnswers[i]===j && j!==q.ans) { bg="#fef2f2"; color="#991b1b"; border="1px solid #fca5a5"; }
                    else if (!rqRevealed && rqAnswers[i]===j) { bg="#eff6ff"; color="#1e40af"; border="1px solid #93c5fd"; }
                    return (
                      <button key={j} onClick={()=>!rqRevealed&&setRqAnswers(prev=>({...prev,[i]:j}))}
                        style={{background:bg,color,border,borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 12px",textAlign:"left",cursor:rqRevealed?"default":"pointer",fontFamily:"inherit",fontSize:13}}>
                        {["A","B","C","D"][j]}. {opt}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
                {rqRevealed&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",marginTop:8}}>ðŸ“– Source: {q.source}</div>}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          {!rqRevealed ? (
            <button onClick={()=>setRqRevealed(true)}
              style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 28px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
              Submit & See Results
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div style={{background:"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:12,padding:16,border:"1px solid #bbf7d0",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:16}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:40}}>
                {Object.keys(rqAnswers).filter(i=>rqAnswers[i]===rqShuffled[i].ans).length >= 7?"ðŸ†":
                 Object.keys(rqAnswers).filter(i=>rqAnswers[i]===rqShuffled[i].ans).length >= 5?"âœ…":"ðŸ“š"}
              </div>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18}}>
                  {Object.keys(rqAnswers).filter(i=>rqAnswers[i]===rqShuffled[i].ans).length}/{rqShuffled.length} Correct
                </div>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#16a34a"}}>
                  {Object.keys(rqAnswers).filter(i=>rqAnswers[i]===rqShuffled[i].ans).length>=7?"Excellent! You know the rules well.":

              {String(Math.floor(psTime/60)).padStart(2,"0")}:{String(Math.floor(psTime%60)).padStart(2,"0")}.{String(Math.floor((psTime%1)*10))}
            </div>
            <input value={psTask} onChange={e=>setPsTask(e.target.value)} placeholder="What are you fixing? (optional)"
              style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",border:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",color:"#fff",fontSize:14,width:"80%",maxWidth:300,boxSizing:"border-box",marginBottom:16,fontFamily:"inherit",textAlign:"center"}}/>
            <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,justifyContent:"center",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
              {!psRunning ? (
                <button onClick={()=>{setPsRunning(true);psTick();}}
                  style={{background:"#10b981",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"14px 28px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                  â–¶ Start
                </button>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <button onClick={psLap}
                    style={{background:"#f59e0b",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"14px 20px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                    ðŸ“ Split
                  </button>
                  <button onClick={psStop}
                    style={{background:"#ef4444",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"14px 28px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
                    â¹ Stop
                  </button>
                </>
              )}

              </div>

                  </div>

              <div style={{padding:"10px 16px",background:"#eff6ff",display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>

              </div>

          )}
          <div style={{marginTop:14,background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:10,padding:12,fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
            ðŸ’¡ <strong>Pit stop target times:</strong> Battery swap: &lt;60s Â· Code deploy: &lt;3min Â· Bumper swap: &lt;5min Â· Chain replacement: &lt;10min Â· Motor swap: &lt;15min
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {tool==="checklist" && (

          <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1d4ed8,#7c3aed)",borderRadius:12,padding:16,color:"#fff",marginBottom:16,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:16}}>

              <div style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",borderRadius:999,height:12,overflow:"hidden"}}>

                        {done&&<span style={{color:"#fff",fontSize:14,fontWeight:900}}>âœ“</span>}

                    </div>

            <div style={{fontSize:20,fontWeight:900,marginBottom:3}}>ðŸ” Live Cycle Counter</div>

          </div>
          <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:12}}>

              <input value={cycleTeam} onChange={e=>setCycleTeam(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. 4512" style={{width:"100%",padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
            <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Match #</div>

              )}

            </div>

            <svg viewBox="0 0 100 60" style={{width:"100%",height:"auto",display:"block"}}>
              <rect x="0" y="0" width="100" height="60" fill={autoGameType==="ftc"?"#1a3a1a":"#1a1a3a"} rx="2"/>
              <rect x="1" y="1" width="98" height="58" fill="none" stroke={autoGameType==="ftc"?"#22c55e":"#3b82f6"} strokeWidth="0.5"/>
              <line x1="50" y1="0" x2="50" y2="60" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.15)" strokeWidth="0.3"/>
              <rect x="0" y="0" width="15" height="60" fill="rgba(59,130,246,0.1)"/>
              <rect x="85" y="0" width="15" height="60" fill="rgba(239,68,68,0.1)"/>
              <text x="7.5" y="30" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="3" fill="rgba(59,130,246,0.6)" fontWeight="bold">BLUE</text>
              <text x="92.5" y="30" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="3" fill="rgba(239,68,68,0.6)" fontWeight="bold">RED</text>

                <line key={"l" + (i)} x1={autoWaypoints[i-1].x} y1={autoWaypoints[i-1].y} x2={autoWaypoints[i].x} y2={autoWaypoints[i].y} stroke="#fbbf24" strokeWidth="0.8" strokeDasharray="1.5,1" opacity="0.8"/>

                  <select value={autoActions[wp.id]||""} onChange={e=>setAutoActions(prev=>({...prev,[wp.id]:e.target.value}))} style={{padding:"4px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
