            <button onClick={()=>navigator.clipboard?.writeText(notepadText)} style={{background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#374151",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>ðŸ“‹ Copy</button>
            <button onClick={()=>{setNotepadText("");localStorage.setItem("hub-notepad","");}} style={{background:"#fee2e2",color:"#991b1b",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"9px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>ðŸ—‘ Clear</button>
            <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",alignSelf:"center",marginLeft:"auto"}}>âœ… Auto-saved Â· {notepadText.length} chars</div>
          </div>
          {notepadPinned.length>0&&(
            <div><div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:8}}>ðŸ“Œ Pinned Notes</div>
              {notepadPinned.map((p,i)=>(
                <div key={p.ts} style={{background:"#fffbeb",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",border:"2px solid #fde68a",display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"flex-start",marginBottom:6}}>
                  <div style={{flex:1,fontSize:13,lineHeight:1.6,fontFamily:"monospace",whiteSpace:"pre-wrap"}}>{p.text}</div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4,flexShrink:0}}>
                    <button onClick={()=>setNotepadText(p.text)} style={{background:"#fbbf24",color:"#0f172a",border:"none",borderRadius:6,padding:"3px 8px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>â†© Load</button>
                    <button onClick={()=>{const u=notepadPinned.filter((_,j)=>j!==i);setNotepadPinned(u);localStorage.setItem("hub-notepad-pins",JSON.stringify(u));}} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14}}>âœ•</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ QUICK QUIZ â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="flashcard2" && <ToolFlashcard2 />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ INCIDENT LOG â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="injurylog" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ©¹ Safety Incident Log</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Document near-misses and incidents. All data stays on this device.</div>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,border:"2px solid #fee2e2",padding:16,marginBottom:16}}>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:10}}>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Type</div>
                <select value={incType} onChange={e=>setIncType(e.target.value)} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
                  {[["near_miss","âš ï¸ Near Miss"],["minor","ðŸ©¹ Minor Injury"],["equipment","ðŸ”§ Equipment"],["fire","ðŸ”¥ Fire"],["electrical","âš¡ Electrical"],["other","ðŸ“ Other"]].map(([v,l])=><option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
                </select></div>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Date</div>
                <input type="date" value={incDate} onChange={e=>setIncDate(e.target.value)} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Person Involved</div>
                <input value={incPerson} onChange={e=>setIncPerson(e.target.value)} placeholder="Name (optional)" style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
            </div>
            <div style={{marginBottom:10}}><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>What Happened *</div>
              <textarea value={incDesc} onChange={e=>setIncDesc(e.target.value)} rows={2} placeholder="Describe the incident..." style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",resize:"vertical",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
            <div style={{marginBottom:12}}><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Corrective Action</div>
              <input value={incAction} onChange={e=>setIncAction(e.target.value)} placeholder="What was done to prevent recurrence?" style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
            <button onClick={addIncident} disabled={!incDesc.trim()} style={{background:"#dc2626",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 22px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit",opacity:incDesc.trim()?1:0.4}}>âš ï¸ Log Incident</button>
          </div>
          {incidents.length>0?(
            <div>
              <div style={{display:"flex",gap:12,marginBottom:12,background:"#fef2f2",borderRadius:10,padding:12,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                {[["âš ï¸ Near Miss",incidents.filter(i=>i.type==="near_miss").length,"#f59e0b"],["ðŸ©¹ Minor",incidents.filter(i=>i.type==="minor").length,"#dc2626"],["ðŸ”§ Equipment",incidents.filter(i=>i.type==="equipment").length,"#6b7280"]].map(([l,n,c])=>(
                  <div key={l} style={{flex:1,textAlign:"center",minWidth:80}}><div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,color:c}}>{n}</div><div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#6b7280"}}>{l}</div></div>
                ))}
              </div>
              {incidents.map(inc=>(
                <div key={inc.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",border:"1px solid #fee2e2",marginBottom:8,display:"flex",gap:10,alignItems:"flex-start"}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:20,flexShrink:0}}>{{near_miss:"âš ï¸",minor:"ðŸ©¹",equipment:"ðŸ”§",fire:"ðŸ”¥",electrical:"âš¡",other:"ðŸ“"}[inc.type]||"ðŸ“"}</div>
                  <div style={{flex:1}}><div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:2}}>{inc.desc}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{inc.date}{inc.person&&" Â· " + (inc.person)}</div>
                    {inc.action&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#059669",marginTop:4}}>âœ… {inc.action}</div>}
                  </div>
                  <button onClick={()=>{const u=incidents.filter(x=>x.id!==inc.id);setIncidents(u);localStorage.setItem("hub-incidents",JSON.stringify(u));}} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14}}>âœ•</button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ):(
            <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:32,color:"#9ca3af",background:"#f8fafc",borderRadius:12}}>âœ… No incidents logged â€” great safety record!</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ SPONSOR TRACKER â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="sponsortracker" && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:17,marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ’° Sponsor Tracker</div>
          <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:13,marginBottom:14}}>Track sponsors and donations. Essential for Chairman's Award documentation.</div>
          {sponsors.length>0&&(
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(130px,1fr))",gap:10,marginBottom:14}}>
              {[["ðŸ’µ Raised","$"+(sponsors.filter(s=>s.type==="monetary").reduce((sum,s)=>sum+s.amount,0)).toLocaleString(),"#059669"],["âœ… Active",sponsors.filter(s=>s.status==="active").length,"#1d4ed8"],["ðŸ“¦ In-Kind",sponsors.filter(s=>s.type==="inkind").length,"#7c3aed"],["ðŸ” Prospects",sponsors.filter(s=>s.status==="prospect").length,"#f59e0b"]].map(([l,v,c])=>(
                <div key={l} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",border:"2px solid " + (c) + "20",textAlign:"center"}}><div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18,color:c}}>{v}</div><div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>{l}</div></div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",padding:16,marginBottom:14}}>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"2fr 1fr 1fr",gap:10,marginBottom:10}}>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Company/Person *</div>
                <input value={spName} onChange={e=>setSpName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. Acme Engineering" style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Amount ($)</div>
                <input type="number" value={spAmount} onChange={e=>setSpAmount(e.target.value)} placeholder="500" style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Type</div>
                <select value={spType} onChange={e=>setSpType(e.target.value)} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
                  <option value="monetary">ðŸ’µ Monetary</option><option value="inkind">ðŸ“¦ In-Kind</option><option value="service">ðŸ› ï¸ Services</option><option value="facility">ðŸ¢ Facility</option>
                </select></div>
            </div>
            <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr 2fr",gap:10,marginBottom:12}}>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Status</div>
                <select value={spStatus} onChange={e=>setSpStatus(e.target.value)} style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
                  <option value="prospect">ðŸ” Prospect</option><option value="contacted">ðŸ“ž Contacted</option><option value="active">âœ… Active</option><option value="declined">âŒ Declined</option><option value="past">ðŸ“ Past</option>
                </select></div>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Contact</div>
                <input value={spContact} onChange={e=>setSpContact(e.target.value)} placeholder="Jane Smith" style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
              <div><div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#9ca3af",marginBottom:4}}>Notes</div>
                <input value={spNotes} onChange={e=>setSpNotes(e.target.value)} placeholder="Follow-up date, conditions..." style={{width:"100%",padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,boxSizing:"border-box",fontFamily:"inherit"}}/></div>
            </div>
            <button onClick={addSponsor} disabled={!spName.trim()} style={{background:"#059669",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 22px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,fontFamily:"inherit",opacity:spName.trim()?1:0.4}}>+ Add Sponsor</button>
          </div>
          {sponsors.length>0&&["active","contacted","prospect","declined","past"].map(status=>{
            const group=sponsors.filter(s=>s.status===status);
            if(!group.length)return null;
            const si={active:["âœ… Active","#059669"],contacted:["ðŸ“ž Contacted","#3b82f6"],prospect:["ðŸ” Prospects","#f59e0b"],declined:["âŒ Declined","#dc2626"],past:["ðŸ“ Past","#6b7280"]}[status];
            return (
              <div key={status} style={{marginBottom:14}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:si[1],marginBottom:8}}>{si[0]} ({group.length})</div>
                {group.map(s=>(
                  <div key={s.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 14px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:6,display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
                    <div style={{flex:1}}><div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14}}>{s.name}</div>
                      {s.contact&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¤ {s.contact}</div>}
                      {s.notes&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{s.notes}</div>}
                    </div>
                    {s.amount>0&&<div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:16,color:"#059669"}}>${s.amount.toLocaleString()}</div>}
                    <select value={s.status} onChange={e=>updateSponsorStatus(s.id,e.target.value)} style={{padding:"5px 8px",borderRadius:6,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
                      {[["prospect","Prospect"],["contacted","Contacted"],["active","Active âœ…"],["declined","Declined"],["past","Past"]].map(([v,l])=><option key={v} value={v}>{l}</option>)}
                    </select>
                    <button onClick={()=>{const u=sponsors.filter(x=>x.id!==s.id);setSponsors(u);localStorage.setItem("hub-sponsors",JSON.stringify(u));}} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:14}}>âœ•</button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* â”€â”€ FASTENER REFERENCE â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="fastenref" && <ToolFastenref />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ MATERIAL SELECTOR â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="materialsel" && <ToolMaterialsel />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ CONTROLLER MAPPER â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="buttonmap" && <ToolButtonmap />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ OPR CALCULATOR â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="oprCalc" && <ToolOprCalc />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ PARTS INVENTORY â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="partsInv" && <ToolPartsInv />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ MAINTENANCE LOG â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="maintLog" && <ToolMaintLog />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ PROTOTYPE TRACKER â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="protoTrack" && <ToolProtoTrack />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ INTERVIEW PREP â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="interviewPrep" && <ToolInterviewPrep />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ REVEAL VIDEO PLANNER â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="revealPlan" && <ToolRevealPlan />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ PRACTICE LOG â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="practiceLog" && <ToolPracticeLog />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ ALLIANCE COMMUNICATION CARDS â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="allianceComm" && <ToolAllianceComm />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ PRE-MATCH CHECKLIST â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="preMatchChk" && <ToolPreMatchChk />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ BATTERY LOG â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="batteryLog" && <ToolBatteryLog />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ SEASON GOALS â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="teamGoals" && <ToolTeamGoals />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ TEAM NOTES BOARD â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="notesBoard" && <ToolNotesBoard />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ TIMER BANK â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="timerBank" && <ToolTimerBank />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ ADVANCED GEAR CALCULATOR â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="gearCalc2" && <ToolGearCalc2 />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ CUSTOM SCOUT FORM â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="scouting2" && <ToolScouting2 />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ ROBOT KNOWLEDGE QUIZ â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="knowledgeQuiz" && <ToolKnowledgeQuiz />})()}

      {/* â”€â”€ FIELD ANNOTATOR â”€â”€ */}
      {tool==="fieldAnnot" && <ToolFieldAnnot />})()}

    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ STUDY PLAN PAGE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function StudyPlanPage({ user, done, totalLessons }) {
  const [plan, setPlan] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [goal, setGoal] = useState("competition");
  const [hoursPerWeek, setHoursPerWeek] = useState(5);
  const [focusSubjects, setFocusSubjects] = useState([]);
  const [generated, setGenerated] = useState(false);
  const [checkedMilestones, setCheckedMilestones] = useState({});

  const GOALS = [
    {id:"competition",label:"ðŸ† Prepare for Competition",desc:"Prioritizes strategy, programming, and mechanics for match readiness"},
    {id:"programming",label:"ðŸ’» Master Programming",desc:"Deep focus on Java/Python, autonomy, and code quality"},
    {id:"allround",label:"âš™ï¸ Well-Rounded Engineer",desc:"Balanced coverage of all subjects"},
    {id:"rookie",label:"ðŸŒ± Rookie â€” Start from Scratch",desc:"Beginner-friendly path covering basics first"},
    {id:"advanced",label:"ðŸš€ Push to Advanced",desc:"Skip basics, focus on Intermediate/Advanced content"},
  ];

  function toggleSubject(id) {
    setFocusSubjects(prev => prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter(s=>s!==id) : [...prev, id]);
  }

  function generatePlan() {
    setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const doneIds = new Set(Object.keys(done));
      
      // Build ordered lesson list based on goal
      const subjectOrder = goal==="programming" ? ["java","python","electronics","strategy","mechanics","webdev","fundraising"]
        : goal==="competition" ? ["strategy","java","mechanics","electronics","python","webdev","fundraising"]
        : goal==="rookie" ? ["java","mechanics","electronics","strategy","python","webdev","fundraising"]
        : goal==="advanced" ? ["java","python","mechanics","electronics","strategy","webdev","fundraising"]
        : ["java","mechanics","electronics","strategy","python","webdev","fundraising"];

      const levelOrder = goal==="advanced" ? ["Intermediate","Advanced","Beginner"]
        : goal==="rookie" ? ["Beginner","Intermediate","Advanced"]
        : ["Beginner","Intermediate","Advanced"];

      const focused = focusSubjects.length > 0
        ? [...focusSubjects, ...subjectOrder.filter(s=>!focusSubjects.includes(s))]
        : subjectOrder;

      const allLessons = [];
      focused.forEach(subId => {
        const sub = SUBJECTS.find(s=>s.id===subId);
        if (!sub) return;
        levelOrder.forEach(level => {
          const arr = LESSONS[subId]?.[level] || [];
          arr.forEach(l => {
            if (!doneIds.has(l.id)) allLessons.push({...l, subId, subName:sub.name, subIcon:sub.icon, level, subColor:sub.color});
          });
        });
      });

      const minsPerLesson = 25;
      const minsPerWeek = hoursPerWeek * 60;
      const lessonsPerWeek = Math.max(1, Math.floor(minsPerWeek / minsPerLesson));
      const weeks = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < allLessons.length; i += lessonsPerWeek) {
        weeks.push(allLessons.slice(i, i + lessonsPerWeek));
      }

      // Milestones
      const milestones = [
        {week:1, label:"ðŸŒ± First Lesson Complete", desc:"Finish your very first lesson on this plan"},
        {week:Math.ceil(weeks.length*0.25), label:"ðŸ“ˆ 25% Progress", desc:"One quarter of your remaining lessons done"},
        {week:Math.ceil(weeks.length*0.5), label:"ðŸ Halfway!", desc:"Half your planned lessons completed"},
        {week:Math.ceil(weeks.length*0.75), label:"ðŸ”¥ Almost There", desc:"75% of the plan finished"},
        {week:weeks.length, label:"ðŸ† Plan Complete!", desc:"All planned lessons done â€” competition ready!"},
      ];

      setPlan({ weeks, milestones, lessonsPerWeek, totalRemaining: allLessons.length, weeksTotal: weeks.length });
      setLoading(false);
      setGenerated(true);
    }, 600);
  }

  const CS = {
    card:{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,padding:20,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)"},
    btn:(active)=>({background:active?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:active?"#fff":"#475569",border:"1px solid " + (active?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:active?700:500,fontSize:13,transition:"all 0.15s"}),
  };

  if (!generated) return (
    <div style={{maxWidth:700,margin:"0 auto",padding:"24px 16px"}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:6}}>ðŸ“… Generate Your Study Plan</div>
      <div style={{color:"#64748b",marginBottom:24,fontSize:14}}>Tell us your goal and we'll create a week-by-week personalized learning plan.</div>

      <div style={{...CS.card,marginBottom:16}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸŽ¯ What's your main goal?</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
          {GOALS.map(g=>(
            <div key={g.id} onClick={()=>setGoal(g.id)}
              style={{padding:"12px 16px",borderRadius:10,border:"2px solid " + (goal===g.id?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),background:goal===g.id?"#eff6ff":"#fff",cursor:"pointer",transition:"all 0.15s"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,color:goal===g.id?"#1d4ed8":"#1e293b"}}>{g.label}</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#64748b",marginTop:2}}>{g.desc}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{...CS.card,marginBottom:16}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:12}}>â± Hours available per week?</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:16}}>
          <input type="range" min={1} max={20} value={hoursPerWeek} onChange={e=>setHoursPerWeek(+e.target.value)} style={{flex:1,accentColor:"#1d4ed8"}} />
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:22,color:"#1d4ed8",minWidth:60}}>{hoursPerWeek}h/wk</div>
        </div>
        <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#94a3b8",marginTop:6}}>â‰ˆ {Math.max(1,Math.floor(hoursPerWeek*60/25))} lessons per week (~25 min each)</div>
      </div>

      <div style={{...CS.card,marginBottom:24}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ“š Focus subjects? (optional â€” leave blank for auto)</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:8}}>
          {SUBJECTS.filter(s=>LESSONS[s.id]&&Object.values(LESSONS[s.id]).some(arr=>arr.length>0)).map(s=>(
            <button key={s.id} onClick={()=>toggleSubject(s.id)} style={CS.btn(focusSubjects.includes(s.id))}>
              {s.icon} {s.name}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <button onClick={generatePlan} disabled={loading}
        style={{width:"100%",background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#1d4ed8)",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:12,padding:"16px 24px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,boxShadow:"0 4px 14px rgba(29,78,216,0.3)"}}>
        {loading ? "â³ Building your planâ€¦" : "âœ¨ Generate My Study Plan â†’"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div style={{maxWidth:800,margin:"0 auto",padding:"24px 16px"}}>
      <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:22}}>ðŸ“… Your Personalized Study Plan</div>
          <div style={{color:"#64748b",fontSize:13}}>{plan.totalRemaining} lessons Â· {plan.weeksTotal} weeks Â· {hoursPerWeek}h/week</div>
        </div>
        <button onClick={()=>setGenerated(false)} style={{marginLeft:"auto",background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#475569",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:600,fontSize:13}}>â†º Rebuild Plan</button>
      </div>

      {/* Milestones */}
      <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#7c3aed)",borderRadius:16,padding:"20px 22px",marginBottom:20,color:"#fff"}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ Milestones</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
          {plan.milestones.map((m,i)=>{
            const checked = checkedMilestones[i];
            return (
              <div key={i} onClick={()=>setCheckedMilestones(p=>({...p,[i]:!p[i]}))}
                style={{background:checked?"rgba(16,185,129,0.3)":"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 14px",cursor:"pointer",border:"1px solid " + (checked?"#10b981":"rgba(255,255,255,0.2)"),flex:1,minWidth:140}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,fontWeight:700}}>{checked?"âœ… ":""}{m.label}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:10,opacity:0.7,marginTop:2}}>Week {m.week}</div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Week-by-week */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
        {plan.weeks.slice(0,12).map((weekLessons,wi)=>(
          <div key={wi} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",overflow:"hidden"}}>
            <div style={{background:"#f8fafc",padding:"12px 18px",borderBottom:"1px solid #e2e8f0",display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,color:"#1e293b"}}>ðŸ“… Week {wi+1}</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#94a3b8"}}>{weekLessons.length} lessons Â· ~{Math.round(weekLessons.length*25/60*10)/10}h</div>
            </div>
            <div style={{padding:"12px 16px",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
              {weekLessons.map(l=>(
                <div key={l.id} style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,padding:"8px 10px",borderRadius:8,background:"#f8fafc",border:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
                  <span style={{fontSize:16}}>{l.subIcon}</span>
                  <div style={{flex:1}}>
                    <div style={{fontWeight:600,fontSize:13,color:"#1e293b"}}>{l.title}</div>
                    <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#94a3b8"}}>{l.subName} Â· {l.level}</div>
                  </div>
                  {l.type&&<span style={{fontSize:10,background:"#eff6ff",color:"#1d4ed8",padding:"2px 7px",borderRadius:5,fontWeight:700}}>
                    {l.type==="scenario"?"ðŸŽ¯":l.type==="checklist"?"âœ…":l.type==="challenge"?"ðŸ›":l.type==="matching"?"ðŸ”—":l.type==="fillblank"?"âœï¸":"ðŸ“–"}
                  </span>}
                  <span style={{fontSize:11,color:"#94a3b8"}}>~25m</span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {plan.weeks.length > 12 && (
          <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:"14px",background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",color:"#64748b",fontSize:13}}>
            + {plan.weeks.length-12} more weeks planned. Complete the first 12 weeks to unlock the rest.
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ GOALS & PROGRESS TRACKER â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function GoalsPage({ user, done, totalLessons }) {
  const [goals, setGoals] = useState([]);
  const [newGoalText, setNewGoalText] = useState("");
  const [newGoalType, setNewGoalType] = useState("lessons");
  const [newGoalTarget, setNewGoalTarget] = useState(10);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(()=>{
    storeGet("hub-goals-"+user.username, false).then(g=>{ setGoals(g||[]); setLoading(false); });
  },[user]);

  async function saveGoals(updated) {
    setGoals(updated);
    await storeSet("hub-goals-"+user.username, updated, false);
  }

  async function addGoal() {
    if (!newGoalText.trim()) return;
    const newGoal = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      text: newGoalText.trim(),
      type: newGoalType,
      target: newGoalTarget,
      created: Date.now(),
      completed: false,
      completedAt: null,
    };
    await saveGoals([...goals, newGoal]);
    setNewGoalText(""); setNewGoalTarget(10);
  }

  async function toggleGoal(id) {
    await saveGoals(goals.map(g=>g.id===id?{...g,completed:!g.completed,completedAt:!g.completed?Date.now():null}:g));
  }

  async function deleteGoal(id) {
    await saveGoals(goals.filter(g=>g.id!==id));
  }

  function getProgress(goal) {
    if (goal.type==="lessons") return {current:Object.keys(done).length, label:"lessons completed"};
    if (goal.type==="percent") return {current:Math.round(Object.keys(done).length/totalLessons*100), label:"% overall"};
    if (goal.type==="subject") return {current:0, label:"subject lessons"};
    return {current:0,label:""};
  }

  const GOAL_TYPES = [
    {id:"lessons",label:"ðŸ“š Complete N lessons"},
    {id:"percent",label:"ðŸ“ˆ Reach X% overall"},
    {id:"custom",label:"âœï¸ Custom goal"},
  ];

  const active = goals.filter(g=>!g.completed);
  const completed = goals.filter(g=>g.completed);

  if (loading) return <div style={{padding:40,textAlign:"center",color:"#64748b"}}>Loading goalsâ€¦</div>;

  return (
    <div style={{maxWidth:700,margin:"0 auto",padding:"24px 16px"}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:6}}>ðŸŽ¯ My Goals</div>
      <div style={{color:"#64748b",marginBottom:24,fontSize:14}}>Set personal learning goals and track your progress toward them.</div>

      {/* Add goal */}
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,padding:20,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:20}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:14}}>âž• Add a New Goal</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:10,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
          {GOAL_TYPES.map(t=>(
            <button key={t.id} onClick={()=>setNewGoalType(t.id)}
              style={{background:newGoalType===t.id?"#1d4ed8":"#f1f5f9",color:newGoalType===t.id?"#fff":"#475569",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:newGoalType===t.id?700:500,fontSize:13}}>
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <input value={newGoalText} onChange={e=>setNewGoalText(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={newGoalType==="custom"?"Describe your goalâ€¦":newGoalType==="lessons"?"e.g. Complete all Java Beginner lessons":"e.g. Reach 50% overall"}
          style={{width:"100%",padding:"10px 14px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14,marginBottom:10,boxSizing:"border-box"}}
          onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&addGoal()}
        />
        {newGoalType!=="custom" && (
          <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12,marginBottom:10}}>
            <span style={{fontSize:13,color:"#64748b"}}>Target:</span>
            <input type="number" value={newGoalTarget} onChange={e=>setNewGoalTarget(+e.target.value)} min={1} max={newGoalType==="percent"?100:totalLessons}
              style={{width:80,padding:"8px 12px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:14}}/>
            <span style={{fontSize:13,color:"#64748b"}}>{newGoalType==="lessons"?"lessons":"%"}</span>
          </div>
        )}
        <button onClick={addGoal} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 20px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700}}>
          Add Goal
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Active goals */}
      {active.length > 0 && (
        <div style={{marginBottom:20}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:10,color:"#1e293b"}}>ðŸ”¥ Active Goals ({active.length})</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
            {active.map(goal=>{
              const {current,label} = getProgress(goal);
              const pct = goal.type!=="custom" ? Math.min(100,Math.round(current/goal.target*100)) : 0;
              return (
                <div key={goal.id} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,padding:"16px 18px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"flex-start",gap:10}}>
                    <div style={{flex:1}}>
                      <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,color:"#1e293b",marginBottom:4}}>{goal.text}</div>
                      {goal.type!=="custom"&&(
                        <>
                          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:5}}>
                            <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#64748b"}}>{current} / {goal.target} {label}</span>
                            <span style={{fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,color:pct>=100?"#10b981":"#1d4ed8"}}>{pct}%</span>
                          </div>
                          <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:999,height:6}}>
                            <div style={{width:(pct) + "%",background:pct>=100?"#10b981":"#1d4ed8",height:"100%",borderRadius:999,transition:"width 0.4s"}}></div>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6}}>
                      <button onClick={()=>toggleGoal(goal.id)}
                        style={{background:"#f0fdf4",color:"#16a34a",border:"1px solid #bbf7d0",borderRadius:8,padding:"6px 12px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,fontWeight:700}}>
                        âœ“ Done
                      </button>
                      <button onClick={()=>deleteGoal(goal.id)}
                        style={{background:"none",color:"#9ca3af",border:"none",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:16,padding:"4px"}}>âœ•</button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {active.length===0&&goals.length===0&&(
        <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:"40px 20px",color:"#94a3b8",background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,border:"1px dashed #e2e8f0"}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:40,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸŽ¯</div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:4}}>No goals yet</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:13}}>Set your first learning goal above to start tracking progress.</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Completed goals */}
      {completed.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:15,marginBottom:10,color:"#64748b"}}>âœ… Completed ({completed.length})</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
            {completed.map(goal=>(
              <div key={goal.id} style={{background:"#f0fdf4",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 16px",border:"1px solid #bbf7d0",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,opacity:0.7}}>
                <span style={{fontSize:18}}>âœ…</span>
                <span style={{flex:1,fontSize:13,color:"#065f46",fontWeight:600,textDecoration:"line-through"}}>{goal.text}</span>
                <button onClick={()=>toggleGoal(goal.id)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12}}>Unmark</button>
                <button onClick={()=>deleteGoal(goal.id)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#9ca3af",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:16}}>âœ•</button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ SKILL TREE PAGE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function SkillTreePage({ user, done, setTab, setSelSub, setSelLevel, setSelLesson }) {
  const [selSubject, setSelSubject] = useState("java");
  const sub = SUBJECTS.find(s=>s.id===selSubject);

  const levelData = LEVELS.map(level => {
    const lessons = LESSONS[selSubject]?.[level] || [];
    const doneCount = lessons.filter(l=>done[l.id]).length;
    return { level, lessons, doneCount, total:lessons.length, pct: lessons.length?Math.round(doneCount/lessons.length*100):0 };
  });

  // A level is "unlocked" if the previous level is >= 50% complete
  function isUnlocked(i) {
    if (i===0) return true;
    return levelData[i-1].pct >= 50;
  }

  function openLesson(lesson, level) {
    setSelSub(selSubject);
    setSelLevel(level);
    setSelLesson(lesson);
    setTab("learn");
  }

  const levelColors = {Beginner:"#10b981",Intermediate:"#f59e0b",Advanced:"#ef4444"};
  const levelIcons = {Beginner:"ðŸŒ±",Intermediate:"âš¡",Advanced:"ðŸ”¥"};

  return (
    <div style={{maxWidth:900,margin:"0 auto",padding:"24px 16px"}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:6}}>ðŸŒ³ Skill Tree</div>
      <div style={{color:"#64748b",marginBottom:20,fontSize:14}}>Visualize your mastery. Complete 50% of each level to unlock the next.</div>

      {/* Subject selector */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:24}}>
        {SUBJECTS.filter(s=>LESSONS[s.id]&&Object.values(LESSONS[s.id]).some(arr=>arr.length>0)).map(s=>(
          <button key={s.id} onClick={()=>setSelSubject(s.id)}
            style={{background:selSubject===s.id?s.color:"#f1f5f9",color:selSubject===s.id?"#fff":"#475569",
              border:"2px solid " + (selSubject===s.id?s.color:"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:selSubject===s.id?700:500,fontSize:13,transition:"all 0.15s"}}>
            {s.icon} {s.name}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tree visualization */}
      <div style={{position:"relative"}}>
        {/* Vertical connector line */}
        <div style={{position:"absolute",left:35,top:40,bottom:40,width:4,background:"linear-gradient(to bottom, #10b981, #f59e0b, #ef4444)",borderRadius:999,zIndex:0,opacity:0.3}}></div>

        {levelData.map((ld,i)=>{
          const unlocked = isUnlocked(i);
          const col = levelColors[ld.level];
          return (
            <div key={ld.level} style={{marginBottom:24,position:"relative",zIndex:1}}>
              {/* Level header */}
              <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:16,marginBottom:12}}>
                <div style={{width:72,height:72,borderRadius:999,background:unlocked?col:"#e2e8f0",
                  display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",
                  boxShadow:unlocked?"0 0 0 4px " + (col) + "30":"none",transition:"all 0.3s",flexShrink:0}}>
                  <div style={{fontSize:unlocked?28:22}}>{unlocked?levelIcons[ld.level]:"ðŸ”’"}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:10,fontWeight:700,color:unlocked?"#fff":"#9ca3af",marginTop:2}}>
                    {ld.doneCount}/{ld.total}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18,color:unlocked?col:"#9ca3af"}}>{ld.level}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#64748b"}}>{ld.total} lessons Â· {ld.pct}% complete</div>
                  {!unlocked&&<div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#f59e0b",marginTop:2}}>âš ï¸ Complete 50% of {LEVELS[i-1]} to unlock</div>}
                </div>
                {/* Level progress bar */}
                <div style={{flex:1,marginLeft:8}}>
                  <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:999,height:10,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                    <div style={{width:(ld.pct) + "%",background:col,height:"100%",borderRadius:999,transition:"width 0.5s"}}></div>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#94a3b8",marginTop:3}}>{ld.pct}%</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Lesson nodes */}
              {unlocked && (
                <div style={{marginLeft:88,display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(220px,1fr))",gap:10}}>
                  {ld.lessons.map(lesson=>{
                    const isDone = !!done[lesson.id];
                    return (
                      <div key={lesson.id} onClick={()=>openLesson(lesson,ld.level)}
                        style={{background:isDone?(col) + "15":"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:"12px 14px",
                          border:"2px solid " + (isDone?col:"#e2e8f0"),cursor:"pointer",transition:"all 0.15s"}}
                        onMouseEnter={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.transform="translateY(-2px)";e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow="0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)";}}
                        onMouseLeave={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.transform="none";e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow="none";}}>
                        <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,marginBottom:4}}>
                          <span style={{fontSize:18}}>{isDone?"âœ…":"â¬œ"}</span>
                          <span style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:isDone?col:"#1e293b",lineHeight:1.3,flex:1}}>{lesson.title}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,marginTop:4}}>
                          <span style={{fontSize:10,color:"#94a3b8"}}>{lesson.id}</span>
                          {lesson.type&&<span style={{fontSize:10,background:"#eff6ff",color:"#1d4ed8",padding:"1px 6px",borderRadius:4,fontWeight:700}}>
                            {lesson.type==="scenario"?"ðŸŽ¯":lesson.type==="checklist"?"âœ…":lesson.type==="challenge"?"ðŸ›":lesson.type==="matching"?"ðŸ”—":lesson.type==="fillblank"?"âœï¸":"ðŸ“–"} {lesson.type}
                          </span>}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Subject completion badge */}
      {(() => {
        const totalDone = levelData.reduce((s,l)=>s+l.doneCount,0);
        const totalAll = levelData.reduce((s,l)=>s+l.total,0);
        if (totalDone===totalAll&&totalAll>0) return (
          <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg," + (sub.color) + ",#1d4ed8)",borderRadius:16,padding:"20px 24px",textAlign:"center",color:"#fff",marginTop:20}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:40,marginBottom:8}}>ðŸ…</div>
            <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18}}>Subject Mastered!</div>
            <div style={{opacity:0.8,marginTop:4}}>You've completed all lessons in {sub.name}.</div>
          </div>
        );
        return null;
      })()}
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ PRACTICE TEST PAGE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function PracticeTestPage({ user }) {
  const [config, setConfig] = useState({subjects:[], numQ:20, level:"all", timed:true, timeLimit:15});
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("config"); // config | test | results
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null);
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState([]);
  const [score, setScore] = useState(0);
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(0);
  const timerRef = useRef(null);

  function toggleSubject(id) {
    setConfig(c=>({...c, subjects: c.subjects.includes(id) ? c.subjects.filter(s=>s!==id) : [...c.subjects, id]}));
  }

  function buildQuestions() {
    const subs = config.subjects.length ? config.subjects : SUBJECTS.map(s=>s.id);
    let pool = [];
    subs.forEach(sid => {
      const levelsToUse = config.level==="all" ? LEVELS : [config.level==="beginner"?"Beginner":config.level==="intermediate"?"Intermediate":"Advanced"];
      levelsToUse.forEach(lv => {
        const lessons = LESSONS[sid]?.[lv] || [];
        lessons.forEach(l => {
          if (l.quiz) pool.push(...l.quiz.map(q=>({...q, subId:sid, level:lv, lessonTitle:l.title})));
        });
      });
    });
    pool = shuffleArr(pool).slice(0, config.numQ);
    setQuestions(pool);
    setPhase("test");
    setCurrent(0); setSelected(null); setConfirmed(false); setAnswers([]); setScore(0);
    if (config.timed) {
      setTimeLeft(config.timeLimit * 60);
    }
  }

  useEffect(()=>{
    if (phase==="test" && config.timed) {
      timerRef.current = setInterval(()=>{
        setTimeLeft(t=>{
          if (t<=1) { clearInterval(timerRef.current); finishTest(); return 0; }
          return t-1;
        });
      },1000);
    }
    return ()=>clearInterval(timerRef.current);
  },[phase]);

  function confirm() {
    if (selected===null) return;
    setConfirmed(true);
    if (selected===questions[current].ans) setScore(s=>s+1);
    setAnswers(prev=>[...prev,{q:questions[current],sel:selected}]);
  }

  function next() {
    if (current+1>=questions.length) { clearInterval(timerRef.current); finishTest(); return; }
    setCurrent(c=>c+1); setSelected(null); setConfirmed(false);
  }

  function finishTest() {
    clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    setPhase("results");
  }

  if (phase==="config") return (
    <div style={{maxWidth:640,margin:"0 auto",padding:"24px 16px"}}>
      <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:6}}>ðŸ“ Practice Test</div>
      <div style={{color:"#64748b",marginBottom:24,fontSize:14}}>Build a custom test from any subjects and difficulty levels.</div>

      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,padding:20,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:16}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:10}}>ðŸ“š Subjects (leave blank for all)</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:8}}>
          {SUBJECTS.filter(s=>QUIZZES[s.id]&&LESSONS[s.id]&&Object.values(LESSONS[s.id]).some(a=>a.length>0)).map(s=>(
            <button key={s.id} onClick={()=>toggleSubject(s.id)}
              style={{background:config.subjects.includes(s.id)?s.color:"#f1f5f9",color:config.subjects.includes(s.id)?"#fff":"#475569",
                border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"8px 14px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:600,fontSize:13}}>
              {s.icon} {s.name}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:12,marginBottom:16}}>
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,padding:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:8,fontSize:14}}>ðŸ“Š Difficulty</div>
          {[["all","All Levels"],["beginner","Beginner Only"],["intermediate","Intermediate Only"],["advanced","Advanced Only"]].map(([v,l])=>(
            <label key={v} style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,marginBottom:6,cursor:"pointer",fontSize:13}}>
              <input type="radio" checked={config.level===v} onChange={()=>setConfig(c=>({...c,level:v}))} />
              {l}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,padding:16,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:8,fontSize:14}}>â“ Questions: <span style={{color:"#1d4ed8"}}>{config.numQ}</span></div>
          <input type="range" min={5} max={50} step={5} value={config.numQ} onChange={e=>setConfig(c=>({...c,numQ:+e.target.value}))} style={{width:"100%",accentColor:"#1d4ed8",marginBottom:12}} />
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:8,fontSize:14}}>
            â± Timer: <label style={{cursor:"pointer"}}>
              <input type="checkbox" checked={config.timed} onChange={e=>setConfig(c=>({...c,timed:e.target.checked}))} /> {config.timed?"ON":"OFF"}
            </label>
          </div>
          {config.timed && (
            <>
              <input type="range" min={5} max={60} step={5} value={config.timeLimit} onChange={e=>setConfig(c=>({...c,timeLimit:+e.target.value}))} style={{width:"100%",accentColor:"#1d4ed8"}} />
              <div style={{fontSize:12,color:"#64748b"}}>{config.timeLimit} minutes</div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <button onClick={buildQuestions}
        style={{width:"100%",background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#b91c1c)",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:12,padding:"16px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:800,fontSize:16}}>
        ðŸš€ Start Practice Test
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  if (phase==="test" && questions.length===0) return (
    <div style={{padding:60,textAlign:"center",color:"#64748b"}}>
      <div style={{fontSize:40,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ˜•</div>
      <div style={{fontWeight:700,marginBottom:8}}>No questions found</div>
      <div style={{fontSize:14}}>The selected subjects/levels don't have quiz questions yet. Try different settings.</div>
      <button onClick={()=>setPhase("config")} style={{marginTop:20,background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:8,padding:"10px 22px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700}}>â† Back to Config</button>
    </div>
  );

  if (phase==="test") {
    const q = questions[current];
    const mins = Math.floor(timeLeft/60).toString().padStart(2,"0");
    const secs = (timeLeft%60).toString().padStart(2,"0");
    const progressPct = Math.round((current/questions.length)*100);

    return (
      <div style={{maxWidth:620,margin:"0 auto",padding:"24px 16px"}}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:16}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#64748b"}}>{current+1} / {questions.length}</div>
          {config.timed&&<div style={{background:timeLeft<60?"#fef2f2":"#eff6ff",color:timeLeft<60?"#ef4444":"#1d4ed8",fontWeight:800,padding:"6px 14px",borderRadius:8,fontSize:15}}>â± {mins}:{secs}</div>}
          <button onClick={finishTest} style={{background:"none",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",borderRadius:7,padding:"6px 12px",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:12,color:"#64748b"}}>End Test</button>
        </div>

        {/* Progress */}
        <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:999,height:6,marginBottom:20}}>
          <div style={{width:(progressPct) + "%",background:"#1d4ed8",height:"100%",borderRadius:999,transition:"width 0.3s"}}></div>
        </div>

        {/* Context */}
        <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#94a3b8",marginBottom:12}}>
          {SUBJECTS.find(s=>s.id===q.subId)?.icon} {q.lessonTitle} Â· {q.level}
        </div>

        {/* Question */}
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,padding:"22px 20px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:16}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:16,lineHeight:1.5,color:"#1e293b"}}>{q.q}</div>
        </div>

        {/* Options */}
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8,marginBottom:16}}>
          {q.opts.map((opt,i)=>{
            const isSelected=selected===i;
            const isCorrect=confirmed&&i===q.ans;
            const isWrong=confirmed&&isSelected&&i!==q.ans;
            return (
              <div key={i} onClick={()=>{if(!confirmed)setSelected(i);}}
                style={{padding:"14px 18px",borderRadius:12,border:"2px solid " + (isCorrect?"#10b981":isWrong?"#ef4444":isSelected?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0"),
                  background:isCorrect?"#f0fdf4":isWrong?"#fef2f2":isSelected?"#eff6ff":"#fff",
                  cursor:confirmed?"default":"pointer",fontSize:14,fontWeight:isSelected||isCorrect?600:400,
                  color:isCorrect?"#065f46":isWrong?"#991b1b":isSelected?"#1e40af":"#334155",transition:"all 0.15s"}}>
                {isCorrect?"âœ… ":isWrong?"âŒ ":""}{opt}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {!confirmed ? (
          <button onClick={confirm} disabled={selected===null}
            style={{width:"100%",background:selected!==null?"#1d4ed8":"#e2e8f0",color:selected!==null?"#fff":"#94a3b8",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"13px",cursor:selected!==null?"pointer":"default",fontWeight:700,fontSize:15}}>
            Submit Answer
          </button>
        ) : (
          <button onClick={next}
            style={{width:"100%",background:"#10b981",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"13px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:15}}>
            {current+1>=questions.length?"ðŸ See Results":"Next Question â†’"}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (phase==="results") {
    const pct = Math.round(score/questions.length*100);
    const grade = pct>=90?"A":pct>=80?"B":pct>=70?"C":pct>=60?"D":"F";
    const gradeColor = pct>=80?"#10b981":pct>=60?"#f59e0b":"#ef4444";
    const wrong = answers.filter(a=>a.sel!==a.q.ans);

    return (
      <div style={{maxWidth:620,margin:"0 auto",padding:"24px 16px"}}>
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:20,padding:"32px 28px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",textAlign:"center",marginBottom:20}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:56,marginBottom:8}}>
            {pct>=90?"ðŸ†":pct>=70?"ðŸŽ‰":pct>=50?"ðŸ‘":"ðŸ’ª"}
          </div>
          <div style={{fontSize:60,fontWeight:900,color:gradeColor,lineHeight:1}}>{grade}</div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:22,marginBottom:4,marginTop:8}}>{score} / {questions.length} correct</div>
          <div style={{color:"#64748b",marginBottom:20}}>{pct}% accuracy</div>
          <div style={{background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:999,height:12,marginBottom:20}}>
            <div style={{width:(pct) + "%",background:gradeColor,height:"100%",borderRadius:999,transition:"width 0.8s"}}></div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={()=>setPhase("config")} style={{background:"#1d4ed8",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:10,padding:"12px 28px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:15}}>
            ðŸ“ Take Another Test
          </button>
        </div>

        {wrong.length>0&&(
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:16,padding:20,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:14,color:"#ef4444"}}>âŒ Review Missed Questions ({wrong.length})</div>
            {wrong.map((a,i)=>(
              <div key={i} style={{marginBottom:16,padding:"14px 16px",background:"#fef2f2",borderRadius:12,border:"1px solid #fecaca"}}>
                <div style={{fontWeight:600,fontSize:14,marginBottom:8,color:"#1e293b"}}>{a.q.q}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#ef4444",marginBottom:4}}>Your answer: <strong>{a.q.opts[a.sel]}</strong></div>
                <div style={{fontSize:13,color:"#10b981"}}>Correct answer: <strong>{a.q.opts[a.q.ans]}</strong></div>
                <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#94a3b8",marginTop:6}}>From: {a.q.lessonTitle}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return null;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ BUILD TRACKER PAGE â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function BuildTrackerPage({ user }) {
  const KEY = "hub-buildtracker";
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||"[]"); } catch(e) { return []; }
  });
  const [newTask, setNewTask] = useState("");
  const [newCat, setNewCat] = useState("mechanical");
  const [newPriority, setNewPriority] = useState("medium");
  const [newDue, setNewDue] = useState("");
  const [newAssign, setNewAssign] = useState("");
  const [filterCat, setFilterCat] = useState("all");
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState("all");
  const [kickoffDate, setKickoffDate] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem("hub-kickoff") || "");
  const [compDate, setCompDate] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem("hub-compdate") || "");

  const CATS = [
    {id:"mechanical",label:"âš™ï¸ Mechanical",color:"#d97706"},
    {id:"electrical",label:"âš¡ Electrical",color:"#7c3aed"},
    {id:"programming",label:"ðŸ’» Programming",color:"#2563eb"},
    {id:"strategy",label:"ðŸ† Strategy",color:"#059669"},
    {id:"outreach",label:"ðŸŒ Outreach",color:"#db2777"},
    {id:"admin",label:"ðŸ“‹ Admin",color:"#64748b"},
  ];
  const PRIORITIES = [{id:"high",label:"ðŸ”´ High"},{id:"medium",label:"ðŸŸ¡ Medium"},{id:"low",label:"ðŸŸ¢ Low"}];

  function save(updated) {
    setTasks(updated);
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
  }

  function addTask() {
    if (!newTask.trim()) return;
    const t = {id:Date.now(), title:newTask, cat:newCat, priority:newPriority, due:newDue, assign:newAssign, done:false, created:Date.now()};
    save([...tasks, t]);
    setNewTask(""); setNewDue(""); setNewAssign("");
  }

  function toggleTask(id) {
    save(tasks.map(t => t.id===id ? {...t, done:!t.done, completedAt:Date.now()} : t));
  }

  function deleteTask(id) { save(tasks.filter(t=>t.id!==id)); }

  // Countdown math
  const now = new Date();
  const daysToComp = compDate ? Math.ceil((new Date(compDate)-now)/(1000*60*60*24)) : null;
  const daysFromKickoff = kickoffDate ? Math.ceil((now-new Date(kickoffDate))/(1000*60*60*24)) : null;

  // Stats
  const done = tasks.filter(t=>t.done).length;
  const total = tasks.length;
  const overdue = tasks.filter(t=>!t.done && t.due && new Date(t.due) < now).length;
  const highPending = tasks.filter(t=>!t.done && t.priority==="high").length;

  // Filtered tasks
  const filtered = tasks.filter(t => {
    const catOk = filterCat==="all" || t.cat===filterCat;
    const statOk = filterStatus==="all" || (filterStatus==="done"?t.done:!t.done);
    return catOk && statOk;
  }).sort((a,b) => {
    // High priority first, then by due date
    const pOrder = {high:0,medium:1,low:2};
    if (a.done !== b.done) return a.done ? 1 : -1;
    return (pOrder[a.priority]||1) - (pOrder[b.priority]||1);
  });

  const catInfo = (id) => CATS.find(c=>c.id===id) || {label:id,color:"#64748b"};

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"flex-start",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap",gap:12}}>
        <div>
          <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:24,marginBottom:3}}>ðŸ”¨ Build Season Tracker</div>
          <div style={{color:"#64748b",fontSize:13}}>Manage your season tasks, deadlines, and team assignments.</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Countdown cards */}
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr))",gap:10,marginBottom:20}}>
        {[
          ["ðŸ“… Build Day",daysFromKickoff!==null?"Day " + (daysFromKickoff):"Set kickoff â†’","#1e293b"],
          ["â± Days to Comp",daysToComp!==null?(daysToComp>0?(daysToComp) + " days":"ðŸ Today!"):"Set date â†’","#7c3aed"],
          ["âœ… Completed",(done) + "/" + (total) + " tasks",done===total&&total>0?"#059669":"#2563eb"],
          ["ðŸ”´ Overdue",(overdue) + " tasks",overdue>0?"#dc2626":"#64748b"],
          ["âš¡ High Priority",(highPending) + " pending",highPending>0?"#d97706":"#64748b"],
        ].map(([label,val,color])=>(
          <div key={label} style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:"14px 16px",border:"2px solid " + (color) + "20",boxShadow:"0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)"}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#94a3b8",marginBottom:4,fontWeight:600}}>{label}</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:17,fontWeight:900,color}}>{val}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Season dates */}
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,padding:"14px 16px",border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",marginBottom:16,display:"flex",gap:16,flexWrap:"wrap",alignItems:"center"}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,color:"#374151",flexShrink:0}}>ðŸ“… Season Dates:</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>Kickoff:</span>
          <input type="date" value={kickoffDate} onChange={e=>{setKickoffDate(e.target.value);localStorage.setItem("hub-kickoff",e.target.value);}}
            style={{padding:"5px 8px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,alignItems:"center"}}>
          <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>Competition:</span>
          <input type="date" value={compDate} onChange={e=>{setCompDate(e.target.value);localStorage.setItem("hub-compdate",e.target.value);}}
            style={{padding:"5px 8px",borderRadius:7,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        </div>
        {total>0 && (
          <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,marginLeft:"auto"}}>
            <div style={{width:120,height:6,background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:3,overflow:"hidden"}}>
              <div style={{width:(Math.round(done/total*100)) + "%",height:"100%",background:"linear-gradient(90deg,#2563eb,#059669)",borderRadius:3,transition:"width 0.4s"}}/>
            </div>
            <span style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:700,color:"#2563eb"}}>{Math.round(done/total*100)}% done</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Add task form */}
      <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",padding:16,marginBottom:16,boxShadow:"0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)"}}>
        <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:12,color:"#374151"}}>+ New Task</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginBottom:10}}>
          <input value={newTask} onChange={e=>setNewTask(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&addTask()}
            placeholder="Task title (press Enter to add)..."
            style={{flex:1,padding:"9px 12px",borderRadius:9,border:"1.5px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",minWidth:0}}/>
          <button onClick={addTask} disabled={!newTask.trim()}
            style={{background:"#2563eb",color:"#fff",border:"none",borderRadius:9,padding:"9px 20px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,fontFamily:"inherit",opacity:newTask.trim()?1:0.4,flexShrink:0}}>
            Add
          </button>
        </div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
          <select value={newCat} onChange={e=>setNewCat(e.target.value)}
            style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
            {CATS.map(c=><option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.label}</option>)}
          </select>
          <select value={newPriority} onChange={e=>setNewPriority(e.target.value)}
            style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit",background:"#fff"}}>
            {PRIORITIES.map(p=><option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.label}</option>)}
          </select>
          <input type="date" value={newDue} onChange={e=>setNewDue(e.target.value)}
            style={{padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
          <input value={newAssign} onChange={e=>setNewAssign(e.target.value)} placeholder="Assigned to..."
            style={{flex:1,minWidth:100,padding:"7px 10px",borderRadius:8,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}/>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:12,alignItems:"center"}}>
        <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#94a3b8",fontWeight:600}}>Filter:</span>
        {["all","done","pending"].map(s=>(
          <button key={s} onClick={()=>setFilterStatus(s)}
            style={{background:filterStatus===s?"#1e293b":"#fff",color:filterStatus===s?"#fff":"#6b7280",border:"1px solid " + (filterStatus===s?"#1e293b":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:7,padding:"5px 12px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
            {s==="all"?"All":s==="done"?"âœ… Done":"ðŸ“‹ Pending"}
          </button>
        ))}
        <div style={{width:1,height:20,background:"#e2e8f0",margin:"0 2px"}}/>
        <button onClick={()=>setFilterCat("all")}
          style={{background:filterCat==="all"?"#1e293b":"#fff",color:filterCat==="all"?"#fff":"#6b7280",border:"1px solid " + (filterCat==="all"?"#1e293b":"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:7,padding:"5px 12px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:12,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
          All
        </button>
        {CATS.map(c=>(
          <button key={c.id} onClick={()=>setFilterCat(c.id)}
            style={{background:filterCat===c.id?c.color:"#fff",color:filterCat===c.id?"#fff":"#6b7280",border:"1px solid " + (filterCat===c.id?c.color:"#e2e8f0"),borderRadius:7,padding:"5px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
            {c.label}
          </button>
        ))}
        {tasks.length>0&&(
          <button onClick={()=>{save(tasks.filter(t=>!t.done));}}
            style={{marginLeft:"auto",background:"#fef2f2",color:"#991b1b",border:"1px solid #fecaca",borderRadius:7,padding:"5px 10px",cursor:"pointer",fontWeight:700,fontSize:11,fontFamily:"inherit"}}>
            ðŸ—‘ Clear Done
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Task list */}
      {filtered.length===0?(
        <div style={{textAlign:"center",padding:40,color:"#94a3b8",background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0"}}>
          {total===0?"ðŸŽ‰ No tasks yet â€” add one above!":"âœ… No tasks match the current filter."}
        </div>
      ):(
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:6}}>
          {filtered.map(t=>{
            const cat = catInfo(t.cat);
            const isOverdue = !t.done && t.due && new Date(t.due) < now;
            const daysLeft = t.due ? Math.ceil((new Date(t.due)-now)/(1000*60*60*24)) : null;
            return (
              <div key={t.id} style={{
                background:"#fff",borderRadius:12,
                border:"1px solid " + (t.done?"#f1f5f9":isOverdue?"#fecaca":"#e2e8f0"),
                padding:"12px 14px",
                display:"flex",gap:12,alignItems:"center",
                opacity:t.done?0.55:1,
                boxShadow:"0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04)",
                transition:"all 0.15s",
              }}>
                <button onClick={()=>toggleTask(t.id)}
                  style={{width:22,height:22,borderRadius:6,border:"2px solid " + (t.done?"#10b981":cat.color),background:t.done?"#10b981":"transparent",
                    display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",cursor:"pointer",flexShrink:0,fontSize:13}}>
                  {t.done?"âœ“":""}
                </button>
                <div style={{flex:1,minWidth:0}}>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:t.done?400:700,fontSize:14,textDecoration:t.done?"line-through":"none",color:t.done?"#94a3b8":"#1e293b",whiteSpace:"nowrap",overflow:"hidden",textOverflow:"ellipsis"}}>
                    {t.priority==="high"&&!t.done&&<span style={{marginRight:4}}>ðŸ”´</span>}
                    {t.title}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",gap:8,marginTop:4,flexWrap:"wrap",alignItems:"center"}}>
                    <span style={{background:(cat.color) + "18",color:cat.color,borderRadius:5,padding:"2px 7px",fontSize:10,fontWeight:700}}>{cat.label}</span>
                    {t.assign&&<span style={{fontSize:11,color:"#6b7280"}}>ðŸ‘¤ {t.assign}</span>}
                    {t.due&&(
                      <span style={{fontSize:11,fontWeight:600,color:isOverdue?"#dc2626":daysLeft<=3?"#d97706":"#6b7280"}}>
                        {isOverdue?"ðŸ”´ Overdue":daysLeft===0?"ðŸ“… Due today":"ðŸ“… " + (daysLeft) + "d"}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {t.done&&t.completedAt&&<span style={{fontSize:10,color:"#10b981"}}>âœ… {new Date(t.completedAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span>}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button onClick={()=>deleteTask(t.id)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"#cbd5e1",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:16,padding:2,flexShrink:0}}>âœ•</button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Category progress bars */}
      {total>0&&(
        <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:14,border:"1px solid #e2e8f0",padding:"16px 18px",marginTop:20}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:13,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ“Š Progress by Category</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:8}}>
            {CATS.map(cat=>{
              const catTasks = tasks.filter(t=>t.cat===cat.id);
              if (!catTasks.length) return null;
              const catDone = catTasks.filter(t=>t.done).length;
              const pct = Math.round(catDone/catTasks.length*100);
              return (
                <div key={cat.id}>
                  <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:4,fontSize:12}}>
                    <span style={{fontWeight:600,color:"#374151"}}>{cat.label}</span>
                    <span style={{color:"#94a3b8"}}>{catDone}/{catTasks.length}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{height:6,background:"#f1f5f9",borderRadius:3,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                    <div style={{width:(pct) + "%",height:"100%",background:cat.color,borderRadius:3,transition:"width 0.4s"}}/>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// â”€â”€â”€ HOME TAB COMPONENT â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function HomeTab({ user, totalLessons, doneCount, done, posts, anns, bookmarks, placementResult, setTab, setSelSub, setSelLevel, setSelLesson }) {
  const [userData, setUserData] = useState(null);
  const pct = totalLessons > 0 ? Math.round(doneCount/totalLessons*100) : 0;

  useEffect(() => {
    storeGet("hub-users",true).then(users=>{
      if(users?.[user.username]) setUserData(users[user.username]);
    });
  }, [done]);  // re-fetch whenever a lesson is completed

  const streak = userData?.streak || 0;
  const learningTime = userData?.learningTime || 0;
  const achievements = userData?.achievements || [];
  const recentDone = Object.keys(done).slice(-3).reverse();

  // Subject progress
  const subjectProgress = SUBJECTS
    .map(s => {
      const all = Object.values(LESSONS[s.id]||{}).flat();
      const dc = all.filter(l => done[l.id]).length;
      return { ...s, dc, total: all.length, pct: all.length ? Math.round(dc/all.length*100) : 0 };
    })
    .filter(s => s.total > 0);

  const lessonMap = {};
  Object.values(LESSONS).forEach(sub => Object.values(sub).forEach(arr => arr.forEach(l => { lessonMap[l.id] = l; })));

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Hero banner */}
      <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#0f172a 0%,#1e3a8a 50%,#1d4ed8 100%)",color:"#fff",marginBottom:20,overflow:"hidden",position:"relative",padding:"28px 28px"}}>
        <div style={{position:"absolute",right:-30,top:-30,fontSize:160,opacity:0.04,userSelect:"none"}}>ðŸ¤–</div>
        <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"flex-start",justifyContent:"space-between",flexWrap:"wrap",gap:16}}>
          <div>
            <div style={{fontSize:13,opacity:0.7,marginBottom:4,letterSpacing:0.5}}>Welcome back,</div>
            <div style={{fontSize:28,fontWeight:900,marginBottom:6}}>{user.name} ðŸ‘‹</div>
            <div style={{opacity:0.8,fontSize:14,lineHeight:1.7,maxWidth:500}}>
              FIRST Robotics Learning Hub â€” {totalLessons} lessons across 7 subjects.
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"flex-end",gap:6}}>
            {streak > 0 && (
              <div style={{background:"rgba(251,146,60,0.25)",border:"1px solid rgba(251,146,60,0.4)",borderRadius:12,padding:"8px 16px",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8}}>
                <span style={{fontSize:22}}>ðŸ”¥</span>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:20,lineHeight:1}}>{streak}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.8}}>day streak</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            <div style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",borderRadius:12,padding:"8px 16px",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8}}>
              <span style={{fontSize:18}}>ðŸ†</span>
              <div>
                <div style={{fontWeight:900,fontSize:18,lineHeight:1}}>{achievements.length}</div>
                <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.8}}>badges earned</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        {/* Overall progress bar */}
        <div style={{marginTop:20}}>
          <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",marginBottom:6}}>
            <span style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.8}}>Overall Progress</span>
            <span style={{fontSize:12,fontWeight:800}}>{doneCount}/{totalLessons} ({pct}%)</span>
          </div>
          <div style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",borderRadius:20,height:8,overflow:"hidden"}}>
            <div style={{background:"linear-gradient(90deg,#60a5fa,#a78bfa)",width:(pct) + "%",height:"100%",borderRadius:20,transition:"width 0.6s"}}/>
          </div>
        </div>
        {/* Stats row */}
        <div style={{marginTop:16,display:"flex",gap:14,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
          {[
            ["â±","Study Time",fmtTime(learningTime)],
            ["ðŸ“š","Lessons Done",doneCount+"/"+totalLessons],
            ["ðŸ’¬","Forum Posts",posts.length],
            ["ðŸ“£","Announcements",anns.length],
          ].map(([ic,lb,ct])=>(
            <div key={lb} style={{background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.08)",borderRadius:10,padding:"8px 14px",textAlign:"center",minWidth:80}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:18,fontWeight:900}}>{ct}</div>
              <div style={{opacity:0.7,fontSize:11,marginTop:2}}>{ic} {lb}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Quick actions */}
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:10,marginBottom:20,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={()=>setTab("learn")}>ðŸ“š Continue Learning</button>
        <button style={S_HANDBO.btn("#7c3aed")} onClick={()=>setTab("quiz")}>ðŸ§  Take a Quiz</button>
        <button style={S_HANDBO.btn("#15803d")} onClick={()=>setTab("achievements")}>ðŸ† Achievements</button>
        <button style={S_HANDBO.btn("#dc2626")} onClick={()=>setTab("leaderboard")}>ðŸ¥‡ Leaderboard</button>
        {bookmarks.length > 0 && <button style={S_HANDBO.btnOut("#b45309")} onClick={()=>setTab("notes")}>â­ Bookmarks ({bookmarks.length})</button>}
      </div>

      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:16,marginBottom:20}}>
        {/* Subject progress */}
        <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card}}>
          <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15,marginBottom:14}}>ðŸ“Š Progress by Subject</div>
          <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
            {subjectProgress.map(s => (
              <div key={s.id} onClick={()=>{setSelSub(s.id);const fl=LEVELS.find(l=>(LESSONS[s.id]?.[l]??[]).length>0)||"Beginner";setSelLevel(fl);setSelLesson(null);setTab("learn");}}
                style={{cursor:"pointer",padding:"6px 0"}}>
                <div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center",marginBottom:4}}>
                  <span style={{fontSize:13,fontWeight:600}}>{s.icon} {s.name.split(" ")[0]}</span>
                  <span style={{fontSize:12,color:"#6b7280"}}>{s.dc}/{s.total}</span>
                </div>
                <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:20,height:6,overflow:"hidden"}}>
                  <div style={{background:s.color,width:(s.pct) + "%",height:"100%",borderRadius:20,transition:"width 0.5s"}}/>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Recent + placement */}
        <div style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:14}}>
          {/* Placement card */}
          <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,cursor:"pointer",borderLeft:"4px solid " + (placementResult?.role?.color||"#7c3aed")}}
            onClick={()=>setTab("placement")}>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14,marginBottom:4}}>
              {placementResult ? placementResult.role?.icon+" "+placementResult.role?.name : "ðŸ§ª Not Placed Yet"}
            </div>
            <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:12}}>
              {placementResult ? "Score: " + (Math.round(placementResult.score/placementResult.total*100)) + "% Â· Click to view" : "Take the placement test â†’"}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Recent lessons */}
          {recentDone.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14,marginBottom:10}}>âœ… Recently Completed</div>
              {recentDone.map(id => (
                <div key={id} style={{fontSize:13,color:"#374151",padding:"3px 0",borderBottom:"1px solid #f1f5f9"}}>
                  âœ“ {lessonMap[id]?.title || id}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Latest announcement */}
          {anns.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{...S_HANDBO.card,cursor:"pointer",background:"#fff7ed",border:"1px solid #fed7aa"}}
              onClick={()=>setTab("announcements")}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:13,color:"#c2410c",marginBottom:4}}>ðŸ“£ Latest Announcement</div>
              <div style={{fontWeight:700,fontSize:14,marginBottom:4}}>{anns[0].title}</div>
              <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:12,lineHeight:1.5}}>{anns[0].body?.slice(0,100)}{anns[0].body?.length>100?"â€¦":""}</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Subject cards */}
      <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:16,marginBottom:12}}>ðŸ“š Start a Subject</div>
      <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(200px,1fr))",gap:12,marginBottom:20}}>
        {subjectProgress.map(s=>(
          <div key={s.id} style={{...S_HANDBO.card,borderTop:"4px solid " + (s.color),cursor:"pointer",padding:16,transition:"all 0.2s"}}
            onClick={()=>{setSelSub(s.id);const fl=LEVELS.find(l=>(LESSONS[s.id]?.[l]??[]).length>0)||"Beginner";setSelLevel(fl);setSelLesson(null);setTab("learn");}}
            onMouseEnter={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.transform="translateY(-2px)";e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow="0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)";}}
            onMouseLeave={e=>{e.currentTarget.style.transform="";e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow="";}}>
            <div style={{fontSize:28}}>{s.icon}</div>
            <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:14,marginTop:8}}>{s.name}</div>
            <div style={{color:"#6b7280",fontSize:12,marginTop:3}}>{s.dc}/{s.total} lessons</div>
            <div style={{background:"#e2e8f0",borderRadius:20,height:4,marginTop:8,overflow:"hidden"}}>
              <div style={{background:s.color,width:(s.pct) + "%",height:"100%",borderRadius:20}}/>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
