function resolveStats(robot, modeId) {
  const gs = robot.gameStats[modeId]; const b = robot.baseStats;
  return { spd:b.spd*gs.sM, push:b.push*gs.pM, cargo:b.cargo+(gs.cB||0), mech:gs.mech||b.mech,
    rot:b.rot, driveType:robot.driveType, col:robot.col, hi:robot.hi, id:robot.id, name:robot.name, num:robot.num, stars:gs.stars };
}

function pickEnemies(modeId) {
  const sorted = [...ALL_ROBOTS].sort((a,b)=>(b.gameStats[modeId]?.stars||0)-(a.gameStats[modeId]?.stars||0));
  const pool = [...sorted.slice(0,7)]; const out = [];
  while (out.length < 3 && pool.length) { const i = Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length); out.push(pool.splice(i,1)[0]); }
  return out;
}

// Pick 2 ally robots that complement the player's game, different from player and each other
function pickAllies(playerRobotId, modeId) {
  // Game-specific curated ally pairs â€” thematically appropriate for each season
  const ALLY_POOLS = {
    rapidReact:    ["swerve254","wcd1114","swerve971","butterfly2910","climber4414"],
    crescendo:     ["mecanum118","swerve254","swerve971","butterfly2910","climber4414"],
    chargedUp:     ["arm3005","mecanum118","catapult3310","climber4414","butterfly2910"],
    infiniteRecharge:["swerve254","wcd1114","swerve971","butterfly2910","climber4414"],
    steamworks:    ["gear217","tank2481","climber4414","butterfly2910","wcd1114"],
    powerUp:       ["arm3005","mecanum118","catapult3310","tank2481","butterfly2910"],
  };
  const pool = (ALLY_POOLS[modeId] || ALL_ROBOTS.map(r=>r.id))
    .filter(id => id !== playerRobotId)
    .map(id => ALL_ROBOTS.find(r => r.id === id))
    .filter(Boolean);
  // Sort by stars for this mode, pick top with some randomness
  const sorted = [...pool].sort((a,b) => (b.gameStats[modeId]?.stars||0) - (a.gameStats[modeId]?.stars||0));
  const top = sorted.slice(0, Math.min(4, sorted.length));
  const i1 = Math.floor(Math.random() * top.length);
  const ally1 = top.splice(i1, 1)[0];
  const i2 = Math.floor(Math.random() * top.length);
  const ally2 = top[i2] || sorted[sorted.length-1];
  return [ally1, ally2];
}

function mkAnalytics() {
  return {
    shotsAttempted:0, shotsScored:0, shotsHighValue:0, shotsLowValue:0, shotsMissed:0,
    cycleCount:0, cycleTimes:[], lastPickupT:-1, lastScoreT:-1,
    tNearZone:0, tEnemyHalf:0, tOwnHalf:0, tMidfield:0, tIdle:0,
    pickupsSucceeded:0, ballsDropped:0,
    pushesDealt:0, pushesReceived:0, knockbacks:0,
    climbAttempted:false, climbSucceeded:false, climbStartT:-1, climbPts:0,
    maxCombo:0, comboScores:0,
    breakdownCount:0, breakdownTotalTime:0, bdStartT:-1,
    scoreEvents:[], moveSamples:[],
    heatmap: new Array(24*14).fill(0),
    autoScored:0, autoPts:0, tDefended:0,
    _lastBDActive:false,
  };
}

function sampleAnalytics(an, player, s, dt) {
  const t = s.mode.time - s.timer;
  if (player.x > s.fw*0.62) an.tNearZone += dt;
  else if (player.x > s.fw*0.5) an.tEnemyHalf += dt;
  else if (player.x > s.fw*0.35) an.tMidfield += dt;
  else an.tOwnHalf += dt;
  const spd = Math.hypot(player.vx, player.vy);
  if (spd < 18) an.tIdle += dt;
  if (an.moveSamples.length < MAX_MOVE_SAMPLES) an.moveSamples.push({t, spd});
  const hx = Math.floor(player.x/s.fw*24), hy = Math.floor(player.y/s.fh*14);
  if (hx>=0&&hx<24&&hy>=0&&hy<14) an.heatmap[hy*24+hx]++;
  if (player.breakdown && !an._lastBDActive) { an.bdStartT = t; an.breakdownCount++; }
  if (!player.breakdown && an._lastBDActive && an.bdStartT>=0) { an.breakdownTotalTime += t - an.bdStartT; an.bdStartT=-1; }
  an._lastBDActive = !!player.breakdown;
  if (s.red.some(r => dst(player,r) < 55)) an.tDefended += dt;
}

const hitWall = (walls,x,y,r) => walls.some(w=>w.solid&&x+r>w.x&&x-r<w.x+w.w&&y+r>w.y&&y-r<w.y+w.h);

const resolveWall = (walls,rob) => {
  for (const w of walls) {
    if (!w.solid) continue;
    const cx=clamp(rob.x,w.x,w.x+w.w), cy=clamp(rob.y,w.y,w.y+w.h);
    const dx=rob.x-cx, dy=rob.y-cy, d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if (d<RS_RS1&&d>0.001) {
      const nx=dx/d, ny=dy/d;
      rob.x+=nx*(RS_RS1-d); rob.y+=ny*(RS_RS1-d);
      const dot=rob.vx*nx+rob.vy*ny;
      if (dot<0) { rob.vx-=dot*nx*(1+WALL_BOUNCE); rob.vy-=dot*ny*(1+WALL_BOUNCE); }
    }
  }
};

const wallBound = (r, fw, fh) => {
  if(r.x<RS_RS1){r.x=RS_RS1;r.vx=Math.abs(r.vx)*WALL_BOUNCE;}
  if(r.x>fw-RS_RS1){r.x=fw-RS_RS1;r.vx=-Math.abs(r.vx)*WALL_BOUNCE;}
  if(r.y<RS_RS1){r.y=RS_RS1;r.vy=Math.abs(r.vy)*WALL_BOUNCE;}
  if(r.y>fh-RS_RS1){r.y=fh-RS_RS1;r.vy=-Math.abs(r.vy)*WALL_BOUNCE;}
};

let _rid = 0;
function mkBot(type, x, y, angle, alliance, isPlayer=false) {
  return { rid:_rid++, type, alliance, isPlayer, x, y, angle,
    vx:0, vy:0, va:0, spin:0, driftVx:0, driftVy:0, staggerTimer:0,
    hp:100, cargo:0, hoodAngle:alliance==="blue"?0:Math.PI,
    intakeOn:false, climbProgress:0, climbLatched:false, climbDeployed:false,
    iframes:0, shootCd:0, pickCd:0, breakdown:null, breakdownCd:rnd(14,22),
    aiState:"collect", aiTimer:rnd(0.2,0.8), stuckTimer:0, lastX:x, lastY:y,
    flashTimer:0, combo:0, comboTimer:0, _fWas:false, _bdWas:false,
  };
}

function mkState(playerRobot, modeKey, enemyRobots, fw, fh) {
  _rid = 0;
  const mode = MODES[modeKey];
  const walls = mode.walls(fw,fh);
  const climbZone = mode.climbZone(fw,fh);
  const zones = mode.zones(fw,fh);
  const pType = resolveStats(playerRobot, modeKey);
  const [allyRaw1, allyRaw2] = pickAllies(playerRobot.id, modeKey);
  const ally1 = resolveStats(allyRaw1, modeKey);
  const ally2 = resolveStats(allyRaw2, modeKey);
  const blue = [
    mkBot(pType, 90, fh/2-75, 0, "blue", true),
    mkBot(ally1, 90, fh/2, 0, "blue"),
    mkBot(ally2, 90, fh/2+75, 0, "blue"),
  ];
  const red = enemyRobots.map((er,i) => mkBot(resolveStats(er,modeKey), fw-90, fh/2+(i-1)*75, Math.PI, "red"));
  const balls=[]; let tries=0;
  while (balls.length<mode.ballCount && tries<8000) {
    tries++;
    const x=rnd(220,fw-220), y=rnd(110,fh-110);
    if (!hitWall(walls,x,y,BR+8) && balls.every(b=>dst({x,y},b)>30) && !blue.some(r=>dst({x,y},r)<55) && !red.some(r=>dst({x,y},r)<55))
      balls.push({id:balls.length, x, y, vx:0, vy:0, spin:0, held:null, scored:false, respawn:0, isAuto:balls.length<mode.autoBalls, pickDelay:0});
  }
  return {
    fw, fh, mode, walls, zones, climbZone, timer:mode.time,
    isAuto:mode.autoTime>0, blueScore:0, redScore:0,
    blue, red, balls, projs:[], parts:[], texts:[], notices:[],
    ampCharge:0, ampActive:false, ampTimer:0,
    done:false, winner:null, autoNoticed:false,
    analytics:mkAnalytics(),
    stats:{ pShots:0, pScored:0, pPushes:0, breakdowns:0, pCombo:0 },
  };
}

const ftext = (s,x,y,t,c="#fde68a") => { if(s.texts.length<MAX_TEXTS) s.texts.push({x,y,t,col:c,life:1.8,vy:-38}); };
const burst = (s,x,y,c,n=10) => { const room=Math.max(0,MAX_PARTS-s.parts.length); for(let i=0;i<Math.min(n,room);i++){const a=rnd(0,Math.PI*2),sp=rnd(70,190);s.parts.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,life:rnd(0.4,0.9),col:c,r:rnd(2,5)});} };
const sparks = (s,x,y,vx,vy,c) => { if(s.parts.length>=MAX_PARTS)return; const n=Math.min(6,MAX_PARTS-s.parts.length); for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=Math.atan2(vy,vx)+rnd(-0.6,0.6),sp=rnd(120,280);s.parts.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,life:rnd(0.2,0.5),col:c,r:rnd(1,3),isSpark:true});} };
const ring  = (s,x,y,c) => { if(s.parts.length<MAX_PARTS) s.parts.push({x,y,vx:0,vy:0,life:0.6,col:c,r:4,ring:true,rr:0}); };
const notice= (s,t,c="#fde68a") => { s.notices.unshift({t,col:c,life:3}); if(s.notices.length>5)s.notices.pop(); };

function driveRobot(robot, fwd, turn, sx, sy, dt) {
  const brk = robot.breakdown;
  if (brk && brk.effect==="immobile") { robot.vx=lerp(robot.vx,0,18*dt); robot.vy=lerp(robot.vy,0,18*dt); robot.va=lerp(robot.va,0,16*dt); robot.spin=(robot.spin||0)*SPIN_DECAY; return; }
  if (brk && brk.effect==="spin") { robot.va=lerp(robot.va,robot.type.rot*3.5,6*dt); robot.vx=lerp(robot.vx,Math.cos(robot.angle)*fwd*robot.type.spd*0.4,8*dt); robot.vy=lerp(robot.vy,Math.sin(robot.angle)*fwd*robot.type.spd*0.4,8*dt); return; }
  const spdMult = (brk&&brk.effect==="slow") ? 0.35 : (brk&&brk.effect==="pneumo_leak") ? 0.5 : 1;
  const spd = robot.type.spd * spdMult;
  const dm = DRIVE_MODELS[robot.type.driveType] || DRIVE_MODELS.arcade;
  if (brk&&brk.effect==="drift") { robot.driftVx=lerp(robot.driftVx||0,rnd(-spd*0.6,spd*0.6),2*dt); robot.driftVy=lerp(robot.driftVy||0,rnd(-spd*0.6,spd*0.6),2*dt); }
  else { robot.driftVx=lerp(robot.driftVx||0,0,6*dt); robot.driftVy=lerp(robot.driftVy||0,0,6*dt); }
  switch(robot.type.driveType){
    case"swerve":case"mecanum":
      robot.vx=lerp(robot.vx,sx*spd+(robot.driftVx||0),dm.accel*dt);
      robot.vy=lerp(robot.vy,sy*spd+(robot.driftVy||0),dm.accel*dt);
      break;
    case"hdrive":
      robot.vx=lerp(robot.vx,Math.cos(robot.angle)*fwd*spd+Math.cos(robot.angle+Math.PI/2)*sx*spd*0.7+(robot.driftVx||0),dm.accel*dt);
      robot.vy=lerp(robot.vy,Math.sin(robot.angle)*fwd*spd+Math.sin(robot.angle+Math.PI/2)*sx*spd*0.7+(robot.driftVy||0),dm.accel*dt);
      break;
    default:
      robot.vx=lerp(robot.vx,Math.cos(robot.angle)*fwd*spd+(robot.driftVx||0),dm.accel*dt);
      robot.vy=lerp(robot.vy,Math.sin(robot.angle)*fwd*spd+(robot.driftVy||0),dm.accel*dt);
      break;
  }
  robot.va=lerp(robot.va,turn*robot.type.rot*(brk&&brk.effect==="slow"?0.5:1),dm.accel*dt);
  robot.spin=(robot.spin||0)*SPIN_DECAY;
  robot.angle+=robot.va*dt;
  if(!fwd&&!sx&&!sy){robot.vx*=FLOOR_FRICTION;robot.vy*=FLOOR_FRICTION;}
}

// KEY HELPER â€” normalises keys stored as e.key (case-sensitive) 
function K(keys, k) {
  return keys.has(k) || keys.has(k.toUpperCase()) || keys.has(k.toLowerCase());
}

function doPlayer(s, keys, dt) {
  const p = s.blue[0]; const rc = p.type;
  p.shootCd=Math.max(0,p.shootCd-dt); p.pickCd=Math.max(0,p.pickCd-dt);
  p.comboTimer=Math.max(0,p.comboTimer-dt); if(p.comboTimer<=0) p.combo=0;
  if(p.staggerTimer>0) p.staggerTimer=Math.max(0,p.staggerTimer-dt);
  let fwd=0,turn=0,sx=0,sy=0;
  const ctrlMult=p.staggerTimer>0?(1-p.staggerTimer/PUSH_STAGGER_DUR*0.65):1;

  switch(rc.driveType){
    case"tank":{
      const L=(+K(keys,"w")-+K(keys,"s"))*ctrlMult;
      const R=(+K(keys,"ArrowUp")-+K(keys,"ArrowDown"))*ctrlMult;
      fwd=(L+R)/2; turn=(L-R)/2;
      break;
    }
    case"swerve":case"mecanum":
      sx=(+K(keys,"d")-+K(keys,"a"))*ctrlMult;
      sy=(+K(keys,"s")-+K(keys,"w"))*ctrlMult;
      turn=(+K(keys,"e")-+K(keys,"q"))*ctrlMult;
      break;
    case"hdrive":
      fwd=(+K(keys,"w")-+K(keys,"s"))*ctrlMult;
      turn=(+K(keys,"d")-+K(keys,"a"))*ctrlMult;
      sx=(+K(keys,"e")-+K(keys,"q"))*0.65*ctrlMult;
      break;
    default:
      fwd=(+K(keys,"w")-+K(keys,"s"))*ctrlMult;
      turn=(+K(keys,"d")-+K(keys,"a"))*ctrlMult;
      break;
  }

  driveRobot(p,fwd,turn,sx,sy,dt);
  p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt;
  const brk=p.breakdown;
  const mechOk=!brk||(brk.effect!=="immobile"&&brk.effect!=="nomech");
  if(mechOk){
    if(K(keys,"j")) p.hoodAngle-=2.8*dt;
    if(K(keys,"l")) p.hoodAngle+=2.8*dt;
    if(K(keys,"f")&&p.pickCd<=0&&!p._fWas){p.intakeOn=!p.intakeOn;p.pickCd=0.2;}
    p._fWas=K(keys,"f");
    if(p.cargo<rc.cargo){
      const near=s.balls.filter(b=>!b.held&&!b.scored&&!(b.pickDelay>0)&&dst(p,b)<RS_RS1+BR+(p.intakeOn?28:8));
      if(near.length>0){
        const closest=near.sort((a,b2)=>dst(p,a)-dst(p,b2))[0];
        closest.held="p0"; p.cargo++;
        s.analytics.pickupsSucceeded++;
        if(s.analytics.lastPickupT<0) s.analytics.lastPickupT=s.mode.time-s.timer;
        else{const gap=(s.mode.time-s.timer)-s.analytics.lastScoreT;if(gap>0&&gap<25){s.analytics.cycleTimes.push(gap);s.analytics.cycleCount++;}s.analytics.lastPickupT=s.mode.time-s.timer;}
        ftext(s,p.x,p.y-32,"INTAKE","#93c5fd");
      }
    }
    if(K(keys," ")&&p.shootCd<=0&&p.cargo>0){
      const t=s.mode.time-s.timer;
      const nearZone=s.zones.blue.find(z=>dst(p,z)<z.r+RS_RS1+18);
      if(nearZone){
        p.combo++;p.comboTimer=2.5;
        if(p.combo>s.stats.pCombo)s.stats.pCombo=p.combo;
        if(p.combo>s.analytics.maxCombo)s.analytics.maxCombo=p.combo;
        let pts=nearZone.pts;
        if(s.mode.ampMechanic&&s.ampActive&&nearZone.label==="SPEAKER") pts=nearZone.ampedPts||nearZone.pts;
        if(nearZone.label==="AMP"){s.ampCharge=Math.min(2,s.ampCharge+1);if(s.ampCharge>=2&&!s.ampActive){s.ampActive=true;s.ampTimer=s.mode.ampDuration||10;notice(s,"SPEAKER AMPED! 5pt per note!","#fbbf24");ring(s,p.x,p.y,"#fbbf24");}}
        const mult=p.combo>=3?2:p.combo>=2?1.5:1;
        const earned=Math.round(pts*mult);
        if(s.isAuto){s.blueScore+=earned*2;s.analytics.autoPts+=earned*2;s.analytics.autoScored++;}
        else s.blueScore+=earned;
        s.stats.pScored++;
        if(nearZone.pts>=3)s.analytics.shotsHighValue++;else s.analytics.shotsLowValue++;
        s.analytics.shotsScored++;
        s.analytics.lastScoreT=t;
        s.analytics.scoreEvents.push({t,pts:s.isAuto?earned*2:earned,zone:nearZone.label,combo:p.combo,auto:s.isAuto});
        if(p.combo>=4){ftext(s,p.x,p.y-54,"ðŸ”¥Ã—" + (p.combo) + " COMBO! +" + (earned),"#fbbf24");burst(s,p.x,p.y,rc.hi,24);ring(s,p.x,p.y,rc.hi);}
        else if(p.combo>=2){ftext(s,p.x,p.y-44,"Ã—" + (p.combo) + " COMBO +" + (earned),"#fde68a");burst(s,p.x,p.y,rc.hi,14);}
        else{ftext(s,p.x,p.y-36,s.isAuto?"AUTO +" + (earned*2) + "!":"+" + (earned),s.isAuto?"#fbbf24":"#fde68a");burst(s,p.x,p.y,rc.hi,10);}
        if(s.isAuto&&!s.autoNoticed){s.autoNoticed=true;notice(s,"AUTO PERIOD â€” EVERY PIECE SCORES 2Ã—!","#fbbf24");}
        const b=s.balls.find(b2=>b2.held==="p0");
        if(b){b.held=null;b.scored=true;b.respawn=rnd(3,6.5);}
        p.cargo--;p.shootCd=0.28;
      } else if(rc.mech==="shooter"||rc.mech==="catapult"){
        const sa=p.angle+p.hoodAngle;
        s.projs.push({x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:Math.cos(sa)*480+p.vx*0.15,vy:Math.sin(sa)*480+p.vy*0.15,owner:"blue",life:2.2,fromPlayer:true});
        const b=s.balls.find(b2=>b2.held==="p0");
        if(b){b.held=null;b.scored=true;b.respawn=rnd(4,8);}
        p.cargo--;p.shootCd=0.4;s.stats.pShots++;s.analytics.shotsAttempted++;
        burst(s,p.x,p.y,rc.hi,8);
        p.vx-=Math.cos(sa)*18; p.vy-=Math.sin(sa)*18;
      } else { ftext(s,p.x,p.y-34,"MOVE TO SCORING ZONE","#6b7280"); p.shootCd=0.55; }
    }
    if(K(keys,"r")&&p.cargo>0){
      const b=s.balls.find(b2=>b2.held==="p0");
      if(b){b.held=null;b.x=p.x+Math.cos(p.angle)*(RS_RS1+20);b.y=p.y+Math.sin(p.angle)*(RS_RS1+20);b.vx=Math.cos(p.angle)*120+p.vx*0.4;b.vy=Math.sin(p.angle)*120+p.vy*0.4;b.spin=(p.spin||0)*2;b.pickDelay=1.8;p.cargo--;s.analytics.ballsDropped++;}
    }
    if(K(keys,"c")){
      p.climbDeployed=true;
      if(!s.analytics.climbAttempted){s.analytics.climbAttempted=true;s.analytics.climbStartT=s.mode.time-s.timer;}
      const cz=s.climbZone;
      const inZ=p.x>cz.x&&p.x<cz.x+cz.w&&p.y>cz.y&&p.y<cz.y+cz.h;
      if(inZ) p.climbProgress=Math.min(1,p.climbProgress+0.26*dt);
      else ftext(s,p.x,p.y-30,"GET TO CLIMB ZONE","#6b7280");
    }
    if(K(keys,"v")) p.climbProgress=Math.max(0,p.climbProgress-0.26*dt);
    if(p.climbProgress>=1&&!p.climbLatched){
      p.climbLatched=true;
      const cp=s.mode.scoring.climbTraversal||s.mode.scoring.climb||s.mode.scoring.climbHigh||6;
      s.blueScore+=cp; s.analytics.climbSucceeded=true; s.analytics.climbPts=cp;
      ftext(s,p.x,p.y-55,"CLIMBED! +" + (cp),"#22c55e");
      burst(s,p.x,p.y,"#22c55e",32);ring(s,p.x,p.y,"#22c55e");
      notice(s,"CLIMB SUCCESSFUL! +" + (cp) + "pts","#22c55e");
    }
  }
  sampleAnalytics(s.analytics,p,s,dt);
  if(s.ampActive){s.ampTimer-=dt;if(s.ampTimer<=0){s.ampActive=false;s.ampCharge=0;notice(s,"Amp window closed","#6b7280");}}
}

// AI difficulty tuning: reduced speed, accuracy, and scoring frequency
const AI_SPEED_MULT = 0.62;       // how fast AI moves (was 0.88)
const AI_SHOOT_CD_MIN = 1.4;      // minimum shoot cooldown in seconds (higher = slower)
const AI_SHOOT_CD_MAX = 2.8;      // max shoot cooldown
const AI_PICKUP_CD = 0.8;         // how long after pickup before scoring
const AI_SCORE_CHANCE = 0.72;     // chance they actually score when in range (miss some)
const AI_SHOOT_SPREAD = 0.35;     // aim spread (higher = less accurate)
const AI_CLIMB_TIME = 55;         // start climbing later (was 38)

function doAI(s, robot, dt) {
  const isBlue=robot.alliance==="blue";
  const myZones=isBlue?s.zones.blue:s.zones.red;
  robot.shootCd=Math.max(0,robot.shootCd-dt);robot.pickCd=Math.max(0,robot.pickCd-dt);robot.aiTimer=Math.max(0,robot.aiTimer-dt);
  if(robot.staggerTimer>0) robot.staggerTimer=Math.max(0,robot.staggerTimer-dt);
  const brk=robot.breakdown;
  if(brk&&brk.effect==="immobile"){robot.vx=lerp(robot.vx,0,14*dt);robot.vy=lerp(robot.vy,0,14*dt);return;}
  robot.stuckTimer+=dt;
  if(robot.stuckTimer>2.5){if(dst({x:robot.lastX,y:robot.lastY},robot)<14){robot.aiState="unstuck";robot.aiTimer=rnd(0.8,1.8);}robot.stuckTimer=0;robot.lastX=robot.x;robot.lastY=robot.y;}
  if(robot.aiState==="unstuck"){aiMove(robot,s.fw/2+rnd(-160,160),s.fh/2+rnd(-160,160),robot.type.spd*0.5,dt);if(robot.aiTimer<=0)robot.aiState="collect";return;}

  // Endgame climb â€” starts later
  const climbTime = isBlue ? AI_CLIMB_TIME : AI_CLIMB_TIME - 10;
  if(s.timer<climbTime&&!robot.climbLatched){
    robot.aiState="climb";
    const cz=s.climbZone;
    aiMove(robot,cz.x+cz.w/2,cz.y+cz.h/2,robot.type.spd*AI_SPEED_MULT,dt);
    const inZ=robot.x>cz.x&&robot.x<cz.x+cz.w&&robot.y>cz.y&&robot.y<cz.y+cz.h;
    if(inZ)robot.climbProgress=Math.min(1,robot.climbProgress+(isBlue?0.18:0.08)*dt);
    if(robot.climbProgress>=1&&!robot.climbLatched){
      robot.climbLatched=true;
      const cp=s.mode.scoring.climbTraversal||s.mode.scoring.climb||6;
      if(isBlue)s.blueScore+=cp;else s.redScore+=cp;
      burst(s,robot.x,robot.y,"#22c55e",16);
    }
    return;
  }

  if(robot.cargo===0||(robot.cargo<robot.type.cargo&&robot.aiState==="collect")){
    robot.aiState="collect";
    const avail=s.balls.filter(b=>!b.held&&!b.scored);
    if(!avail.length){robot.aiState="score";return;}
    const sorted=avail.sort((a,b)=>dst(robot,a)-dst(robot,b));
    // Red AI picks a random ball from top 3 (less optimal pathing)
    const target=isBlue?sorted[0]:sorted[Math.min(sorted.length-1,Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.min(4,sorted.length)))];
    // Red AI moves slower and occasionally pauses
    const moveSpd = isBlue ? 0.78 : (Math.random()<0.08 ? 0.15 : AI_SPEED_MULT);
    aiMove(robot,target.x,target.y,moveSpd*robot.type.spd,dt);
    if(dst(robot,target)<RS_RS1+BR+14&&robot.pickCd<=0){
      target.held="r" + (robot.rid);robot.cargo++;
      robot.pickCd=isBlue?rnd(0.3,0.5):rnd(AI_PICKUP_CD,AI_PICKUP_CD*1.8);
      if(robot.cargo>=robot.type.cargo)robot.aiState="score";
    }
    return;
  }

  if(robot.aiState==="score"&&robot.cargo>0){
    const best=myZones.slice().sort((a,b)=>b.pts-a.pts)[0];
    if(!best){robot.aiState="collect";return;}
    const chosen=best;
    // Red AI is slower when approaching scoring zone
    const scoreSpd=isBlue?(0.78*robot.type.spd):(AI_SPEED_MULT*robot.type.spd*(0.7+Math.random()*0.3));
    const canShoot=robot.type.mech==="shooter"||robot.type.mech==="catapult";
    const shootDist=canShoot?chosen.r+RS_RS1+130:0;

    if(canShoot&&dst(robot,chosen)<shootDist&&robot.shootCd<=0&&s.projs.length<20){
      // Red AI misses shots sometimes
      const willScore = isBlue ? true : (Math.random() < AI_SCORE_CHANCE);
      const sa=ang(robot,chosen);robot.angle=sa;
      // Red gets more spread/inaccuracy
      const spread=isBlue?rnd(-0.05,0.05):rnd(-AI_SHOOT_SPREAD, AI_SHOOT_SPREAD);
      s.projs.push({x:robot.x,y:robot.y,vx:Math.cos(sa+spread)*460,vy:Math.sin(sa+spread)*460,owner:isBlue?"blue":"red",life:2.0,fromPlayer:false});
      const held=s.balls.find(b=>b.held==="r" + (robot.rid));
      if(held){held.held=null;held.scored=true;held.respawn=rnd(3,6);}
      robot.cargo=Math.max(0,robot.cargo-1);
      robot.shootCd=isBlue?rnd(0.7,1.2):rnd(AI_SHOOT_CD_MIN,AI_SHOOT_CD_MAX);
      if(robot.cargo===0)robot.aiState="collect";
      return;
    }

    aiMove(robot,chosen.x,chosen.y,scoreSpd,dt);

    if(!canShoot&&dst(robot,chosen)<chosen.r+RS_RS1+4&&robot.shootCd<=0){
      // Red AI scores less reliably up close
      const willScore = isBlue ? true : (Math.random() < AI_SCORE_CHANCE);
      if(willScore){
        const pts=isBlue?chosen.pts:(Math.random()<0.2?Math.max(1,chosen.pts-1):chosen.pts);
        if(isBlue){s.blueScore+=pts;burst(s,robot.x,robot.y,"#60a5fa",8);ftext(s,robot.x,robot.y-24,"+" + (pts),"#93c5fd");}
        else{s.redScore+=pts;burst(s,robot.x,robot.y,"#f87171",7);}
      }
      const held=s.balls.find(b=>b.held==="r" + (robot.rid));
      if(held){held.held=null;held.scored=true;held.respawn=rnd(3.5,7);}
      robot.cargo=Math.max(0,robot.cargo-1);
      robot.shootCd=isBlue?rnd(0.5,0.9):rnd(AI_SHOOT_CD_MIN,AI_SHOOT_CD_MAX);
      if(robot.cargo===0)robot.aiState="collect";
    }

    // Red robots occasionally idle or wander instead of ramming player
    if(!isBlue&&robot.aiTimer<=0){
      if(Math.random()<0.3&&dst(robot,s.blue[0])<180){
        // sometimes chase but not very aggressively
        aiMove(robot,s.blue[0].x+rnd(-40,40),s.blue[0].y+rnd(-40,40),robot.type.spd*0.45,dt);
      }
      robot.aiTimer=rnd(1.5,3.5);
    }
    return;
  }
  if(robot.cargo===0)robot.aiState="collect";
}

function aiMove(robot,tx,ty,spd,dt){
  const d=dst(robot,{x:tx,y:ty});if(d<8){robot.vx=lerp(robot.vx,0,16*dt);robot.vy=lerp(robot.vy,0,16*dt);return;}
  const a=ang(robot,{x:tx,y:ty});robot.angle=a;
  const sm=robot.staggerTimer>0?0.45:1;
  robot.vx=lerp(robot.vx,Math.cos(a)*spd*sm,9*dt);robot.vy=lerp(robot.vy,Math.sin(a)*spd*sm,9*dt);
}

function doProjs(s,dt){
  const keep=[];
  for(const pr of s.projs){
    pr.x+=pr.vx*dt;pr.y+=pr.vy*dt;pr.life-=dt;
    if(pr.life<=0||pr.x<0||pr.x>s.fw||pr.y<0||pr.y>s.fh){if(pr.fromPlayer&&pr.life<=0)s.analytics.shotsMissed++;continue;}
    if(hitWall(s.walls,pr.x,pr.y,5)){burst(s,pr.x,pr.y,"#374151",4);sparks(s,pr.x,pr.y,pr.vx,pr.vy,"#6b7280");if(pr.fromPlayer)s.analytics.shotsMissed++;continue;}
    const mz=pr.owner==="blue"?s.zones.blue:pr.owner==="red"?s.zones.red:[];
    let hit=false;
    for(const z of mz){
      if(dst(pr,z)<z.r+7){
        if(pr.owner==="blue"&&pr.fromPlayer){
          const p=s.blue[0];p.combo++;p.comboTimer=2.5;
          const mult=p.combo>=3?2:p.combo>=2?1.5:1;const earned=Math.round(z.pts*mult);
          if(s.isAuto){s.blueScore+=earned*2;s.analytics.autoPts+=earned*2;}else s.blueScore+=earned;
          s.stats.pScored++;if(z.pts>=3)s.analytics.shotsHighValue++;else s.analytics.shotsLowValue++;
          s.analytics.shotsScored++;
          s.analytics.scoreEvents.push({t:s.mode.time-s.timer,pts:s.isAuto?earned*2:earned,zone:z.label,combo:p.combo});
          if(p.combo>s.stats.pCombo)s.stats.pCombo=p.combo;if(p.combo>s.analytics.maxCombo)s.analytics.maxCombo=p.combo;
          burst(s,pr.x,pr.y,"#fde68a",14);ftext(s,pr.x,pr.y-22,"+" + (s.isAuto?earned*2:earned) + (mult>1?" Ã—"+p.combo:""),mult>1?"#fbbf24":"#fde68a");ring(s,pr.x,pr.y,"#fde68a");
        } else if(pr.owner==="red"){s.redScore+=z.pts;burst(s,pr.x,pr.y,"#fca5a5",8);}
          else if(pr.owner==="blue"){s.blueScore+=z.pts;burst(s,pr.x,pr.y,"#93c5fd",8);}
        hit=true;break;
      }
    }
    if(!hit){
      const targets=pr.owner==="blue"?s.red:s.blue;
      for(const r of targets){
        if(dst(pr,r)<RS_RS1+10){
          r.hp=Math.max(0,r.hp-12);
          r.flashTimer=0.4;r.staggerTimer=0.28;r.iframes=0.6;
          burst(s,pr.x,pr.y,r.type.col||"#fff",8);
          sparks(s,pr.x,pr.y,pr.vx,pr.vy,"#fbbf24");
          if(r.isPlayer&&pr.owner==="red") s.analytics.pushesReceived++;
          if(!r.isPlayer&&pr.fromPlayer) s.analytics.pushesDealt++;
          hit=true;break;
        }
      }
    }
    if(!hit)keep.push(pr);
  }
  s.projs=keep;
}

function doBalls(s,dt){
  const all=[...s.blue,...s.red];
  for(const b of s.balls){
    if(b.held==="p0"){b.x=s.blue[0].x;b.y=s.blue[0].y;continue;}
    const holder=all.find(r=>b.held==="r" + (r.rid));
    if(holder){b.x=holder.x;b.y=holder.y;continue;}
    if(!b.scored){
      if(b.pickDelay>0) b.pickDelay=Math.max(0,b.pickDelay-dt);
      b.x+=b.vx*dt;b.y+=b.vy*dt;b.vx*=BALL_FRICTION;b.vy*=BALL_FRICTION;b.spin=(b.spin||0)*SPIN_DECAY;
      if(b.x<BR){b.x=BR;b.vx=Math.abs(b.vx)*0.4;}if(b.x>s.fw-BR){b.x=s.fw-BR;b.vx=-Math.abs(b.vx)*0.4;}
      if(b.y<BR){b.y=BR;b.vy=Math.abs(b.vy)*0.4;}if(b.y>s.fh-BR){b.y=s.fh-BR;b.vy=-Math.abs(b.vy)*0.4;}
      for(const o of s.balls){
        if(o===b||o.scored||o.held)continue;
        const d=dst(b,o);if(d<BR*2&&d>0.01){
          const nx=(b.x-o.x)/d,ny=(b.y-o.y)/d,ov=BR*2-d;
          b.x+=nx*ov*0.4;b.y+=ny*ov*0.4;o.x-=nx*ov*0.4;o.y-=ny*ov*0.4;
          const dot=(b.vx-o.vx)*nx+(b.vy-o.vy)*ny;
          if(dot>0){b.vx-=dot*nx*0.65;b.vy-=dot*ny*0.65;o.vx+=dot*nx*0.65;o.vy+=dot*ny*0.65;
            const ds=(b.spin||0)-(o.spin||0);b.spin=(b.spin||0)-ds*0.35;o.spin=(o.spin||0)+ds*0.35;}
        }
      }
      for(const r of all){
        const d=dst(b,r);if(d<RS_RS1+BR&&d>0.01){
          const nx=(b.x-r.x)/d,ny=(b.y-r.y)/d,ov=RS_RS1+BR-d;
          b.x+=nx*ov*0.9;b.y+=ny*ov*0.9;
          const dot=(b.vx-r.vx)*nx+(b.vy-r.vy)*ny;
          if(dot<0){const imp=-dot*BALL_ROBOT_RESTITUTION;b.vx+=nx*imp;b.vy+=ny*imp;}
        }
      }
    }
    if(b.scored){
      b.respawn-=dt;
      if(b.respawn<=0){
        let nx,ny,t=0;
        do{nx=rnd(220,s.fw-220);ny=rnd(110,s.fh-110);t++;}
        while(t<200&&(hitWall(s.walls,nx,ny,BR+10)||s.balls.some(o=>o!==b&&!o.scored&&dst({x:nx,y:ny},o)<30)));
        b.x=nx;b.y=ny;b.vx=0;b.vy=0;b.spin=0;b.scored=false;b.held=null;b.pickDelay=0;
        burst(s,nx,ny,s.mode.theme.ball,6);
      }
    }
  }
}

function doCollisions(s){
  const all=[...s.blue,...s.red];
  for(let i=0;i<all.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<all.length;j++){
    const a=all[i],b=all[j];const d=dst(a,b),min=RS_RS1*2+3;if(d>=min||d<0.01)continue;
    const dx=(b.x-a.x)/d,dy=(b.y-a.y)/d,ov=min-d;
    a.x-=dx*ov*0.5;a.y-=dy*ov*0.5;b.x+=dx*ov*0.5;b.y+=dy*ov*0.5;
    const rx=a.vx-b.vx,ry=a.vy-b.vy,dot=rx*dx+ry*dy;if(dot<=0)continue;
    const ma=a.type.push||1,mb=b.type.push||1,tot=ma+mb,imp=dot*1.25;
    a.vx-=(imp*mb/tot)*dx;a.vy-=(imp*mb/tot)*dy;b.vx+=(imp*ma/tot)*dx;b.vy+=(imp*ma/tot)*dy;
    const capA=a.type.spd*1.6,capB=b.type.spd*1.6;
    const sA=Math.hypot(a.vx,a.vy);if(sA>capA){a.vx=a.vx/sA*capA;a.vy=a.vy/sA*capA;}
    const sB=Math.hypot(b.vx,b.vy);if(sB>capB){b.vx=b.vx/sB*capB;b.vy=b.vy/sB*capB;}
    const rv=Math.hypot(a.vx-b.vx,a.vy-b.vy);
    const isEnemy=a.alliance!==b.alliance;
    if(rv>IMPACT_SPARK_VEL) sparks(s,(a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2,(b.vx-a.vx),(b.vy-a.vy),isEnemy?"#fbbf24":"#6b7280");
    if(rv>100&&isEnemy){
      const dmg=clamp(rv*0.009,0,3.5);
      if(a.iframes<=0){a.hp=Math.max(0,a.hp-dmg);a.iframes=1.0;a.flashTimer=0.3;if(rv>180)a.staggerTimer=PUSH_STAGGER_DUR;if(a.isPlayer){s.analytics.pushesReceived++;s.analytics.knockbacks++;}}
      if(b.iframes<=0){b.hp=Math.max(0,b.hp-dmg);b.iframes=1.0;b.flashTimer=0.3;if(rv>180)b.staggerTimer=PUSH_STAGGER_DUR;if(b.isPlayer){s.analytics.pushesReceived++;s.analytics.knockbacks++;}}
      if(a.isPlayer&&!b.isPlayer)s.analytics.pushesDealt++;
      if(b.isPlayer&&!a.isPlayer)s.analytics.pushesDealt++;
    }
    const tang=(a.vx-b.vx)*(-dy)+(a.vy-b.vy)*dx;
    a.spin=clamp((a.spin||0)-tang*0.002,-MAX_SPIN_RATE,MAX_SPIN_RATE);
    b.spin=clamp((b.spin||0)+tang*0.002,-MAX_SPIN_RATE,MAX_SPIN_RATE);
  }
}

function doBreakdowns(s,dt){
  const all=[...s.blue,...s.red];
  for(const r of all){
    r.breakdownCd=Math.max(0,r.breakdownCd-dt);r.iframes=Math.max(0,r.iframes-dt);r.flashTimer=Math.max(0,r.flashTimer-dt);
    if(r.breakdown){r.breakdown.timer-=dt;if(r.breakdown.timer<=0){r.breakdown=null;r.breakdownCd=rnd(15,28);}}
    else if(r.breakdownCd<=0){const bd=rollBreakdown();if(bd){r.breakdown=bd;r.breakdownCd=rnd(15,30);ftext(s,r.x,r.y-38,bd.label,bd.col);burst(s,r.x,r.y,bd.col,14);s.stats.breakdowns++;}}
  }
}

function tick(s,keys,dt){
  if(s.done)return;
  s.timer=Math.max(0,s.timer-dt);
  if(s.isAuto&&s.timer<s.mode.time-s.mode.autoTime){s.isAuto=false;notice(s,"TELEOP PERIOD","#60a5fa");}
  if(s.notices)s.notices.forEach(n=>n.life-=dt);s.notices=s.notices?.filter(n=>n.life>0)||[];
  doPlayer(s,keys,dt);
  doAI(s,s.blue[1],dt);doAI(s,s.blue[2],dt);
  doAI(s,s.red[0],dt);doAI(s,s.red[1],dt);doAI(s,s.red[2],dt);
  [...s.blue.slice(1),...s.red].forEach(r=>{r.x+=r.vx*dt;r.y+=r.vy*dt;r.angle+=r.va*dt;r.spin=(r.spin||0)*SPIN_DECAY;});
  doProjs(s,dt);doBalls(s,dt);doCollisions(s);doBreakdowns(s,dt);
  [...s.blue,...s.red].forEach(r=>{resolveWall(s.walls,r);wallBound(r,s.fw,s.fh);});
  s.parts=s.parts.filter(p=>{
    p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;
    p.vx*=p.isSpark?0.78:0.82;p.vy*=p.isSpark?0.78:0.82;
    if(p.isSpark)p.vy+=60*dt;
    p.life-=dt;if(p.ring)p.rr+=260*dt;
    return p.life>0;
  });
  if(s.parts.length>MAX_PARTS) s.parts=s.parts.slice(-MAX_PARTS);
  s.texts=s.texts.filter(t=>{t.y+=t.vy*dt;t.life-=dt;return t.life>0;});
  if(s.texts.length>MAX_TEXTS) s.texts=s.texts.slice(-MAX_TEXTS);
  if(s.timer<=0){s.done=true;s.winner=s.blueScore>s.redScore?"blue":s.blueScore<s.redScore?"red":"tie";}
}

function drawHUD(ctx, s) {
  const fw=s.fw, fh=s.fh, T=s.mode.theme, ac=T.accent;
  const p=s.blue[0];
  ctx.fillStyle=T.bg+"f2";
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,fw,82);
  ctx.strokeStyle=ac+"28";ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,82);ctx.lineTo(fw,82);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle="#3b82f6";ctx.font="bold 9px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="left";ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  ctx.fillText("ðŸ”µ BLUE",14,20);
  ctx.fillStyle="#93c5fd";ctx.font="bold 36px " + (MF);
  ctx.fillText(String(s.blueScore),14,56);

  if(p.combo>=2){ctx.fillStyle="#fbbf24";ctx.font="bold 10px " + (MF);ctx.fillText("ðŸ”¥Ã—" + (p.combo),bx,42);bx+=52;}
  if(s.isAuto){
    ctx.strokeStyle="#fbbf2466";ctx.fillStyle="#fbbf2418";ctx.lineWidth=1;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(bx,26,66,15);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle="#fbbf24";ctx.font="bold 8px " + (MF);ctx.fillText("AUTO Ã—2",bx+5,38);bx+=72;
  }
  if(s.ampActive){ctx.fillStyle="#a78bfa";ctx.font="bold 9px " + (MF);ctx.fillText("AMP " + (Math.ceil(s.ampTimer)) + "s",bx,38);}
  s.blue.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const rx=14+i*116;
    ctx.fillStyle=r.isPlayer?"#fbbf24":"#60a5fa";ctx.font="bold 7px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="left";

    ctx.fillStyle="#0a0f1a";ctx.fillRect(rx,70,50,4);
    ctx.fillStyle=r.hp>50?"#22c55e":r.hp>25?"#f59e0b":"#ef4444";
    ctx.fillRect(rx,70,Math.max(0,r.hp/100*50),4);
    if(r.breakdown){ctx.fillStyle=r.breakdown.col;ctx.font="7px " + (MF);ctx.fillText("âš¡",rx+52,74);}
    if(r.climbLatched){ctx.fillStyle="#22c55e";ctx.font="8px " + (MF);ctx.fillText("ðŸª",rx+62,74);}
    if(r.cargo>0){ctx.fillStyle="#fde68a";ctx.font="7px " + (MF);ctx.fillText("â—"+r.cargo,rx+72,74);}
  });
  const mins=Math.floor(s.timer/60);
  const secs=String(Math.floor(s.timer%60)).padStart(2,"0");
  const tenths=String(Math.floor((s.timer%1)*10));
  const tcol=s.timer<40?"#ef4444":s.isAuto?"#fbbf24":ac;

  ctx.fillStyle=tcol;ctx.font="bold 42px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";
  ctx.fillText((mins) + ":" + (secs),fw/2,54);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.fillStyle=tcol+"66";ctx.font="15px " + (MF);

  if(s.timer<40){
    ctx.fillStyle="#22c55e";ctx.font="bold 9px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";

  } else if(s.isAuto){
    ctx.fillStyle="#fbbf24";ctx.font="bold 9px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText("AUTO Ã—2 SCORING",fw/2,70);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle="#ef4444";ctx.font="bold 9px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="right";
  ctx.fillText("RED ðŸ”´",fw-14,20);
  ctx.fillStyle="#fca5a5";ctx.font="bold 36px " + (MF);
  ctx.fillText(String(s.redScore),fw-14,56);
  s.red.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const rx=fw-14-50-i*116;
    ctx.fillStyle="#f87171";ctx.font="bold 7px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="right";
    ctx.fillText(r.type.name.split(" ")[0].slice(0,7),rx+50,68);
    ctx.fillStyle="#0a0f1a";ctx.fillRect(rx,70,50,4);
    ctx.fillStyle="#ef4444";ctx.fillRect(rx,70,Math.max(0,r.hp/100*50),4);
    if(r.breakdown){ctx.fillStyle=r.breakdown.col;ctx.font="7px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="right";ctx.fillText("âš¡",rx-4,74);}
    if(r.climbLatched){ctx.fillStyle="#22c55e";ctx.font="8px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="right";ctx.fillText("ðŸª",rx-14,74);}
  });
  ctx.textAlign="center";

    ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(fw/2-tw/2-10,ny-13,tw+20,16);ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle=n.col+"44";ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,n.life*0.65);

  const hints=[
    {lbl:"ðŸŽ® DRIVE",txt:driveHint,col:p.type?.hi||ac},
    {lbl:"ðŸ¦¾ OPS",txt:"F=Intake  SPACE=Shoot  J/L=Aim  C=Climb  R=Eject",col:p.type?.hi||ac},
    {lbl:"ðŸ’¡ ESC=Pause",txt:"Physics: spin Â· recoil Â· stagger Â· sparks",col:"#22c55e"},
  ];
  hints.forEach((h,i)=>{
    const hx=14+i*(fw/3);
    ctx.textAlign="left";
    ctx.fillStyle=h.col;ctx.font="bold 8px " + (MF);ctx.fillText(h.lbl,hx,fh-7);
    ctx.fillStyle=ac+"55";ctx.font="8px " + (MF);
    ctx.fillText("  "+h.txt,hx+ctx.measureText(h.lbl).width+2,fh-7);
  });
  const mw=158,mh=88,mx=fw-mw-8,my=fh-mh-30;
  const scx=mw/fw,scy=mh/fh;
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(2,6,23,0.78)";ctx.fillRect(mx,my,mw,mh);
  ctx.strokeStyle="#0d1929";ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.strokeRect(mx,my,mw,mh);
  ctx.fillStyle=T.t1;ctx.fillRect(mx,my,mw/2,mh);
  ctx.fillStyle=T.t2;ctx.fillRect(mx+mw/2,my,mw/2,mh);
  s.walls.forEach(w=>{if(w.solid){ctx.fillStyle=ac+"22";ctx.fillRect(mx+w.x*scx,my+w.y*scy,Math.max(2,w.w*scx),Math.max(2,w.h*scy));}});
  s.balls.forEach(b=>{if(!b.scored){ctx.fillStyle=T.ball||"#f59e0b";ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(mx+b.x*scx,my+b.y*scy,2.2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}});
  [...s.red,...s.blue].forEach(r=>{
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    ctx.fillStyle=r.alliance==="blue"?(r.isPlayer?"#fde68a":"#3b82f6"):"#ef4444";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(mx+r.x*scx,my+r.y*scy,r.isPlayer?4:2.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.fillStyle="#1e3a5f";ctx.font="bold 6px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="left";ctx.fillText("MAP",mx+3,my+8);
  ctx.textAlign="left";ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
}

function draw(canvas, s) {
  if(!canvas||!s)return;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
  const fw=s.fw, fh=s.fh, T=s.mode.theme, ac=T.accent;
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";ctx.textAlign="left";
  ctx.fillStyle=T.bg;ctx.fillRect(0,0,fw,fh);
  ctx.strokeStyle=T.grid;ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<=fw;x+=56){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,fh);ctx.stroke();}
  for(let y=0;y<=fh;y+=56){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(fw,y);ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.fillStyle=T.t1;ctx.fillRect(0,0,fw/2,fh);
  ctx.fillStyle=T.t2;ctx.fillRect(fw/2,0,fw/2,fh);
  ctx.setLineDash([18,12]);ctx.strokeStyle=ac+"22";ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(fw/2,0);ctx.lineTo(fw/2,fh);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.shadowColor=ac;ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.strokeStyle=T.border;ctx.lineWidth=7;ctx.strokeRect(3,3,fw-6,fh-6);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.strokeStyle=ac+"38";ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(13,13,fw-26,fh-26);
  [[15,15],[fw-15,15],[15,fh-15],[fw-15,fh-15]].forEach(([cx,cy])=>{
    const sx2=cx<fw/2?1:-1,sy2=cy<fh/2?1:-1;
    ctx.strokeStyle=ac+"88";ctx.lineWidth=2;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,cy+sy2*22);ctx.lineTo(cx,cy);ctx.lineTo(cx+sx2*22,cy);ctx.stroke();
  });
  if(s.isAuto){ctx.fillStyle="rgba(251,191,36,0.05)";ctx.fillRect(0,0,fw,fh);}
  s.walls.forEach(w=>{
    if(!w.solid)return;
    ctx.fillStyle=ac+"2a";ctx.fillRect(w.x,w.y,w.w,w.h);
    ctx.strokeStyle=ac+"80";ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(w.x,w.y,w.w,w.h);
    if(w.label){ctx.fillStyle=ac+"cc";ctx.font="bold 11px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";ctx.fillText(w.label,w.x+w.w/2,w.y+w.h/2);ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";}
  });
  const cz=s.climbZone,eg=s.timer<40;
  const pulse=0.5+0.5*Math.sin(Date.now()/220);
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  ctx.fillStyle=eg?"rgba(34,197,94," + (0.09+pulse*0.1) + ")":ac+"10";ctx.fillRect(cz.x,cz.y,cz.w,cz.h);
  ctx.strokeStyle=eg?"#22c55e":ac+"55";ctx.lineWidth=eg?2.5:1.5;ctx.strokeRect(cz.x,cz.y,cz.w,cz.h);
  ctx.fillStyle=eg?"#4ade80":ac+"80";ctx.font="bold 10px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  ctx.fillText("CLIMB",cz.x+cz.w/2,cz.y+cz.h/2-6);
  if(cz.rungs){cz.rungs.forEach((rg,i)=>{ctx.fillStyle=eg?"#22c55e":ac+"44";ctx.font="7px " + (MF);ctx.fillText((rg.label) + "+" + (rg.pts),cz.x+cz.w/2,cz.y+cz.h/2+6+i*11);});}
  ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  const drawZones=(zones,amped)=>{zones.forEach((z,i)=>{
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(z.x,z.y,z.r,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=z.col+(i===0?"22":"14");ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle=amped&&z.label==="SPEAKER"?"#fbbf24":z.col;ctx.lineWidth=2+(i===0?1.5:0);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle=(amped&&z.label==="SPEAKER")?"#fbbf24":z.col+"ee";
    ctx.font="bold " + (i===0?12:10) + "px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
    ctx.fillText(z.label,z.x,z.y-z.r-7);
    ctx.fillText(amped&&z.label==="SPEAKER"?"+" + (z.ampedPts||z.pts):"+" + (z.pts),z.x,z.y+6);
    if(amped&&z.label==="SPEAKER"){ctx.fillStyle="#fbbf24";ctx.font="7px " + (MF);ctx.fillText("AMPED!",z.x,z.y+17);}
    ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";
  });};
  drawZones(s.zones.blue,s.ampActive&&s.mode.ampMechanic);
  drawZones(s.zones.red,false);
  const bc=T.ball||"#f59e0b";
  s.balls.forEach(b=>{
    if(b.scored)return;
    const delayed=b.pickDelay>0;
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(b.x,b.y);ctx.rotate((b.spin||0)*0.1);
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,BR,0,Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle=delayed?"#888":bc;ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle=delayed?"#666":bc+"aa";ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();
    if(Math.abs(b.spin||0)>0.5){ctx.strokeStyle=bc+"66";ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);ctx.lineTo(BR*0.7,0);ctx.stroke();}
    ctx.restore();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    if(b.isAuto&&s.isAuto){ctx.strokeStyle="#fbbf24";ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,BR+3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();}
  });
  s.projs.forEach(pr=>{
    const col=pr.owner==="blue"?(pr.fromPlayer?"#fde68a":"#93c5fd"):"#fca5a5";
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    ctx.save();ctx.translate(pr.x,pr.y);ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(pr.vy,pr.vx));
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,10,5,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.globalAlpha=0.2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pr.x-pr.vx*0.018,pr.y-pr.vy*0.018,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  });
  s.parts.forEach(pt=>{
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,pt.life*1.6);
    if(pt.ring){ctx.strokeStyle=pt.col;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.shadowColor=pt.col;ctx.shadowBlur=8;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pt.x,pt.y,pt.rr,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.shadowBlur=0;}
    else if(pt.isSpark){ctx.strokeStyle=pt.col;ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pt.x,pt.y);ctx.lineTo(pt.x-pt.vx*0.04,pt.y-pt.vy*0.04);ctx.stroke();}
    else{ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(pt.x,pt.y,pt.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=pt.col;ctx.fill();}
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  [...s.red,...s.blue].forEach(r=>drawBot(ctx,r));
  s.texts.forEach(t=>{
    ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,t.life*0.8);
    ctx.font="bold " + (t.t.length>14?10:t.t.length>8?12:14) + "px " + (MF);
    ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.fillStyle=t.col;ctx.fillText(t.t,t.x,t.y);
  });
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  if(s.isAuto){
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(251,191,36,0.88)";ctx.font="bold 11px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";
    ctx.fillText("âš¡ AUTO PERIOD â€” ALL PIECES SCORE 2Ã— âš¡",fw/2,fh-36);
  }
  drawHUD(ctx,s);
}

function drawBot(ctx,r){
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(r.x,r.y);ctx.rotate(r.angle);
  const h=RS_RS1,brk=r.breakdown,flash=r.flashTimer>0&&Math.floor(r.flashTimer*20)%2===0;
  const col=flash?"#fff":brk?"#374151":r.type.col;
  if(r.staggerTimer>0){ctx.rotate(Math.sin(r.staggerTimer*40)*r.staggerTimer*0.12);}
  ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)";ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(3,5,h,h-2,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  if(r.type.driveType==="tank"){ctx.fillStyle=col+"aa";ctx.fillRect(-h,-h,6,h*2);ctx.fillRect(h-6,-h,6,h*2);}
  if(r.type.driveType==="swerve"||r.type.driveType==="mecanum"){
    [[-1,-1],[1,-1],[-1,1],[1,1]].forEach(([dx,dy],wi)=>{
      ctx.save();ctx.translate(dx*(h-5),dy*(h-5));
      if(r.type.driveType==="swerve")ctx.rotate((r.spin||0)*0.15+wi*0.05);
      ctx.fillStyle=r.type.hi;ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.fillRect(-3,-5,6,10);ctx.restore();
    });
  }
  if(r.type.driveType==="hdrive"){ctx.fillStyle=r.type.hi+"80";ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.fillStyle=flash?"#fff":col;ctx.strokeStyle=r.type.hi;ctx.lineWidth=r.isPlayer?3:2.5;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-h+7,-h);ctx.lineTo(h-7,-h);ctx.lineTo(h,-h+7);ctx.lineTo(h,h-7);ctx.lineTo(h-7,h);ctx.lineTo(-h+7,h);ctx.lineTo(-h,h-7);ctx.lineTo(-h,-h+7);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.shadowBlur=0;
  if(r.isPlayer){ctx.strokeStyle="rgba(255,255,255,0.2)";ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,h+5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.fillStyle=r.type.hi;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(h+2,0);ctx.lineTo(h+14,-6);ctx.lineTo(h+14,6);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle=flash?r.type.col:"#ffffffcc";ctx.font="bold " + (r.isPlayer?9:8) + "px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";
  ctx.fillText(r.isPlayer?"â˜…YOU":("#"+r.type.num),0,0);
  switch(r.type.mech){
    case"shooter":ctx.save();ctx.rotate(r.hoodAngle);ctx.strokeStyle=r.type.hi;ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-2,0);ctx.lineTo(h+20,0);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle="#1e3a8a";ctx.strokeStyle=r.type.hi;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,7,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();break;
    case"catapult":ctx.save();ctx.rotate(-0.55+Math.sin(Date.now()/380)*0.1);ctx.strokeStyle="#fda4af";ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);ctx.lineTo(0,-h-20);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle="#fda4af";ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-h-20,5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();break;
    case"arm":ctx.save();ctx.rotate(-0.8+Math.sin(Date.now()/560)*0.14);ctx.strokeStyle=r.type.hi;ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);ctx.lineTo(0,-h-26);ctx.stroke();ctx.strokeStyle=r.type.hi+"77";ctx.lineWidth=7;ctx.lineCap="square";ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-10,-h-20);ctx.lineTo(10,-h-20);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();break;
    case"intake":ctx.strokeStyle=r.intakeOn?"#6ee7b7":"#374151";ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.lineCap="round";ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(h+2,-h+6);ctx.lineTo(h+2,h-6);ctx.stroke();break;
  }
  if(r.climbDeployed||r.climbProgress>0){
    const al=h+14+r.climbProgress*32;
    ctx.strokeStyle=r.climbLatched?"#22c55e":"#67e8f9";ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.lineCap="round";
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-h+3);ctx.lineTo(0,-al);ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle=r.climbLatched?"#22c55e":"#67e8f9";
    ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-al,r.climbLatched?6:4.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.shadowBlur=0;
    if(r.climbProgress>0&&r.climbProgress<1){ctx.strokeStyle="#67e8f9";ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-al,11,0,Math.PI*2*r.climbProgress);ctx.stroke();}
  }
  if(r.cargo>0){ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.fillStyle="#fde68a";ctx.strokeStyle="#78350f";ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(h-4,-h+4,8,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle="#000";ctx.font="bold 9px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";ctx.fillText(r.cargo,h-4,-h+4);}
  if(brk){ctx.fillStyle=brk.col;ctx.font="bold 8px " + (MF);ctx.textAlign="center";ctx.textBaseline="middle";ctx.shadowBlur=0;ctx.fillText(brk.label,0,-h-18);}
  ctx.fillStyle="#050c14";ctx.fillRect(-h,h+7,RS_RS1*2,7);
  const hpP=r.hp/100;ctx.fillStyle=hpP>0.5?"#22c55e":hpP>0.25?"#f59e0b":"#ef4444";ctx.fillRect(-h,h+7,RS_RS1*2*hpP,7);
  ctx.strokeStyle="#000a14";ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.strokeRect(-h,h+7,RS_RS1*2,7);
  ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.textBaseline="alphabetic";ctx.restore();
}

function buildReport(s,robot,modeKey){
  const a=s.analytics,mode=MODES[modeKey],T=mode.time;
  const totalScored=a.shotsScored;
  const shotAccuracy=(a.shotsAttempted+a.shotsScored)>0?Math.round(a.shotsScored/(a.shotsAttempted+a.shotsScored)*100):(totalScored>0?100:0);
  const highValPct=totalScored>0?Math.round(a.shotsHighValue/totalScored*100):0;
  const avgCycle=a.cycleTimes.length>0?a.cycleTimes.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/a.cycleTimes.length:null;
  const idlePct=Math.round(a.tIdle/T*100);
  let pts=0;
  if(s.blueScore>s.redScore)pts+=35;else if(s.blueScore===s.redScore)pts+=17;
  pts+=Math.min(28,totalScored*3.5);pts+=Math.min(10,highValPct/10);
  if(avgCycle)pts+=Math.min(10,Math.max(0,16-avgCycle));
  if(a.climbSucceeded)pts+=10;
  pts-=Math.min(18,idlePct*1.2);pts-=Math.min(8,a.breakdownCount*2.5);pts-=Math.min(5,a.ballsDropped);
  pts=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(pts)));
  const grade=pts>=95?"S":pts>=88?"A+":pts>=80?"A":pts>=72?"B+":pts>=63?"B":pts>=55?"C+":pts>=45?"C":pts>=35?"D+":"D";
  const gradeColor=grade.startsWith("S")?"#fbbf24":grade.startsWith("A")?"#22c55e":grade.startsWith("B")?"#60a5fa":grade.startsWith("C")?"#f59e0b":"#ef4444";
  const improvements=[],strengths=[];
  if(s.blueScore>s.redScore)strengths.push({icon:"ðŸ†",title:"Won the match",detail:"Blue Alliance won " + (s.blueScore) + "â€“" + (s.redScore) + "."});
  if(shotAccuracy>=80)strengths.push({icon:"ðŸŽ¯",title:(shotAccuracy) + "% Shot Accuracy",detail:"Excellent precision. Elite FRC drivers aim for 90%+."});
  if(avgCycle&&avgCycle<=7)strengths.push({icon:"âš¡",title:(avgCycle.toFixed(1)) + "s Cycles",detail:"Sub-7s cycles is elite-tier FRC driving."});
  if(a.maxCombo>=3)strengths.push({icon:"ðŸ”¥",title:(a.maxCombo) + "Ã— Combo",detail:"Chaining " + (a.maxCombo) + " quick scores shows excellent zone mastery."});
  if(a.climbSucceeded)strengths.push({icon:"ðŸª",title:"Clean Climb (+" + (a.climbPts) + "pts)",detail:"Secured the endgame climb. Free points every match."});
  if(highValPct>=65)strengths.push({icon:"â¬†ï¸",title:(highValPct) + "% High-Value Scoring",detail:(highValPct) + "% of pieces went into premium zones."});
  if(idlePct>18)improvements.push({icon:"â¸",title:(idlePct) + "% Idle Time",detail:(Math.round(a.tIdle)) + "s stationary. Every second still is a wasted cycle.",drill:"DRILL: Move continuously â€” never stop."});
  if(highValPct<40&&totalScored>3)improvements.push({icon:"ðŸŽ¯",title:"Only " + (highValPct) + "% High-Value",detail:(100-highValPct) + "% of scores went into lower-value targets.",drill:"DRILL: 5 consecutive runs targeting high zones only."});
  if(!a.climbSucceeded)improvements.push({icon:"ðŸ§—",title:"Missed Endgame Climb",detail:(mode.scoring.climbTraversal||mode.scoring.climb||6) + " free points left on the field.",drill:"DRILL: Start climbing at 40s. Latch with 20s spare."});
  if(a.knockbacks>4)improvements.push({icon:"ðŸ›¡ï¸",title:"Knocked Back " + (a.knockbacks) + " Times",detail:"Approach scoring zones from 45Â° angles â€” harder to defend.",drill:"DRILL: Approach zone from a 45Â° angle every time."});
  const strats=mode.tips.map((tip,i)=>{
    let done=false;
    if(i===0)done=a.tEnemyHalf>T*0.2;else if(i===1)done=highValPct>50;else if(i===2)done=a.climbSucceeded;
    else if(i===3)done=avgCycle&&avgCycle<10;else if(i===4)done=a.knockbacks<4;else done=a.comboScores>0;
    return{tip,done};
  });
  return{grade,gradeColor,score:pts,won:s.winner==="blue",tied:s.winner==="tie",blueScore:s.blueScore,redScore:s.redScore,
    improvements,strengths,strats,
    metrics:{shotAccuracy,highValPct,avgCycle,idlePct,totalScored,cycleCount:a.cycleCount,maxCombo:a.maxCombo,
      climbSucceeded:a.climbSucceeded,climbPts:a.climbPts,breakdownCount:a.breakdownCount,
      autoScored:a.autoScored,autoPts:a.autoPts,pushesDealt:a.pushesDealt,pushesReceived:a.pushesReceived,ballsDropped:a.ballsDropped},
    analytics:a,robot,mode,stars:robot.gameStats[modeKey]?.stars||1,robotNote:robot.gameStats[modeKey]?.note};
}

const F="'Courier New', monospace";
const TAB_BTN={padding:"5px 14px",borderRadius:6,cursor:"pointer",fontFamily:F,fontSize:9,letterSpacing:1,border:"1px solid",transition:"all 0.15s"};
const PILL={fontSize:7,color:"#334155",border:"1px solid #0f172a",padding:"2px 7px",borderRadius:4,letterSpacing:1};
const Stars=({n,max=5,size=12})=><span>{Array.from({length:max},(_,i)=><span key={i} style={{color:i<n?"#fbbf24":"#1e293b",fontSize:size}}>â˜…</span>)}</span>;
function StatBar({label,val,max,col,sub}){const pct=Math.min(100,val/max*100);return(<div style={{marginBottom:8}}><div style={{display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",fontSize:8,color:"#475569",marginBottom:3}}><span>{label}</span><span style={{color:col}}>{sub||val}</span></div><div style={{background:"#060e1a",borderRadius:3,height:5,border:"1px solid #0d1a2a"}}><div style={{height:"100%",borderRadius:3,background:col,width:pct+"%",transition:"width 0.5s"}}/></div></div>);}

function RobotSelect({onSelect}){
  const[hov,setHov]=useState(null);const[filter,setFilter]=useState(null);const[page,setPage]=useState(0);
  const PER=3,pages=Math.ceil(ALL_ROBOTS.length/PER);const modeList=Object.values(MODES);const vis=ALL_ROBOTS.slice(page*PER,page*PER+PER);
  return(<div style={{background:"#020617",minHeight:"100vh",fontFamily:F,color:"#fff",padding:"28px 20px",backgroundImage:"radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 50% 0%,rgba(59,130,246,0.1) 0%,transparent 70%)"}}>
    <div style={{maxWidth:1100,margin:"0 auto"}}>
      <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginBottom:30}}>
        <div style={{display:"inline-block",border:"1px solid #1e293b",borderRadius:20,padding:"4px 18px",fontSize:9,color:"#334155",letterSpacing:5,marginBottom:14}}>FIRST ROBOTICS COMPETITION Â· DRIVER TRAINING SYSTEM</div>
        <h1 style={{fontSize:52,fontWeight:900,margin:"0 0 8px",letterSpacing:-4,background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#60a5fa 0%,#a78bfa 50%,#f472b6 100%)",WebkitBackgroundClip:"text",WebkitTextFillColor:"transparent"}}>ALLIANCE 3v3 TRAINER</h1>
        <p style={{color:"#1e3a5f",fontSize:10,margin:"0 0 4px",letterSpacing:1}}>SELECT YOUR ROBOT Â· CHOOSE YOUR ERA Â· FACE GAME-MATCHED OPPONENTS</p>
      </div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:6,justifyContent:"center",marginBottom:22,flexWrap:"wrap"}}>
        <button onClick={()=>setFilter(null)} style={{...TAB_BTN,borderColor:!filter?"#64748b":"#1e293b",color:!filter?"#e2e8f0":"#334155",background:!filter?"#1e293b":"none"}}>ALL ROBOTS</button>
        {modeList.map(m=>(<button key={m.id} onClick={()=>setFilter(m.id)} style={{...TAB_BTN,borderColor:filter===m.id?m.theme.accent:"#1e293b",color:filter===m.id?m.theme.accent:"#334155",background:filter===m.id?m.theme.accent+"18":"none"}}>{m.icon} {m.abbr}</button>))}
      </div>
      <div style={{display:"flex",gap:16,justifyContent:"center",flexWrap:"wrap",marginBottom:22}}>
        {vis.map(r=>{const dm=filter||"rapidReact";const gs=r.gameStats[dm];return(
          <div key={r.id} onClick={()=>onSelect(r)} onMouseEnter={()=>setHov(r.id)} onMouseLeave={()=>setHov(null)}
            style={{width:340,padding:20,borderRadius:16,cursor:"pointer",background:hov===r.id?"#0a1828":"#060e1a",border:"2px solid " + (hov===r.id?r.col:"#0f172a"),transition:"all 0.18s",transform:hov===r.id?"translateY(-10px)":"none",boxShadow:hov===r.id?"0 22px 55px " + (r.col) + "44":"0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)"}}>
            <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"flex-start",gap:12,marginBottom:14}}>
              <div style={{width:50,height:50,borderRadius:10,background:r.col+"1a",border:"2px solid " + (r.col) + "44",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",flexShrink:0}}>
                <span style={{fontSize:14,fontWeight:900,color:r.hi,lineHeight:1}}>#{r.num}</span>
                <span style={{fontSize:6,color:r.col,marginTop:1}}>FRC</span>
              </div>
              <div style={{flex:1}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:16,fontWeight:800,color:r.hi,marginBottom:4}}>{r.name}</div>
                <div style={{display:"flex",gap:4,flexWrap:"wrap"}}><span style={PILL}>{r.driveType}</span><span style={PILL}>{r.baseStats.mech}</span><span style={PILL}>{r.weight}</span></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{fontSize:9,color:"#475569",lineHeight:1.75,marginBottom:12}}>{r.desc}</div>
            <div style={{background:"#040a12",borderRadius:10,padding:"10px 12px",marginBottom:14,border:"1px solid #0d1a2a"}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:7,color:"#0f1929",letterSpacing:3,marginBottom:8}}>GAME COMPATIBILITY</div>
              <div style={{display:"grid",gridTemplateColumns:"1fr 1fr",gap:3}}>
                {modeList.map(m=>{const stars=r.gameStats[m.id]?.stars||1;const isHl=filter===m.id;return(
                  <div key={m.id} style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:5,padding:"3px 7px",borderRadius:5,background:isHl?m.theme.accent+"1a":"transparent",border:isHl?"1px solid " + (m.theme.accent) + "33":"1px solid transparent"}}>
                    <span style={{fontSize:10}}>{m.icon}</span><span style={{fontSize:7,color:isHl?m.theme.accent:"#1e3a5f",flex:1,whiteSpace:"nowrap",overflow:"hidden"}}>{m.abbr}</span><Stars n={stars} size={10}/>
                  </div>);
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{marginBottom:14}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:7,color:"#0f1929",letterSpacing:3,marginBottom:7}}>IN <span style={{color:MODES[dm].theme.accent}}>{MODES[dm].abbr}</span> â€” {gs.note}</div>
              <StatBar label="DRIVE SPEED" val={Math.round(r.baseStats.spd*gs.sM)} max={260} col="#22c55e"/>
              <StatBar label="PUSH FORCE"  val={Math.round(r.baseStats.push*gs.pM*50)} max={140} col="#f59e0b"/>
              <StatBar label="CARGO CAP"   val={r.baseStats.cargo+(gs.cB||0)} max={3} col="#60a5fa"/>
            </div>

              <div style={{color:"#3b82f6",marginBottom:1}}>ðŸŽ® {r.dCtrl}</div>
              <div style={{color:"#8b5cf6"}}>ðŸ¦¾ {r.oCtrl}</div>
            </div>
          </div>);})}
      </div>

      <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:16,marginBottom:28}}>

        <div style={{flex:1}}><div style={{fontSize:9,color:"#334155",letterSpacing:2,marginBottom:2}}>ROBOT CONFIRMED</div><div style={{fontSize:18,fontWeight:800,color:robot.hi}}>{robot.name} <span style={{color:"#334155"}}>#{robot.num}</span></div></div>
      </div>
      <div style={{textAlign:"center",marginBottom:28}}><h1 style={{fontSize:38,fontWeight:900,margin:"0 0 8px",letterSpacing:-2}}>CHOOSE YOUR GAME SEASON</h1><p style={{color:"#334155",fontSize:10,margin:0}}>Each era has unique physics, game pieces, and a hand-picked enemy lineup</p></div>

            </div>

function Game({robot,modeKey,enemies,onEnd}){
  const canvasRef=useRef(null);
  const stateRef=useRef(null);
  const keysRef=useRef(new Set());
  const lastRef=useRef(null);
  const rafRef=useRef(null);
  const pausedRef=useRef(false);
  const [paused,setPaused]=useState(false);
  const mode=MODES[modeKey];

  useEffect(()=>{
    const fw=window.innerWidth,fh=window.innerHeight;
    stateRef.current=mkState(robot,modeKey,enemies,fw,fh);
    if(canvasRef.current){canvasRef.current.width=fw;canvasRef.current.height=fh;}
    // Focus canvas immediately so keyboard events fire
    if(canvasRef.current) canvasRef.current.focus();
  },[robot,modeKey,enemies]);

  useEffect(()=>{
    const dn=e=>{
      // Prevent default for game keys to stop page scrolling
      if(["w","a","s","d","W","A","S","D"," ","ArrowUp","ArrowDown","ArrowLeft","ArrowRight"].includes(e.key)){
        e.preventDefault();
      }
      if(e.key==="Escape"){
        pausedRef.current=!pausedRef.current;
        setPaused(p=>!p);
        return;
      }
      keysRef.current.add(e.key);
    };
    const up=e=>{keysRef.current.delete(e.key);};
    // Use capture=true and attach to window to catch all keypresses regardless of focus
    window.addEventListener("keydown",dn,{capture:true});
    window.addEventListener("keyup",up,{capture:true});
    return()=>{
      window.removeEventListener("keydown",dn,{capture:true});
      window.removeEventListener("keyup",up,{capture:true});
    };
  },[]);

  const loop=useCallback(ts=>{
    const s=stateRef.current;
    if(!s){rafRef.current=requestAnimationFrame(loop);return;}
    const dt=lastRef.current?Math.min((ts-lastRef.current)/1000,0.033):0.016;
    lastRef.current=ts;
    if(!pausedRef.current){
      tick(s,keysRef.current,dt);
      draw(canvasRef.current,s);
      if(s.done){onEnd(s);return;}
    }
    rafRef.current=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  },[onEnd]);

  useEffect(()=>{
    rafRef.current=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return()=>{if(rafRef.current)cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);};
  },[loop]);

  return(
    <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"#000",overflow:"hidden"}}>
      {/* tabIndex makes div focusable; onClick refocuses if user clicked away */}
      <canvas
        ref={canvasRef}
        tabIndex={0}
        onClick={()=>canvasRef.current?.focus()}
        style={{display:"block",width:"100%",height:"100%",outline:"none"}}
      />
      {paused&&(
        <div style={{position:"absolute",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.88)",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",pointerEvents:"none"}}>
          <div style={{fontSize:52,fontWeight:900,color:mode.theme.accent,letterSpacing:7,fontFamily:F}}>â¸ PAUSED</div>
          <div style={{fontSize:11,color:"#334155",marginTop:14,letterSpacing:2,fontFamily:F}}>PRESS ESC TO RESUME</div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function FRCGameTrainer() {
  const[screen,setScreen]=useState("robot");
  const[robot,setRobot]=useState(null);
  const[modeKey,setModeKey]=useState(null);
  const[enemies,setEnemies]=useState(null);
  const[result,setResult]=useState(null);
  if(screen==="robot") return (<RobotSelect onSelect={r=>{setRobot(r);setScreen("mode");}}/>);
  if(screen==="mode")  return (<ModeSelect robot={robot} onSelect={(mk,en)=>{setModeKey(mk);setEnemies(en);setScreen("game");}} onBack={()=>setScreen("robot")}/>);
  if(screen==="game")  return (<Game robot={robot} modeKey={modeKey} enemies={enemies} onEnd={s=>{setResult(s);setScreen("report");}}/>);
  if(screen==="report") return (<CoachingReport result={result} robot={robot} modeKey={modeKey} onReplay={()=>setScreen("game")} onMenu={()=>setScreen("robot")}/>);
  return null;
}

// â”€â”€â”€ ERROR BOUNDARY â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) { super(props); this.state = { error: null, info: null }; }
  componentDidCatch(error, info) { this.setState({ error, info }); }
  render() {
    if (this.state.error) {
      return (
        <div style={{padding:40,fontFamily:"monospace",background:"#fff",minHeight:"100vh"}}>
          <h1 style={{color:"#dc2626"}}>App crashed â€” error details:</h1>
          <pre style={{background:"#fef2f2",padding:20,borderRadius:8,overflow:"auto",fontSize:13,color:"#991b1b"}}>
            {this.state.error.toString()}
          </pre>
          <pre style={{background:"#f8fafc",padding:20,borderRadius:8,overflow:"auto",fontSize:12,color:"#374151",marginTop:16}}>
            {this.state.info?.componentStack}
          </pre>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

  const [selLesson, setSelLesson] = useState(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState({});
  const [quizMode, setQuizMode] = useState(false);
  const [lessonNote, setLessonNote] = useState("");
  const [showLessonNote, setShowLessonNote] = useState(false);
  const [bookmarks, setBookmarks] = useState([]);
  const [savingNote, setSavingNote] = useState(false);

  // Forum state
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState([]);
  const [viewPost, setViewPost] = useState(null);
  const [showNewPost, setShowNewPost] = useState(false);
  const [npTitle, setNpTitle] = useState("");
  const [npBody, setNpBody] = useState("");
  const [repText, setRepText] = useState("");

  // Announcements
  const [anns, setAnns] = useState([]);

  // Messages
  const [inbox, setInbox] = useState([]);
  const [replyText, setReplyText] = useState("");
  const [showInbox, setShowInbox] = useState(false);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [newAchievements, setNewAchievements] = useState([]);

  // Define early so useCallbacks below can reference it
  const totalLessons = Object.values(LESSONS).reduce((a,s)=>a+Object.values(s).reduce((b,l)=>b+l.length,0),0);

  useEffect(()=>{ loadShared(); },[]);
  useEffect(()=>{ if(user&&!user.isAdmin) loadUserData(); },[user]);
useEffect(()=>{
  const interval = setInterval(()=>{
    loadShared();
    if(user&&!user.isAdmin) loadUserData();
  }, 15000);
  return ()=>clearInterval(interval);
},[user]);

  async function loadShared() {
    setLoading(true);
    const p = await storeGet("fr-posts",true); if(p) setPosts(p);
    const a = await storeGet("fr-anns",true); if(a) setAnns(a);
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function loadUserData() {
    if (!user||user.isAdmin) return;
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users",true)||{};
    const u = users[user.username];
    if (u) {
      setDone(u.done||{});
      setInbox(u.messages||[]);
      if(u.placementResult) setPlacementResult(u.placementResult);
      if(u.bookmarks) setBookmarks(u.bookmarks);
    }
  }

  const savePosts = useCallback(async p=>{setPosts(p);await storeSet("fr-posts",p,true);},[]);
  const saveAnns = useCallback(async a=>{setAnns(a);await storeSet("fr-anns",a,true);},[]);

  // Time tracking: start timer when lesson opens, pause when leaving
  useEffect(()=>{
    if (selLesson && user && !user.isAdmin) {
      startLearningTimer();
      setShowLessonNote(false);
      // Load existing note for this lesson
      storeGet("hub-users",true).then(users=>{
        const note = users?.[user.username]?.notes?.[selLesson.id] || "";
        setLessonNote(note);
      });
      return () => {
        const t = stopLearningTimer();
        if (t > 0) addLearningTime(user.username, t);
      };
    }
  }, [selLesson?.id]);

  const markDone = useCallback(async id=>{
    if (!user) return;
    // Save elapsed learning time
    const elapsed = stopLearningTimer();
    if (elapsed > 0) addLearningTime(user.username, elapsed);
    // Update streak
    await updateStreak(user.username);
    setDone(prev=>{
      const c={...prev,[id]:true};
      storeGet("hub-users",true).then(async users=>{
        if(users&&users[user.username]){
          users[user.username].done=c;
          await storeSet("hub-users",users,true);
          // Check for new achievements
          const newAchs = await checkAndUnlockAchievements(user.username, totalLessons);
          if (newAchs.length > 0) {
            setNewAchievements(prev=>[...prev,...newAchs]);
          }
        }
      });
      return c;
    });
  },[user,totalLessons]);

  const saveQuizScore = useCallback(async(subjectId,level,score,total)=>{
    if(!user) return;
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users",true)||{};
    if(users[user.username]){
      if(!users[user.username].quizScores) users[user.username].quizScores={};
      const key=(subjectId) + "-" + (level);
      const prev = users[user.username].quizScores[key];
      if(!prev||score/total>prev.score/prev.total){
        users[user.username].quizScores[key]={score,total,ts:Date.now()};
        await storeSet("hub-users",users,true);
      }
    }
  },[user]);

  async function saveCurrentNote(lessonId) {
    if (!user || !lessonId) return;
    setSavingNote(true);
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users",true)||{};
    if(users[user.username]) {
      users[user.username].notes = {...(users[user.username].notes||{}), [lessonId]: lessonNote};
      await storeSet("hub-users",users,true);
      await checkAndUnlockAchievements(user.username, totalLessons);
    }
    setSavingNote(false);
    setShowLessonNote(false);
  }

  async function toggleBookmark(lessonId) {
    if (!user) return;
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users",true)||{};
    if(!users[user.username]) return;
    const prev = users[user.username].bookmarks || [];
    const updated = prev.includes(lessonId) ? prev.filter(id=>id!==lessonId) : [...prev,lessonId];
    users[user.username].bookmarks = updated;
    await storeSet("hub-users",users,true);
    setBookmarks(updated);
    const newAchs = await checkAndUnlockAchievements(user.username, totalLessons);
    if(newAchs.length>0) setNewAchievements(prev=>[...prev,...newAchs]);
  }

  async function savePlacementResult(result){
    if(!user) return;
    setPlacementResult(result);
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users",true)||{};
    if(users[user.username]){
      users[user.username].placementResult=result;
      await storeSet("hub-users",users,true);
    }
  }

  async function sendReply() {
    if(!replyText.trim()||!user) return;
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users",true)||{};
    if(users[user.username]){
      const msgs = users[user.username].messages||[];
      msgs.push({isAdmin:false,from:user.name,text:replyText.trim(),ts:Date.now()});
      users[user.username].messages=msgs;
      await storeSet("hub-users",users,true);
      setInbox(msgs);
      setReplyText("");
    }
  }

  async function markInboxRead() {
    const users = await storeGet("hub-users",true)||{};
    if(users[user.username]){
      const msgs=(users[user.username].messages||[]).map(m=>({...m,read:true}));
      users[user.username].messages=msgs;
      await storeSet("hub-users",users,true);
      setInbox(msgs);
    }
  }

  function handleLogin(u) { setUser(u); }
  function handleLogout() { setUser(null); setDone({}); setInbox([]); setTab("home"); setSelSub(null); setSelLesson(null); }

  if (!user) return <AuthScreen onLogin={handleLogin} />;

  if (user.isAdmin) return (
    <AdminPanel anns={anns} posts={posts} onSaveAnns={saveAnns} onSavePosts={savePosts} onLogout={handleLogout} />
  );

  const doneCount = Object.keys(done).length;
  const unreadCount = inbox.filter(m=>m.isAdmin&&!m.read).length;

  const activeGroup = NAV_GROUPS.find(g => g.tabs.some(t => t.id === tab));

  function goTab(id) {
    setTab(id);
    setNavGroup(null);
    setMobileMenuOpen(false);
    setQuizMode(false);
    setSelLesson(null);
    setViewPost(null);
  }

  return (

    <div style={{fontFamily:"'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif",height:"100vh",width:"100vw",overflow:"hidden",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",background:"#f1f5f9",color:"#1e293b",position:"fixed",inset:0}}>
      {/* â”€â”€ HEADER â”€â”€ */}
      <div style={{background:"#0f172a",color:"#fff",position:"sticky",top:0,zIndex:1000,boxShadow:"0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)"}}>

        {/* Top bar: brand + user controls */}
        <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:10,padding:"0 20px",height:52,borderBottom:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)"}}>

          <button onClick={()=>goTab("home")} style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:9,background:"none",border:"none",color:"#fff",cursor:"pointer",padding:"4px 0",flexShrink:0}}>
            <div style={{width:30,height:30,background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)",borderRadius:8,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:16,fontWeight:900,flexShrink:0}}>âš¡</div>
            <div style={{textAlign:"left"}}>
              <div style={{fontSize:14,fontWeight:900,letterSpacing:0.2,lineHeight:1}}>FIRST Hub</div>
              <div style={{fontSize:8,opacity:0.4,letterSpacing:1.5,textTransform:"uppercase"}}>FTC Â· FRC Platform</div>
            </div>
          </button>

          <div style={{flex:1}}/>

          {/* Progress bar pill */}
          <div style={{display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:8,background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.05)",borderRadius:20,padding:"5px 12px",border:"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)"}}>
            <span style={{fontSize:10,opacity:0.5,fontWeight:600,whiteSpace:"nowrap"}}>{doneCount}/{totalLessons}</span>
            <div style={{width:70,height:4,background:"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)",borderRadius:2,overflow:"hidden"}}>
              <div style={{width:(Math.min(100,Math.round(doneCount/totalLessons*100))) + "%",height:"100%",background:"linear-gradient(90deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)",borderRadius:2,transition:"width 0.5s"}}/>

          <FRCGameTrainer />
        )}

        {/* â”€â”€ TEAM MODULES â”€â”€ */}
        {tab==="roster"      && <RosterModule      user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="attendance"  && <AttendanceModule  user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="scouting"    && <ScoutingModule    user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="bom"         && <BOMModule         user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="fundraising" && <FundraisingModule user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="schedule"    && <ScheduleModule    user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="awards"      && <AwardsModule      user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="tasks"       && <TaskBoardModule   user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="safety2"     && <SafetyModule      user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="outreach2"   && <OutreachModule    user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="robotspec"   && <RobotSpecModule       user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="media2"      && <MediaModule           user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="notebook"    && <NotebookModule        user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="driveteam"   && <DriveTeamModule       user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="mentor"      && <MentorDashboardModule user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="alumni"      && <AlumniModule          user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="picklist"    && <PicklistModule        user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="travel"      && <TravelModule          user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="minutes"     && <MeetingMinutesModule  user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="polls"       && <PollsModule           user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="toolcheckout"&& <ToolCheckoutModule    user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
        {tab==="handbook"    && <HandbookModule        user={user} isAdmin={isAdmin} />}
      </div>

        {newAchievements.length > 0 && (
          <div style={{position:"fixed",bottom:24,right:24,zIndex:9999,display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10,alignItems:"flex-end"}}>
            {newAchievements.map((ach,i)=>(
              <div key={ach.id+i} style={{background:"linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a8a,#1d4ed8)",color:"#fff",
                borderRadius:14,padding:"14px 18px",boxShadow:"0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",
                display:"flex",alignItems:"center",gap:12,minWidth:260,
                animation:"slideIn 0.3s ease-out"}}>
                <div style={{fontSize:32}}>{ach.icon}</div>
                <div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:11,opacity:0.8,marginBottom:2}}>ðŸŽ‰ Achievement Unlocked!</div>
                  <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:15}}>{ach.name}</div>
                  <div style={{fontSize:12,opacity:0.8,marginTop:1}}>{ach.desc}</div>
                </div>
                <button onClick={()=>setNewAchievements(prev=>prev.filter((_,j)=>j!==i))}
                  style={{background:"none",border:"none",color:"rgba(255,255,255,0.6)",cursor:"pointer",fontSize:18,marginLeft:"auto",padding:0}}>âœ•</button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

      {/* INBOX MODAL */}
      {showInbox && (
        <div style={{position:"fixed",inset:0,background:"rgba(0,0,0,0.6)",display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",zIndex:999,backdropFilter:"blur(4px)"}}
          onClick={()=>setShowInbox(false)}>
          <div style={{background:"#fff",borderRadius:18,width:"100%",maxWidth:480,maxHeight:"80vh",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",boxShadow:"0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)",overflow:"hidden"}} onClick={e=>e.stopPropagation()}>
            <div style={{padding:"18px 22px",borderBottom:"1px solid #e2e8f0",display:"flex",justifyContent:"space-between",alignItems:"center"}}>
              <div style={{fontWeight:800,fontSize:18}}>ðŸ“¬ Messages from Admin</div>
              <button onClick={()=>setShowInbox(false)} style={{background:"none",border:"none",fontSize:18,cursor:"pointer",color:"#9ca3af"}}>âœ•</button>
            </div>
            <div style={{flex:1,overflowY:"auto",padding:"16px 22px",display:"flex",flexDirection:"column",gap:10}}>
              {inbox.length===0 && <div style={{textAlign:"center",color:"#9ca3af",padding:30}}>No messages yet.</div>}
              {inbox.map((m,i)=>(
                <div key={i} style={{display:"flex",flexDirection:m.isAdmin?"row":"row-reverse",gap:8,alignItems:"flex-end"}}>
                  <div style={{width:28,height:28,background:m.isAdmin?"#b91c1c":"#1d4ed8",borderRadius:7,display:"flex",alignItems:"center",justifyContent:"center",fontSize:12,fontWeight:700,color:"#fff",flexShrink:0}}>
                    {m.isAdmin?"A":user.name?.charAt(0)?.toUpperCase()}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{maxWidth:"75%"}}>
                    <div style={{background:m.isAdmin?"#fef2f2":"#eff6ff",color:"#1e293b",padding:"10px 14px",borderRadius:m.isAdmin?"12px 12px 12px 4px":"12px 12px 4px 12px",fontSize:14,lineHeight:1.5,border:"1px solid " + (m.isAdmin?"#fecaca":"#bfdbfe")}}>
                      {m.text}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{color:"#9ca3af",fontSize:11,marginTop:3,textAlign:m.isAdmin?"left":"right"}}>{fmt(m.ts)}</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div style={{padding:"14px 22px",borderTop:"1px solid #e2e8f0",display:"flex",gap:10}}>
              <input style={{...S_HANDBO.inp,margin:0,flex:1}} placeholder="Reply to adminâ€¦" value={replyText} onChange={e=>setReplyText(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e=>e.key==="Enter"&&sendReply()} />
              <button style={S_HANDBO.btn()} onClick={sendReply}>Send</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}
